const BASE58_ALPHABET = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';

function encodeBase58(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let value = BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex')}`);
  let encoded = '';
  while (value > 0n) {
    encoded = BASE58_ALPHABET[Number(value % 58n)] + encoded;
    value /= 58n;
  }
  for (const byte of bytes) {
    if (byte !== 0) break;
    encoded = `1${encoded}`;
  }
  return encoded || '1';
}

type Fixture = {
  chain: Chain;
  address: string;
  signature: string;
  tokenIn: string;
  tokenOut: string;
  targetToken: string;
};

function createFixtures(runId: string): Fixture[] {
  const evmAddress = () => `0x${randomBytes(20).toString('hex')}`;
  return [
    {
      chain: 'solana',
      address: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      signature: `${runId}-solana`,
      tokenIn: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      tokenOut: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      targetToken: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32))
    },
    {
      chain: 'polygon',
      address: evmAddress(),
      signature: `${runId}-polygon`,
      tokenIn: evmAddress(),
      tokenOut: evmAddress(),
      targetToken: evmAddress()
    },
    {
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      address: evmAddress(),
      signature: `${runId}-robinhood`,
      tokenIn: evmAddress(),
      tokenOut: evmAddress(),
      targetToken: evmAddress()
    }
  ];
}

export async function runG0D11Acceptance(): Promise<void> {
  const runId = `g0d11-${Date.now()}-${randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
  const fixtures = createFixtures(runId);
  const fixtureByWallet = new Map(
    fixtures.map((fixture) => [`${fixture.chain}:${fixture.address.toLowerCase()}`, fixture])
  );
  const executionCounts = new Map<Chain, number>();
  const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
  const queueName = `${QUEUES.walletBackfill}-acceptance-${runId}`;
  const queueConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const eventsConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const workerConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const queue = new Queue(queueName, { connection: queueConnection });
  const queueEvents = new QueueEvents(queueName, { connection: eventsConnection });
  let worker: Worker | null = null;
  const jobs: Job[] = [];
  let passSummary: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
  let primaryError: unknown;

  const backfillFixture = async (address: string, chain: Chain): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> => {
    const fixture = fixtureByWallet.get(`${chain}:${address.toLowerCase()}`);
    if (!fixture) throw new Error(`No ${chain} acceptance fixture for ${address}`);
    executionCounts.set(chain, (executionCounts.get(chain) ?? 0) + 1);

    await Promise.all([
      upsertToken(fixture.tokenIn, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0IN' }),
      upsertToken(fixture.tokenOut, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0OUT' }),
      upsertToken(fixture.targetToken, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0TARGET' })
    ]);
    const eventAt = new Date();
    const inserted = await insertParsedTransaction({
      chain,
      signature: fixture.signature,
      walletAddress: fixture.address,
      tokenIn: fixture.tokenIn,
      tokenOut: fixture.tokenOut,
      amountIn: '1000000',
      amountOut: '2000000',
      amountInUsd: 1,
      amountOutUsd: 2,
      direction: 'buy',
      targetToken: fixture.targetToken,
      programId: 'g0-d11-fixture',
      timestamp: eventAt,
      blockTime: Math.floor(eventAt.getTime() / 1000)
    });
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, chain).prefixed,
      eventAt,
      inserted ? 1 : 0
    );
    return {
      fetched: 1,
      inserted: inserted ? 1 : 0,
      skipped: inserted ? 0 : 1,
      failed: 0,
      lastEventAt: eventAt
    };
  };

  try {
    await queueEvents.waitUntilReady();
    const [existingWorkers, existingJobs] = await Promise.all([
      queue.getWorkers(),
      queue.getJobs(['active', 'waiting', 'delayed', 'prioritized', 'waiting-children'])
    ]);
    if (existingWorkers.length > 0 || existingJobs.length > 0) {
      const jobSummary = await Promise.all(existingJobs.map(async (job) => ({
        id: job.id,
        state: await job.getState()
      })));
      throw new Error(
        `Backfill queue is not isolated: ${JSON.stringify({
          workers: existingWorkers.map((workerInfo) => ({
            id: workerInfo.id,
            name: workerInfo.name
          })),
          jobs: jobSummary
        })}`
      );
    }

    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      await upsertWallet({
        address: fixture.address,
        chain: fixture.chain,
        source: 'discovered',
        discoveryMethod: 'g0-d11-acceptance'
      });
      const spec = createWalletBackfillJob(fixture.address, fixture.chain);
      const first = await queue.add(spec.name, spec.data, spec.options);
      const duplicate = await queue.add(spec.name, spec.data, spec.options);
      if (first.id !== spec.options.jobId || duplicate.id !== first.id) {
        throw new Error(`Queue did not deduplicate ${fixture.chain} job ${spec.options.jobId}`);
      }
      jobs.push(first);
    }

    const queuedIds = new Set(
      (await queue.getJobs(['waiting', 'prioritized'])).map((job) => job.id)
    );
    if (queuedIds.size !== jobs.length || jobs.some((job) => !queuedIds.has(job.id))) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${jobs.length} unique queued jobs before worker startup`);
    }

    const waits = jobs.map((job) => job.waitUntilFinished(queueEvents, 30_000));
    const processor = createWalletBackfillProcessor({
      backfillSolana: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'solana'),
      backfillPolygon: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'polygon'),
      backfillRobinhood: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'robinhood-chain'),
      recordBatch: async () => {},
      sourceForChain: (chain) => `g0-d11-acceptance-${chain}`
    });
    worker = new Worker(queueName, processor, {
      connection: workerConnection,
      concurrency: 1
    });
    await worker.waitUntilReady();
    const results = await Promise.all(waits);

    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      if (executionCounts.get(fixture.chain) !== 1) {
        throw new Error(`${fixture.chain} fixture executed ${executionCounts.get(fixture.chain) ?? 0} times`);
      }
    }
    if (results.some((result) => result.inserted !== 1 || result.failed !== 0)) {
      throw new Error(`Backfill results were not successful: ${JSON.stringify(results)}`);
    }

    const signatures = fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.signature);
    const transactions = await query<{
      chain: Chain;
      signature: string;
      wallet_address: string;
    }>(
      `SELECT chain, signature, wallet_address
         FROM transactions
        WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])
        ORDER BY chain`,
      [signatures]
    );
    if (transactions.length !== fixtures.length) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${fixtures.length} transaction rows, found ${transactions.length}`);
    }
    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      const expectedWallet = resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, fixture.chain).prefixed;
      const transaction = transactions.find((row) => row.signature === fixture.signature);
      if (transaction?.chain !== fixture.chain || transaction.wallet_address !== expectedWallet) {
        throw new Error(`Transaction identity mismatch for ${fixture.chain}`);
      }
    }

    passSummary = {
      runId,
      queueName,
      deduplicatedJobs: jobs.map((job) => job.id),
      transactions: transactions.map((row) => ({
        chain: row.chain,
        signature: row.signature,
        walletAddress: row.wallet_address
      }))
    };
  } catch (error) {
    primaryError = error;
  }

  const cleanupErrors: Error[] = [];
  const cleanupStep = async (label: string, action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await action();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(new Error(`G0-D11 cleanup failed: ${label}`, { cause: error }));
    }
  };

  await cleanupStep('close worker', async () => {
    await worker?.close();
  });
  await cleanupStep('obliterate isolated queue', async () => {
    await queue.obliterate({ force: true });
  });

  const signatures = fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.signature);
  const tokenMints = fixtures.flatMap((fixture) => [
    resolveChainValue(fixture.tokenIn, fixture.chain).prefixed,
    resolveChainValue(fixture.tokenOut, fixture.chain).prefixed,
    resolveChainValue(fixture.targetToken, fixture.chain).prefixed
  ]);
  const walletAddresses = fixtures.map((fixture) =>
    resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, fixture.chain).prefixed
  );
  await cleanupStep('delete transaction fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM transactions WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])', [signatures]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('delete token fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE mint = ANY($1::varchar[])', [tokenMints]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('delete wallet fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM wallets WHERE address = ANY($1::varchar[])', [walletAddresses]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('verify database fixture cleanup', async () => {
    const [counts] = await query<{
      transaction_count: string;
      token_count: string;
      wallet_count: string;
    }>(
      `SELECT
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])) AS transaction_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tokens WHERE mint = ANY($2::varchar[])) AS token_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallets WHERE address = ANY($3::varchar[])) AS wallet_count`,
      [signatures, tokenMints, walletAddresses]
    );
    if (
      !counts
      || Number(counts.transaction_count) !== 0
      || Number(counts.token_count) !== 0
      || Number(counts.wallet_count) !== 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Fixture rows remain after cleanup: ${JSON.stringify(counts)}`);
    }
  });
  await cleanupStep('close queue events', () => queueEvents.close());
  await cleanupStep('close queue', () => queue.close());
  await cleanupStep('close queue Redis connection', () => queueConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close event Redis connection', () => eventsConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close worker Redis connection', () => workerConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close PostgreSQL pool', () => closePool());

  const errors = [primaryError, ...cleanupErrors].filter((error) => error !== undefined);
  if (errors.length === 1) throw errors[0];
  if (errors.length > 1) {
    throw new AggregateError(errors, 'G0-D11 acceptance and cleanup encountered multiple failures');
  }

  console.log('[G0-D11] PASS', JSON.stringify(passSummary));
}

export async function ingestWallets(input: Array<{ address: string; chain?: WalletChain; source?: 'shiller' | 'manual' | 'discovered'; nickname?: string }>) {
  const parsed = input.map((wallet) => walletInputSchema.safeParse(wallet));
  const valid = parsed.filter((p): p is { success: true; data: { address: string; chain: WalletChain; source: 'shiller' | 'manual' | 'discovered'; nickname?: string } } => p.success).map((p) => p.data);

  for (const wallet of valid) {
    await upsertWallet(wallet);
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(wallet.address, wallet.chain);
    await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }

  return { accepted: valid.length, rejected: parsed.length - valid.length };
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Helius RPC helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

type HeliusSignature = { signature: string; slot: number; blockTime?: number };

const HELIUS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.HELIUS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS ?? 15000);
const HELIUS_MAX_RETRIES = Number(process.env.HELIUS_MAX_RETRIES ?? 5);

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function heliusRpc<T>(method: string, params: unknown[]): Promise<T> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) throw new Error('HELIUS_API_KEY is not set');

  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    // Without a timeout a single stalled request hangs the whole backfill batch
    // (Promise.all never settles). Abort slow requests so they fail fast.
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), HELIUS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS);
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: method, method, params }),
        signal: controller.signal
      });
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }

    // Back off and retry on rate limits (429) and transient 5xx â€” the Helius
    // free tier throttles aggressively during bulk backfills.
    if ((response.status === 429 || response.status >= 500) && attempt < HELIUS_MAX_RETRIES) {
      const retryAfter = Number(response.headers.get('retry-after')) * 1000;
      const backoff = Number.isFinite(retryAfter) && retryAfter > 0 ? retryAfter : 500 * 2 ** attempt;
      await sleep(backoff);
      continue;
    }

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Helius RPC failed: ${response.status}`);

    const json = (await response.json()) as { result?: T; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (json.error) throw new Error(`Helius RPC error (${method}): ${json.error.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
    return json.result as T;
  }
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Token metadata fetcher â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

async function fetchTokenMintInfo(mint: string): Promise<{ decimals: number; mintAuthorityDisabled: boolean; freezeAuthorityDisabled: boolean } | null> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) return null;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id: 'getMintInfo',
        method: 'getAccountInfo',
        params: [mint, { encoding: 'jsonParsed' }]
      })
    });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    const json = await response.json() as any;
    const info = json.result?.value?.data?.parsed?.info;
    if (!info) return null;
    return {
      decimals: info.decimals ?? 9,
      mintAuthorityDisabled: info.mintAuthority === null,
      freezeAuthorityDisabled: info.freezeAuthority === null
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function extractProgramId(tx: HeliusParsedTransaction): string | null {
  const instructions = tx.transaction?.message?.instructions ?? [];
  const ids = instructions
    .map((i) => i.programId)
    .filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string');

  return ids.find((id) => SWAP_PROGRAM_IDS.has(id)) ?? ids[0] ?? null;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ SOL Price Cache â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

async function getCachedSolPrice(): Promise<number | null> {
  const cached = await redis.get('sol:price');
  if (cached) {
    const p = parseFloat(cached);
    if (Number.isFinite(p)) return p;
  }

  // Negative cache: if the price lookup just failed (e.g. APIs unreachable), a
  // marker is set for a short window so we don't re-hit the network â€” and
  // re-log the failure â€” on every single transaction in a backfill batch.
  if (await redis.get('sol:price:fail')) return null;

  // Do NOT fabricate a fallback price â€” a wrong SOL price silently corrupts every
  // SOL-leg trade's USD value (and gets cached for 30s). Return null on failure
  // and only cache a real price.
  const price = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(SOL_MINT);
  if (price === null || !Number.isFinite(price)) {
    await redis.setex('sol:price:fail', 15, '1');
    return null;
  }
  await redis.setex('sol:price', 30, price.toString());
  return price;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ USD Enrichment â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

async function enrichTransactionUsd(
  tokenIn: string,
  tokenOut: string,
  amountInStr: string,
  amountOutStr: string,
  targetToken: string
): Promise<{ amountInUsd: number | null; amountOutUsd: number | null }> {
  const solPrice = await getCachedSolPrice();

  // SOL â†’ token (buy) or token â†’ SOL (sell) â€” both legs measured in SOL.
  // If the SOL price is unavailable, leave USD null rather than fabricating it.
  if (tokenIn === SOL_MINT) {
    if (solPrice === null) return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };
    const amountInUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountInStr, 9) * solPrice;
    return { amountInUsd, amountOutUsd: amountInUsd };
  }
  if (tokenOut === SOL_MINT) {
    if (solPrice === null) return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };
    const amountOutUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountOutStr, 9) * solPrice;
    return { amountInUsd: amountOutUsd, amountOutUsd };
  }

  // USDC-denominated pairs
  if (tokenIn === USDC_MINT) {
    const amountInUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountInStr, 6);
    return { amountInUsd, amountOutUsd: amountInUsd };
  }
  if (tokenOut === USDC_MINT) {
    const amountOutUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountOutStr, 6);
    return { amountInUsd: amountOutUsd, amountOutUsd };
  }

  // Token-to-token swaps (Jupiter routed) â€” use target token price + known decimals
  const targetPrice = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(targetToken);
  if (targetPrice) {
    // Decimals must be known: applying the wrong scale (e.g. defaulting 9-decimal
    // tokens to 6) produces a 1000x-wrong USD value. If we don't know the
    // decimals, leave USD null rather than recording a fabricated number â€” the
    // backfill-usd pass can fill it once the token's decimals are populated.
    const decimals = await getTokenDecimals(targetToken);
    if (decimals === null) return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };

    // Determine which side is the target
    if (targetToken === tokenOut) {
      const amountUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountOutStr, decimals) * targetPrice;
      return { amountInUsd: amountUsd, amountOutUsd: amountUsd };
    } else {
      const amountUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountInStr, decimals) * targetPrice;
      return { amountInUsd: amountUsd, amountOutUsd: amountUsd };
    }
  }

  return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Process Single Transaction (shared by backfill + webhook) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export async function processTransaction(
  tx: HeliusParsedTransaction,
  address: string,
  source: SolanaIngestionSource = 'solana-backfill'
): Promise<'inserted' | 'skipped'> {
  const canonicalEvent = parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(tx, address);
  if (!canonicalEvent) return 'skipped';
  const parsed = canonicalEvent;
  const signature = canonicalEvent.transactionIdentity;

  // Upsert both tokens â€” fetch mint info for target token to populate safety data
  const [, , targetMintInfo] = await Promise.all([
    upsertToken(parsed.tokenIn),
    upsertToken(parsed.tokenOut),
    fetchTokenMintInfo(parsed.targetToken)
  ]);

  await upsertToken(parsed.targetToken, targetMintInfo ? {
    decimals: targetMintInfo.decimals,
    mintAuthorityDisabled: targetMintInfo.mintAuthorityDisabled,
    freezeAuthorityDisabled: targetMintInfo.freezeAuthorityDisabled
  } : undefined);

  const blockTime = tx.blockTime!;
  const timestamp = canonicalEvent.occurredAt;

  const { amountInUsd, amountOutUsd } = await enrichTransactionUsd(
    parsed.tokenIn,
    parsed.tokenOut,
    parsed.amountIn,
    parsed.amountOut,
    parsed.targetToken
  );

  const persisted = await insertParsedTransaction({
    signature,
    walletAddress: address,
    tokenIn: parsed.tokenIn,
    tokenOut: parsed.tokenOut,
    amountIn: parsed.amountIn,
    amountOut: parsed.amountOut,
    amountInUsd,
    amountOutUsd,
    direction: parsed.direction,
    targetToken: parsed.targetToken,
    programId: extractProgramId(tx),
    slot: tx.slot ?? null,
    timestamp,
    blockTime
  });

  const sourceTrade = await persistSolanaSourceTrade({
    event: canonicalEvent,
    source
  });

  if (persisted) {
    // Record earliest-seen time for the traded token (powers early-entry score)
    // and any SOL-funding edges observed in this transaction.
    await updateTokenLaunchTimestamp(parsed.targetToken, timestamp);
    await recordFundingEdges(tx);

    await redis.publish(
      REDIS_CHANNELS.walletSwap,
      JSON.stringify({
        chain: 'solana',
        walletAddress: prefixChainValue(address, 'solana'),
        signature,
        sourceTradeId: sourceTrade.event.id,
        tokenMint: prefixChainValue(parsed.targetToken, 'solana'),
        direction: parsed.direction,
        amountUsd: amountInUsd,
        timestamp: timestamp.toISOString()
      })
    );
  }

  return persisted ? 'inserted' : 'skipped';
}

/**
 * Persist any meaningful SOL transfers in this transaction as funding edges.
 * Best-effort: failures are logged but never block ingestion.
 */
async function recordFundingEdges(tx: HeliusParsedTransaction) {
  const transfers = extractFundingTransfers(tx);
  for (const t of transfers) {
    try {
      await recordFundingEdge(t.source, t.destination, t.lamports);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[indexer] failed to record funding edge', error);
    }
  }
}

// â”€â”€â”€ On-chain token discovery â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

// How many signatures, from the OLDEST (launch) forward, to scan for buyers.
const TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW = Number(process.env.TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW ?? 5000);
// Hard cap on total signatures paged while walking back to the launch, so a
// hyper-active token can't make us page forever. If we hit this before reaching
// the genesis the launch time is best-effort (logged).
const TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES = Number(process.env.TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES ?? 20000);
// 40 earliest big buyers (kept unconditionally) + 10 biggest buyers (profit-gated
// later by the scorer's pruneUnprofitableBigBuyers).
const EARLY_BUYER_SLOTS = Number(process.env.EARLY_BUYER_SLOTS ?? 40);
const BIG_BUYER_SLOTS = Number(process.env.BIG_BUYER_SLOTS ?? 10);

const SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID_OWNER = '11111111111111111111111111111111';

// Owners that are never real trader wallets â€” the mint itself and the swap
// programs. Pool/vault accounts can still slip through; the backfill+scoring
// pass and the token-big profit prune filter those out downstream.
function isDiscardableOwner(owner: string, mint: string): boolean {
  return owner === mint || SWAP_PROGRAM_IDS.has(owner) || owner === SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID_OWNER;
}

/**
 * Discover and seed a token's early & biggest buyers from on-chain history.
 *
 * 1. Page `getSignaturesForAddress(mint)` back to the launch (bounded by a safety
 *    cap), reverse to chronological order, take the first `TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW`
 *    signatures from launch forward.
 * 2. Fetch those txs, and for each gather the accounts that net-gained the mint
 *    (`extractTokenBuyers`). Aggregate per owner: earliest buy time + total base
 *    units acquired.
 * 3. Take the 40 EARLIEST distinct buyers (`token-early`, kept unconditionally)
 *    and, from the rest, the 10 LARGEST by acquired amount (`token-big`,
 *    profit-gated later). Upsert each and enqueue a normal history backfill so the
 *    scorer can score/cluster them like any other wallet.
 */
export async function discoverFromToken(mint: string) {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) {
    console.warn('[indexer] skipping token discovery: HELIUS_API_KEY is not set');
    return { earlyBuyers: 0, bigBuyers: 0, scanned: 0 };
  }

  // â”€â”€ 1. Walk signatures back to the launch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const all: HeliusSignature[] = [];
  let before: string | undefined;
  let cappedOut = false;
  while (all.length < TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES) {
    const page = await heliusRpc<HeliusSignature[]>('getSignaturesForAddress', [
      mint,
      before ? { limit: 1000, before } : { limit: 1000 }
    ]);
    if (page.length === 0) break;
    all.push(...page);
    before = page[page.length - 1].signature;
    if (page.length < 1000) break; // reached the genesis of this account
    await sleep(150); // gentle pacing
  }
  if (all.length >= TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES) {
    cappedOut = true;
    console.warn(`[indexer] token ${mint}: hit signature cap (${TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES}); launch detection best-effort`);
  }
  if (all.length === 0) {
    console.warn(`[indexer] token ${mint}: no signatures found`);
    return { earlyBuyers: 0, bigBuyers: 0, scanned: 0 };
  }

  // Oldest-first. getSignaturesForAddress returns newestâ†’oldest within a page and
  // we paged from newestâ†’oldest, so the global ordering is already newestâ†’oldest.
  // Reversing ensures intra-slot order is oldestâ†’newest.
  all.reverse();
  all.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.blockTime != null && b.blockTime != null && a.blockTime !== b.blockTime) {
      return a.blockTime - b.blockTime;
    }
    return a.slot - b.slot;
  });
  const window = all.slice(0, TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW);
  const launchBlockTime = window[0]?.blockTime;

  // Ensure the token row + decimals exist so USD math elsewhere works, and record
  // the launch time (LEAST â†’ only moves earlier).
  const mintInfo = await fetchTokenMintInfo(mint);
  await upsertToken(mint, mintInfo ? { decimals: mintInfo.decimals } : undefined);
  if (launchBlockTime) await updateTokenLaunchTimestamp(mint, new Date(launchBlockTime * 1000));

  console.log(`[indexer] token ${mint}: scanning ${window.length}/${all.length} sigs from launch${cappedOut ? ' (capped)' : ''}`);

  // â”€â”€ 2. Fetch the window's transactions and aggregate buyers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  type Agg = { earliest: number; amount: bigint };
  const buyers = new Map<string, Agg>();
  const sigList = window.map((s) => s.signature);
  const BATCH = Number(process.env.BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE ?? 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < sigList.length; i += BATCH) {
    if (i > 0) await sleep(150);
    const batch = sigList.slice(i, i + BATCH);
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batch.map((sig) =>
        heliusRpc<HeliusParsedTransaction | null>('getTransaction', [
          sig,
          { maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0, commitment: 'confirmed', encoding: 'jsonParsed' }
        ]).catch(() => null)
      )
    );
    for (const tx of results) {
      if (!tx?.blockTime) continue;
      for (const buyer of extractTokenBuyers(tx, mint)) {
        if (isDiscardableOwner(buyer.owner, mint)) continue;
        const cur = buyers.get(buyer.owner);
        if (cur) {
          cur.amount += buyer.amount;
          if (tx.blockTime < cur.earliest) cur.earliest = tx.blockTime;
        } else {
          buyers.set(buyer.owner, { earliest: tx.blockTime, amount: buyer.amount });
        }
      }
    }
    if ((i / BATCH) % 20 === 0) console.log(`[indexer] token ${mint}: scanned ${Math.min(i + BATCH, sigList.length)}/${sigList.length}`);
  }

  // â”€â”€ 3. Allocate slots: 40 earliest, then 10 biggest of the rest â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const entries = Array.from(buyers.entries()); // [owner, Agg]
  const byEarliest = [...entries].sort((a, b) => a[1].earliest - b[1].earliest);
  const early = byEarliest.slice(0, EARLY_BUYER_SLOTS).map(([owner]) => owner);
  const earlySet = new Set(early);

  const byAmount = [...entries]
    .filter(([owner]) => !earlySet.has(owner))
    .sort((a, b) => (b[1].amount > a[1].amount ? 1 : b[1].amount < a[1].amount ? -1 : 0));
  const big = byAmount.slice(0, BIG_BUYER_SLOTS).map(([owner]) => owner);

  // â”€â”€ 4. Seed wallets + enqueue history backfill â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  for (const owner of early) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain: 'solana', source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-early' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, 'solana');
    await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }
  for (const owner of big) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain: 'solana', source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-big' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, 'solana');
    await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }

  await logDiscoveryRun('token', mint, early.length + big.length);
  // Tell the scorer to (re)cluster once backfills settle; the profit prune runs
  // there too. Best-effort â€” the nightly batch would pick it up regardless.
  await redis.publish(REDIS_CHANNELS.clusterRefresh, JSON.stringify({ reason: 'token-discovery', mint }));

  console.log(`[indexer] token ${mint}: seeded ${early.length} early + ${big.length} big buyers from ${buyers.size} candidates`);
  return { earlyBuyers: early.length, bigBuyers: big.length, scanned: window.length };
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Backfill â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export async function backfillWallet(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) {
    throw new Error('HELIUS_API_KEY is not set');
  }

  const sigLimit = clampInteger(
    process.env.BACKFILL_SIGNATURE_LIMIT,
    1000,
    1,
    1000
  );
  const signatures = await heliusRpc<HeliusSignature[]>('getSignaturesForAddress', [address, { limit: sigLimit }]);
  if (signatures.length === 0) {
    await refreshWalletActivity(address.includes(':') ? address : `solana:${address}`, null, 0);
    return {
      fetched: 0,
      inserted: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      failed: 0,
      lastEventAt: null
    };
  }

  const signatureList = signatures.map((s) => s.signature);
  console.log(`[indexer] fetching ${signatureList.length} transactions for ${address}`);
  // Solana JSON-RPC has no `getParsedTransactions` (plural) method â€” Helius
  // replies "Method not found". Fetch each signature with `getTransaction`
  // (jsonParsed), in bounded-concurrency batches to respect rate limits.
  const txs: Array<HeliusParsedTransaction | null | undefined> = [];
  let failed = 0;
  const BATCH = Number(process.env.BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE ?? 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < signatureList.length; i += BATCH) {
    if (i > 0) await sleep(150); // gentle pacing to stay under rate limits
    const batch = signatureList.slice(i, i + BATCH);
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batch.map((sig) =>
        heliusRpc<HeliusParsedTransaction | null>('getTransaction', [
          sig,
          { maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0, commitment: 'confirmed', encoding: 'jsonParsed' }
        ]).catch((err) => {
          console.warn(`[indexer] getTransaction failed for ${sig}:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
          failed++;
          return undefined;
        })
      )
    );
    txs.push(...results);
    console.log(`[indexer] ${address}: fetched ${txs.length}/${signatureList.length}`);
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let latestBlockTime: number | null = null;
  let lastEventAt: Date | null = null;
  let sourceTradeFailure: SourceTradePersistenceError | null = null;

  for (const tx of txs) {
    if (tx === undefined) continue;
    if (tx === null) {
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }
    if (tx.blockTime) {
      const eventAt = new Date(tx.blockTime * 1000);
      if (!lastEventAt || eventAt > lastEventAt) lastEventAt = eventAt;
    }

    try {
      const result = await processTransaction(tx, address);
      if (result === 'inserted') {
        inserted++;
        if (tx.blockTime && (!latestBlockTime || tx.blockTime > latestBlockTime)) {
          latestBlockTime = tx.blockTime;
        }
      } else {
        skipped++;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failed++;
      if (error instanceof SourceTradePersistenceError) {
        sourceTradeFailure ??= error;
      }
      console.warn(
        `[indexer] failed to process Solana transaction ${tx.transaction?.signatures?.[0] ?? 'unknown'}:`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  const result = {
    fetched: signatureList.length,
    inserted,
    skipped,
    failed,
    lastEventAt
  };

  try {
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      address.includes(':') ? address : `solana:${address}`,
      latestBlockTime ? new Date(latestBlockTime * 1000) : null,
      inserted
    );
  } catch (error) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Failed to refresh Solana wallet activity for ${address}`,
      { ...result, failed: result.failed + 1 },
      { cause: error }
    );
  }
  if (sourceTradeFailure) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Canonical Solana source-trade persistence failed for ${address}`,
      result,
      { cause: sourceTradeFailure }
    );
  }
  return result;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ BullMQ Worker â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

new Worker(
  QUEUES.walletBackfill,
  createWalletBackfillProcessor({
    backfillSolana: backfillWallet,
    backfillPolygon: backfillPolymarketWallet,
    backfillRobinhood: (address) => backfillEvmWallet(address, 'robinhood-chain'),
    recordBatch: recordIngestionBatch
  }),
  // Concurrency 1: backfill one wallet at a time so we don't fan out hundreds of
  // concurrent RPC requests and trip the rate limiter.
  { connection: redis, concurrency: Number(process.env.BACKFILL_CONCURRENCY ?? 1) }
).on('error', (err) => console.error('[indexer] backfill worker error', err));

// Token-discovery worker: heavy on-chain scan that seeds early/big buyers.
new Worker(
  QUEUES.tokenDiscovery,
  async (job) => {
    const { tokenMint, chain = 'solana' } = job.data as { tokenMint: string; chain?: WalletChain };
    console.log(`[indexer] token discovery started for ${tokenMint} on ${chain}`);
    const result = chain === 'solana'
      ? await discoverFromToken(tokenMint)
      : await discoverFromEvmToken(tokenMint, chain as 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain', { backfillQueue });
    console.log(`[indexer] token discovery complete for ${tokenMint} on ${chain}:`, result);
    return { mint: tokenMint, chain, ...result };
  },
  // Concurrency 1: a single discovery already pages thousands of Helius requests;
  // running several in parallel would trip the rate limiter.
  { connection: redis, concurrency: 1 }
).on('error', (err) => console.error('[indexer] discovery worker error', err));

// â”€â”€â”€ Startup seed from env â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const fromEnv = parseSeedWalletAddresses(process.env.WALLET_ADDRESSES);

if (fromEnv.length > 0) {
  ingestWallets(fromEnv)
    .then((result) => console.log('[indexer] ingestion result', result))
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error('[indexer] ingestion failed', error);
      process.exit(1);
    });
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Polymarket resolution polling â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

// Check active markets every 15 minutes for resolution.
setInterval(() => {
  pollPolymarketResolutions().catch(console.error);
}, 15 * 60 * 1000);
pollPolymarketResolutions().catch(console.error);

// â”€â”€â”€ Polymarket order-book feed (S4-M38) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/**
 * Streams Polymarket order books into Redis so `signal-engine` can gate fan-out
 * on real depth before admitting copiers.
 *
 * **Why this lives here.** The book is the only honest liquidity figure for a
 * Polymarket outcome share â€” it trades on Polymarket's own CLOB, not a DEX pair,
 * so DexScreener TVL is either absent or belongs to an unrelated Polygon pair.
 * Without this feed every polygon cohort reads `capacity-unknown` and nobody
 * copies a Polymarket signal.
 *
 * **Failure is bounded on purpose.** Everything below degrades rather than
 * throws: a failed seed starts with no markets, a dropped socket invalidates
 * books to `awaiting-snapshot`, a failed resync lets entries age into
 * `book-snapshot-stale`. Every one of those reads as *unknown* downstream, which
 * excludes copiers rather than admitting them against depth nobody measured. A
 * throw here, by contrast, would take down the process that also ingests Solana
 * and Robinhood Chain.
 */
/**
 * How often the subscription set is recomputed.
 *
 * Five minutes, not the resync cadence: this is a *membership* refresh (which
 * markets exist and matter), not a *freshness* refresh (what the book says).
 * Freshness is the subscriber's own 15s resync. A market that becomes active
 * between refreshes is simply unsubscribed until the next one, which reads as
 * `book-not-cached` and excludes its cohort â€” fail-closed, and the cost of a
 * tighter cadence is a repeated scan of two tables for a set that rarely moves.
 */
const POLYMARKET_BOOK_SUBSCRIPTION_REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

const polymarketBookRuntime = createPolymarketBookRuntimeOnRedis(redis, {
  logger: {
    info: (message: string) => console.log(`[indexer] ${message}`),
    warn: (message: string, error?: unknown) =>
      console.warn(`[indexer] ${message}`, error ?? '')
  }
});

polymarketBookRuntime.start();

/**
 * Seed the subscription set, then refresh it periodically.
 *
 * The set is the union of markets a tracked master traded recently and markets
 * somebody still holds â€” the first are fan-out candidates, the second have to
 * stay exitable. Refreshed on a cadence because a market that becomes active
 * after boot would otherwise never be subscribed until the next restart.
 */
async function refreshPolymarketBookSubscriptions(): Promise<void> {
  const set = await loadPolymarketBookSubscriptionSet({
    now: new Date(),
    onFailure: (detail: string) => console.warn(`[indexer] ${detail}`)
  });

  polymarketBookRuntime.subscriber.subscribe(set.tokenIds);

  console.log(
    `[indexer] polymarket book subscriptions: ${set.tokenIds.length} market(s) `
      + `(${set.counts.recentTrade} recently traded, ${set.counts.openPosition} held)`
      + `${set.evicted === 0 ? '' : `, ${set.evicted} evicted by the cap`}`
  );
}

void refreshPolymarketBookSubscriptions().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.warn('[indexer] polymarket book subscription seed failed', error);
});

setInterval(() => {
  void refreshPolymarketBookSubscriptions().catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.warn('[indexer] polymarket book subscription refresh failed', error);
  });
}, POLYMARKET_BOOK_SUBSCRIPTION_REFRESH_MS);

// â”€â”€â”€ Shutdown â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/**
 * Stop the book feed on the way out.
 *
 * `stop()` invalidates every cached book before closing the socket, so a
 * deliberate shutdown cannot leave entries in Redis that look fresh while
 * nothing is updating them. Registered for both signals because a container stop
 * sends SIGTERM and an interactive run sends SIGINT.
 */
let shuttingDown = false;
function shutdown(signal: string): void {
  if (shuttingDown) return;
  shuttingDown = true;
  console.log(`[indexer] ${signal} received; stopping the polymarket book feed`);
  try {
    polymarketBookRuntime.stop();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[indexer] book feed shutdown failed', error);
  }
}

process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));

console.log('[indexer] service running');

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  IngestionBatchError,
  runTrackedIngestion,
  type IngestionBatchResult
} from './ingestion-health.js';

const RESULT: IngestionBatchResult = {
  fetched: 12,
  inserted: 8,
  skipped: 3,
  failed: 1,
  lastEventAt: new Date('2026-07-19T12:00:00.000Z')
};

describe('tracked ingestion batches', () => {
  it('records completed counters with the source event time', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'robinhood-chain',
        source: 'robinhood-evm',
        run: async () => RESULT
      }, recorder)
    ).resolves.toBe(RESULT);

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      source: 'robinhood-evm',
      lastEventAt: RESULT.lastEventAt,
      inserted: 8,
      skipped: 3,
      failed: 1
    }));
  });

  it('records partial counters and rethrows a failed batch', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    const error = new IngestionBatchError('wallet refresh failed', RESULT);

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'polygon',
        source: 'polymarket-data-api',
        run: async () => {
          throw error;
        }
      }, recorder)
    ).rejects.toBe(error);

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      inserted: 8,
      skipped: 3,
      failed: 1,
      errorMessage: 'wallet refresh failed'
    }));
  });

  it('records one failed batch when ingestion stops before counters exist', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'solana',
        source: 'solana-backfill',
        run: async () => {
          throw new Error('RPC unavailable');
        }
      }, recorder)
    ).rejects.toThrow('RPC unavailable');

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      inserted: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      failed: 1,
      lastEventAt: null
    }));
  });

  it('does not misclassify a health write failure as an ingestion failure', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('health write failed'));

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'solana',
        source: 'solana-backfill',
        run: async () => RESULT
      }, recorder)
    ).rejects.toThrow('health write failed');

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});

==> apps/indexer/src/ingestion-health.ts <==
import type { RecordIngestionBatchInput } from '@swat/db';
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';

export type IngestionBatchResult = {
  fetched: number;
  inserted: number;
  skipped: number;
  failed: number;
  lastEventAt: Date | null;
};

export class IngestionBatchError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    readonly result: IngestionBatchResult,
    options?: { cause?: unknown }
  ) {
    super(message, options);
    this.name = 'IngestionBatchError';
  }
}

type Recorder = (input: RecordIngestionBatchInput) => Promise<void>;

export async function runTrackedIngestion(
  input: {
    chain: Chain;
    source: string;
    run: () => Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  },
  recorder: Recorder
): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  const batchAt = new Date();
  let result: IngestionBatchResult;

  try {
    result = await input.run();
  } catch (error) {
    const failedResult = error instanceof IngestionBatchError
      ? error.result
      : {
          fetched: 0,
          inserted: 0,
          skipped: 0,
          failed: 1,
          lastEventAt: null
        };

    try {
      await recorder({
        chain: input.chain,
        source: input.source,
        batchAt,
        lastEventAt: failedResult.lastEventAt,
        inserted: failedResult.inserted,
        skipped: failedResult.skipped,
        failed: Math.max(1, failedResult.failed),
        errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      });
    } catch (recordError) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [error, recordError],
        `Ingestion and health recording both failed for ${input.chain}`
      );
    }
    throw error;
  }

  await recorder({
    chain: input.chain,
    source: input.source,
    batchAt,
    lastEventAt: result.lastEventAt,
    inserted: result.inserted,
    skipped: result.skipped,
    failed: result.failed
  });
  return result;
}

        ]

      }
    };
    expect(extractTokenBuyers(tx, TOKEN)).toEqual([]);
  });

    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {

          { owner: BUYER_A, mint: TOKEN, uiTokenAmount: { amount: '100' } },
          { owner: BUYER_A, mint: TOKEN, uiTokenAmount: { amount: '0' } }
        ],
        postTokenBalances: [
          { owner: BUYER_A, mint: TOKEN, uiTokenAmount: { amount: '300' } },
          { owner: BUYER_A, mint: TOKEN, uiTokenAmount: { amount: '200' } }

      }
    };
    // (300+200) - (100+0) = 400
    expect(extractTokenBuyers(tx, TOKEN)).toEqual([{ owner: BUYER_A, amount: 400n }]);
  });

==> apps/indexer/src/parse.ts <==
// Pure transaction-parsing helpers â€” no Redis/Worker/network side effects so
// they can be unit tested in isolation.

export type HeliusTokenBalance = {
  owner?: string;
  mint: string;
  uiTokenAmount?: { amount?: string };
};

export type HeliusParsedInstruction = {
  programId?: string;
  program?: string;
  parsed?: {
    type?: string;
    info?: {
      source?: string;
      destination?: string;
      lamports?: number | string;
    };
  };
};

// With jsonParsed encoding each account key is an object; some RPCs still
// return bare pubkey strings, so accept both.
export type HeliusAccountKey = string | { pubkey?: string };

export type HeliusParsedTransaction = {
  slot?: number;
  blockTime?: number;
  transaction?: {
    signatures?: string[];
    message?: {
      instructions?: HeliusParsedInstruction[];
      accountKeys?: HeliusAccountKey[];
    };
  };
  meta?: {
    fee?: number;
    preBalances?: number[];
    postBalances?: number[];
    preTokenBalances?: HeliusTokenBalance[];
    postTokenBalances?: HeliusTokenBalance[];
    innerInstructions?: Array<{ instructions?: HeliusParsedInstruction[] }>;
  };
};

export function accountKeyPubkey(key: HeliusAccountKey | undefined): string | undefined {
  return typeof key === 'string' ? key : key?.pubkey;
}

/**
 * Convert a base-unit integer amount (as a string) to a human-unit float
 * WITHOUT precision loss for large values. `Number("50000000000000000")`
 * silently rounds past 2^53 (~9e15); a 9-decimal memecoin trade routinely
 * exceeds that. We split the integer and fractional parts in BigInt space first
 * so only the (small) scaled quotient is handed to Number.
 */
export function baseUnitsToFloat(amountStr: string, decimals: number): number {
  let v: bigint;
  try {
    v = BigInt(amountStr);
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
  if (decimals <= 0) return Number(v);
  const negative = v < 0n;
  if (negative) v = -v;
  const divisor = 10n ** BigInt(decimals);
  const intPart = v / divisor;
  const fracPart = v % divisor;
  const fracStr = fracPart.toString().padStart(decimals, '0');
  const num = Number(`${intPart.toString()}.${fracStr}`);
  return negative ? -num : num;
}

// Ignore native-SOL deltas below this when treating SOL as a swap leg, so that
// pure-fee txs and tiny rent movements aren't mistaken for trades (0.001 SOL).
export const MIN_SOL_LEG_LAMPORTS = 1_000_000;

export const SOL_MINT = 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112';
export const USDC_MINT = 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v';
export const USDT_MINT = 'Es9vMFrzaCERmJfrF4H2FYD4KCoNkY11McCe8BenwNYB';
const QUOTE_MINTS = new Set([SOL_MINT, USDC_MINT, USDT_MINT]);
export const SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID = '11111111111111111111111111111111';
// Ignore dust / fee-sized transfers when inferring funding (0.05 SOL).
export const MIN_FUNDING_LAMPORTS = 50_000_000;

export type FundingTransfer = { source: string; destination: string; lamports: number };

/**
 * Extract SystemProgram SOL transfers from a parsed transaction.
 * Looks at both top-level and inner instructions. Filters to `transfer` /
 * `transferChecked` instructions above the dust threshold.
 */
export function extractFundingTransfers(
  tx: HeliusParsedTransaction,
  minLamports = MIN_FUNDING_LAMPORTS
): FundingTransfer[] {
  const top = tx.transaction?.message?.instructions ?? [];
  const inner = (tx.meta?.innerInstructions ?? []).flatMap((i) => i.instructions ?? []);
  const all = [...top, ...inner];

  const transfers: FundingTransfer[] = [];
  // Dedup identical transfers within the same tx: a CPI'd SystemProgram transfer
  // can surface in both the top-level and inner instruction lists, which would
  // otherwise double-count the funding edge's accumulated lamports.
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const ix of all) {
    const isSystem = ix.programId === SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID || ix.program === 'system';
    if (!isSystem) continue;
    // SystemProgram funding is always a plain `transfer` (SPL `transferChecked`
    // carries tokenAmount, not lamports), so only `transfer` is relevant here.
    if (ix.parsed?.type !== 'transfer') continue;

    const info = ix.parsed?.info;
    const source = info?.source;
    const destination = info?.destination;
    const lamports = info?.lamports != null ? Number(info.lamports) : NaN;

    if (!source || !destination) continue;
    if (!Number.isFinite(lamports) || lamports < minLamports) continue;
    if (source === destination) continue;

    const key = `${source}|${destination}|${lamports}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);

    transfers.push({ source, destination, lamports });
  }
  return transfers;
}

/**
 * Compute the buy/sell direction and target token for a swap from the wallet's
 * pre/post token balance deltas. Returns null if the tx isn't a clean 2-sided
 * swap for this wallet.
 */
export function getWalletTokenDeltas(tx: HeliusParsedTransaction, walletAddress: string) {
  const pre = tx.meta?.preTokenBalances ?? [];
  const post = tx.meta?.postTokenBalances ?? [];
  const balances = new Map<string, { pre: bigint; post: bigint }>();

  for (const item of pre) {
    if (item.owner !== walletAddress || !item.mint) continue;
    const amount = BigInt(item.uiTokenAmount?.amount ?? '0');
    const current = balances.get(item.mint) ?? { pre: 0n, post: 0n };
    balances.set(item.mint, { pre: current.pre + amount, post: current.post });
  }

  for (const item of post) {
    if (item.owner !== walletAddress || !item.mint) continue;
    const amount = BigInt(item.uiTokenAmount?.amount ?? '0');
    const current = balances.get(item.mint) ?? { pre: 0n, post: 0n };
    balances.set(item.mint, { pre: current.pre, post: current.post + amount });
  }

  // Native SOL is NOT in pre/postTokenBalances â€” it lives in the lamports
  // arrays. Without this leg, SOLâ†’token buys and tokenâ†’SOL sells (the common
  // memecoin case) look one-sided and get skipped. Synthesize a SOL_MINT delta
  // from the wallet's native balance change, removing the tx fee when the
  // wallet paid it so the leg reflects only swapped SOL.
  const accountKeys = tx.transaction?.message?.accountKeys ?? [];
  const walletIndex = accountKeys.findIndex((k) => accountKeyPubkey(k) === walletAddress);
  const preLamports = tx.meta?.preBalances;
  const postLamports = tx.meta?.postBalances;
  if (walletIndex >= 0 && preLamports && postLamports &&
      preLamports[walletIndex] != null && postLamports[walletIndex] != null) {
    let nativeDelta = BigInt(postLamports[walletIndex]) - BigInt(preLamports[walletIndex]);
    // The fee payer is always account index 0; add the fee back so it doesn't
    // count as SOL spent on the swap.
    if (walletIndex === 0 && tx.meta?.fee != null) nativeDelta += BigInt(tx.meta.fee);
    if (nativeDelta < 0n ? -nativeDelta >= MIN_SOL_LEG_LAMPORTS : nativeDelta >= MIN_SOL_LEG_LAMPORTS) {
      const current = balances.get(SOL_MINT) ?? { pre: 0n, post: 0n };
      // Fold the native delta into the existing SOL entry (covers wrapped-SOL too).
      balances.set(SOL_MINT, { pre: current.pre, post: current.post + nativeDelta });
    }
  }

  const deltas = Array.from(balances.entries())
    .map(([mint, value]) => ({ mint, delta: value.post - value.pre }))
    .filter((e) => e.delta !== 0n);

  if (deltas.length < 2) return null;

  const negatives = deltas.filter((e) => e.delta < 0n);
  const positives = deltas.filter((e) => e.delta > 0n);
  if (negatives.length === 0 || positives.length === 0) return null;

  const tokenIn = negatives.reduce((min, cur) => (cur.delta < min.delta ? cur : min));
  const tokenOut = positives.reduce((max, cur) => (cur.delta > max.delta ? cur : max));
  if (!tokenIn || !tokenOut) return null;

  const inputIsQuote = QUOTE_MINTS.has(tokenIn.mint);
  const outputIsQuote = QUOTE_MINTS.has(tokenOut.mint);
  // Quote-to-quote conversions do not establish or exit a tracked position.
  if (inputIsQuote && outputIsQuote) return null;
  // Without an explicit target-token hint, a supported non-quote route is the
  // disposal of tokenIn. This fails safer than fabricating an entry in tokenOut.
  const direction: 'buy' | 'sell' = inputIsQuote ? 'buy' : 'sell';
  const targetToken = direction === 'buy' ? tokenOut.mint : tokenIn.mint;

  return {
    tokenIn: tokenIn.mint,
    tokenOut: tokenOut.mint,
    amountIn: (-tokenIn.delta).toString(),
    amountOut: tokenOut.delta.toString(),
    direction,
    targetToken
  };
}

export type CanonicalSolanaSwapEvent = {
  chain: 'solana';
  transactionIdentity: string;
  slot: number | null;
  walletAddress: string;
  occurredAt: Date;
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  targetToken: string;
  tokenIn: string;
  tokenOut: string;
  amountIn: string;
  amountOut: string;
};

/**
 * Produce the source-independent swap event consumed by Solana ingestion.
 *
 * Helius enhanced webhooks are first converted to a
 * {@link HeliusParsedTransaction}; JSON-RPC backfills already have that shape.
 * Keeping source labels out of this value makes parity directly testable and
 * prevents the two ingestion paths from drifting on direction or quantities.
 */
export function parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(
  tx: HeliusParsedTransaction,
  walletAddress: string
): CanonicalSolanaSwapEvent | null {
  const transactionIdentity = tx.transaction?.signatures?.[0];
  const blockTime = tx.blockTime;
  if (
    typeof transactionIdentity !== 'string'
    || transactionIdentity.length === 0
    || typeof blockTime !== 'number'
    || !Number.isInteger(blockTime)
    || blockTime <= 0
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const swap = getWalletTokenDeltas(tx, walletAddress);
  if (!swap) return null;

  return {
    chain: 'solana',
    transactionIdentity,
    slot: Number.isInteger(tx.slot) && (tx.slot ?? -1) >= 0 ? tx.slot! : null,
    walletAddress,
    occurredAt: new Date(blockTime * 1000),
    ...swap
  };
}

export type TokenBuyer = {
  owner: string;
  /** Base units of `mint` the owner gained in this tx (post - pre, > 0). */
  amount: bigint;
};

/**
 * Find every account that NET-GAINED a balance of `mint` in this transaction â€”
 * i.e. the buyers/receivers of the token in this tx. Used by token-discovery to
 * enumerate candidate early/big buyers from each on-chain swap.
 *
 * Aggregates per owner across all of that owner's token accounts for `mint`
 * (an owner can hold the mint in several ATAs). Owners whose net delta is <= 0
 * (sellers, unchanged) are excluded.
 */
export function extractTokenBuyers(tx: HeliusParsedTransaction, mint: string): TokenBuyer[] {
  const pre = tx.meta?.preTokenBalances ?? [];
  const post = tx.meta?.postTokenBalances ?? [];

  // owner -> { pre, post } summed base units of `mint`.
  const balances = new Map<string, { pre: bigint; post: bigint }>();

  for (const item of pre) {
    if (item.mint !== mint || !item.owner) continue;
    const amount = BigInt(item.uiTokenAmount?.amount ?? '0');
    const current = balances.get(item.owner) ?? { pre: 0n, post: 0n };
    balances.set(item.owner, { pre: current.pre + amount, post: current.post });
  }

  for (const item of post) {
    if (item.mint !== mint || !item.owner) continue;
    const amount = BigInt(item.uiTokenAmount?.amount ?? '0');
    const current = balances.get(item.owner) ?? { pre: 0n, post: 0n };
    balances.set(item.owner, { pre: current.pre, post: current.post + amount });
  }

  const buyers: TokenBuyer[] = [];
  for (const [owner, value] of balances.entries()) {
    const delta = value.post - value.pre;
    if (delta > 0n) buyers.push({ owner, amount: delta });
  }
  return buyers;
}

/**
 * End-to-end smoke test for the Polymarket book feed (`S4-M38`).
 *
 * â”€â”€ Why this exists â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *
 * The feed has 115 unit tests across three modules and every one of them runs
 * against injected fakes: a fake WebSocket, a fake `fetch`, an in-memory
 * key/value store. That is the right way to test the *decisions*, and it is
 * structurally incapable of answering the questions that actually matter on
 * first deployment:
 *
 *   1. Does the venue's WebSocket accept our subscribe frame, and does it push
 *      `book` events for the tokens we asked for?
 *   2. Does `POST /books` accept our body shape and return rows our parser
 *      recognises?
 *   3. Does an entry written by `indexer`'s publisher come back out of Redis
 *      decodable by `signal-engine`'s reader â€” same key, same wire version?
 *   4. Does the whole chain produce a **priced** verdict, or does it produce a
 *      plausible-looking unknown?
 *
 * Every one of those is a live-infrastructure question. A unit test that mocks
 * the socket cannot fail when the venue renames a field.
 *
 * â”€â”€ What it needs, and what it does NOT need â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *
 * Needs: **Redis**, and outbound network to Polymarket. That is all.
 *
 * Does **not** need Postgres. The token ids are discovered from the venue's own
 * public Gamma API rather than from `source_trades`, so this runs before any
 * migration has ever been applied â€” which is deliberate, because the point is to
 * de-risk the feed independently of the database work.
 *
 * â”€â”€ Read-only and side-effect-bounded â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *
 * Writes nothing but its own book keys, which carry the feed's normal TTL and
 * expire on their own. Places no orders, touches no wallet, needs no private
 * key, and never consults `TRADING_MODE` because it cannot trade: there is no
 * order path in this file. Safe to run against production Redis, though a local
 * instance is the obvious choice.
 */

/** Polygon's aggregate-impact ceiling: `DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.polygon` x 1/3. */
const CAP_BPS = 100;

/** How long to wait for the stream to deliver a first snapshot. */
const STREAM_WAIT_MS = 20_000;

/** Public market list. No auth, no key â€” this is the same endpoint the UI uses. */
const GAMMA_MARKETS_URL =
  'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets?closed=false&order=volume24hr&ascending=false&limit=5';

interface Step {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly ok: boolean;
  readonly detail: string;
}

const steps: Step[] = [];

function record(name: string, ok: boolean, detail: string): void {
  steps.push({ name, ok, detail });
  console.log(`[book-acceptance] ${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name} â€” ${detail}`);
}

/**
 * Discover a few live, liquid token ids from the public Gamma API.
 *
 * Deliberately not hardcoded: a token id baked into this file would resolve to a
 * market that has since closed, and the harness would then "fail" for a reason
 * that has nothing to do with our code â€” the worst kind of smoke test, because
 * it trains you to ignore it.
 */
async function discoverLiveTokenIds(): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  const response = await fetch(GAMMA_MARKETS_URL);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Gamma returned HTTP ${response.status} listing open markets`);
  }
  const body: unknown = await response.json();
  if (!Array.isArray(body)) {
    throw new Error(`Gamma returned a ${typeof body} rather than an array of markets`);
  }

  const tokenIds: string[] = [];
  for (const market of body) {
    if (typeof market !== 'object' || market === null) continue;
    const raw = (market as { clobTokenIds?: unknown }).clobTokenIds;
    // Gamma serialises this as a JSON *string* containing an array.
    const parsed: unknown = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) continue;
    for (const id of parsed) {
      if (typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0) tokenIds.push(id);
    }
  }
  if (tokenIds.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Gamma listed open markets but none carried a clobTokenIds pair');
  }
  // Two tokens is enough to prove the batch path without being noisy.
  return tokenIds.slice(0, 2);
}

/** Poll a predicate until it holds or the budget runs out. */
async function waitFor(
  label: string,
  predicate: () => boolean,
  budgetMs: number
): Promise<boolean> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + budgetMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (predicate()) return true;
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(resolve, 250);
    });
  }
  console.warn(`[book-acceptance] timed out after ${budgetMs}ms waiting for ${label}`);
  return false;
}

export async function runPolymarketBookAcceptance(): Promise<void> {
  const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
  const redis = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null, lazyConnect: true });

  let tokenIds: readonly string[] = [];
  let runtime: ReturnType<typeof createPolymarketBookRuntimeOnRedis> | null = null;

  try {
    // â”€â”€ 0. Redis reachable â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    await redis.connect();
    const pong = await redis.ping();
    record('redis reachable', pong === 'PONG', `${redisUrl} replied ${pong}`);

    // â”€â”€ 1. Discover live markets â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    tokenIds = await discoverLiveTokenIds();
    record(
      'discovered live token ids',
      tokenIds.length > 0,
      `${tokenIds.length} token(s) from the public Gamma market list`
    );

    // â”€â”€ 2. POST /books over the real endpoint â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    // Run before the socket, because it is the simpler failure to diagnose: if
    // the REST shape has changed, the stream shape almost certainly has too.
    const rows = await createPolymarketBooksFetcher({
      logger: { warn: (message, error) => console.warn(`[book-acceptance] ${message}`, error ?? '') }
    })(tokenIds);
    const hasRows = rows.length > 0;
    record(
      'POST /books returned rows',
      hasRows,
      `${rows.length} row(s) for ${tokenIds.length} token(s)`
    );
    if (!hasRows) {
      throw new Error(
        `POST /books returned no rows for ${tokenIds.length} discovered token(s); `
        + 'the REST prerequisite failed, so the stream phase was not started.'
      );
    }

    const firstRow = rows[0];
    const rowHasLadder =
      typeof firstRow === 'object'
      && firstRow !== null
      && Array.isArray((firstRow as { bids?: unknown }).bids)
      && Array.isArray((firstRow as { asks?: unknown }).asks);
    record(
      'POST /books row carries a ladder',
      rowHasLadder,
      rowHasLadder
        ? 'bids and asks are both arrays, as the parser expects'
        : `row shape is ${JSON.stringify(firstRow).slice(0, 200)}`
    );

    // â”€â”€ 3. The live stream, writing through to Redis â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    runtime = createPolymarketBookRuntimeOnRedis(redis, {
      tokenIds,
      logger: {
        info: (message: string) => console.log(`[book-acceptance] ${message}`),
        warn: (message: string, error?: unknown) =>
          console.warn(`[book-acceptance] ${message}`, error ?? '')
      }
    });
    runtime.start();

    const streamed = await waitFor(
      'a book snapshot from the market stream',
      () => tokenIds.some((id) => runtime?.subscriber.cache.get(id)?.status === 'book'),
      STREAM_WAIT_MS
    );
    const stats = runtime.subscriber.stats();
    record(
      'market stream delivered a snapshot',
      streamed,
      `applied-snapshot=${stats['applied-snapshot']} applied-delta=${stats['applied-delta']} `
        + `refused-malformed=${stats['refused-malformed-frame']}`
    );

    // â”€â”€ 4. Cross-process round trip: writer -> Redis -> reader â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    // This is the step the unit tests structurally cannot cover, because it is
    // the only one where the bytes leave the process.
    const subscribed = tokenIds.find((id) => runtime?.subscriber.cache.get(id)?.status === 'book')
      ?? tokenIds[0]!;
    const rawFromRedis = await redis.get(polymarketBookKey(subscribed));
    record(
      'publisher wrote the entry to Redis',
      rawFromRedis !== null,
      rawFromRedis === null
        ? `no value at ${polymarketBookKey(subscribed)} â€” the writer half is not reaching Redis`
        : `${rawFromRedis.length} bytes at ${polymarketBookKey(subscribed)}`
    );

    const transport: PolymarketBookKeyValueTransport = polymarketBookRedisTransport({
      get: (key: string) => redis.get(key),
      set: (key: string, value: string, mode: 'PX', ttlMs: number) =>
        redis.set(key, value, mode, ttlMs),
      mget: (...keys: string[]) => redis.mget(...keys)
    });

    const snapshot = await loadPolymarketBookEntry(
      { transport, now: () => Date.now(), maxAgeMs: POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS },
      subscribed
    );
    const status = snapshot.statusFor(subscribed);
    record(
      'reader decoded the entry',
      status?.code === 'entry-decoded',
      `transport code ${status?.code ?? 'none'} â€” ${status?.detail ?? 'no detail'}`
    );

    // â”€â”€ 5. The whole point: a PRICED verdict, not a plausible unknown â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    // Gamma's highest-volume markets can still be one-sided at the instant of
    // the smoke test. Evaluate every streamed token and use an assessed book;
    // failing because the first token has no asks would test market selection,
    // not the feed.
    const verdicts = tokenIds.flatMap((tokenId) =>
      (['buy', 'sell'] as const).map((cohortDirection) => ({
        tokenId,
        cohortDirection,
        verdict: assessPolymarketBookDepth(snapshot.cache, {
          tokenMint: `polygon:${tokenId}`,
          cohortDirection,
          impactCapBps: CAP_BPS,
          now: snapshot.readAt
        })
      }))
    );
    const priced = verdicts.find(({ verdict }) => verdict.outcome === 'assessed');
    const verdict = priced?.verdict ?? verdicts[0]!.verdict;
    record(
      'depth model priced the book',
      priced !== undefined,
      priced !== undefined
        ? `token ${priced.tokenId} (${priced.cohortDirection}): usable liquidity $${priced.verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd?.toFixed(2) ?? '?'} `
          + `at ${CAP_BPS}bps; capacity $${priced.verdict.capacity?.capacityNotionalUsd.toFixed(2) ?? '?'}`
        : `${verdict.reasonCode} â€” ${verdict.detail}`
    );

    // A no-depth-within-bound outcome is a legitimate venue condition rather
    // than a feed fault, but it cannot prove the priced depth path in this run.
    if (priced === undefined && verdict.outcome === 'no-depth-within-bound') {
      console.log(
        '[book-acceptance] NOTE every discovered ladder was genuinely empty inside the bound. '
          + 'That is a real market condition, not a feed fault â€” re-run against a busier market.'
      );
    }
  } finally {
    try {
      runtime?.stop();
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[book-acceptance] runtime shutdown failed', error);
    }
    // Leave no keys behind: this harness should not seed the cache that a real
    // fan-out might then read and trust.
    try {
      if (tokenIds.length > 0) {
        await redis.del(...tokenIds.map((id) => polymarketBookKey(id)));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[book-acceptance] key cleanup failed', error);
    }
    redis.disconnect();
  }

  const failed = steps.filter((step) => !step.ok);
  console.log(
    `\n[book-acceptance] ${steps.length - failed.length}/${steps.length} step(s) passed`
  );
  if (failed.length > 0) {
    for (const step of failed) console.error(`[book-acceptance]   FAILED: ${step.name}`);
    throw new Error(
      `${failed.length} acceptance step(s) failed. The feed is not proven end to end; `
      + 'see the per-step detail above.'
    );
  }
  console.log('[book-acceptance] the Polymarket book feed works end to end.');
}
