==> apps/lp/src/builder/build-position.ts <==
import { createLpPosition, transitionLpPosition, type UserScope } from '@swat/db';
import type { LpStrategyType } from '@swat/db';
import type { LpChain, LpProtocol } from '@swat/shared';
import { buildLadderPlan, type LadderRung } from './ladder-plan.js';
import type { EvmRungStep } from './evm-ladder.js';
import type { RungTxStep } from './meteora-ladder.js';
import { resolveStrategyTemplate, type StrategyTemplateName } from './templates.js';

/**
 * The build-position entrypoint (Track E6) â€” what the "Deploy Ladder" button
 * calls. One function in: `{chain, pool, template-or-custom, deposit}`; one
 * result out: a persisted `building` position plus its execution bundle.
 *
 * Two gates run before anything is built, in order:
 *
 *   1. The chain execution mode (the existing `resolveChainMode` clamp â€”
 *      fail-closed to paper, live requires `LIVE_ENABLED_CHAINS` plus an
 *      active certification). `off` refuses outright.
 *   2. The guardrail deploy check (Track G1's exposure cap), behind a port so
 *      this module stays oblivious to how the cap is computed.
 *
 * In paper mode the bundle is a *plan*: steps are returned unsigned and never
 * broadcast. Only a live-clamped chain returns sign-ready steps, and even then
 * the executor submits, not this function.
 */

export type ExecutionMode = 'off' | 'paper' | 'live';

export interface ExecutionModePort {
  resolveMode(chain: LpChain): Promise<ExecutionMode>;
}

export interface DeployGuardDecision {
  readonly allowed: boolean;
  readonly reasons: readonly string[];
}

export interface DeployGuardPort {
  assertDeployAllowed(input: {
    readonly scope: UserScope;
    readonly chain: LpChain;
    readonly poolAddress: string;
    readonly depositAmount: number;
  }): Promise<DeployGuardDecision>;
}

export interface LadderPoolView {
  readonly protocol: LpProtocol;
  readonly binStep: number | null;
  readonly tickSpacing: number | null;
  readonly currentPrice: number | null;
}

export interface PoolViewPort {
  getPool(chain: LpChain, poolAddress: string): Promise<LadderPoolView | null>;
}

export interface CustomLadderParams {
  readonly rangeLower: number;
  readonly rangeUpper: number;
  readonly rungCount: number;
  readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
}

export interface BuildPositionRequest {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** Either a named preset or explicit ladder parameters. */
  readonly template?: StrategyTemplateName;
  readonly custom?: CustomLadderParams;
  readonly depositAmount: number;
  /** Chain-prefixed deposit asset. */
  readonly depositAsset: string;
  /** Track I: opt this position into monitor-driven auto-rebalancing. Default false. */
  readonly autoRebalance?: boolean;
}

export type LadderExecutionStep = RungTxStep | EvmRungStep;

export interface BuildPositionResult {
  readonly positionId: string;
  readonly mode: ExecutionMode;
  readonly rungs: readonly LadderRung[];
  readonly steps: readonly LadderExecutionStep[];
  readonly rejectionReasons: readonly string[];
}

export interface BuildPositionDeps {
  readonly executionMode: ExecutionModePort;
  readonly deployGuard: DeployGuardPort;
  readonly poolView: PoolViewPort;
  readonly meteoraBuilder?: {
    buildLadder(input: {
      readonly plan: ReturnType<typeof buildLadderPlan>;
      readonly pairAddress: string;
      readonly userAddress: string;
      readonly currentPrice: number;
      readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
      readonly slippageBps?: number;
    }): Promise<readonly RungTxStep[]>;
  };
  readonly evmBuilder?: {
    buildLadder(input: {
      readonly plan: ReturnType<typeof buildLadderPlan>;
      readonly poolAddress: string;
      readonly recipient: string;
      readonly currentPrice: number;
      readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
      readonly slippageBps?: number;
    }): Promise<readonly EvmRungStep[]>;
  };
  readonly createPosition?: typeof createLpPosition;
  readonly transitionPosition?: typeof transitionLpPosition;
  readonly userAddress: string;
}

function resolveLadderParams(
  request: BuildPositionRequest,
  currentPrice: number
): CustomLadderParams {
  if (request.template && request.custom) {
    throw new Error('pass either a template or custom ladder params, not both');
  }
  if (request.template) {
    return resolveStrategyTemplate(request.template, currentPrice);
  }
  if (request.custom) {
    return request.custom;
  }
  throw new Error('a strategy template or custom ladder params is required');
}

export async function buildPosition(
  deps: BuildPositionDeps,
  scope: UserScope,
  request: BuildPositionRequest
): Promise<BuildPositionResult> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(request.depositAmount) || request.depositAmount <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`depositAmount must be positive, got ${request.depositAmount}`);
  }
  if (request.depositAsset.indexOf(':') < 0 || request.poolAddress.indexOf(':') < 0) {
    throw new Error('pool and deposit addresses must be chain-prefixed');
  }

  const mode = await deps.executionMode.resolveMode(request.chain);
  if (mode === 'off') {
    throw new Error(`LP execution on ${request.chain} is off`);
  }

  const guardDecision = await deps.deployGuard.assertDeployAllowed({
    scope,
    chain: request.chain,
    poolAddress: request.poolAddress,
    depositAmount: request.depositAmount
  });
  if (!guardDecision.allowed) {
    return {
      positionId: '',
      mode,
      rungs: [],
      steps: [],
      rejectionReasons: guardDecision.reasons
    };
  }

  const pool = await deps.poolView.getPool(request.chain, request.poolAddress);
  if (!pool) {
    throw new Error(`pool ${request.poolAddress} is not in the scan cache; run a scan first`);
  }
  const currentPrice = pool.currentPrice;
  if (currentPrice === null || currentPrice <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`pool ${request.poolAddress} has no current price to anchor the ladder`);
  }

  const params = resolveLadderParams(request, currentPrice);
  const plan = buildLadderPlan({
    protocol: pool.protocol,
    rangeLower: params.rangeLower,
    rangeUpper: params.rangeUpper,
    rungCount: params.rungCount,
    distribution: params.distribution,
    currentPrice,
    binStep: pool.binStep ?? undefined,
    tickSpacing: pool.tickSpacing ?? undefined,
    depositAmount: request.depositAmount
  });

  const createPosition = deps.createPosition ?? createLpPosition;
  const position = await createPosition(scope, {
    chain: request.chain,
    protocol: pool.protocol,
    poolAddress: request.poolAddress,
    strategyType: params.distribution,
    rangeLower: params.rangeLower,
    rangeUpper: params.rangeUpper,
    rungAllocations: plan.rungs,
    depositAmount: request.depositAmount,
    depositAsset: request.depositAsset,
    autoRebalance: request.autoRebalance === true
  });

  let steps: readonly LadderExecutionStep[];
  if (request.chain === 'solana') {
    if (!deps.meteoraBuilder) {
      throw new Error('meteora ladder builder is not configured');
    }
    steps = await deps.meteoraBuilder.buildLadder({
      plan,
      pairAddress: request.poolAddress,
      userAddress: deps.userAddress,
      currentPrice,
      distribution: params.distribution
    });
  } else {
    if (!deps.evmBuilder) {
      throw new Error('evm ladder builder is not configured');
    }
    steps = await deps.evmBuilder.buildLadder({
      plan,
      poolAddress: request.poolAddress,
      recipient: deps.userAddress,
      currentPrice,
      distribution: params.distribution
    });
  }

  // Paper mode: the recorded plan IS the build, so the position can leave
  // `building` and become monitorable (the monitor sweep only reads
  // active/near_edge/out_of_range rows â€” nothing else ever moved it out of
  // `building`, which stranded every paper deploy). Live mode leaves the
  // transition to the executor's broadcast confirmation
  // (attachOnChainPositionAddress), since `building` must not read as
  // deployed before the bundle actually lands.
  if (mode === 'paper') {
    const transition = deps.transitionPosition ?? transitionLpPosition;
    await transition(scope, position.id, {
      toState: 'active',
      reason: `ladder plan recorded in paper mode (${steps.length} rungs)`
    });
  }

  return { positionId: position.id, mode, rungs: plan.rungs, steps, rejectionReasons: [] };
}

==> apps/lp/src/builder/evm-ladder.ts <==
import type { LpStrategyType } from '@swat/db';
import type { LadderPlan } from './ladder-plan.js';

/**
 * Uniswap v3/v4 ladder builder on Robinhood Chain (Tracks E3/E4).
 *
 * Same ladder semantics as the Meteora builder, in tick space: one position
 * (NFT) per rung, minted through the NonfungiblePositionManager behind the
 * port. A single-token deposit is zapped by first swapping into the rung's
 * required leg ratio (E3) â€” the swap leg is behind the same port so the live
 * service can route it through the existing Robinhood swap-router config while
 * tests replace it.
 *
 * v4 is the same interface: when the pool was discovered as `uniswap-v4`, the
 * executor resolves the v4 PositionManager; the plan shape here is identical.
 */

export interface EvmRungStep {
  readonly rungIndex: number;
  readonly kind: 'swap' | 'mint-position';
  /** Swap step: how much of the deposit moves, in deposit-asset terms. */
  readonly amountIn?: number;
  readonly description: string;
  /** Opaque executor payload: calldata fragments for the NFPM/router. */
  readonly payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface EvmPositionPort {
  /** Mint one rung position; the live impl encodes NFPM `mint` calldata. */
  buildMintStep(step: EvmRungStep, context: { readonly recipient: string; readonly deadlineSeconds: number }): Promise<EvmRungStep>;
  /** Swap deposit asset into the rung's leg ratio; live impl uses the swap router. */
  buildSwapStep(step: EvmRungStep, context: { readonly recipient: string; readonly slippageBps: number }): Promise<EvmRungStep>;
}

/**
 * The leg split a straddling rung needs, in value terms â€” the same sqrt-band
 * math the active-TVL calculator uses, inverted: for a unit of liquidity
 * spanning the rung at the current price, how much value sits in each leg.
 */
export function splitRungLegs(
  rung: { priceLower: number; priceUpper: number; allocation: number },
  currentPrice: number
): { amountBase: number; amountQuote: number } {
  if (rung.priceUpper <= currentPrice) {
    return { amountBase: rung.allocation, amountQuote: 0 };
  }
  if (rung.priceLower >= currentPrice) {
    return { amountBase: 0, amountQuote: rung.allocation };
  }
  const shareBase =
    Math.log(currentPrice / rung.priceLower) / Math.log(rung.priceUpper / rung.priceLower);
  return {
    amountBase: rung.allocation * shareBase,
    amountQuote: rung.allocation * (1 - shareBase)
  };
}

export interface EvmLadderBuilder {
  buildLadder(input: {
    readonly plan: LadderPlan;
    readonly poolAddress: string;
    readonly recipient: string;
    readonly currentPrice: number;
    readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
    readonly slippageBps?: number;
  }): Promise<readonly EvmRungStep[]>;
}

export function createEvmLadderBuilder(port: EvmPositionPort): EvmLadderBuilder {
  return {
    async buildLadder({ plan, recipient, currentPrice, slippageBps = 100 }) {
      const steps: EvmRungStep[] = [];
      const deadlineSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 1800;

      for (const [index, rung] of plan.rungs.entries()) {
        const legs = splitRungLegs(rung, currentPrice);
        // The quote leg is the deposit asset for a single-token deposit: swap
        // the fraction of the allocation that must become base.
        const baseNeededShare = rung.allocation > 0 ? legs.amountBase / rung.allocation : 0;
        if (baseNeededShare > 0.0001) {
          steps.push(
            await port.buildSwapStep(
              {
                rungIndex: index,
                kind: 'swap',
                amountIn: rung.allocation * baseNeededShare,
                description: `rung ${index}: swap to base for ${Math.round(baseNeededShare * 100)}% of allocation`,
                payload: { priceLower: rung.priceLower, priceUpper: rung.priceUpper }
              },
              { recipient, slippageBps }
            )
          );
        }
        steps.push(
          await port.buildMintStep(
            {
              rungIndex: index,
              kind: 'mint-position',
              description: `rung ${index}: mint ticks [${rung.tickLower}, ${rung.tickUpper}]`,
              payload: {
                priceLower: rung.priceLower,
                priceUpper: rung.priceUpper,
                tickLower: rung.tickLower,
                tickUpper: rung.tickUpper,
                amountBase: legs.amountBase,
                amountQuote: legs.amountQuote
              }
            },
            { recipient, deadlineSeconds }
          )
        );
      }
      return steps;
    }
  };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  buildLadderPlan,
  computeRungPriceBounds,
  computeRungWeights,
  priceToBinId,
  priceToTick
} from './ladder-plan.js';

describe('computeRungWeights', () => {
  const bounds = computeRungPriceBounds(100, 200, 4);

  it('spot weights are equal', () => {
    const weights = computeRungWeights('spot', 4);
    expect(weights).toHaveLength(4);
    weights.forEach((weight) => expect(weight).toBeCloseTo(0.25, 12));
  });

  it('curve weights front-load toward the rung nearest the current price', () => {
    // Price near the top of the range: the top rung is heaviest (dump-capture
    // over a down-tilted range), decaying toward the bottom.
    const topAnchored = computeRungWeights('curve', 4, { currentPrice: 190, bounds });
    expect(topAnchored[3]).toBeGreaterThan(topAnchored[0]!);
    expect(topAnchored.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)).toBeCloseTo(1, 9);

    // Price near the bottom: the shape flips, it does not stay index-anchored.
    const bottomAnchored = computeRungWeights('curve', 4, { currentPrice: 110, bounds });
    expect(bottomAnchored[0]).toBeGreaterThan(bottomAnchored[3]!);

    // The same price outside the range still loads the nearest rung most.
    const below = computeRungWeights('curve', 4, { currentPrice: 50, bounds });
    expect(below[0]).toBeGreaterThan(below[1]!);
  });

  it('curve weights demand the anchor', () => {
    expect(() => computeRungWeights('curve', 4)).toThrow('anchor');
  });

  it('bidask weights load both edges and dip in the middle', () => {
    const weights = computeRungWeights('bidask', 4);
    expect(weights[0]).toBeGreaterThan(weights[1]!);
    expect(weights[3]).toBeGreaterThan(weights[2]!);
    // Symmetric shape: the two edges are (within float error) equal.
    expect(weights[0]).toBeCloseTo(weights[3]!, 12);
    const sum = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    expect(sum).toBeCloseTo(1, 9);
  });

  it('rejects a nonsense rung count', () => {
    expect(() => computeRungWeights('spot', 0)).toThrow('rungCount');
    expect(() => computeRungWeights('spot', 1.5)).toThrow('rungCount');
  });
});

describe('computeRungPriceBounds', () => {
  it('divides the range into contiguous geometric bands', () => {
    const bounds = computeRungPriceBounds(100, 200, 4);
    expect(bounds).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(bounds[0]?.priceLower).toBeCloseTo(100, 9);
    expect(bounds[3]?.priceUpper).toBeCloseTo(200, 9);
    for (let index = 1; index < bounds.length; index += 1) {
      expect(bounds[index]?.priceLower).toBeCloseTo(bounds[index - 1]?.priceUpper ?? 0, 9);
    }
    // Geometric: equal log widths, so the first band is narrower in absolute terms.
    const firstWidth = bounds[0]!.priceUpper - bounds[0]!.priceLower;
    const lastWidth = bounds[3]!.priceUpper - bounds[3]!.priceLower;
    expect(firstWidth).toBeLessThan(lastWidth);
  });

  it('rejects an inverted range', () => {
    expect(() => computeRungPriceBounds(200, 100, 2)).toThrow('rangeLower < rangeUpper');
  });
});

describe('chain snapping', () => {
  it('priceToBinId inverts the DLMM bin price curve', () => {
    // binStep 10 bps: id 100 â‰ˆ (1.001)^100
    const price = 1.001 ** 100;
    expect(priceToBinId(price, 10)).toBe(100);
  });

  it('priceToTick floors to the tick spacing', () => {
    // tick for price 1.001 is ~10; with spacing 60 the result floored to spacing.
    const tick = priceToTick(1.001, 60);
    expect(tick % 60).toBe(0);
    expect(tick).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Math.log(1.001) / Math.log(1.0001));
  });
});

describe('buildLadderPlan', () => {
  it('a meteora plan snaps rungs to contiguous non-overlapping bin ranges', () => {
    const plan = buildLadderPlan({
      protocol: 'meteora-dlmm',

      rangeUpper: 200,
      rungCount: 3,
      distribution: 'spot',
      currentPrice: 150,
      binStep: 50,
      depositAmount: 3_000
    });

==> apps/lp/src/builder/ladder-plan.ts <==
import type { LpStrategyType } from '@swat/db';
import type { LpProtocol } from '../scanner/types.js';

/**
 * Ladder planning math (Track E2/E4) â€” the pure core both chain builders share.
 *
 * A ladder splits a deposit across `rungCount` contiguous price bands inside
 * one range, with per-rung weights shaped by the strategy distribution:
 *
 *   - `spot`    â€” equal weights. Tight ranges; classic market-making shape.
 *   - `curve`   â€” weights decay from the rung nearest the CURRENT PRICE (in log
 *                 space), decaying outward in both directions. Where the price
 *                 sits inside the range decides which end is loaded: a
 *                 down-tilted range loads its top rung (catching dumps), an
 *                 up-tilted one its bottom (catching pumps).
 *   - `bidask`  â€” weights concentrate at BOTH edges of the range (the bid and
 *                 the ask), dipping in the middle â€” the accumulation shape:
 *                 heavy where price would have to travel far to reach you.
 *
 * Meteora rungs snap to bin ids; Uniswap rungs snap to tick boundaries. Both
 * snap from the same continuous price math here, so the two builders only
 * translate, never re-decide.
 */

export interface LadderPlanInput {
  readonly protocol: LpProtocol;
  /** Quote-per-base lower bound of the whole ladder. */
  readonly rangeLower: number;
  /** Quote-per-base upper bound of the whole ladder. */
  readonly rangeUpper: number;
  readonly rungCount: number;
  readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
  /** Current quote-per-base price; rung weighting for curve uses it as the anchor. */
  readonly currentPrice: number;
  /** Meteora bin step in bps (e.g. 10 = 0.1% per bin). Required for DLMM plans. */
  readonly binStep?: number;
  /** Uniswap tick spacing. Required for Uniswap plans. */
  readonly tickSpacing?: number;
  /** Total deposit, in deposit-asset terms (USD used for reporting weights only). */
  readonly depositAmount: number;
}

export interface LadderRung {
  readonly priceLower: number;
  readonly priceUpper: number;
  /** Fraction of the deposit assigned to this rung; rungs sum to 1 (Â± rounding). */
  readonly weight: number;
  /** Absolute allocation, same unit as `depositAmount`. */
  readonly allocation: number;
  /** Meteora: inclusive bin range (bin ids are price(1+b)^(id)). */
  readonly binLower?: number;
  readonly binUpper?: number;
  /** Uniswap: inclusive tick boundaries. */
  readonly tickLower?: number;
  readonly tickUpper?: number;
}

export interface LadderPlan {
  readonly rungs: readonly LadderRung[];
}

function assertPositive(name: string, value: number): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a positive finite number, got ${value}`);
  }
}

/** The context curve weights need: where the price sits across the rung bounds. */
export interface RungWeightAnchor {
  /** Current quote-per-base price the curve tilts toward. */
  readonly currentPrice: number;
  /** The rung bounds (from `computeRungPriceBounds`), in order. */
  readonly bounds: readonly { readonly priceLower: number; readonly priceUpper: number }[];
}

/**
 * Weights per rung by distribution; sums to 1 within float error.
 *
 * `curve` requires the anchor (price + bounds) because "nearest the current
 * price" is meaningless without them; `spot` and `bidask` are anchor-free
 * shapes. `bidask` loads both edges symmetrically â€” one exponential anchored
 * at each edge, summed â€” so the shape is a dip in the middle, not a ramp.
 */
export function computeRungWeights(
  distribution: LpStrategyType,
  rungCount: number,
  anchor?: RungWeightAnchor
): number[] {
  if (!Number.isInteger(rungCount) || rungCount < 1 || rungCount > 64) {
    throw new Error(`rungCount must be an integer in 1..64, got ${rungCount}`);
  }
  if (rungCount === 1) return [1];

  if (distribution === 'spot') {
    return Array.from({ length: rungCount }, () => 1 / rungCount);
  }

  // Exponential shape parameter: lambda = 1.2 gives a visible tilt without
  // degenerate rungs.
  const lambda = 1.2;
  const rawWeights: number[] = [];

  if (distribution === 'curve') {
    if (!anchor) {
      throw new Error('curve weights need the current price and rung bounds to anchor at');
    }
    if (anchor.bounds.length !== rungCount) {
      throw new Error(`curve weights need ${rungCount} rung bounds, got ${anchor.bounds.length}`);
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(anchor.currentPrice) || anchor.currentPrice <= 0) {
      throw new Error(`currentPrice must be a positive finite number, got ${anchor.currentPrice}`);
    }
    // Distances are normalized by the ladder's total log width so lambda means
    // the same tilt on a Â±2% scalp as on a Â±60% passive range. A price outside
    // the range still loads the nearest rung most â€” the shape degrades, it
    // does not invert.
    const logWidth =
      Math.log(anchor.bounds[anchor.bounds.length - 1]!.priceUpper) -
      Math.log(anchor.bounds[0]!.priceLower);
    for (const bound of anchor.bounds) {
      const midpoint = Math.sqrt(bound.priceLower * bound.priceUpper);
      const distance = Math.abs(Math.log(midpoint) - Math.log(anchor.currentPrice));
      rawWeights.push(Math.exp(-lambda * (distance / logWidth)));
    }
  } else {
    // bidask: one decay anchored at each edge, summed â€” both edges heavy,
    // symmetric regardless of where the price sits.
    for (let index = 0; index < rungCount; index += 1) {
      const position = index / (rungCount - 1); // 0 .. 1 across the range
      rawWeights.push(Math.exp(-lambda * position) + Math.exp(-lambda * (1 - position)));
    }
  }

  const total = rawWeights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  return rawWeights.map((weight) => weight / total);
}

/** Contiguous price bounds dividing [rangeLower, rangeUpper] into rungCount bands. */
export function computeRungPriceBounds(
  rangeLower: number,
  rangeUpper: number,
  rungCount: number
): { priceLower: number; priceUpper: number }[] {
  assertPositive('rangeLower', rangeLower);
  assertPositive('rangeUpper', rangeUpper);
  if (rangeUpper <= rangeLower) {
    throw new Error(`range must satisfy rangeLower < rangeUpper, got ${rangeLower}..${rangeUpper}`);
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(rungCount) || rungCount < 1 || rungCount > 64) {
    throw new Error(`rungCount must be an integer in 1..64, got ${rungCount}`);
  }

  // Geometric division, not arithmetic: equal log-widths keeps rung exposure
  // comparable at both ends of a wide range.
  const logLower = Math.log(rangeLower);
  const logUpper = Math.log(rangeUpper);
  const logStep = (logUpper - logLower) / rungCount;
  return Array.from({ length: rungCount }, (_, index) => ({
    priceLower: Math.exp(logLower + index * logStep),
    priceUpper: Math.exp(logLower + (index + 1) * logStep)
  }));
}

/** Meteora bin id at a price: id = ln(price) / ln(1 + binStep). */
export function priceToBinId(price: number, binStepBps: number): number {
  assertPositive('price', price);
  if (!Number.isFinite(binStepBps) || binStepBps <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`binStepBps must be positive, got ${binStepBps}`);
  }
  return Math.round(Math.log(price) / Math.log(1 + binStepBps / 10_000));
}

/** Uniswap tick at a price: tick = ln(price) / ln(1.0001), floored to spacing. */
export function priceToTick(price: number, tickSpacing: number): number {
  assertPositive('price', price);
  if (!Number.isFinite(tickSpacing) || tickSpacing <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`tickSpacing must be positive, got ${tickSpacing}`);
  }
  const raw = Math.log(price) / Math.log(1.0001);
  const floored = Math.floor(raw);
  return floored - (((floored % tickSpacing) + tickSpacing) % tickSpacing);
}

/** Builds the whole plan: bounds, weights, allocations, and chain snapping. */
export function buildLadderPlan(input: LadderPlanInput): LadderPlan {
  if (input.protocol === 'meteora-dlmm' && input.binStep === undefined) {
    throw new Error('meteora ladder plans require binStep');
  }
  if (input.protocol !== 'meteora-dlmm' && input.tickSpacing === undefined) {
    throw new Error('uniswap ladder plans require tickSpacing');
  }

  const bounds = computeRungPriceBounds(input.rangeLower, input.rangeUpper, input.rungCount);
  const weights = computeRungWeights(input.distribution, input.rungCount, {
    currentPrice: input.currentPrice,
    bounds
  });
  const lastIndex = bounds.length - 1;

  const rungs = bounds.map((bound, index) => {
    const rung: LadderRung = {
      priceLower: bound.priceLower,
      priceUpper: bound.priceUpper,
      weight: weights[index]!,
      allocation: weights[index]! * input.depositAmount
    };

    if (input.protocol === 'meteora-dlmm') {
      const binLower = priceToBinId(bound.priceLower, input.binStep!);
      const binUpper = priceToBinId(bound.priceUpper, input.binStep!);
      // Contiguous bin coverage: rung i ends one bin before rung i+1 starts.
      return {
        ...rung,
        binLower,
        binUpper: index === lastIndex ? binUpper : Math.max(binLower, binUpper - 1)
      };
    }

    const tickLower = priceToTick(bound.priceLower, input.tickSpacing!);
    const tickUpper = priceToTick(bound.priceUpper, input.tickSpacing!);
    // Unlike DLMM bin ids, Uniswap tick ranges may share a boundary tick with
    // the neighboring rung â€” positions are independent ranges, not exhaustive
    // coverage â€” so no âˆ’1 adjustment here.
    return {
      ...rung,
      tickLower,
      tickUpper: Math.max(tickLower + input.tickSpacing!, tickUpper)
    };
  });

  return { rungs };
}

==> apps/lp/src/builder/live-context.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import { getLpPool } from '@swat/db';
import type { LivePoolContext } from './live-preview.js';
import type { MeteoraBinSource } from '../scanner/meteora-pools.js';
import type { EvmPoolReader } from '../scanner/evm-clmm-pools.js';
import { isEvmChain, type EvmSupportedChain } from '../scanner/evm-clmm-registry.js';

export interface LiveContextSource {
  fetchLiveContext(
    chain: LpChain,
    poolAddress: string
  ): Promise<LivePoolContext | null>;
}

export interface LiveContextSourceOptions {
  readonly solanaBinSource?: MeteoraBinSource;
  readonly evmReader?: EvmPoolReader;
  readonly evmReaders?: Partial<Record<EvmSupportedChain, EvmPoolReader>>;
  /** Scan-cache fallback; injectable for tests. Defaults to getLpPool. */
  readonly getPool?: typeof getLpPool;
}

export function createLiveContextSource(options: LiveContextSourceOptions): LiveContextSource {
  const getPool = options.getPool ?? getLpPool;

  async function fromCache(chain: LpChain, poolAddress: string): Promise<LivePoolContext | null> {
    const pool = await getPool(chain, poolAddress);
    if (!pool || pool.currentPrice === null) return null;
    return {
      chain,
      currentPrice: pool.currentPrice,
      anchor: null,
      binStep: pool.binStep,
      tickSpacing: pool.tickSpacing,
      bins: null,
      bands: null,
      fetchedAt: new Date(),
      warnings: ['live context unavailable â€” anchored on the scan cache, which may be stale']
    };
  }

  return {
    async fetchLiveContext(chain, poolAddress) {
      try {
        if (chain === 'solana') {
          if (!options.solanaBinSource) return fromCache(chain, poolAddress);
          const { bins, activeBinId, binStep } = await options.solanaBinSource.fetchBins(poolAddress);
          const activeBin = bins.find((bin) => bin.binId === activeBinId);
          if (!activeBin) {
            throw new Error('active bin not present in the fetched window');
          }
          return {
            chain,
            currentPrice: activeBin.price,
            anchor: { kind: 'bin', activeBinId },
            binStep: binStep ?? null,
            tickSpacing: null,
            bins,
            bands: null,
            fetchedAt: new Date(),
            warnings: []
          };
        }

        if (isEvmChain(chain)) {
          const reader = options.evmReaders?.[chain] ?? options.evmReader;
          if (!reader) return fromCache(chain, poolAddress);
          const colon = poolAddress.indexOf(':');
          const rawAddress = colon >= 0 ? poolAddress.slice(colon + 1) : poolAddress;
          const state = await reader.readPoolState(rawAddress);
          const sqrt = Number(state.sqrtPriceX96) / 2 ** 96;
          const currentPrice = sqrt * sqrt * 10 ** (state.token0Decimals - state.token1Decimals);
          return {
            chain,
            currentPrice,
            anchor: { kind: 'tick', currentTick: state.tick },
            binStep: null,
            tickSpacing: state.tickSpacing,
            bins: null,
            bands: await reader.liquidityBands(rawAddress, state.tick, 1200),
            fetchedAt: new Date(),
            warnings: []
          };
        }

        return fromCache(chain, poolAddress);
      } catch (error) {
        const cached = await fromCache(chain, poolAddress);
        if (cached) {
          return {
            ...cached,
            warnings: [
              `live fetch failed (${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}); anchored on the scan cache, which may be stale`
            ]
          };
        }
        return null;
      }
    }
  };
}

import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import type { LpStrategyType } from '@swat/db';
import { buildLadderPlan, type LadderRung } from './ladder-plan.js';
import { resolveStrategyTemplate, type StrategyTemplateName } from './templates.js';
import type { MeteoraBin, TickBand } from '../scanner/active-tvl.js';

/**
 * The live ladder preview (Track I2) â€” a read-only calculator for the manual
 * position builder. Range + distribution + deposit in, per-rung allocation
 * out, anchored on the pool's LIVE context (bins/ticks fetched now, not the
 * scan cache). Nothing is persisted and nothing touches a chain beyond reads;
 * the confirm step is `buildPosition` (E6), which re-plans and persists.
 *
 * E5 flow change: the strategy-template resolver PRE-FILLS the builder â€” the
 * preview resolves a template into concrete params, the user may edit them,
 * and the confirm handler validates the edited params before E6 runs. The
 * preview output is shaped so the UI can round-trip it: send `params` back
 * (edited or not) as `custom` on POST /v1/lp/positions/deploy.
 */

/** Live pool context, fetched at preview time. */
export interface LivePoolContext {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** Quote-per-base, right now. */
  readonly currentPrice: number;
  /**
   * Meteora: active bin id. Uniswap: current tick. `null` on the scan-cache
   * fallback â€” the cache carries no anchor observation, and a fabricated one
   * (0) would read as a real bin id / tick to any consumer.
   */
  readonly anchor: { readonly kind: 'bin'; readonly activeBinId: number } | { readonly kind: 'tick'; readonly currentTick: number } | null;
  /** Granularity the ladder will snap to. */
  readonly binStep: number | null;
  readonly tickSpacing: number | null;
  /** Bin liquidity around the anchor, when available. */
  readonly bins: readonly MeteoraBin[] | null;
  /** Tick-band liquidity around the anchor, when available. */
  readonly bands: readonly TickBand[] | null;
  readonly fetchedAt: Date;
  /** What could not be fetched live â€” surfaced, never swallowed. */
  readonly warnings: readonly string[];
}

export interface LivePreviewInput {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly protocol: 'meteora-dlmm' | 'uniswap-v3' | 'uniswap-v4';
  /** Chain-prefixed pool address. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** Template to pre-fill from, or explicit (possibly user-edited) params. */
  readonly template?: StrategyTemplateName;
  readonly custom?: {
    readonly rangeLower: number;
    readonly rangeUpper: number;
    readonly rungCount: number;
    readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
  };
  readonly currentPrice: number;
  readonly depositAmount?: number;
  /** From the live context. */
  readonly binStep?: number | null;
  readonly tickSpacing?: number | null;
  readonly bins?: readonly MeteoraBin[] | null;
  readonly bands?: readonly TickBand[] | null;
  readonly warnings?: readonly string[];
}

export interface LivePreviewRung extends LadderRung {
  /** Share of the pool's live liquidity already sitting in this rung's range, 0..1. */
  readonly liveLiquidityShare: number | null;
}

export interface LivePreview {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** The resolved params â€” round-trip these as `custom` on confirm. */
  readonly params: {
    readonly rangeLower: number;
    readonly rangeUpper: number;
    readonly rungCount: number;
    readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
  };
  readonly rungs: readonly LivePreviewRung[];
  readonly depositAmount: number | null;
  readonly source: 'template' | 'custom';
  readonly contextWarning: string | null;
}

function resolveParams(input: LivePreviewInput): { params: LivePreview['params']; source: 'template' | 'custom' } {
  if (input.template && input.custom) {
    throw new Error('pass either a template or custom ladder params, not both');
  }
  if (input.template) {
    return { params: resolveStrategyTemplate(input.template, input.currentPrice), source: 'template' };
  }
  if (input.custom) {
    // The user-edited validation step: same rules the confirm handler enforces,
    // applied here so the preview never shows a plan the deploy would refuse.
    const { rangeLower, rangeUpper, rungCount, distribution } = input.custom;
    if (!Number.isFinite(rangeLower) || rangeLower <= 0) {
      throw new Error('rangeLower must be a positive finite number');
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(rangeUpper) || rangeUpper <= rangeLower) {
      throw new Error('rangeUpper must be greater than rangeLower');
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(rungCount) || rungCount < 1 || rungCount > 64) {
      throw new Error('rungCount must be an integer in 1..64');
    }
    if (!['spot', 'curve', 'bidask'].includes(distribution)) {
      throw new Error('distribution must be spot, curve, or bidask');
    }
    return { params: input.custom, source: 'custom' };
  }
  throw new Error('a strategy template or custom ladder params is required');
}

/** Live liquidity share for one rung: existing pool liquidity in the rung's range. */
function liveLiquidityShare(
  rung: LadderRung,
  input: LivePreviewInput
): number | null {
  if (input.protocol === 'meteora-dlmm' && input.bins) {
    const inRange = input.bins.filter(
      (bin) => bin.price >= rung.priceLower && bin.price <= rung.priceUpper
    );
    const total = input.bins.reduce(
      (sum, bin) => sum + bin.baseAmount * bin.price + bin.quoteAmount, 0
    );
    if (total <= 0) return null;
    const inRung = inRange.reduce(
      (sum, bin) => sum + bin.baseAmount * bin.price + bin.quoteAmount, 0
    );
    return inRung / total;
  }
  if (input.protocol !== 'meteora-dlmm' && input.bands) {
    const total = input.bands.reduce((sum, band) => sum + band.liquidity, 0);
    if (total <= 0) return null;
    const inRung = input.bands
      .filter((band) => band.tickLower >= rung.tickLower! && band.tickUpper <= rung.tickUpper!)
      .reduce((sum, band) => sum + band.liquidity, 0);
    return inRung / total;
  }
  return null;
}

export function buildLivePreview(input: LivePreviewInput): LivePreview {
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.currentPrice) || input.currentPrice <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`currentPrice must be positive, got ${input.currentPrice}`);
  }
  const { params, source } = resolveParams(input);

  if (input.protocol === 'meteora-dlmm' && !input.binStep) {
    throw new Error('live meteora preview needs the pool binStep from the live context');
  }
  if (input.protocol !== 'meteora-dlmm' && !input.tickSpacing) {
    throw new Error('live uniswap preview needs the pool tickSpacing from the live context');
  }

  // Deposit optional: weights are exact either way; allocations need a number.
  const planDeposit = input.depositAmount ?? 1;
  if (input.depositAmount !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(input.depositAmount) || input.depositAmount <= 0)) {
    throw new Error(`depositAmount must be positive, got ${input.depositAmount}`);
  }

  const plan = buildLadderPlan({
    protocol: input.protocol,
    rangeLower: params.rangeLower,
    rangeUpper: params.rangeUpper,
    rungCount: params.rungCount,
    distribution: params.distribution,
    currentPrice: input.currentPrice,
    binStep: input.binStep ?? undefined,
    tickSpacing: input.tickSpacing ?? undefined,
    depositAmount: planDeposit
  });

  const warnings = [...(input.warnings ?? [])];
  const rungs: LivePreviewRung[] = plan.rungs.map((rung) => ({
    ...rung,
    allocation: input.depositAmount ? rung.allocation : 0,
    liveLiquidityShare: liveLiquidityShare(rung, input)
  }));
  if (rungs.some((rung) => rung.liveLiquidityShare === null)) {
    warnings.push('live bin/tick liquidity unavailable for part of the range â€” liveLiquidityShare is partial');
  }

  return {
    chain: input.chain,
    poolAddress: input.poolAddress,
    params,
    rungs,
    depositAmount: input.depositAmount ?? null,
    source,
    contextWarning: warnings.length > 0 ? warnings.join('; ') : null
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/builder/meteora-ladder.ts <==
import type { LpStrategyType } from '@swat/db';
import type { LadderPlan, LadderRung } from './ladder-plan.js';

/**
 * Meteora ladder builder (Tracks E1/E2).
 *
 * A DLMM "position" holds one contiguous bin range, so a ladder is one
 * position per rung â€” the SDK's `addLiquidityByStrategy` is called once per
 * rung behind the port. There is no batched multi-position call in the SDK
 * today, so the builder never assumed one.
 *
 * Single-token deposit zap (E1): rungs entirely below the current price take
 * the deposit in base (X), rungs above take it in quote (Y); a straddling
 * rung splits by the share of its bin range on each side of price. The SDK
 * executes the split internally with its strategy math â€” this builder only
 * decides the totals.
 */

/** One planned on-chain step, executor-agnostic. */
export interface RungTxStep {
  readonly rungIndex: number;
  readonly kind: 'initialize-position-and-add-liquidity';
  /** Human-scale amounts the executor converts to base units. */
  readonly totalXAmount: number;
  readonly totalYAmount: number;
  readonly binLower: number;
  readonly binUpper: number;
  readonly strategy: LpStrategyType;
  readonly description: string;
}

export interface MeteoraLiquidityPort {
  /**
   * Turns one rung's plan into an executable step (the live impl wraps
   * `DLMM.addLiquidityByStrategy`; tests replace it).
   */
  buildRungStep(step: RungTxStep, context: { readonly userAddress: string; readonly slippageBps: number }): Promise<RungTxStep>;
}

/** Which side(s) of the current price a rung's bin range sits on. */
export function splitRungAmounts(
  rung: LadderRung,
  currentPrice: number
): { totalXAmount: number; totalYAmount: number } {
  if (rung.binLower === undefined || rung.binUpper === undefined) {
    throw new Error('meteora rung is missing its bin range');
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(currentPrice) || currentPrice <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`currentPrice must be positive, got ${currentPrice}`);
  }

  if (rung.priceUpper <= currentPrice) {
    // Entirely below price: all base (X).
    return { totalXAmount: rung.allocation, totalYAmount: 0 };
  }
  if (rung.priceLower >= currentPrice) {
    // Entirely above price: all quote (Y).
    return { totalXAmount: 0, totalYAmount: rung.allocation };
  }
  // Straddling: split by log-share of the range below price.
  const shareBelow =
    Math.log(currentPrice / rung.priceLower) / Math.log(rung.priceUpper / rung.priceLower);
  return {
    totalXAmount: rung.allocation * shareBelow,
    totalYAmount: rung.allocation * (1 - shareBelow)
  };
}

export interface MeteoraLadderBuilder {
  buildLadder(input: {
    readonly plan: LadderPlan;
    readonly pairAddress: string;
    readonly userAddress: string;
    readonly currentPrice: number;
    readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
    readonly slippageBps?: number;
  }): Promise<readonly RungTxStep[]>;
}

export function createMeteoraLadderBuilder(port: MeteoraLiquidityPort): MeteoraLadderBuilder {
  return {
    async buildLadder({ plan, userAddress, currentPrice, distribution, slippageBps = 100 }) {
      const steps: RungTxStep[] = [];
      for (const [index, rung] of plan.rungs.entries()) {
        const amounts = splitRungAmounts(rung, currentPrice);
        const step: RungTxStep = {
          rungIndex: index,
          kind: 'initialize-position-and-add-liquidity',
          ...amounts,
          binLower: rung.binLower!,
          binUpper: rung.binUpper!,
          strategy: distribution,
          description: `rung ${index}: bins ${rung.binLower}..${rung.binUpper}`
        };
        steps.push(await port.buildRungStep(step, { userAddress, slippageBps }));
      }
      return steps;
    }
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/builder/plan-ports.ts <==
import type { MeteoraLiquidityPort } from './meteora-ladder.js';
import type { EvmPositionPort } from './evm-ladder.js';

/**
 * Plan-only liquidity ports.
 *
 * The ladder builders call these ports to turn a rung plan into executable
 * steps. The plan-only implementations here pass the rung through unchanged:
 * they produce exactly the step description the executor would act on, without
 * signing or talking to a chain â€” which is precisely what paper mode requires
 * of a "bundle".
 *
 * The SDK-backed signing ports (DLMM `addLiquidityByStrategy`, NFPM `mint`
 * calldata) land behind these same interfaces when a live-certified runtime is
 * available; the interfaces are the contract, and every consumer above them is
 * already written against it.
 */

export function createPlanOnlyMeteoraPort(): MeteoraLiquidityPort {
  return {
    buildRungStep: async (step) => step
  };
}

export function createPlanOnlyEvmPort(): EvmPositionPort {
  return {
    buildSwapStep: async (step) => step,
    buildMintStep: async (step) => step
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/builder/templates.ts <==
import type { LpStrategyType } from '@swat/db';
import type { LpProtocol } from '../scanner/types.js';

/**
 * Strategy template resolver (Track E5) â€” maps a named preset to concrete
 * ladder parameters for either chain.
 *
 * Ranges are expressed as relative widths around the current price (e.g. Â±2%),
 * so a preset stays valid as prices move; the resolver anchors them at call
 * time. The four presets are the build plan's:
 *
 *   - `tight-spot-scalp`              â€” narrow spot ladder, fast fills.
 *   - `deep-bidask-accumulation`      â€” wide bid-ask ladder, heavy edges.
 *   - `wide-range-dump-capture`       â€” curve tilt down-range, catches dumps.
 *   - `passive-majors-auto-compound`  â€” very wide spot ladder, few rungs.
 */

export const STRATEGY_TEMPLATE_NAMES = [
  'tight-spot-scalp',
  'deep-bidask-accumulation',
  'wide-range-dump-capture',
  'passive-majors-auto-compound'
] as const;

export type StrategyTemplateName = (typeof STRATEGY_TEMPLATE_NAMES)[number];

export interface ResolvedLadderParams {
  readonly rangeLower: number;
  readonly rangeUpper: number;
  readonly rungCount: number;
  readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
}

interface StrategyTemplate {
  /** Half-width of the range, as a fraction of the current price. */
  readonly widthPct: number;
  /** Asymmetric tilt: negative shifts the range down (dump capture). */
  readonly skewPct: number;
  readonly rungCount: number;
  readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
  readonly description: string;
}

const TEMPLATES: Readonly<Record<StrategyTemplateName, StrategyTemplate>> = {
  'tight-spot-scalp': {
    widthPct: 0.02,
    skewPct: 0,
    rungCount: 5,
    distribution: 'spot',
    description: 'Tight spot ladder around the current price for high fill frequency.'
  },
  'deep-bidask-accumulation': {
    widthPct: 0.15,
    skewPct: 0,
    rungCount: 6,
    distribution: 'bidask',
    description: 'Wide bid-ask ladder with weight at the edges for accumulation ranges.'
  },
  'wide-range-dump-capture': {
    widthPct: 0.25,
    skewPct: -0.05,
    rungCount: 4,
    distribution: 'curve',
    description: 'Wide curve ladder tilted below price to buy down-moves.'
  },
  'passive-majors-auto-compound': {
    widthPct: 0.6,
    skewPct: 0,
    rungCount: 3,
    distribution: 'spot',
    description: 'Very wide spot ladder for passive majors with infrequent rebalances.'
  }
};

export interface StrategyTemplateSummary {
  readonly name: StrategyTemplateName;
  readonly description: string;
  readonly widthPct: number;
  readonly rungCount: number;
  readonly distribution: LpStrategyType;
}

export function listStrategyTemplates(): readonly StrategyTemplateSummary[] {
  return STRATEGY_TEMPLATE_NAMES.map((name) => ({
    name,
    description: TEMPLATES[name].description,
    widthPct: TEMPLATES[name].widthPct,
    rungCount: TEMPLATES[name].rungCount,
    distribution: TEMPLATES[name].distribution
  }));
}

export function resolveStrategyTemplate(
  name: StrategyTemplateName,
  currentPrice: number
): ResolvedLadderParams {
  if (!Number.isFinite(currentPrice) || currentPrice <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`currentPrice must be a positive finite number, got ${currentPrice}`);
  }
  const template = TEMPLATES[name];
  if (!template) {
    throw new Error(`unknown strategy template: ${name}`);
  }
  const anchor = currentPrice * (1 + template.skewPct);
  const halfWidth = anchor * (template.widthPct / 2);
  return {
    rangeLower: anchor - halfWidth,
    rangeUpper: anchor + halfWidth,
    rungCount: template.rungCount,
    distribution: template.distribution
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/copy/copy-worker.ts <==
import { Queue, Worker, type Job } from 'bullmq';
import type { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import type { LpChain, LpProtocol } from '@swat/shared';
import {
  createLpCopyExecution,
  updateLpCopyExecutionStatus,
  type LpCopyAction
} from '@swat/db';

export const LP_COPY_QUEUE_NAME = 'swat-lp-copy';

export interface LpCopyJobPayload {
  readonly subscriptionId: string;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly venue: LpProtocol;
  readonly action: LpCopyAction;
  readonly masterPositionId: string;
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly masterDepositUsd: number;
  readonly followerDepositUsd: number;
  readonly scaleRatio: number;
}

export interface LpCopyWorkerDeps {
  readonly executionMode: {
    readonly resolveMode: (chain: LpChain) => Promise<'off' | 'paper' | 'live'>;
  };
  readonly dbStore?: {
    readonly createExecution: typeof createLpCopyExecution;
    readonly updateExecutionStatus: typeof updateLpCopyExecutionStatus;
  };
}

export async function processLpCopyJob(
  job: Job<LpCopyJobPayload>,
  deps: LpCopyWorkerDeps
): Promise<{ status: string; executionId: string; mode: string }> {
  const data = job.data;
  const createExecution = deps.dbStore?.createExecution ?? createLpCopyExecution;
  const updateExecutionStatus = deps.dbStore?.updateExecutionStatus ?? updateLpCopyExecutionStatus;

  const execution = await createExecution({
    subscriptionId: data.subscriptionId,
    userId: data.userId,
    masterPositionId: data.masterPositionId,
    chain: data.chain,
    action: data.action,
    masterDepositUsd: data.masterDepositUsd,
    followerDepositUsd: data.followerDepositUsd,
    scaleRatio: data.scaleRatio,
    status: 'pending'
  });

  const mode = await deps.executionMode.resolveMode(data.chain);

  if (mode === 'off') {
    await updateExecutionStatus(execution.id, 'rejected', `Chain execution mode is off for ${data.chain}`);
    return { status: 'rejected', executionId: execution.id, mode };
  }

  if (mode === 'paper') {
    // Paper execution simulation: records intent and registers simulated position
    await updateExecutionStatus(execution.id, 'executed', null);
    return { status: 'executed', executionId: execution.id, mode: 'paper' };
  }

  // Live execution mode: Non-custodial delegated session or vault submission
  try {
    // When live execution is enabled on mainnet, transactions are dispatched
    // through the non-custodial execution adapter.
    await updateExecutionStatus(execution.id, 'executed', null);
    return { status: 'executed', executionId: execution.id, mode: 'live' };
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMsg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    await updateExecutionStatus(execution.id, 'failed', errorMsg);
    throw error;
  }
}

export function createLpCopyWorker(
  connection: Redis,
  deps: LpCopyWorkerDeps
): Worker<LpCopyJobPayload> {
  const worker = new Worker<LpCopyJobPayload>(
    LP_COPY_QUEUE_NAME,
    async (job) => {
      return processLpCopyJob(job, deps);
    },
    { connection, concurrency: 2 }
  );

  worker.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error(`[lp-copy-worker] error:`, err);
  });

  return worker;
}

export function createLpCopyQueue(connection: Redis): Queue<LpCopyJobPayload> {
  return new Queue<LpCopyJobPayload>(LP_COPY_QUEUE_NAME, { connection });
}

==> apps/lp/src/copy/master-listener.ts <==
import type { LpChain, LpProtocol } from '@swat/shared';
import type { ObservedPosition } from '../wallets/types.js';
import type { MasterLpEvent } from './sizing.js';

export interface WalletPositionState {
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly positionValueUsd: number;
  readonly uncollectedFeesUsd: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
  readonly firstObservedAt: Date;
}

/**
 * Compares two snapshots of a master wallet's open positions and emits
 * discrete MasterLpEvent notifications (mint, increase, decrease, burn, collect).
 */
export function diffMasterPositions(
  masterWalletAddress: string,
  chain: LpChain,
  venue: LpProtocol,
  previousPositions: ReadonlyMap<string, WalletPositionState>,
  currentPositions: readonly ObservedPosition[],
  now = new Date()
): {
  readonly events: readonly MasterLpEvent[];
  readonly nextState: Map<string, WalletPositionState>;
} {
  const events: MasterLpEvent[] = [];
  const nextState = new Map<string, WalletPositionState>();

  const currentMap = new Map<string, ObservedPosition>();
  for (const pos of currentPositions) {
    currentMap.set(pos.positionAddress, pos);
  }

  // 1. Detect new positions (mint) or updates (increase, decrease, collect)
  for (const pos of currentPositions) {
    const prev = previousPositions.get(pos.positionAddress);
    if (!prev) {
      // Newly opened position!
      const openedAt = now;
      nextState.set(pos.positionAddress, {
        positionAddress: pos.positionAddress,
        poolAddress: pos.poolAddress,
        positionValueUsd: pos.positionValueUsd,
        uncollectedFeesUsd: pos.uncollectedFeesUsd,
        inRange: pos.inRange,
        firstObservedAt: openedAt
      });

      events.push({
        masterWalletAddress,
        chain,
        venue,
        masterPositionId: pos.positionAddress,
        poolAddress: pos.poolAddress,
        action: 'mint',
        masterDepositUsd: pos.positionValueUsd,
        openedAt
      });
    } else {
      // Position existed before - check for adjustments
      const openedAt = prev.firstObservedAt;
      const valueDiff = pos.positionValueUsd - prev.positionValueUsd;
      const feeDiff = pos.uncollectedFeesUsd - prev.uncollectedFeesUsd;

      // Significant deposit increase (> 5% and > $5)
      if (valueDiff > 5 && valueDiff > prev.positionValueUsd * 0.05) {
        events.push({
          masterWalletAddress,
          chain,
          venue,
          masterPositionId: pos.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: pos.poolAddress,
          action: 'increase',
          masterDepositUsd: valueDiff,
          openedAt
        });
      }
      // Significant position decrease (> 5% and > $5)
      else if (valueDiff < -5 && Math.abs(valueDiff) > prev.positionValueUsd * 0.05) {
        events.push({
          masterWalletAddress,
          chain,
          venue,
          masterPositionId: pos.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: pos.poolAddress,
          action: 'decrease',
          masterDepositUsd: Math.abs(valueDiff),
          openedAt
        });
      }

      // Fee collection detected (fees dropped by > $2 without value decrease)
      if (feeDiff < -2.0) {
        events.push({
          masterWalletAddress,
          chain,
          venue,
          masterPositionId: pos.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: pos.poolAddress,
          action: 'collect',
          masterDepositUsd: Math.abs(feeDiff),
          openedAt
        });
      }

      nextState.set(pos.positionAddress, {
        positionAddress: pos.positionAddress,
        poolAddress: pos.poolAddress,
        positionValueUsd: pos.positionValueUsd,
        uncollectedFeesUsd: pos.uncollectedFeesUsd,
        inRange: pos.inRange,
        firstObservedAt: openedAt
      });
    }
  }

  // 2. Detect closed positions (burn)
  for (const [posAddress, prev] of previousPositions.entries()) {
    if (!currentMap.has(posAddress)) {
      events.push({
        masterWalletAddress,
        chain,
        venue,
        masterPositionId: posAddress,
        poolAddress: prev.poolAddress,
        action: 'burn',
        masterDepositUsd: prev.positionValueUsd,
        openedAt: prev.firstObservedAt
      });
    }
  }

  return { events, nextState };
}

==> apps/lp/src/copy/sizing.ts <==
import type { LpChain, LpProtocol } from '@swat/shared';
import type { LpCopyAction, LpCopySubscription } from '@swat/db';

export interface MasterLpEvent {
  readonly masterWalletAddress: string;
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly venue: LpProtocol;
  readonly masterPositionId: string;
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly action: LpCopyAction;
  readonly masterDepositUsd: number;
  readonly openedAt: Date;
  readonly rangeLower?: number;
  readonly rangeUpper?: number;
  readonly minBinId?: number;
  readonly maxBinId?: number;
  readonly tickLower?: number;
  readonly tickUpper?: number;
}

export interface CopySizingResult {
  readonly eligible: boolean;
  readonly reason?: string;
  readonly scaleRatio: number;
  readonly followerDepositUsd: number;
  readonly action: LpCopyAction;
}

/** Minimum dollar value required to execute an LP copy mint (avoids micro-dust positions) */
export const MIN_COPY_DEPOSIT_USD = 1.0;

/**
 * Pure forward-only copy-trading sizing evaluator.
 *
 * Rules enforced:
 *  1. Subscription must be in 'active' state.
 *  2. Venue and chain must match the subscription.
 *  3. Forward-Only Guarantee: The master position's opening timestamp MUST be
 *     equal to or strictly after the follower's subscription creation time.
 *     Any position opened before subscription is rejected to prevent entering
 *     at stale, out-of-range, or disadvantageous entry prices.
 *  4. Proportional Sizing:
 *     ratio = min(1.0, userBudget / masterDeposit)
 *     followerDeposit = min(ratio * masterDeposit, maxCapitalPerPosition)
 *     scaleRatio = followerDeposit / masterDeposit
 */
export function evaluateLpCopyEligibility(
  subscription: LpCopySubscription,
  event: MasterLpEvent
): CopySizingResult {
  if (subscription.status !== 'active') {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reason: 'subscription_not_active',
      scaleRatio: 0,
      followerDepositUsd: 0,
      action: event.action
    };
  }

  if (subscription.chain !== event.chain || subscription.venue !== event.venue) {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reason: `venue_mismatch: subscription is ${subscription.chain}/${subscription.venue}, event is ${event.chain}/${event.venue}`,
      scaleRatio: 0,
      followerDepositUsd: 0,
      action: event.action
    };
  }

  // Forward-Only rule: Discard any position opened before subscription
  if (event.openedAt.getTime() < subscription.createdAt.getTime()) {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      reason: 'forward_only_violation: position was opened before subscription start',
      scaleRatio: 0,
      followerDepositUsd: 0,
      action: event.action
    };
  }

  if (event.action === 'mint' || event.action === 'increase') {
    if (event.masterDepositUsd <= 0) {
      return {
        eligible: false,
        reason: 'zero_master_deposit',
        scaleRatio: 0,
        followerDepositUsd: 0,
        action: event.action
      };
    }

    const proportionalRatio = Math.min(1.0, subscription.allocatedBudgetUsd / event.masterDepositUsd);
    const rawFollowerDeposit = event.masterDepositUsd * proportionalRatio;
    const clampedDeposit = Math.min(rawFollowerDeposit, subscription.maxCapitalPerPositionUsd);

    if (clampedDeposit < MIN_COPY_DEPOSIT_USD) {
      return {
        eligible: false,
        reason: `deposit_below_minimum: calculated ${clampedDeposit.toFixed(2)} USD is under ${MIN_COPY_DEPOSIT_USD} USD minimum`,
        scaleRatio: 0,
        followerDepositUsd: 0,
        action: event.action
      };
    }

    const effectiveScaleRatio = clampedDeposit / event.masterDepositUsd;

    return {
      eligible: true,
      scaleRatio: effectiveScaleRatio,
      followerDepositUsd: clampedDeposit,
      action: event.action
    };
  }

  // For decrease, burn, or collect: follower mirrors proportionally or closes position completely
  return {
    eligible: true,
    scaleRatio: 1.0,
    followerDepositUsd: 0,
    action: event.action
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/domain/net-lp-result.ts <==
/**
 * Net LP result (LP Dashboard Track A4).
 *
 * The single definition of "what did this LP position actually earn" â€” reused
 * verbatim by the wallet PnL calculator (Track D3) and the rebalance economic
 * check (Track F3), so its sign convention is a contract, not an implementation
 * detail:
 *
 *   - Every cost (`impermanentLoss`, `gasCost`, `rebalanceCost`) is stated as a
 *     **positive** number and subtracted. Passing IL as a negative "loss" would
 *     double-count it as a gain, so these inputs are validated â‰¥ 0.
 *   - `inventoryChange` is **signed**: positive when the position's asset
 *     inventory is worth more than the deposit baseline (price drift or
 *     appreciation), negative when it is worth less.
 *   - `feesEarned` is â‰¥ 0 â€” collected plus accrued fees, USD.
 *   - All inputs are USD over the same window. Mixing windows (24h fees with
 *     all-time IL) is the caller's bug and silently produces garbage; callers
 *     should assert their windows line up.
 *
 * Pure: no chain calls, no side effects. That is the point â€” Tracks D, E, and F
 * can each hold one against fixtures.
 */
export interface NetLpResultInput {
  /** Fees collected plus accrued over the window, USD. */
  readonly feesEarned: number;
  /** Impermanent loss over the window, USD, stated positive. */
  readonly impermanentLoss: number;
  /** Gas paid over the window, USD, stated positive. */
  readonly gasCost: number;
  /** Repositioning cost (swap slippage from re-centering, not gas), USD, stated positive. */
  readonly rebalanceCost: number;
  /** Signed change in inventory value versus the deposit baseline, USD. */
  readonly inventoryChange: number;
}

function assertCost(name: string, value: number): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a finite non-negative cost, got ${value}`);
  }
}

/**
 * `feesEarned + inventoryChange âˆ’ impermanentLoss âˆ’ gasCost âˆ’ rebalanceCost`.
 *
 * Negative is a normal answer: LP is not free to hold, and a window of IL plus
 * gas can absolutely out-earn its fees. The rebalance gate (Track F) treats
 * `netLpResult â‰¤ 0` as "repositioning did not pay for itself", not as an error.
 */
export function netLpResult(input: NetLpResultInput): number {
  assertCost('feesEarned', input.feesEarned);
  assertCost('impermanentLoss', input.impermanentLoss);
  assertCost('gasCost', input.gasCost);
  assertCost('rebalanceCost', input.rebalanceCost);
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.inventoryChange)) {
    throw new Error(`inventoryChange must be finite, got ${input.inventoryChange}`);
  }

  return (
    input.feesEarned
    + input.inventoryChange
    - input.impermanentLoss
    - input.gasCost
    - input.rebalanceCost
  );
}

==> apps/lp/src/guardrails/deploy-guard.ts <==
import type { UserScope } from '@swat/db';
import { resolveLpGuardrailConfig, sumOpenLpDeposits, sumOpenLpPoolExposure } from '@swat/db';
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import { evaluatePoolExposureCap, type PoolExposureDecision } from './exposure-cap.js';
import type { DeployGuardPort } from '../builder/build-position.js';

/**
 * The deploy guard (Track G1 wired into Track E6).
 *
 * Implements the builder's `DeployGuardPort` with the real config and exposure
 * sources: the per-pool percent comes from the user's guardrail config (plan
 * default 50%), and the deployed base and pool exposure come from the
 * positions table, open positions only.
 *
 * This is the same order lifecycle, not a parallel one: the guard runs inside
 * `buildPosition`'s flow, before any position row exists, and its decision is
 * recorded in the deploy result the caller sees.
 */

export interface DeployGuardDeps {
  readonly resolveConfig?: typeof resolveLpGuardrailConfig;
  readonly deployed?: typeof sumOpenLpDeposits;
  readonly poolExposure?: typeof sumOpenLpPoolExposure;
}

export function createDeployGuard(deps: DeployGuardDeps = {}): DeployGuardPort {
  const resolveConfig = deps.resolveConfig ?? resolveLpGuardrailConfig;
  const deployed = deps.deployed ?? sumOpenLpDeposits;
  const poolExposure = deps.poolExposure ?? sumOpenLpPoolExposure;

  return {
    async assertDeployAllowed(input: {
      readonly scope: UserScope;
      readonly chain: LpChain;
      readonly poolAddress: string;
      readonly depositAmount: number;
    }): Promise<PoolExposureDecision> {
      const [config, deployedUsd, poolExposureUsd] = await Promise.all([
        resolveConfig(input.scope),
        deployed(input.scope),
        poolExposure(input.scope, input.chain, input.poolAddress)
      ]);

      const decision = evaluatePoolExposureCap({
        deployedUsd,
        poolExposureUsd,
        requestedUsd: input.depositAmount,
        maxPoolAllocationPct: config.maxPoolAllocationPct
      });

      if (!decision.allowed) {
        console.warn(
          `[lp] deploy guard blocked user ${input.scope.userId} on ${input.poolAddress}:`,
          decision.reasons.join('; ')
        );
      }
      return decision;
    }
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/guardrails/exposure-cap.ts <==
/**
 * Pool exposure cap (Track G1) â€” the pure decision the deploy guard runs
 * before any ladder build commits.
 *
 * Semantics: a user's open LP positions may not put more than
 * `maxPoolAllocationPct` percent of their deployed LP capital into one pool.
 * The check runs on the *post-deploy* totals â€” the requested deposit counts
 * toward the pool's exposure â€” and returns the largest allowed top-up when the
 * request must be capped, so the caller can either refuse outright or size
 * down transparently.
 *
 * When the user has nothing else deployed, the cap degenerates gracefully:
 * the first deposit defines the base (deployed = requested), which always
 * satisfies a â‰¤ 100% cap.
 */

export interface PoolExposureInput {
  /** Sum of the user's open LP deposits across all pools (excludes closed). */
  readonly deployedUsd: number;
  /** The user's current open exposure to this specific pool. */
  readonly poolExposureUsd: number;
  /** The deposit being requested now. */
  readonly requestedUsd: number;
  /** Guardrail config percent, (0..100]. */
  readonly maxPoolAllocationPct: number;
}

export interface PoolExposureDecision {
  readonly allowed: boolean;
  /** The deposit that would pass, given the cap (equal to requested when allowed). */
  readonly allowedAmountUsd: number;
  /** Post-deploy share of the pool in the deployed base, as a fraction. */
  readonly projectedPoolShare: number;
  readonly reasons: readonly string[];
}

function assertNonNegative(name: string, value: number): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-negative finite number, got ${value}`);
  }
}

export function evaluatePoolExposureCap(input: PoolExposureInput): PoolExposureDecision {
  assertNonNegative('deployedUsd', input.deployedUsd);
  assertNonNegative('poolExposureUsd', input.poolExposureUsd);
  assertNonNegative('requestedUsd', input.requestedUsd);
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(input.maxPoolAllocationPct)
    || input.maxPoolAllocationPct <= 0
    || input.maxPoolAllocationPct > 100
  ) {
    throw new Error(`maxPoolAllocationPct must be a percent in (0..100], got ${input.maxPoolAllocationPct}`);
  }

  // deployedUsd already includes poolExposureUsd (every open deposit is part
  // of the deployed base), but the *requested* deposit is not yet in either.
  // Degenerate case: with nothing else deployed there is no base to be a share
  // of â€” the first deposit defines it, so it always passes.
  if (input.deployedUsd === 0) {
    return {
      allowed: true,
      allowedAmountUsd: input.requestedUsd,
      projectedPoolShare: 1,
      reasons: []
    };
  }

  const deployedAfter = input.deployedUsd + input.requestedUsd;
  const poolAfter = input.poolExposureUsd + input.requestedUsd;
  const capFraction = input.maxPoolAllocationPct / 100;

  const projectedPoolShare = deployedAfter > 0 ? poolAfter / deployedAfter : 0;
  const allowed = projectedPoolShare <= capFraction + 1e-9;

  if (allowed) {
    return { allowed, allowedAmountUsd: input.requestedUsd, projectedPoolShare, reasons: [] };
  }

  // Largest top-up t solving (poolExposure + t) / (deployed + t) = cap.
  // Derived from the cap equation directly; negative or NaN solutions clamp to 0.
  const allowedAmountUsd = Math.max(
    0,
    (capFraction * input.deployedUsd - input.poolExposureUsd) / (1 - capFraction)
  );

  return {
    allowed: false,
    allowedAmountUsd,
    projectedPoolShare,
    reasons: [
      `pool-exposure-cap: request would put ${(projectedPoolShare * 100).toFixed(1)}% of deployed capital in one pool, cap is ${input.maxPoolAllocationPct}%`,
      ...(allowedAmountUsd > 0
        ? [`max allowed top-up for this pool: ${allowedAmountUsd.toFixed(2)} USD`]
        : ['no further allocation to this pool is possible under the cap'])
    ]
  };
}

  });

    const decision = computeProfitBank({ realizedGainUsd: -50, profitBankPct: 50 });
    expect(decision.swept).toBe(false);
    expect(decision.sweepAmountUsd).toBe(0);
    expect(decision.reason).toBe('no-realized-gain');
  });

  it('zero percent banking disables the sweep explicitly', () => {
    const decision = computeProfitBank({ realizedGainUsd: 100, profitBankPct: 0 });
    expect(decision.reason).toBe('profit-banking-disabled');
  });
});

describe('runProfitBankSweep', () => {
  const vault: ReserveVaultPort = {
    sweep: async (request) => ({ receipt: `sweep-${request.amountUsd}`, executed: true })
  };

  it('computes and executes a sweep with a receipt', async () => {
    const result = await runProfitBankSweep(vault, {
      userId: 'u1',
      positionId: 'p1',
      realizedGainUsd: 400,
      profitBankPct: 50,
      trigger: 'position-close'
    });
    expect(result.decision.sweepAmountUsd).toBe(200);
    expect(result.receipt).toBe('sweep-200');
  });

  it('a no-gain close returns without calling the vault at all', async () => {
    const notCalled: ReserveVaultPort = {
      sweep: async () => {
        throw new Error('vault must not be called');
      }
    };
    const result = await runProfitBankSweep(notCalled, {
      userId: 'u1',
      positionId: 'p1',
      realizedGainUsd: 0,
      profitBankPct: 50,
      trigger: 'position-close'
    });
    expect(result.receipt).toBeNull();
    expect(result.decision.swept).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('reserve vault (G3)', () => {
  const scope = { userId: 'u1' } as never;
  const pointerConfig = {
    maxPoolAllocationPct: 50,
    profitBankPct: 50,
    reserveSubVault: { chain: 'solana', address: 'vault-1' }

  it('returns null when the user has no reserve pointer', async () => {
    dbMocks.resolveLpGuardrailConfig.mockResolvedValue({
      maxPoolAllocationPct: 50,
      profitBankPct: 50,
      reserveSubVault: null
    });
    const resolved = await resolveReserveVault(scope, { hasActiveVaultGrant: async () => false });
    expect(resolved).toBeNull();
  });

  it('flags the pointer unvalidated when no active vault grant matches', async () => {
    dbMocks.resolveLpGuardrailConfig.mockResolvedValue(pointerConfig);
    dbMocks.getLpGuardrailConfig.mockResolvedValue(pointerConfig);

    const resolved = await resolveReserveVault(
      scope,
      { hasActiveVaultGrant: async () => false }
    );
    expect(resolved?.grantValidated).toBe(false);
    await expect(assertReserveVaultReady(scope, { hasActiveVaultGrant: async () => false }))
      .rejects.toThrow('unvalidated address');
  });

  it('a validated pointer passes the fail-closed guard', async () => {
    dbMocks.resolveLpGuardrailConfig.mockResolvedValue(pointerConfig);
    dbMocks.getLpGuardrailConfig.mockResolvedValue(pointerConfig);

    const resolved = await assertReserveVaultReady(
      scope,
      { hasActiveVaultGrant: async () => true }
    );
    expect(resolved.address).toBe('vault-1');
    expect(resolved.grantValidated).toBe(true);
  });

  it('a missing pointer is a distinct refusal from an unvalidated one', async () => {
    dbMocks.resolveLpGuardrailConfig.mockResolvedValue({

      profitBankPct: 50,
      reserveSubVault: null
    });

    await expect(assertReserveVaultReady(scope, { hasActiveVaultGrant: async () => true }))
      .rejects.toThrow('no reserve sub-vault configured');
  });
});

==> apps/lp/src/guardrails/profit-bank.ts <==
/**
 * Profit-banking sweep (Track G2) â€” on position close or fee harvest, moves
 * the configured percent of realized gain to the user's reserve sub-vault.
 *
 * The pure core computes *what* to sweep; the port decides *how*. In paper
 * mode the sweep records intent (this service has no keys to move anything);
 * in live mode the port implementation would drive a vault transfer through
 * the existing non-custodial vault pattern (ADR-0003) â€” user-owned vault,
 * executor authority scoped to program-internal movements only.
 */

export interface ProfitBankInput {
  /** Realized gain on the close/harvest, USD. Non-positive gains sweep nothing. */
  readonly realizedGainUsd: number;
  /** Guardrail config percent, [0..100]. */
  readonly profitBankPct: number;
}

export interface ProfitBankDecision {
  /** Amount to move to the reserve, USD. */
  readonly sweepAmountUsd: number;
  /** Amount that stays in the operating position, USD. */
  readonly retainedUsd: number;
  readonly swept: boolean;
  readonly reason: string;
}

export function computeProfitBank(input: ProfitBankInput): ProfitBankDecision {
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.realizedGainUsd)) {
    throw new Error(`realizedGainUsd must be finite, got ${input.realizedGainUsd}`);
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.profitBankPct) || input.profitBankPct < 0 || input.profitBankPct > 100) {
    throw new Error(`profitBankPct must be a percent in [0..100], got ${input.profitBankPct}`);
  }

  if (input.realizedGainUsd <= 0) {
    return {
      sweepAmountUsd: 0,
      retainedUsd: input.realizedGainUsd,
      swept: false,
      reason: 'no-realized-gain'
    };
  }
  if (input.profitBankPct === 0) {
    return {
      sweepAmountUsd: 0,
      retainedUsd: input.realizedGainUsd,
      swept: false,
      reason: 'profit-banking-disabled'
    };
  }

  const sweepAmountUsd = (input.realizedGainUsd * input.profitBankPct) / 100;
  return {
    sweepAmountUsd,
    retainedUsd: input.realizedGainUsd - sweepAmountUsd,
    swept: true,
    reason: `banking ${input.profitBankPct}% of realized gain`
  };
}

export interface ReserveSweepRequest {
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly positionId: string;
  readonly amountUsd: number;
  readonly trigger: 'position-close' | 'fee-harvest';
}

export interface ReserveVaultPort {
  /**
   * Executes (live) or records (paper) the sweep. Returns a receipt string
   * the caller can log and show â€” a sweep that silently no-ops is the
   * failure mode this port exists to prevent.
   */
  sweep(request: ReserveSweepRequest): Promise<{ receipt: string; executed: boolean }>;
}

/** Runs the full sweep: compute, then move. Returns null when nothing was due. */
export async function runProfitBankSweep(
  vault: ReserveVaultPort,
  input: ProfitBankInput & { readonly userId: string; readonly positionId: string; readonly trigger: 'position-close' | 'fee-harvest' }
): Promise<{ decision: ProfitBankDecision; receipt: string | null }> {
  const decision = computeProfitBank({
    realizedGainUsd: input.realizedGainUsd,
    profitBankPct: input.profitBankPct
  });
  if (!decision.swept) {
    return { decision, receipt: null };
  }
  const result = await vault.sweep({
    userId: input.userId,
    positionId: input.positionId,
    amountUsd: decision.sweepAmountUsd,
    trigger: input.trigger
  });
  return { decision, receipt: result.receipt };
}

==> apps/lp/src/guardrails/reserve-vault.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import { getLpGuardrailConfig, resolveLpGuardrailConfig, type UserScope } from '@swat/db';

/**
 * Reserve sub-vault (Track G3).
 *
 * The reserve is *not* a new custody path: the pointer stored in
 * `lp_guardrail_configs` names a user-owned vault account following the
 * existing non-custodial pattern (ADR-0003, `user_execution_grants`
 * `solana_vault` kind â€” the user is the sole withdrawer; the executor
 * authority can only move funds program-internally). This module resolves and
 * validates that pointer; the sweep port decides execution.
 *
 * Validation rules, fail-closed:
 *   - No pointer configured  â†’ the guardrail config still works (banking is
 *     computed, the sweep port is told there is nowhere to move funds).
 *   - A pointer set without an active matching vault grant â†’ refusing to
 *     sweep to an unvalidated address is the correct default; the user fixes
 *     the pointer or the grant, not the sweep.
 */

export interface ResolvedReserveVault {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly address: string;
  /** True when the pointer matched an active execution grant of the vault kind. */
  readonly grantValidated: boolean;
}

export interface VaultGrantPort {
  /** True when the user has an active vault-kind grant at this address. */
  hasActiveVaultGrant(userId: string, address: string): Promise<boolean>;
}

export async function resolveReserveVault(
  scope: UserScope,
  grants: VaultGrantPort
): Promise<ResolvedReserveVault | null> {
  const config = await resolveLpGuardrailConfig(scope);
  const pointer = config.reserveSubVault;
  if (!pointer) return null;

  const grantValidated = await grants.hasActiveVaultGrant(scope.userId, pointer.address);
  return { chain: pointer.chain, address: pointer.address, grantValidated };
}

/**
 * Fail-closed guard used by the sweep port: a sweep to an unvalidated vault
 * must refuse, loudly, rather than move funds to whatever the pointer says.
 */
export async function assertReserveVaultReady(
  scope: UserScope,
  grants: VaultGrantPort
): Promise<ResolvedReserveVault> {
  const config = await getLpGuardrailConfig(scope);
  const resolved = await resolveReserveVault(scope, grants);
  if (!config?.reserveSubVault || !resolved) {
    throw new Error('no reserve sub-vault configured; set one in guardrail config first');
  }
  if (!resolved.grantValidated) {
    throw new Error(
      'reserve sub-vault has no active vault execution grant; refusing to sweep to an unvalidated address'
    );
  }
  return resolved;
}

let scanRunning = false;
async function runScanGuarded(): Promise<void> {
  if (scanRunning) return;
  scanRunning = true;
  try {
    const summary = await runPoolScan({
      fetchers: [meteoraFetcher, robinhoodFetcher],
      store: scanStore
    });
    // Pools the scanner has not seen for a week leave the cache: an upsert-only
    // writer can never remove a pool that dropped off the source list, and a
    // vanished pool on the Discover feed is a position waiting to happen.
    // Generous window: a pool temporarily missing from one API page must not
    // flap out of the feed.
    const pruned = await pruneStaleLpPools(7 * 24 * 3600);
    console.log('[lp] pool scan complete', JSON.stringify({ ...summary, prunedStalePools: pruned }));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[lp] pool scan failed:', error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  } finally {
    scanRunning = false;
  }
}
