describe('runMasterMetricsBatch', () => {
  function deps(overrides: Partial<MasterMetricsBatchDependencies> = {}): MasterMetricsBatchDependencies {
    return {
      listMasters: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([
        { walletAddress: 'solana:MASTER', chain: 'solana', observationStartAt: at(-48) }
      ]),
      fetchTrades: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([
        row({ direction: 'buy', amountUsd: 1000, eventAt: at(-10) }),
        row({ direction: 'sell', amountUsd: 1100, eventAt: at(-2) })
      ]),
      asOf: at(0),
      minTradesByWindow: { '24h': 1, '7d': 1, '30d': 1 },
      ...overrides
    };
  }

  it('computes one report per master and passes the fetch window through', async () => {
    const dependencies = deps();
    const result = await runMasterMetricsBatch(dependencies);

    expect(result.masters).toBe(1);
    expect(result.reports).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.failed).toBe(0);
    expect(dependencies.fetchTrades).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      walletAddress: 'solana:MASTER',
      chain: 'solana',
      since: at(-48),
      asOf: at(0)
    });
    expect(ok(result.reports[0]!.windows['24h']).pnlNetUsd).toBeCloseTo(100, 10);
  });

  it('clamps an observation start older than the lookback bound', async () => {
    const dependencies = deps({
      listMasters: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([
        { walletAddress: 'solana:MASTER', chain: 'solana', observationStartAt: at(-365 * 24) }
      ])
    });
    await runMasterMetricsBatch(dependencies);

    expect(dependencies.fetchTrades).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      since: new Date(at(0).getTime() - ROUND_TRIP_LOOKBACK_MS)
    }));
  });

  it('skips the query entirely when the observation start is unknown', async () => {
    const dependencies = deps({
      listMasters: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([
        { walletAddress: 'solana:MASTER', chain: 'solana', observationStartAt: null }
      ])
    });
    const result = await runMasterMetricsBatch(dependencies);

    expect(dependencies.fetchTrades).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result.insufficientEverywhere).toBe(1);
    expect(result.reports[0]!.observationStartAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('contains one master failure without losing the rest of the batch', async () => {
    const failing = vi.fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('boom'))
      .mockResolvedValue([
        row({ direction: 'buy', amountUsd: 1000, eventAt: at(-10) }),
        row({ direction: 'sell', amountUsd: 1100, eventAt: at(-2) })
      ]);
    const dependencies = deps({
      listMasters: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([
        { walletAddress: 'solana:BROKEN', chain: 'solana', observationStartAt: at(-48) },
        { walletAddress: 'solana:FINE', chain: 'solana', observationStartAt: at(-48) }
      ]),
      fetchTrades: failing
    });
    const errorSpy = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    const result = await runMasterMetricsBatch(dependencies);

    expect(result.masters).toBe(2);
    expect(result.failed).toBe(1);
    expect(result.reports).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.reports[0]!.walletAddress).toBe('solana:FINE');
    errorSpy.mockRestore();
  });

  it('hands each report to the optional persist hook', async () => {
    const persistReport = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    await runMasterMetricsBatch(deps({ persistReport }));
    expect(persistReport).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

==> apps/scorer/src/master-metrics.ts <==
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import { query } from '@swat/db';

/**
 * S4-M8 - out-of-sample master metrics over 24h / 7d / 30d.
 *
 * ADR-0005 section 5 is the specification. A *master* is a single wallet a user
 * copies (section 3), never a cluster, so every figure here is keyed on one
 * chain-prefixed wallet address.
 *
 * The module is split the way `stop-loss.ts` is: everything above
 * `runMasterMetricsBatch` is pure arithmetic over plain rows and is unit tested
 * without Postgres; the two `fetch*` / `list*` helpers at the bottom are the
 * only code that touches SQL, and the batch takes them as injected
 * dependencies.
 *
 * Deliberate omissions, each with a reason - a later contributor will read them
 * as oversights otherwise:
 *
 * - **No raw ROI, anywhere.** ADR-0005 section 5.1: it ranks the luckiest.
 *   `pnlNetUsd` and `pnlPerTradeUsd` are absolute dollars; the only ratio
 *   reported is drawdown, whose denominator is named in the field itself.
 * - **No follower count and no popularity figure** (ADR-0005 section 5.4,
 *   `S4-M9`). Nothing here reads a subscription count, and `capacityEstimate` is
 *   deliberately not derived from one.
 * - **`capacityEstimate` is always null.** Capacity is denominated in price
 *   impact as a fraction of usable liquidity (ADR-0005 section 4.1) and is owned
 *   by `S4-M6`. Returning null with `capacityStatus: 'deferred-to-s4-m6'` is
 *   honest; inventing a headcount-derived number would contradict section 4.1.
 */

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Windows and gating policy
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS = ['24h', '7d', '30d'] as const;
export type MasterMetricWindow = (typeof MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS)[number];

const HOUR_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;

export const WINDOW_DURATION_MS: Record<MasterMetricWindow, number> = {
  '24h': DAY_MS,
  '7d': 7 * DAY_MS,
  '30d': 30 * DAY_MS
};

/**
 * Minimum closed round trips before a window reports numbers at all
 * (ADR-0005 section 5.2). Policy values, not measurements: they scale with the
 * window because "20 trades in 24h" would gate out every master who is not a
 * bot, while "3 trades in 30d" is the noise-wearing-a-number the ADR rejects.
 * Overridable per call so the API and the nightly batch can differ.
 */
export const DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW: Record<MasterMetricWindow, number> = {
  '24h': 5,
  '7d': 10,
  '30d': 20
};

/**
 * How far back round-trip reconstruction reads. Entries older than this are not
 * fetched, so an episode opened before the bound is reported as excluded rather
 * than mismeasured. Bounds the scan for a wallet we have tracked for years.
 */
export const ROUND_TRIP_LOOKBACK_MS = 180 * DAY_MS;

/** Quantity below which a position counts as closed - mirrors `pnl-math.ts`. */
const QUANTITY_EPSILON = 1e-12;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Inputs
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * One confirmed, mirrorable trade by the master, as stored in `source_trades`.
 *
 * `direction` is narrowed to buy/sell on purpose: `source_trades` also carries
 * `transfer_in` / `transfer_out`, which are not mirrorable activity (ADR-0005
 * section 3.2, `S4-M5`) and must never enter a track record - a master
 * shuffling funds between their own wallets is not a trade.
 *
 * `feeUsd` is `null` on every `source_trades` row today: `031_execution_fees`
 * added `fee_usd` to `trades` (our own executions) only, and no migration adds a
 * fee column to `source_trades`. The field exists so the arithmetic is already
 * net-of-fees the day that column lands; until then `netOfFees` reports false
 * rather than presenting a gross figure as net.
 */
export interface MasterTradeRow {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: Chain;
  tokenMint: string;
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  tokenAmount: number;
  amountUsd: number | null;
  feeUsd: number | null;
  eventAt: Date;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Round trips
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * One entry-to-flat episode on a single (wallet, chain, token). Partial exits
 * are folded into the *same* round trip rather than emitted separately: three
 * sells that between them close one position are one decision with one hold
 * time, and splitting them would triple-count the entry in hit rate.
 */
export interface MasterRoundTrip {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: Chain;
  tokenMint: string;
  openedAt: Date;
  closedAt: Date;
  holdMs: number;
  /** Total basis committed over the episode, including buy-side fees. */
  costBasisUsd: number;
  /** Total proceeds returned, net of sell-side fees. */
  proceedsUsd: number;
  realizedPnlUsd: number;
  feeUsd: number;
  /** True only when every leg carried a non-null `feeUsd`. */
  feesRecorded: boolean;
  legs: number;
}

export interface MasterRoundTripSet {
  roundTrips: MasterRoundTrip[];
  /**
   * Positions still open at `asOf`. Excluded entirely - an open position has no
   * exit price, and counting it as a flat trade would silently dilute both hit
   * rate and PnL toward zero.
   */
  openEpisodes: number;
  /** Episodes with a leg missing `amountUsd`, so no PnL is derivable. */
  incompleteEpisodes: number;
  /**
   * Sells with no (or insufficient) open quantity - a history gap or a partial
   * fetch window. The sell is capped at what we can see, never taken negative
   * (same rule as ADR-0005 section 3.8).
   */
  unmatchedSells: number;
}

interface OpenEpisode {
  openedAt: Date;
  quantity: number;
  basisUsd: number;
  costBasisUsd: number;
  proceedsUsd: number;
  realizedPnlUsd: number;
  feeUsd: number;
  feesRecorded: boolean;
  legs: number;
  usdComplete: boolean;
}

function groupKey(row: MasterTradeRow): string {
  return `${row.walletAddress}\u0000${row.chain}\u0000${row.tokenMint}`;
}

function finiteOrNull(value: number | null | undefined): number | null {
  return value != null && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
}

/**
 * Reconstruct closed round trips from a master's confirmed trade stream using
 * the same chronological average-cost convention as `calculateAverageCostPnl`
 * in `@swat/db` (`pnl-math.ts`) - buys add `amountUsd + feeUsd` to basis, a sell
 * releases `avgUnitCost * quantity` of it and realizes
 * `amountUsd - feeUsd - releasedBasis`. The test asserts the sum of round-trip
 * PnL equals that function's `realizedPnlUsd` for the same ledger, so the two
 * cannot drift apart.
 *
 * Rows may arrive in any order; they are sorted per group by `eventAt`.
 */
export function buildMasterRoundTrips(rows: MasterTradeRow[]): MasterRoundTripSet {
  const set: MasterRoundTripSet = {
    roundTrips: [],
    openEpisodes: 0,
    incompleteEpisodes: 0,
    unmatchedSells: 0
  };

  const groups = new Map<string, MasterTradeRow[]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.direction !== 'buy' && row.direction !== 'sell') continue;
    if (!Number.isFinite(row.tokenAmount) || row.tokenAmount <= 0) continue;
    if (!(row.eventAt instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(row.eventAt.getTime())) continue;
    const key = groupKey(row);
    const bucket = groups.get(key);
    if (bucket) bucket.push(row);
    else groups.set(key, [row]);
  }

  for (const bucket of groups.values()) {
    bucket.sort((a, b) => a.eventAt.getTime() - b.eventAt.getTime());
    let episode: OpenEpisode | null = null;

    for (const row of bucket) {
      const amountUsd = finiteOrNull(row.amountUsd);
      const feeUsd = finiteOrNull(row.feeUsd);

      if (row.direction === 'buy') {
        if (!episode) {
          episode = {
            openedAt: row.eventAt,
            quantity: 0,
            basisUsd: 0,
            costBasisUsd: 0,
            proceedsUsd: 0,
            realizedPnlUsd: 0,
            feeUsd: 0,
            feesRecorded: true,
            legs: 0,
            usdComplete: true
          };
        }
        episode.quantity += row.tokenAmount;
        episode.basisUsd += (amountUsd ?? 0) + (feeUsd ?? 0);
        episode.costBasisUsd += (amountUsd ?? 0) + (feeUsd ?? 0);
        episode.feeUsd += feeUsd ?? 0;
        if (amountUsd === null || amountUsd < 0) episode.usdComplete = false;
        if (feeUsd === null || feeUsd < 0) episode.feesRecorded = false;
        episode.legs++;
        continue;
      }

      if (!episode || episode.quantity <= QUANTITY_EPSILON) {
        // A sell with nothing open: we are missing the entry. Never invent one.
        set.unmatchedSells++;
        continue;
      }

      let soldQuantity = row.tokenAmount;
      if (soldQuantity > episode.quantity) {
        set.unmatchedSells++;
        soldQuantity = episode.quantity;
      }

      const releasedBasis = (episode.basisUsd / episode.quantity) * soldQuantity;
      // Pro-rate a capped sell's USD so proceeds match the quantity we credited.
      const fraction = soldQuantity / row.tokenAmount;
      const legProceeds = (amountUsd ?? 0) * fraction;
      const legFee = (feeUsd ?? 0) * fraction;

      episode.realizedPnlUsd += legProceeds - legFee - releasedBasis;
      episode.proceedsUsd += legProceeds - legFee;
      episode.feeUsd += legFee;
      episode.quantity -= soldQuantity;
      episode.basisUsd -= releasedBasis;
      if (amountUsd === null || amountUsd < 0) episode.usdComplete = false;
      if (feeUsd === null || feeUsd < 0) episode.feesRecorded = false;
      episode.legs++;

      if (episode.quantity > QUANTITY_EPSILON) continue;

      if (episode.usdComplete) {
        set.roundTrips.push({
          walletAddress: row.walletAddress,
          chain: row.chain,
          tokenMint: row.tokenMint,
          openedAt: episode.openedAt,
          closedAt: row.eventAt,
          holdMs: row.eventAt.getTime() - episode.openedAt.getTime(),
          costBasisUsd: episode.costBasisUsd,
          proceedsUsd: episode.proceedsUsd,
          realizedPnlUsd: episode.realizedPnlUsd,
          feeUsd: episode.feeUsd,
          feesRecorded: episode.feesRecorded,
          legs: episode.legs
        });
      } else {
        set.incompleteEpisodes++;
      }
      episode = null;
    }

    if (episode && episode.quantity > QUANTITY_EPSILON) set.openEpisodes++;
  }

  set.roundTrips.sort((a, b) => a.closedAt.getTime() - b.closedAt.getTime());
  return set;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Per-window metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface MasterWindowCommon {
  window: MasterMetricWindow;
  windowStartAt: Date;
  /** Closed, out-of-sample round trips whose exit landed inside the window. */
  tradeCount: number;
  minTradeCount: number;
}

/**
 * The window is reported as a phrase, not a number. ADR-0005 section 5.2: a
 * 30-day metric from three trades is noise wearing a number, and a caller given
 * a number will render it.
 */
export interface MasterWindowInsufficient extends MasterWindowCommon {
  status: 'insufficient_history';
}

export interface MasterWindowFigures extends MasterWindowCommon {
  status: 'ok';
  /** Realized PnL in USD, net of every fee we hold. Never a return ratio. */
  pnlNetUsd: number;
  /**
   * `pnlNetUsd / tradeCount`. Exists so windows of different lengths are
   * comparable for the divergence finding without introducing a capital
   * denominator, which is the ROI ADR-0005 section 5.1 rejects.
   */
  pnlPerTradeUsd: number;
  /**
   * False when any contributing leg had no recorded fee. Today this is always
   * false for `source_trades`, so a caller must render the figure as
   * "gross of the master's own fees" rather than as a net number.
   */
  netOfFees: boolean;
  /** Sum of round-trip cost basis - the drawdown denominator. */
  deployedCapitalUsd: number;
  /**
   * Peak-to-trough of the cumulative realized-PnL curve, ordered by exit time.
   * This is a *realized* drawdown: we hold no continuous marks for a wallet we
   * merely observe, so an intra-hold excursion is invisible here. Stating that
   * is better than implying a mark-to-market drawdown we cannot compute.
   */
  maxDrawdownUsd: number;
  /**
   * `maxDrawdownUsd` as a percent of `deployedCapitalUsd`. The denominator is in
   * the field name deliberately: percent-of-peak-equity is undefined for a curve
   * that starts at zero, and percent-of-portfolio needs a portfolio we cannot
   * see. Null when no capital is attributable.
   */
  maxDrawdownPctOfDeployedCapital: number | null;
  hitRatePct: number;
  winCount: number;
  lossCount: number;
  medianHoldMinutes: number;
  /** Always null - see the module header. Owned by `S4-M6`. */
  capacityEstimate: null;
  capacityStatus: 'deferred-to-s4-m6';
}

export type MasterWindowMetrics = MasterWindowInsufficient | MasterWindowFigures;

/** Median of a numeric sample; null when the sample is empty. */
export function median(values: number[]): number | null {
  const sorted = values.filter((value) => Number.isFinite(value)).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
  if (sorted.length === 0) return null;
  const middle = sorted.length >> 1;
  if (sorted.length % 2 === 1) return sorted[middle]!;
  return (sorted[middle - 1]! + sorted[middle]!) / 2;
}

/**
 * Peak-to-trough decline of the cumulative realized-PnL curve. The peak starts
 * at zero, so a master who only loses reports their whole loss as the drawdown
 * rather than zero.
 *
 * Expects `roundTrips` ordered by `closedAt`; `buildMasterRoundTrips` guarantees
 * that and `roundTripsInWindow` preserves it.
 */
export function realizedMaxDrawdownUsd(roundTrips: Pick<MasterRoundTrip, 'realizedPnlUsd'>[]): number {
  let cumulative = 0;
  let peak = 0;
  let worst = 0;
  for (const roundTrip of roundTrips) {
    cumulative += roundTrip.realizedPnlUsd;
    if (cumulative > peak) peak = cumulative;
    const drawdown = peak - cumulative;
    if (drawdown > worst) worst = drawdown;
  }
  return worst;
}

/**
 * Round trips assigned to a window by **exit** time. Exit time is the right
 * key: it is when the result became knowable, and it keeps a single trade from
 * appearing in one window's entry and another's exit.
 */
export function roundTripsInWindow(
  roundTrips: MasterRoundTrip[],
  window: MasterMetricWindow,
  asOf: Date
): MasterRoundTrip[] {
  const startMs = asOf.getTime() - WINDOW_DURATION_MS[window];
  const asOfMs = asOf.getTime();
  return roundTrips.filter((roundTrip) => {
    const closed = roundTrip.closedAt.getTime();
    return closed >= startMs && closed <= asOfMs;
  });
}

export function computeWindowMetrics(
  window: MasterMetricWindow,
  roundTrips: MasterRoundTrip[],
  asOf: Date,
  minTradeCount: number
): MasterWindowMetrics {
  const windowStartAt = new Date(asOf.getTime() - WINDOW_DURATION_MS[window]);
  const common: MasterWindowCommon = {
    window,
    windowStartAt,
    tradeCount: roundTrips.length,
    minTradeCount
  };

  if (roundTrips.length < minTradeCount) {
    return { ...common, status: 'insufficient_history' };
  }

  let pnlNetUsd = 0;
  let deployedCapitalUsd = 0;
  let winCount = 0;
  let lossCount = 0;
  let netOfFees = true;
  const holdMinutes: number[] = [];

  for (const roundTrip of roundTrips) {
    pnlNetUsd += roundTrip.realizedPnlUsd;
    deployedCapitalUsd += roundTrip.costBasisUsd;
    if (roundTrip.realizedPnlUsd > 0) winCount++;
    else lossCount++;
    if (!roundTrip.feesRecorded) netOfFees = false;
    holdMinutes.push(roundTrip.holdMs / 60_000);
  }

  const maxDrawdownUsd = realizedMaxDrawdownUsd(roundTrips);

  return {
    ...common,
    status: 'ok',
    pnlNetUsd,
    pnlPerTradeUsd: pnlNetUsd / roundTrips.length,
    netOfFees,
    deployedCapitalUsd,
    maxDrawdownUsd,
    maxDrawdownPctOfDeployedCapital:
      deployedCapitalUsd > 0 ? (maxDrawdownUsd / deployedCapitalUsd) * 100 : null,
    hitRatePct: (winCount / roundTrips.length) * 100,
    winCount,
    lossCount,
    medianHoldMinutes: median(holdMinutes) ?? 0,
    capacityEstimate: null,
    capacityStatus: 'deferred-to-s4-m6'
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Divergence across windows - itself the finding (ADR-0005 section 5.3)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type MasterTrend = 'decaying' | 'improving' | 'stable' | 'indeterminate';

/**
 * Relative change at or below this counts as decay. -0.5 means the shorter
 * window's per-trade PnL has fallen by half the larger of the two magnitudes,
 * which a sign flip (for example +10 then -10, giving -2.0) always clears.
 */
export const DIVERGENCE_DECAY_THRESHOLD = -0.5;
export const DIVERGENCE_IMPROVEMENT_THRESHOLD = 0.5;

export interface MasterWindowDivergence {
  shorter: MasterMetricWindow;
  longer: MasterMetricWindow;
  trend: MasterTrend;
  /**
   * `(shorter - longer) / max(|shorter|, |longer|)` over `pnlPerTradeUsd`, so it
   * is bounded in [-2, 2] and handles a sign flip without dividing by a number
   * that crosses zero.
   */
  relativeChange: number | null;
  hitRatePctDelta: number | null;
  /** Populated only when `trend` is `indeterminate`. */
  reason: string | null;
}

/** Pairs compared. `24h` vs `30d` is the headline the ADR names. */
export const DIVERGENCE_PAIRS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [MasterMetricWindow, MasterMetricWindow]> = [
  ['24h', '7d'],
  ['7d', '30d'],
  ['24h', '30d']
];

export const HEADLINE_DIVERGENCE_PAIR: readonly [MasterMetricWindow, MasterMetricWindow] = ['24h', '30d'];

export function compareWindows(
  shorter: MasterWindowMetrics,
  longer: MasterWindowMetrics
): MasterWindowDivergence {
  const base = { shorter: shorter.window, longer: longer.window };

  if (shorter.status !== 'ok' || longer.status !== 'ok') {
    const missing = [shorter, longer]
      .filter((side) => side.status !== 'ok')
      .map((side) => side.window)
      .join(' and ');
    return {
      ...base,
      trend: 'indeterminate',
      relativeChange: null,
      hitRatePctDelta: null,
      reason: `insufficient history in ${missing}`
    };
  }

  const scale = Math.max(Math.abs(shorter.pnlPerTradeUsd), Math.abs(longer.pnlPerTradeUsd));
  const relativeChange =
    scale === 0 ? 0 : (shorter.pnlPerTradeUsd - longer.pnlPerTradeUsd) / scale;

  let trend: MasterTrend = 'stable';
  if (relativeChange <= DIVERGENCE_DECAY_THRESHOLD) trend = 'decaying';
  else if (relativeChange >= DIVERGENCE_IMPROVEMENT_THRESHOLD) trend = 'improving';

  return {
    ...base,
    trend,
    relativeChange,
    hitRatePctDelta: shorter.hitRatePct - longer.hitRatePct,
    reason: null
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The report
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface MasterMetricsReport {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: Chain;
  asOf: Date;
  /**
   * The instant our observation of this master began. Round trips **entered**
   * before it are in-sample - they are the history that got the wallet selected
   * in the first place - and are excluded. Null means we cannot establish it, in
   * which case nothing is treated as out-of-sample and every window reports
   * insufficient history. Fail closed: a metric we cannot prove is out-of-sample
   * is worse than no metric.
   */
  observationStartAt: Date | null;
  outOfSampleRoundTrips: number;
  inSampleRoundTripsExcluded: number;
  openEpisodes: number;
  incompleteEpisodes: number;
  unmatchedSells: number;
  /** False whenever any contributing leg lacked a recorded fee. */
  feesRecordedOnEveryRoundTrip: boolean;
  windows: Record<MasterMetricWindow, MasterWindowMetrics>;
  divergence: MasterWindowDivergence[];
  /** Headline trend, from the 24h-vs-30d comparison. */
  trend: MasterTrend;
}

export interface ComputeMasterMetricsInput {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: Chain;
  rows: MasterTradeRow[];
  asOf: Date;
  observationStartAt: Date | null;
  minTradesByWindow?: Partial<Record<MasterMetricWindow, number>>;
}

export function resolveMinTradesByWindow(
  overrides?: Partial<Record<MasterMetricWindow, number>>
): Record<MasterMetricWindow, number> {
  const resolved = { ...DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW };
  if (!overrides) return resolved;
  for (const window of MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS) {
    const override = overrides[window];
    if (override != null && Number.isFinite(override) && override > 0) {
      resolved[window] = Math.floor(override);
    }
  }
  return resolved;
}

/**
 * The whole metric set for one master, from raw rows. Pure: no clock, no DB.
 *
 * Order of operations matters and is not interchangeable:
 * 1. Build round trips from **all** supplied rows, so a sell is matched to the
 *    buy that opened it even when that buy predates every window.
 * 2. Drop round trips entered before `observationStartAt` - the out-of-sample
 *    cut, applied at episode level rather than row level so an episode
 *    straddling the boundary is excluded rather than half-counted.
 * 3. Assign what remains to windows by exit time.
 */
export function computeMasterMetrics(input: ComputeMasterMetricsInput): MasterMetricsReport {
  const minTradesByWindow = resolveMinTradesByWindow(input.minTradesByWindow);
  const built = buildMasterRoundTrips(input.rows);

  const startMs = input.observationStartAt?.getTime() ?? null;
  const outOfSample = startMs === null
    ? []
    : built.roundTrips.filter((roundTrip) => roundTrip.openedAt.getTime() >= startMs);

  const windows = {} as Record<MasterMetricWindow, MasterWindowMetrics>;
  for (const window of MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS) {
    windows[window] = computeWindowMetrics(
      window,
      roundTripsInWindow(outOfSample, window, input.asOf),
      input.asOf,
      minTradesByWindow[window]
    );
  }

  const divergence = DIVERGENCE_PAIRS.map(([shorter, longer]) =>
    compareWindows(windows[shorter], windows[longer])
  );
  const headline = divergence.find(
    (entry) => entry.shorter === HEADLINE_DIVERGENCE_PAIR[0] && entry.longer === HEADLINE_DIVERGENCE_PAIR[1]
  );

  return {
    walletAddress: input.walletAddress,
    chain: input.chain,
    asOf: input.asOf,
    observationStartAt: input.observationStartAt,
    outOfSampleRoundTrips: outOfSample.length,
    inSampleRoundTripsExcluded: built.roundTrips.length - outOfSample.length,
    openEpisodes: built.openEpisodes,
    incompleteEpisodes: built.incompleteEpisodes,
    unmatchedSells: built.unmatchedSells,
    feesRecordedOnEveryRoundTrip:
      outOfSample.length > 0 && outOfSample.every((roundTrip) => roundTrip.feesRecorded),
    windows,
    divergence,
    trend: headline?.trend ?? 'indeterminate'
  };
}

/** One log line per master. Never mentions follower count (`S4-M9`). */
export function formatMasterMetricsLine(report: MasterMetricsReport): string {
  const windows = MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS.map((window) => {
    const metrics = report.windows[window];
    if (metrics.status !== 'ok') {
      return `${window}: insufficient history (${metrics.tradeCount}/${metrics.minTradeCount})`;
    }
    const drawdown = metrics.maxDrawdownPctOfDeployedCapital;
    return (
      `${window}: n=${metrics.tradeCount} ` +
      `pnl=$${metrics.pnlNetUsd.toFixed(2)}${metrics.netOfFees ? '' : ' (gross of master fees)'} ` +
      `hr=${metrics.hitRatePct.toFixed(1)}% ` +
      `mdd=$${metrics.maxDrawdownUsd.toFixed(2)}` +
      `${drawdown === null ? '' : ` (${drawdown.toFixed(1)}% of deployed)`} ` +
      `hold=${metrics.medianHoldMinutes.toFixed(1)}m`
    );
  }).join(' | ');
  return `${report.walletAddress} trend=${report.trend} | ${windows}`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The injected batch
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface MasterCandidate {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: Chain;
  observationStartAt: Date | null;
}

export interface MasterTradeFetchInput {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: Chain;
  since: Date;
  asOf: Date;
}

export interface MasterMetricsBatchDependencies {
  listMasters: () => Promise<MasterCandidate[]>;
  fetchTrades: (input: MasterTradeFetchInput) => Promise<MasterTradeRow[]>;
  /**
   * Optional sink for `S6-27`'s suggestions list. Left unwired: persisting these
   * needs a table this item does not own (the `052`/`053` band in the plan), so
   * the batch currently computes, logs and discards rather than writing to a
   * schema that does not exist.
   */
  persistReport?: (report: MasterMetricsReport) => Promise<unknown>;
  asOf?: Date;
  minTradesByWindow?: Partial<Record<MasterMetricWindow, number>>;
  lookbackMs?: number;
}

export interface MasterMetricsBatchResult {
  masters: number;
  reports: MasterMetricsReport[];
  failed: number;
  decaying: number;
  improving: number;
  /** Masters with no window that cleared its minimum trade count. */
  insufficientEverywhere: number;
}

/**
 * Compute the metric set for every candidate master. One failure is contained to
 * one master: this runs inside the nightly batch alongside scoring, and a single
 * unparseable wallet must not cost the run.
 */
export async function runMasterMetricsBatch(
  dependencies: MasterMetricsBatchDependencies
): Promise<MasterMetricsBatchResult> {
  const asOf = dependencies.asOf ?? new Date();
  const lookbackMs = dependencies.lookbackMs ?? ROUND_TRIP_LOOKBACK_MS;
  const lookbackStart = new Date(asOf.getTime() - lookbackMs);

  const result: MasterMetricsBatchResult = {
    masters: 0,
    reports: [],
    failed: 0,
    decaying: 0,
    improving: 0,
    insufficientEverywhere: 0
  };

  const masters = await dependencies.listMasters();
  result.masters = masters.length;

  for (const master of masters) {
    try {
      // Clamp the observation start to the fetch bound. Without the clamp an
      // episode opened before the bound would pass the out-of-sample cut with
      // its entry legs unfetched, and be scored off proceeds alone.
      const observationStartAt = master.observationStartAt
        ? (master.observationStartAt.getTime() > lookbackStart.getTime()
          ? master.observationStartAt
          : lookbackStart)
        : null;

      const rows = observationStartAt === null
        ? []
        : await dependencies.fetchTrades({
          walletAddress: master.walletAddress,
          chain: master.chain,
          since: observationStartAt,
          asOf
        });

      const report = computeMasterMetrics({
        walletAddress: master.walletAddress,
        chain: master.chain,
        rows,
        asOf,
        observationStartAt,
        minTradesByWindow: dependencies.minTradesByWindow
      });

      result.reports.push(report);
      if (report.trend === 'decaying') result.decaying++;
      if (report.trend === 'improving') result.improving++;
      if (MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS.every((window) => report.windows[window].status !== 'ok')) {
        result.insufficientEverywhere++;
      }

      if (dependencies.persistReport) await dependencies.persistReport(report);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[scorer] master metrics failed for ${master.walletAddress}`, error);
      result.failed++;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SQL - the only part that needs Postgres
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** NUMERIC comes back as number or string depending on magnitude; normalise. */
function numberOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function dateOrNull(value: unknown): Date | null {
  if (value instanceof Date) return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value;
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') {
    const parsed = new Date(value);
    return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Wallets that are candidate masters: active, and with at least one confirmed
 * mirrorable trade inside the longest window. Derived from `source_trades`
 * rather than from `user_wallet_subscriptions` on purpose - the suggestion
 * engine needs wallets nobody copies yet, and reading a subscription table here
 * would be the first step toward the popularity ranking `S4-M9` forbids.
 *
 * `wallets.first_seen` is the observation start: the row is created when we begin
 * tracking, so backfilled history carries an `event_at` earlier than it.
 */
export async function listMasterCandidates(input: {
  asOf: Date;
  activityWindowMs?: number;
}): Promise<MasterCandidate[]> {
  const activityWindowMs = input.activityWindowMs ?? WINDOW_DURATION_MS['30d'];
  const rows = await query<{ wallet_address: string; chain: string; first_seen: Date | null }>(
    `SELECT w.address AS wallet_address,
            w.chain AS chain,
            w.first_seen AS first_seen
       FROM wallets w
      WHERE w.status = 'active'
        AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
                FROM source_trades st
               WHERE st.wallet_address = w.address
                 AND st.chain = w.chain
                 AND st.confirmation_state IN ('confirmed', 'finalized')
                 AND st.direction IN ('buy', 'sell')
                 AND st.event_at >= $1::timestamptz - ($2::bigint * INTERVAL '1 millisecond')
                 AND st.event_at <= $1::timestamptz
            )
      ORDER BY w.address`,
    [input.asOf.toISOString(), Math.floor(activityWindowMs)]
  );

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    walletAddress: row.wallet_address,
    chain: row.chain as Chain,
    observationStartAt: dateOrNull(row.first_seen)
  }));
}

/**
 * A master's confirmed mirrorable trades. Filters match the partial index
 * `idx_source_trades_position_order`, which covers
 * `confirmation_state IN ('confirmed','finalized')`.
 *
 * `fee_usd` is selected as a NULL literal because **`source_trades` has no fee
 * column**: `031_execution_fees` added `fee_usd` to `trades` only. The literal
 * is here rather than absent so the gap is visible at the one place it is
 * introduced, and so closing it is a one-line change.
 */
export async function fetchMasterTradeRows(input: MasterTradeFetchInput): Promise<MasterTradeRow[]> {
  const rows = await query<{
    wallet_address: string;
    chain: string;
    token_mint: string;
    direction: string;
    token_amount: unknown;
    amount_usd: unknown;
    fee_usd: unknown;
    event_at: Date;
  }>(
    `SELECT st.wallet_address,
            st.chain,
            st.token_mint,
            st.direction,
            st.token_amount,
            st.amount_usd,
            NULL::numeric AS fee_usd,
            st.event_at
       FROM source_trades st
      WHERE st.wallet_address = $1
        AND st.chain = $2
        AND st.confirmation_state IN ('confirmed', 'finalized')
        AND st.direction IN ('buy', 'sell')
        AND st.event_at >= $3::timestamptz
        AND st.event_at <= $4::timestamptz
      ORDER BY st.event_at ASC, st.id ASC`,
    [input.walletAddress, input.chain, input.since.toISOString(), input.asOf.toISOString()]
  );

  const mapped: MasterTradeRow[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const tokenAmount = numberOrNull(row.token_amount);
    const eventAt = dateOrNull(row.event_at);
    if (tokenAmount === null || tokenAmount <= 0 || eventAt === null) continue;
    if (row.direction !== 'buy' && row.direction !== 'sell') continue;
    mapped.push({
      walletAddress: row.wallet_address,
      chain: row.chain as Chain,
      tokenMint: row.token_mint,
      direction: row.direction,
      tokenAmount,
      amountUsd: numberOrNull(row.amount_usd),
      feeUsd: numberOrNull(row.fee_usd),
      eventAt
    });
  }
  return mapped;
}

==> apps/scorer/src/starter-pack.ts <==
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';
import {
  chainSchema,
  getChainPrefix,
  isValidAddressForChain,
  resolveChainValue,
  type Chain
} from '@swat/shared';

export type StarterPackWallet = {
  address: string;
  chain: Chain;
};

export function parseWalletChain(value: unknown): Chain {
  const parsed = chainSchema.safeParse(value ?? 'solana');
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new Error(
      `WALLET_CHAIN must be one of solana, polygon, or robinhood-chain; received ${JSON.stringify(value)}`
    );
  }
  return parsed.data;
}

export function parseStarterPackWallets(
  text: string,
  defaultChain: Chain
): StarterPackWallet[] {
  let raw: unknown;
  try {
    raw = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      `Starter pack JSON is invalid: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
    );
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) {
    throw new Error('Starter pack JSON must be an array of wallet strings or wallet objects');
  }

  const wallets: StarterPackWallet[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const [index, entry] of raw.entries()) {
    const address =
      typeof entry === 'string'
        ? entry
        : entry && typeof entry === 'object' && 'address' in entry
          ? (entry as { address?: unknown }).address
          : null;
    const entryChain =
      entry && typeof entry === 'object' && 'chain' in entry
        ? (entry as { chain?: unknown }).chain
        : undefined;

    if (typeof address !== 'string') {
      throw new Error(`Starter pack entry ${index} must contain a wallet address string`);
    }

    const chain = parseWalletChain(
      entryChain ?? getChainPrefix(address) ?? defaultChain
    );
    const resolved = resolveChainValue(address, chain);
    if (!isValidAddressForChain(resolved.raw, resolved.chain)) {
      throw new Error(
        `Starter pack entry ${index} is not a valid ${resolved.chain} address`
      );
    }

    if (!seen.has(resolved.prefixed)) {
      seen.add(resolved.prefixed);
      wallets.push({
        address: resolved.raw,
        chain: resolved.chain
      });
    }
  }

  return wallets;
}

export function resolveStarterPackPath(
  moduleUrl: string,
  configuredPath?: string
): string {
  const repositoryRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', moduleUrl));
  return path.resolve(
    repositoryRoot,
    configuredPath ?? 'wallet-starter-pack.json'
  );
}

==> apps/scorer/src/stop-loss.ts <==
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import type { OpenPositionSnapshot, StopLossClaimInput } from '@swat/db';
import { isStopLossBreached, positionDrawdownPct } from '@swat/db';

/**
 * Stop-loss sweep. Runs on the back of the scorer's existing 5-minute
 * mark-to-market pass, so it reuses the prices that pass already fetched
 * instead of adding a second polling loop.
 *
 * Every dependency is injected so the sweep can be tested without Postgres,
 * Redis or BullMQ â€” same shape as `runAttributionReporting`.
 *
 * ## Per-position accounts (`S4-M46`)
 *
 * The account used to be resolved ONCE before the loop and every position claimed
 * under it. `signal_stop_losses` is `PRIMARY KEY (account, signal_id)`, so under
 * fan-out the first holder to breach claimed the signal and every other holder was
 * never sold â€” the sweep reporting success, having protected one of them. The account
 * is now derived per position from `position.userId`, which `markToMarketOpenPositions`
 * fills from `trades.user_id`.
 *
 * ## Driven by positions, never by subscription state
 *
 * This sweep does not enumerate users and never reads `user_wallet_subscriptions`. Its
 * input is the set of positions that mark-to-market just priced, so a user is swept
 * because they hold something.
 *
 * The alternative â€” enumerate subscribers, then look for their positions â€” is the trap
 * `S4-M45` named. Written the natural way (`state = 'active'`) it silently drops every
 * `winding_down` user, which is precisely the cohort whose master may have gone quiet
 * and whose open positions most need a stop-loss. `state <> 'ended'`, the predicate
 * `pauseUnsubscribedWallets` already uses, fixes that one instance â€” and `ended` is
 * still wrong, because a subscription reaches `ended` on the claim that nothing is open,
 * and if that claim is ever false the position it left behind is exactly the one nobody
 * is protecting. Driving from positions removes the class: there is no state to get
 * wrong, because there is no state consulted.
 */

/**
 * The account key for a position with no tenant â€” the pre-tenancy operator.
 *
 * A tenancy key, matching the executor's `RISK_POLICY_ACCOUNT`. **Not**
 * `RECONCILIATION_ACCOUNT`, which is the same string and must stay `'operator'` for a
 * different reason (it labels an escalation stream keyed by wallet address, so
 * substituting a user id there scopes nothing). Keeping the two apart is what stops a
 * find-and-replace over `'operator'` from breaking reconciliation.
 */
export const STOP_LOSS_ACCOUNT = 'operator';

/**
 * The `signal_stop_losses.account` key for one position.
 *
 * Mirrors `riskPolicyAccountForUser` in `apps/trade-executor/src/per-user-sizing.ts`
 * deliberately rather than importing it: the scorer does not depend on the executor,
 * and a second copy of the *rule* would be the problem â€” a second copy of a two-line
 * mapping with a test asserting it agrees is not. `account` is a `VARCHAR(64)` label
 * here, not a `users(id)` foreign key, which is why the user id is used as-is.
 *
 * Throws on an empty or blank string rather than falling back to the operator. A blank
 * user id means the caller thought it had a tenant; keying that position on the
 * operator would file one user's stop-loss claim under another account, and then the
 * `(account, signal_id)` primary key would block the real owner's claim â€” the exact
 * defect this item exists to close, reintroduced by a fallback.
 */
export function stopLossAccountForPosition(userId: string | null): string {
  if (userId === null) return STOP_LOSS_ACCOUNT;
  if (typeof userId !== 'string' || userId.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new Error('stopLossAccountForPosition requires a non-empty user id or null');
  }
  return userId;
}

/**
 * Separates the two halves of the policy cache key. NUL, matching
 * `COPY_IDENTITY_SEPARATOR` in `copy-trade-lifecycle.ts`: neither a UUID nor a chain
 * name can contain one, so two distinct (account, chain) pairs cannot collide.
 */
const POLICY_CACHE_SEPARATOR = String.fromCharCode(0);

/** The sell handed to the trade executor. Always closes the whole position. */
export type StopLossSellJob = {
  signalId: string;
  tokenMint: string;
  score: number;
  direction: 'sell';
  stopLoss: true;
  sellTokenAmount: number;
  /**
   * Whose exit this is. **Absent, not `null`, for the operator** â€” the executor's
   * `resolveExecutionPrincipal` reads `typeof payload.userId === 'string'`, and the
   * operator job is deliberately kept byte-identical to the pre-fan-out one so a
   * replayed BullMQ job cannot change principal across a deploy.
   */
  userId?: string;
  positionKey?: string;
};

export type StopLossAlert = {
  type: 'STOP_LOSS_TRIGGERED';
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: 'high';
  chain: Chain;
};

export type StopLossSweepDependencies = {
  positions: OpenPositionSnapshot[];
  resolvePolicy: (account: string, chain: Chain) => Promise<{ stopLossPct: number }>;
  claim: (input: StopLossClaimInput) => Promise<boolean>;
  release: (account: string, signalId: string, positionKey?: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  /**
   * `chain` is passed explicitly rather than left for the caller to re-derive
   * from `job.tokenMint`: since S3-25 the queue is chosen per chain, and the
   * position already carries the authoritative chain. Re-deriving it would be a
   * second implementation of the same decision.
   */
  enqueueSell: (job: StopLossSellJob, jobId: string, chain: Chain) => Promise<unknown>;
  publishAlert: (alert: StopLossAlert) => Promise<unknown>;
};

export type StopLossSweepResult = {
  scanned: number;
  breached: number;
  queued: number;
  alreadyTriggered: number;
  failed: number;
  /**
   * Positions whose account key could not be derived â€” a blank user id from
   * `stopLossAccountForPosition`.
   *
   * Counted separately from `failed` because it is a different event with a different
   * fix: `failed` means an infrastructure call did not land and the next sweep retries
   * it, while this means the position arrived with an unusable owner and every sweep
   * will reject it identically until the ledger row is corrected. Folding it into
   * `failed` would make a permanent condition look like a transient one.
   */
  unaccountable: number;
};

export function formatStopLossAlert(
  position: OpenPositionSnapshot,
  thresholdPct: number,
  drawdownPct: number
): StopLossAlert {
  return {
    type: 'STOP_LOSS_TRIGGERED',
    title: `Stop-loss triggered: ${position.tokenMint}`,
    message:
      `Position on ${position.tokenMint} is down ${drawdownPct.toFixed(2)}% ` +
      `against a ${thresholdPct}% stop-loss.\n` +
      `Signal: ${position.signalId}\n` +
      `Open quantity: ${position.openQuantity}\n` +
      `Cost basis: $${position.openCostBasisUsd.toFixed(2)}\n` +
      `Unrealised P&L: $${position.unrealizedPnlUsd.toFixed(2)}\n` +
      `A full closing sell has been queued.`,
    severity: 'high',
    chain: position.chain
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluate every open position against its chain's stop-loss threshold and
 * queue one closing sell per breach.
 *
 * The claim is what makes this exactly-once: `claim` inserts the single
 * (account, signal) row and only the winner queues a sell. If queueing then
 * fails the claim is released so the next sweep can retry â€” a position is never
 * left both unclaimed and unsold.
 *
 * Every account-scoped call inside the loop uses that **position's** account: the
 * policy lookup, the claim, the job id and the release. A single one of them left on a
 * shared account reopens `S4-M46` on its own â€” a shared job id would have BullMQ
 * dedupe two users' distinct exits into one, and a shared release would delete another
 * user's live claim.
 */
export async function runStopLossSweep(
  dependencies: StopLossSweepDependencies
): Promise<StopLossSweepResult> {
  const result: StopLossSweepResult = {
    scanned: dependencies.positions.length,
    breached: 0,
    queued: 0,
    alreadyTriggered: 0,
    failed: 0,
    unaccountable: 0
  };

  // Keyed by (account, chain), not by chain. `resolveRiskPolicy` is account-scoped, so
  // caching on chain alone would serve the first user's stop-loss threshold to every
  // other user on that chain â€” a user who set a tighter stop would be swept at
  // somebody else's.
  const policyByAccountChain = new Map<string, { stopLossPct: number }>();

  for (const position of dependencies.positions) {
    let account: string;
    try {
      account = stopLossAccountForPosition(position.userId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[scorer] stop-loss account unresolvable for ${position.signalId}`, error);
      result.unaccountable++;
      continue;
    }

    const policyKey = `${account}${POLICY_CACHE_SEPARATOR}${position.chain}`;
    let policy = policyByAccountChain.get(policyKey);
    if (!policy) {
      try {
        policy = await dependencies.resolvePolicy(account, position.chain);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `[scorer] stop-loss policy lookup failed for ${account} on ${position.chain}`,
          error
        );
        result.failed++;
        continue;
      }
      policyByAccountChain.set(policyKey, policy);
    }

    if (!isStopLossBreached(position, policy.stopLossPct)) continue;
    const drawdownPct = positionDrawdownPct(position);
    if (drawdownPct === null) continue;
    result.breached++;

    let claimed: boolean;
    try {
      claimed = await dependencies.claim({
        account,
        signalId: position.signalId,
        chain: position.chain,
        tokenMint: position.tokenMint,
        thresholdPct: policy.stopLossPct,
        drawdownPct,
        openQuantity: position.openQuantity,
        openCostBasisUsd: position.openCostBasisUsd,
        priceUsd: position.currentPriceUsd,
        positionKey: position.positionKey
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[scorer] stop-loss claim failed for ${account} on ${position.signalId}`, error);
      result.failed++;
      continue;
    }

    if (!claimed) {
      result.alreadyTriggered++;
      continue;
    }

    try {
      await dependencies.enqueueSell(
        {
          signalId: position.signalId,
          tokenMint: position.tokenMint,
          score: 100,
          direction: 'sell',
          stopLoss: true,
          sellTokenAmount: position.openQuantity,
          // The executor reads this to pick the acting principal
          // (`resolveExecutionPrincipal`). Omitted for the operator so the job stays
          // byte-identical to what this sweep enqueued before fan-out.
          ...(position.userId === null ? {} : { userId: position.userId })
        },
        position.positionKey === undefined || position.positionKey === null
          ? `stop-loss-${account}-${position.signalId}`
          : `stop-loss-${account}-${position.signalId}-${position.positionKey}`,
        position.chain
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[scorer] stop-loss sell enqueue failed for ${position.signalId}`, error);
      const release = position.positionKey === undefined || position.positionKey === null
        ? dependencies.release(account, position.signalId)
        : dependencies.release(account, position.signalId, position.positionKey);
      await release.catch((releaseError) => {
        console.error(`[scorer] stop-loss claim release failed for ${position.signalId}`, releaseError);
      });
      result.failed++;
      continue;
    }

    result.queued++;

    // Alerting must not undo a queued exit, so a failure here is logged only.
    await dependencies
      .publishAlert(formatStopLossAlert(position, policy.stopLossPct, drawdownPct))
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error(`[scorer] stop-loss alert failed for ${position.signalId}`, error);
      });
  }

  return result;
}

describe('usableLiquidityForFanout', () => {
  it('halves a DexScreener pool TVL into a one-sided reserve on solana', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 200_000
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('amm-pool-tvl');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(100_000);
    expect(liquidity.approximate).toBe(true);
  });

  it('uses the same pool basis on robinhood-chain', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      tokenMint: 'robinhood-chain:0xabc',
      poolTvlUsd: 50_000
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('amm-pool-tvl');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(25_000);
  });

  it('reports unknown, not zero, when DexScreener has no pair', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses to substitute a pool figure for Polymarket, even when one is supplied', () => {
    // The whole point of the polygon branch: a non-null figure here is some
    // unrelated Polygon DEX pair, and using it would let the cap admit a cohort
    // against liquidity that does not exist for this market.
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 5_000_000
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('names the CLOB and the missing feed in the polygon note, for whoever reads the skip', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null
    });
    expect(liquidity.note).toMatch(/CLOB/);
    expect(liquidity.note).toMatch(/S4-M38/);
  });

  it('does not fetch DexScreener for polygon at all', async () => {
    await expect(fetchPoolTvlUsdForCapacity('polygon', POLY_TOKEN)).resolves.toBeNull();
  });
  it('accepts a measured order-book verdict on polygon (S4-M38)', () => {
    // The gate this replaces was correct while no honest depth figure existed.
    // Now that one does, refusing it would keep Polymarket permanently
    // uncopyable for a reason that no longer applies.
    const book = {
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      usableLiquidityUsd: 250_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      // Always true for a book: resting size is an option the maker holds, not a
      // commitment, so the figure can evaporate before the order lands.
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder within 100bps'
    };
    const result = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: 5_000_000,
      polymarketBook: book
    });
    expect(result).toBe(book);
    // The pool figure must still be ignored even now the gate is open.
    expect(result.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(250_000);
  });

  it('refuses a book verdict that came back unknown, rather than publishing it', () => {
    // A stale, gapped or unsnapshotted book is a VENUE condition; no subscriber
    // at all is a DEPLOYMENT gap. Both fail closed, and the notes differ so an
    // operator is not sent to the wrong place.
    const result = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      polymarketBook: {
        chain: 'polygon',
        tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
        // Deliberately INCONSISTENT: a figure present while the basis says the
        // book was not measured. A verdict like this should never arrive, and the
        // point of the fixture is that trusting `basis` blindly -- or passing the
        // verdict straight through -- publishes 999_999 as real liquidity.
        // An earlier version of this test used a null figure, which the
        // pass-through mutation satisfied trivially.
        usableLiquidityUsd: 999_999,
        basis: 'unknown',
        approximate: false,
        note: 'snapshot is 40s stale'
      }
    });
    expect(result.basis).toBe('unknown');
    // The load-bearing assertion: the inconsistent figure must NOT survive.
    expect(result.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
    expect(result.note).toContain('40s stale');
    expect(result.note).toContain('S4-M38');
  });

  it('carries a book verdict through resolveFanoutCapacity, not just the pure helper', () => {
    // The wiring test. `usableLiquidityForFanout` accepting a verdict is useless
    // if `resolveFanoutCapacity` never passes one -- which is exactly the
    // correct-but-inert shape this checklist has been burned by four times, and
    // which a unit test on the helper alone cannot detect.
    const forwarded = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: 9_999_999,
      polymarketBook: {
        chain: 'polygon',
        tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
        usableLiquidityUsd: 250_000,
        basis: 'order-book-depth',
        approximate: true,
        note: 'walked ladder'
      }
    });
    expect(forwarded.basis).toBe('order-book-depth');
    expect(forwarded.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(250_000);
    // And the pool figure is still ignored, even though it is much larger.
    expect(forwarded.usableLiquidityUsd).not.toBe(9_999_999);
  });

  it('still refuses polygon when no subscriber supplied a book', () => {
    // The pre-S4-M38 behaviour, retained for the case it was written for.
    const result = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: 5_000_000
    });
    expect(result.basis).toBe('unknown');
    expect(result.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

});

// The cohort projection
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

describe('projectCohortNotionalUsd', () => {
  it('sums the whole known balance of every admissible user', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [
        candidate({ userId: 'a', knownBalanceUsd: 1_000 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'b', knownBalanceUsd: 250 })
      ],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(1_250);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(2);
    expect(projection.basis).toBe('sum-of-admissible-known-balances');
  });

  it('errs high: the bound exceeds what per-user sizing would really request', () => {
    // A user at the default 5% max_position_pct would request $50 of a $1,000
    // balance. The bound charges the whole $1,000, which refuses a cohort that
    // would have fitted rather than admitting one that moves the market.
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 1_000 })],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBeGreaterThan(1_000 * 0.05);
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(1_000);
  });

  it('excludes users the fan-out would exclude anyway, so the cap is not charged for them', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [
        candidate({ userId: 'in', knownBalanceUsd: 100 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'killed', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, killed: true }),
        candidate({ userId: 'manual', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, autoExecute: false }),
        candidate({ userId: 'low-score', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, minSignalScore: 99 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'capped', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, openPositionCount: 10 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'gone', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, subscriptionState: 'ended' })
      ],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(100);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(1);
  });

  it('never counts an unknown balance as zero â€” such a user is excluded upstream', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [
        candidate({ userId: 'known', knownBalanceUsd: 500 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'unpriced', knownBalanceUsd: null })
      ],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(500);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(1);
  });

  it('projects zero for an empty candidate list', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd([], SIGNAL, PLATFORM);
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(0);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(0);
  });

  it('excludes nobody for capacity itself â€” the provisional plan admits', () => {
    // If the provisional gate were `skip` or `null`, the projection would always
    // be 0 and the cap would admit every cohort.
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 777 })],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(777);
  });
});

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// Gate mapping and direction
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

describe('capacityGateFor', () => {
  it('maps an unevaluable cap to null so users read capacity-unknown', async () => {
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 4_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).toBe('capacity-not-assessable');
    expect(resolved.capacity).toBeNull();
  });

  it('calls the injected book reader with the cap actually in force (S4-M38)', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    // The reader must be reached at all -- the inert-wiring failure this repo has
    // hit repeatedly is a value accepted by the pure helper and never fetched.
    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(resolved.capacity).not.toBeNull();
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).not.toBe('capacity-not-assessable');
  });

  it('hands the reader the platform default cap when no override exists', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ impactCapBps: PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS.polygon })
    );
  });

  it("hands the reader the master's override cap, not the platform default", async () => {
    // The reason the read is deferred into this function at all. The published
    // reserve is exact only at its own cap, so pricing the book at the default
    // while the cap judges it at 42bps is a fail-open arithmetic error.
    dbMocks.fetchMasterCapacityPolicy.mockResolvedValue({
      policy: { maxAggregateImpactBps: 42 },
      dailyBudgetShareBps: null
    });
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ impactCapBps: 42 })
    );
    expect(readPolymarketBook).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ impactCapBps: PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS.polygon })
    );
  });

  it('defaults the cohort direction to buy, the side the cap governs', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ cohortDirection: 'buy' })
    );
  });

  it('does not read the book on a chain priced from pool TVL', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn();

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: 'solana:master',
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: 'solana:So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112',
      poolTvlUsd: 4_000_000,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('prefers an explicitly supplied book over the reader', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn();

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      polymarketBook: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('still excludes everyone when the reader returns an unknown book', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: null,
      basis: 'unknown' as const,
      approximate: false,
      note: 'polymarket-book-snapshot-stale'
    }));

    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    // A stale book must not admit anybody. This is the fail-closed direction and
    // the reason the reader never substitutes a last-known value.
    expect(resolved.capacity).toBeNull();
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).toBe('capacity-not-assessable');
  });

  it('survives a reader that throws, degrading to no feed rather than aborting', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => {
      throw new Error('redis unreachable');
    });

    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    // `decision` is still formed: a thrown reader must not collapse the whole
    // resolution the way a failed window read does.
    expect(resolved.decision).not.toBeNull();
    expect(resolved.capacity).toBeNull();
    expect(resolved.logLine).toContain('polymarket book read threw');
  });

  it('admits a polygon cohort once a book verdict is threaded through (S4-M38)', async () => {
    // The wiring assertion. The test directly above proves polygon is
    // unassessable WITHOUT a book; this proves the verdict actually reaches
    // `assessMasterCapacity` rather than being accepted by the pure helper and
    // then dropped on the floor -- the correct-but-inert shape this checklist has
    // been burned by four times, and which a helper-only test cannot detect.
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      polymarketBook: {
        chain: 'polygon',
        tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
        usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
        basis: 'order-book-depth',
        approximate: true,
        note: 'walked ladder within 100bps'
      },
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).not.toBe('capacity-not-assessable');
    expect(resolved.capacity).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('maps a real impact breach to skip so users read capacity-exhausted', async () => {
    // $20,000 TVL -> $10,000 usable -> 500 bps on solana -> $500 of room.
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 20_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd(
        [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 50_000 })],
        SIGNAL,
        PLATFORM
      ),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).toBe('capacity-price-impact-cap-reached');
    expect(resolved.capacity).toEqual({ outcome: 'skip' });
  });

  it('maps the follower soft cap to skip, not to unknown', async () => {
    dbMocks.countActiveMasterFollowers.mockResolvedValue(DEFAULT_FOLLOWER_SOFT_CAP + 1);
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 100_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).toBe('capacity-follower-soft-cap-reached');
    expect(resolved.capacity).toEqual({ outcome: 'skip' });
  });

  it('admits when the cohort fits under the chain ceiling', async () => {
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 1_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 100 })], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.outcome).toBe('admit');
    expect(resolved.capacity).toEqual({ outcome: 'admit' });
  });

  it('never renders the internal detail as a user message', async () => {
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 20_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd(
        [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 50_000 })],
        SIGNAL,
        PLATFORM
      ),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.user.message).not.toMatch(/\d/);
    expect(resolved.decision?.user.message).not.toMatch(/follower/i);
  });
});

describe('resolveFanoutCapacity', () => {
  it('reads the 5-minute fan-out drain window, live modes only', async () => {
    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 1_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(FANOUT_CAPACITY_WINDOW_MS).toBe(MASTER_CAPACITY_WINDOWS.fanoutDrainMs);
    const call = dbMocks.fetchMasterWindowNotional.mock.calls[0]?.[0];
    expect(call.executionModes).toEqual(['live']);
    expect(call.windowEndsAt.getTime() - call.windowStartsAt.getTime()).toBe(
      FANOUT_CAPACITY_WINDOW_MS
    );
    expect(FANOUT_CAPACITY_EXECUTION_MODES).toEqual(['live']);
  });

  it('overrides only the projected notional and keeps the window coverage', async () => {
    dbMocks.fetchMasterWindowNotional.mockResolvedValue({
      committedNotionalUsd: 400,
      projectedNotionalUsd: 0,
      coverage: 'partial-unpriced-legs',
      unpricedLegCount: 3
    });
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 1_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 100 })], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.internal.priceImpact?.lowerBound).toBe(true);
    expect(resolved.decision?.unassessed.map((entry) => entry.reason)).toContain(
      'copy-notional-partial'
    );
    // Still an admit â€” a lower-bound pass, flagged rather than smoothed away.
    expect(resolved.decision?.outcome).toBe('admit');
  });

  it('feeds an unknown follower count through as unassessed rather than as zero', async () => {
    dbMocks.countActiveMasterFollowers.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 1_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 100 })], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.unassessed.map((entry) => entry.reason)).toContain(
      'follower-count-unknown'
    );
    expect(resolved.decision?.internal.followerSoftCap).toBeNull();
  });

  it('applies a per-master policy override to the ceiling', async () => {
    dbMocks.fetchMasterCapacityPolicy.mockResolvedValue({
      policy: { maxAggregateImpactBps: 1 },
      dailyBudgetShareBps: null
    });
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 1_000_000,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd(
        [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 5_000 })],
        SIGNAL,
        PLATFORM
      ),
      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.internal.priceImpact?.capBps).toBe(1);
    expect(resolved.decision?.outcome).toBe('skip');
  });

  it('declares unassessablePolicy skip, never admit', async () => {
    // Asserted through behaviour rather than by inspecting the argument: an
    // unassessable primary must not admit.
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',

      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.outcome).toBe('skip');
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).not.toBe('capacity-admitted-unassessed');
  });

  it('excludes everyone as capacity-unknown when a read throws', async () => {
    dbMocks.fetchMasterWindowNotional.mockRejectedValue(new Error('connection terminated'));
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,

    });

  });

  it('uses the chain ceiling derived from DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS, not a literal', async () => {

      now: NOW
    });
    expect(resolved.decision?.internal.priceImpact?.capBps).toBe(
      PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS.solana
    );
  });
});

describe('planCapacityLedgerEntries', () => {
  const base = {
    masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
    chain: 'solana' as const,
    tokenMint: TOKEN,
    sourceTradeId: 'source-trade-1',
    effectiveMode: 'live' as const,
    cohortSize: 3,
    committedAt: NOW
  };

  it('records an unpriced null notional rather than a fabricated figure', () => {
    const [entry] = planCapacityLedgerEntries(base);
    expect(entry?.notionalUsd).toBeNull();
    expect(entry?.notionalBasis).toBe('unpriced');
  });

  it('writes one row per mode, keyed on the fan-out event', () => {
    const entries = planCapacityLedgerEntries({ ...base, effectiveMode: 'live+shadow' });
    expect(entries.map((entry) => entry.executionMode)).toEqual(['live', 'shadow']);
    expect(new Set(entries.map((entry) => entry.sourceTradeId)).size).toBe(1);
  });

  it('writes nothing when no user job was enqueued', () => {
    expect(planCapacityLedgerEntries({ ...base, cohortSize: 0 })).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('writes nothing for an off chain', () => {
    expect(planCapacityLedgerEntries({ ...base, effectiveMode: 'off' })).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('carries the chain-prefixed master address, so 053 prefix CHECK holds', () => {
    const [entry] = planCapacityLedgerEntries(base);
    expect(entry?.masterWalletAddress.startsWith('solana:')).toBe(true);
    expect(entry?.chain).toBe('solana');
  });

  it('writes every planned row', async () => {
    const entries = planCapacityLedgerEntries({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      sourceTradeId: 'source-trade-1',
      effectiveMode: 'live+shadow',
      cohortSize: 2,
      committedAt: NOW
    });
    await expect(recordFanoutCapacityLedger(entries)).resolves.toBe(2);
    expect(dbMocks.recordMasterCapacityLedgerEntry).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('swallows a write failure â€” the orders are already queued', async () => {
    dbMocks.recordMasterCapacityLedgerEntry.mockRejectedValue(new Error('deadlock detected'));
    const entries = planCapacityLedgerEntries({
      masterWalletAddress: MASTER,

      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      sourceTradeId: 'source-trade-1',
      effectiveMode: 'live',
      cohortSize: 1,
      committedAt: NOW
    });
    await expect(recordFanoutCapacityLedger(entries)).resolves.toBe(0);
  });

  it('is a no-op for an empty plan', async () => {
    await expect(recordFanoutCapacityLedger([])).resolves.toBe(0);
    expect(dbMocks.recordMasterCapacityLedgerEntry).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
