import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker } from './polymarket-relayer-budget.js';

describe('Polymarket Relayer Daily Budget Enforcement (S4-P15)', () => {
  it('allows operations when below the configured daily limit', () => {
    const tracker = new PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker(100);
    const status = tracker.checkBudget();

    expect(status.allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(status.budget).toBe(100);
    expect(status.usedToday).toBe(0);
    expect(status.remaining).toBe(100);
  });

  it('tracks execution counts and decrements remaining budget', () => {
    const tracker = new PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker(10);
    tracker.recordExecution();
    tracker.recordExecution();

    const status = tracker.checkBudget();
    expect(status.allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(status.usedToday).toBe(2);
    expect(status.remaining).toBe(8);
  });

  it('refuses the N+1st operation when budget is reached with actionable code', () => {
    const tracker = new PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker(3);
    tracker.recordExecution();
    tracker.recordExecution();
    tracker.recordExecution();

    const status = tracker.checkBudget();
    expect(status.allowed).toBe(false);
    expect(status.remaining).toBe(0);
    expect(status.code).toBe('polymarket-relayer-capacity-exhausted');
    expect(status.reason).toContain('Polymarket daily relayer capacity exhausted (3/3 used)');
  });

  it('resets budget on a new UTC calendar day', () => {
    const tracker = new PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker(5);
    const day1 = new Date('2026-10-28T23:59:00Z');
    const day2 = new Date('2026-10-29T00:01:00Z');

    tracker.checkBudget(day1);
    tracker.recordExecution(day1);
    tracker.recordExecution(day1);
    expect(tracker.checkBudget(day1).usedToday).toBe(2);

    // On day 2, should reset to 0
    const day2Status = tracker.checkBudget(day2);
    expect(day2Status.allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(day2Status.usedToday).toBe(0);
    expect(day2Status.remaining).toBe(5);
  });

  it('defaults to 10,000 operations when no budget is specified', () => {
    const tracker = new PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker();
    expect(tracker.checkBudget().budget).toBe(10_000);
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-relayer-budget.ts <==
/**
 * Daily relayer budget tracker for Polymarket Builder executions (S4-P15).
 *
 * Polymarket grants 10,000 builder executions/day. Relayer transactions cover
 * orders, approvals, and settlements.
 *
 * Bounded: tracks usage in a calendar day (UTC). When remaining budget drops to 0,
 * checks fail-closed with explicit code `polymarket-relayer-capacity-exhausted`
 * and skip-with-reason, rather than firing requests that burst into venue rejections.
 *
 * Configurable via `POLYMARKET_RELAYER_DAILY_BUDGET` (scales with growth, not a literal).
 */

export interface RelayerBudgetStatus {
  readonly allowed: boolean;
  readonly budget: number;
  readonly usedToday: number;
  readonly remaining: number;
  readonly reason?: string;
  readonly code?: 'polymarket-relayer-capacity-exhausted';
}

export class PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker {
  private usedCount = 0;
  private currentDay: string = '';
  private readonly budget: number;

  constructor(budget?: number) {
    this.budget = budget ?? Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_RELAYER_DAILY_BUDGET ?? 10_000);
  }

  private resetIfNewDay(now: Date = new Date()): void {
    const today = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    if (this.currentDay !== today) {
      this.currentDay = today;
      this.usedCount = 0;
    }
  }

  checkBudget(now: Date = new Date()): RelayerBudgetStatus {
    this.resetIfNewDay(now);
    const remaining = Math.max(0, this.budget - this.usedCount);

    if (this.usedCount >= this.budget) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        budget: this.budget,
        usedToday: this.usedCount,
        remaining: 0,
        code: 'polymarket-relayer-capacity-exhausted',
        reason: `Polymarket daily relayer capacity exhausted (${this.usedCount}/${this.budget} used)`
      };
    }

    return {
      allowed: true,
      budget: this.budget,
      usedToday: this.usedCount,
      remaining
    };
  }

  recordExecution(now: Date = new Date()): void {
    this.resetIfNewDay(now);
    this.usedCount += 1;
  }

  setUsedForTest(count: number, now: Date = new Date()): void {
    this.currentDay = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    this.usedCount = count;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.usedCount = 0;
    this.currentDay = '';
  }
}

export const globalPolymarketRelayerBudget = new PolymarketRelayerBudgetTracker();

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-representation.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct,
  describePolymarketComplement,
  isSamePolymarketPosition,
  parsePolymarketOutcomePosition,
  polymarketPositionKey,
  type PolymarketOutcomePosition
} from './polymarket-representation.js';

const CONDITION_A = `0x${'a'.repeat(64)}`;
const CONDITION_B = `0x${'b'.repeat(64)}`;
const CONDITION_C = `0x${'c'.repeat(64)}`;

// Real-shaped uint256 outcome token ids, as the CLOB reports `asset_id`.
const YES_TOKEN = '107505882767731489358349912513945399560393482969656700824895970500493757150417';
const NO_TOKEN = '7305630249804085635496399869905769372294302716159034447326228509068694952392';

function position(overrides: Partial<{
  conditionId: string;
  tokenId: string;
  outcomeIndex: number;
  outcome: string;
  negRisk: boolean;
}> = {}): PolymarketOutcomePosition {
  return parsePolymarketOutcomePosition({
    conditionId: CONDITION_A,
    tokenId: YES_TOKEN,
    outcomeIndex: 0,
    outcome: 'Yes',
    negRisk: false,
    ...overrides
  });
}

describe('Polymarket outcome representation is preserved, not normalised (S4-M20)', () => {
  describe('identity is the outcome token', () => {
    it('keys a position on the token id, never the condition id', () => {
      // A condition holds two outcomes. Keying on it would merge YES and NO into
      // one position row, which is the normalisation this item forbids.
      const yes = position({ tokenId: YES_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 0, outcome: 'Yes' });
      const no = position({ tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No' });

      expect(polymarketPositionKey(yes)).toBe(`polygon:${YES_TOKEN}`);
      expect(polymarketPositionKey(no)).toBe(`polygon:${NO_TOKEN}`);
      expect(polymarketPositionKey(yes)).not.toBe(polymarketPositionKey(no));
      expect(yes.conditionId).toBe(no.conditionId);
    });

    it('does not let negRisk enter the key, so no adapter branch is re-introduced', () => {
      // `negRisk` is context for reasoning about a position. The client still
      // picks the collateral adapter from the condition id, and
      // polymarket-negrisk.test.ts still asserts we send no negRisk/adapter key.
      expect(polymarketPositionKey(position({ negRisk: false })))
        .toBe(polymarketPositionKey(position({ negRisk: true })));
    });

    it('treats NO on one outcome as a different position from YES on the same market', () => {
      const no = position({ tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No' });
      expect(isSamePolymarketPosition(position(), no)).toBe(false);
      // ...and the same outcome seen twice is one position, not two.
      expect(isSamePolymarketPosition(position(), position())).toBe(true);
    });

    it('refuses a condition id where a token id belongs', () => {
      // The concrete failure this rejection prevents: a condition id used as a
      // position key silently collapses both outcomes into one row.
      expect(() => position({ tokenId: CONDITION_A })).toThrow('is not a uint256');
      expect(() => position({ tokenId: '0' })).toThrow('is not a uint256');
    });

    it('accepts a token id in either the bare or the polygon-prefixed form', () => {
      // Bare from the venue (`trade.asset`, order books), prefixed from our own
      // `token_mint` columns. Both must land on one identity.
      expect(polymarketPositionKey(position({ tokenId: `polygon:${YES_TOKEN}` })))
        .toBe(polymarketPositionKey(position({ tokenId: YES_TOKEN })));
    });

    it('will not infer an outcome label from the index', () => {
      // A named neg-risk outcome carries a candidate name, not a polarity, so
      // index 1 does not mean 'No' and must never be filled in for the user.
      expect(() => parsePolymarketOutcomePosition({
        conditionId: CONDITION_A, tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: ''
      })).toThrow('outcome label');
    });
  });

  describe('the netting guard', () => {
    it('refuses to merge two outcomes of one condition', () => {
      // The shape that means a caller reached the condition level and lost the
      // outcome â€” the S4-M19 redemption fan-out and exposure aggregation are the
      // two places this is about to be tempted.
      expect(() => assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct([
        position({ tokenId: YES_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 0, outcome: 'Yes' }),
        position({ tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No' })
      ])).toThrow('distinct outcomes are distinct positions');
    });

    it('allows the same outcome twice, and outcomes across different conditions', () => {
      expect(() => assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct([position(), position()])).not.toThrow();
      expect(() => assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct([
        position({ conditionId: CONDITION_A }),
        position({ conditionId: CONDITION_B })
      ])).not.toThrow();
    });

    it('names both outcomes in the refusal so an operator can see what collapsed', () => {
      expect(() => assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct([
        position({ tokenId: YES_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 0, outcome: 'Yes' }),
        position({ tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No' })
      ])).toThrow(/Yes.*index 0.*No.*index 1/);
    });
  });

  describe('the complement is a set, described but never substituted', () => {
    it('is the other outcome of the same condition on a binary market, via merge', () => {
      // `/trading/positions/manage` â†’ Merge Positions: 1 YES + 1 NO returns 1 pUSD,
      // and only through `mergePositions` with equal balances and a prior adapter
      // approval. Holding one is not holding the other.
      const complement = describePolymarketComplement(
        position({ tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No' })
      );

      expect(complement).toEqual({
        kind: 'known',
        mechanism: 'merge-positions',
        legs: [{ conditionId: CONDITION_A, outcomeIndex: 0 }],
        interchangeableWithoutAction: false,
        outcomeSetStable: true
      });
    });

    it('is one YES per OTHER market of a neg-risk event, spanning other conditions', () => {
      // `/concepts/negative-risk` â†’ Conversion Mechanics: 1 NO for Outcome A
      // converts to 1 YES for every other outcome in the event. So the complement
      // is N-1 legs in N-1 distinct conditions â€” it cannot be one position row
      // under any keying, and merging it would touch conditions never traded.
      const complement = describePolymarketComplement(
        position({ tokenId: NO_TOKEN, outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No', negRisk: true }),
        { siblingConditionIds: [CONDITION_B, CONDITION_C] }
      );

      expect(complement).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', mechanism: 'neg-risk-convert' });
      expect(complement.kind === 'known' && complement.legs).toEqual([
        { conditionId: CONDITION_B, outcomeIndex: 0 },
        { conditionId: CONDITION_C, outcomeIndex: 0 }
      ]);
      // More than one leg, and none of them in this position's own condition.
      expect(complement.kind === 'known' && complement.legs.length).toBe(2);
      expect(complement.kind === 'known'
        && complement.legs.every((leg) => leg.conditionId !== CONDITION_A)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('never reports the complement as interchangeable without an on-chain call', () => {
      // The docs call the neg-risk relationship "economically equivalent", which is
      // exactly the reasoning this item forbids acting on. The equivalence is
      // realised by an adapter call this executor does not make.
      for (const complement of [
        describePolymarketComplement(position()),
        describePolymarketComplement(
          position({ negRisk: true }), { siblingConditionIds: [CONDITION_B] }
        )
      ]) {
        expect(complement.kind === 'known' && complement.interchangeableWithoutAction).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    it('reports an unstable outcome set under augmented neg risk', () => {
      // `/concepts/negative-risk` â†’ Augmented Negative Risk: placeholders are
      // clarified after trading begins and the 'Other' definition narrows. A
      // complement computed now can be incomplete by resolution, so a
      // normalisation would be wrong even if it were legitimate.
      const complement = describePolymarketComplement(
        position({ negRisk: true }),
        { siblingConditionIds: [CONDITION_B, CONDITION_C], augmented: true }
      );

      expect(complement).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', outcomeSetStable: false });
    });

    it('is undeterminable when the neg-risk event has not been read', () => {
      // Not "no complement" â€” an unread event. An empty set would read as
      // "nothing on the other side", which is the more dangerous of the two.
      expect(describePolymarketComplement(position({ negRisk: true })))
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'undeterminable' });
      expect(describePolymarketComplement(
        position({ negRisk: true }), { siblingConditionIds: [] }
      )).toMatchObject({ kind: 'undeterminable' });
      // A group that lists only this position's own condition is also no set.
      expect(describePolymarketComplement(
        position({ negRisk: true }), { siblingConditionIds: [CONDITION_A] }
      )).toMatchObject({ kind: 'undeterminable' });
    });

    it('is undeterminable for an out-of-range outcome on a standard market', () => {
      // `/concepts/positions-tokens`: each market has exactly two outcome tokens.
      expect(describePolymarketComplement(position({ outcomeIndex: 2 })))
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'undeterminable' });
    });
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-representation.ts <==
import { UnrecoverableError } from 'bullmq';

/**
 * Polymarket position identity â€” preserved per outcome, never normalised into an
 * economically-equivalent alternative (checklist `S4-M20`).
 *
 * **What was found before anything was written.** Nothing in this repo normalises
 * today, and the item is therefore a guard rather than a refactor. The canonical
 * ledger already keys on the outcome token: `buildPolymarketSourceTradeInput`
 * (`apps/indexer/src/source-trade-lifecycle.ts`) sets
 * `tokenMint = resolveChainValue(trade.asset, 'polygon').raw`, and `trade.asset`
 * is the ERC-1155 outcome token id, not the condition id. `polymarket_outcomes`
 * is keyed `(condition_id, outcome_index)` with its own `token_id`, and
 * `getPolymarketOutcomeContext` looks up by `token_id`. So YES and NO already
 * occupy distinct `copy_positions` rows. This module exists to make that a
 * checked invariant instead of an accident, because the next item in the
 * checklist is the one that will be tempted to break it.
 *
 * **Where the temptation is, concretely.** `S4-M19` wires redemption into the
 * mirroring path, and redemption is the one Polymarket operation that is
 * legitimately *condition*-scoped: `redeemPositions({conditionId})` takes no
 * amount and redeems both outcomes. Going from a condition back to "the
 * position" is exactly the step at which two outcome rows get collapsed into
 * one. A second temptation is exposure aggregation: netting a YES against a NO
 * on the same condition looks like flat risk and is not.
 *
 * **Why the economics being similar is not enough** (live docs, verified
 * 2026-08-20):
 *
 *   * `/concepts/negative-risk` states the equivalence in the venue's own words â€”
 *     "betting against one outcome is economically equivalent to betting *for*
 *     all other outcomes" â€” which is precisely the reasoning this item forbids
 *     acting on. The equivalence is realised only by an explicit call:
 *     *Conversion Mechanics* is "you hold 1 No token for Outcome A â†’ call the
 *     convert function on the adapter â†’ you receive 1 Yes token for every other
 *     outcome in the event". Until that call, the positions are different
 *     ERC-1155 assets with different token ids.
 *   * The complement is a **set**, and in a neg-risk event it is a set spread
 *     across *other conditions*. `/concepts/markets-events` â†’ *Multi-Market
 *     Events* shows a neg-risk group as N separate Yes/No markets under one
 *     event, and `/concepts/positions-tokens` â†’ *Outcome Tokens* confirms "each
 *     market has exactly two outcome tokens". So the complement of NO-on-A is
 *     Nâˆ’1 YES tokens in Nâˆ’1 distinct conditions. It cannot be the same position
 *     row under any keying, and merging it into one would create or destroy
 *     positions in conditions the user never traded.
 *   * The complement is not even **stable**. `/concepts/negative-risk` â†’
 *     *Augmented Negative Risk* documents placeholder outcomes clarified after
 *     trading begins via the bulletin board, with "the 'Other' definition
 *     narrow[ing] as placeholders are assigned". So the set that NO-on-A
 *     converts into today is not the set it converts into tomorrow. A
 *     normalisation computed at fill time would be wrong by resolution.
 *   * Even the binary case needs an explicit action. `/trading/positions/manage`
 *     â†’ *Merge Positions* is "every 1 YES token and 1 NO token returns 1 pUSD",
 *     via `mergePositions(collateralToken, parentCollectionId, conditionId,
 *     partition [1,2], amount)`, requiring equal balances and a prior
 *     `setApprovalForAll` of the market's collateral adapter. A YES and a NO are
 *     interchangeable with collateral only after that call succeeds.
 *
 * **This does not re-introduce an adapter branch.** `negRisk` is carried here as
 * *context for reasoning about a position*, and deliberately plays no part in
 * `polymarketPositionKey` â€” the key is the outcome token either way. The client
 * still picks the collateral adapter from the condition id, and
 * `polymarket-negrisk.test.ts` still asserts no `negRisk`/`adapter`/`exchange`
 * key is ever sent on an order. Preserving representation is about what we
 * record and reason about, not about what we route on.
 *
 * Pure and dependency-injected: no clock, no environment, no I/O.
 */

/** Polymarket is chain `polygon`; a position key is a chain-prefixed token mint. */
const POLYGON_PREFIX = 'polygon:';

export interface PolymarketOutcomePosition {
  /** Normalised `0x`-prefixed 64-hex condition id of the market holding this outcome. */
  readonly conditionId: string;
  /** The ERC-1155 outcome token id, as an unpadded decimal string. */
  readonly tokenId: string;
  /** Index of this outcome within its market â€” 0 or 1, since a market has two. */
  readonly outcomeIndex: number;
  /** The outcome label, preserved verbatim ('Yes', 'No', or a named outcome). */
  readonly outcome: string;
  /** Neg-risk membership. Context for reasoning; never an input to the key. */
  readonly negRisk: boolean;
}

export interface PolymarketNegRiskGroup {
  /**
   * Condition ids of the sibling markets in the neg-risk event, excluding the
   * position's own. Absent when we have not read the event, which makes the
   * complement undeterminable rather than empty.
   */
  readonly siblingConditionIds?: readonly string[];
  /**
   * Whether the event uses augmented neg risk. When true the outcome set can grow
   * after trading begins, so any complement we compute is a snapshot with an
   * expiry we cannot see.
   */
  readonly augmented?: boolean;
}

export type PolymarketComplementMechanism =
  /** `mergePositions` on the market's collateral adapter, partition [1, 2]. */
  | 'merge-positions'
  /** `convert` on the Neg Risk Adapter. */
  | 'neg-risk-convert';

export interface PolymarketComplementLeg {
  readonly conditionId: string;
  /** The outcome index that would have to be held in that condition. */
  readonly outcomeIndex: number;
}

export interface PolymarketComplementKnown {
  readonly kind: 'known';
  readonly mechanism: PolymarketComplementMechanism;
  /**
   * The positions the complement consists of. Length > 1, or spanning more than
   * one condition, is by itself proof that the complement is not this position.
   */
  readonly legs: readonly PolymarketComplementLeg[];
  /**
   * Always false. The complement becomes the same economic exposure only after an
   * on-chain call this executor does not make, so it is never a substitution we
   * are entitled to perform silently.
   */
  readonly interchangeableWithoutAction: false;
  /** False under augmented neg risk, where the outcome set can still change. */
  readonly outcomeSetStable: boolean;
}

export interface PolymarketComplementUndeterminable {
  readonly kind: 'undeterminable';
  readonly reason: string;
}

export type PolymarketComplement =
  | PolymarketComplementKnown
  | PolymarketComplementUndeterminable;

function normalizeConditionId(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket ${label} must be a string`);
  }
  const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(normalized)) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket ${label} is not a condition id: ${value}`);
  }
  return normalized;
}

/**
 * Accept a bare or `polygon:`-prefixed outcome token id and return the bare form.
 *
 * Token ids arrive both ways â€” bare from the venue (`trade.asset`, order books)
 * and prefixed from our own tables (`token_mint`) â€” and confusing the two is how
 * a lookup silently misses.
 */
function normalizeTokenId(value: unknown): string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket outcome token id must be a string');
  }
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  const bare = trimmed.startsWith(POLYGON_PREFIX)
    ? trimmed.slice(POLYGON_PREFIX.length)
    : trimmed;
  // uint256 decimal, as the CLOB reports `asset_id`. Rejecting a condition id
  // here is the point: `0xâ€¦` never parses, so a condition id can never be
  // mistaken for a token id and become a position key.
  if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(bare) || /^0+$/.test(bare)) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket outcome token id is not a uint256: ${value}`);
  }
  return bare.replace(/^0+(?=[0-9])/, '');
}

/** Validate and normalise an outcome position, rejecting anything ambiguous. */
export function parsePolymarketOutcomePosition(input: {
  readonly conditionId: unknown;
  readonly tokenId: unknown;
  readonly outcomeIndex: unknown;
  readonly outcome: unknown;
  readonly negRisk?: unknown;
}): PolymarketOutcomePosition {
  const conditionId = normalizeConditionId(input.conditionId, 'condition id');
  const tokenId = normalizeTokenId(input.tokenId);
  if (typeof input.outcomeIndex !== 'number'
    || !Number.isInteger(input.outcomeIndex)
    || input.outcomeIndex < 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `Polymarket outcome index must be a non-negative integer, got ${String(input.outcomeIndex)}`
    );
  }
  if (typeof input.outcome !== 'string' || !input.outcome.trim()) {
    // The label is what a user reads on their position. An outcome we cannot name
    // is one we cannot show, and 'Yes'/'No' must not be inferred from the index â€”
    // a named neg-risk outcome carries a candidate name, not a polarity.
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket outcome label must be a non-empty string');
  }
  return {
    conditionId,
    tokenId,
    outcomeIndex: input.outcomeIndex,
    outcome: input.outcome.trim(),
    negRisk: input.negRisk === true
  };
}

/**
 * The canonical position key: the chain-prefixed **outcome token** mint.
 *
 * Derived from the token id and nothing else. In particular it is not derived
 * from the condition id â€” a condition holds two outcomes, so a condition-keyed
 * position would merge them â€” and not from `negRisk`, which is context rather
 * than identity.
 */
export function polymarketPositionKey(position: PolymarketOutcomePosition): string {
  return `${POLYGON_PREFIX}${position.tokenId}`;
}

/** Two positions are the same only when they are the same outcome token. */
export function isSamePolymarketPosition(
  left: PolymarketOutcomePosition,
  right: PolymarketOutcomePosition
): boolean {
  return left.tokenId === right.tokenId;
}

/**
 * Refuse a set of positions that a condition-level view would have collapsed.
 *
 * This is the guard the item asks for. Given the positions a caller is about to
 * net, aggregate, or write as one row, it throws when two of them share a
 * condition but name different outcomes â€” the shape that means someone has
 * reached the condition level and lost the outcome. Duplicates of the *same*
 * outcome token are fine; that is one position seen twice.
 *
 * Intended call sites are exposure aggregation and the `S4-M19` redemption
 * fan-out from `redeemPositions({conditionId})` back to positions.
 */
export function assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct(
  positions: readonly PolymarketOutcomePosition[]
): void {
  const byCondition = new Map<string, PolymarketOutcomePosition>();
  for (const position of positions) {
    const seen = byCondition.get(position.conditionId);
    if (seen && !isSamePolymarketPosition(seen, position)) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        `Polymarket Protection: refusing to merge outcome ${seen.outcome} (index ${seen.outcomeIndex})`
        + ` with outcome ${position.outcome} (index ${position.outcomeIndex})`
        + ` on condition ${position.conditionId} â€” distinct outcomes are distinct positions`
      );
    }
    byCondition.set(position.conditionId, position);
  }
}

/**
 * Describe what this position's complement actually consists of.
 *
 * Returns a *description*, never a substitution. The point of the return value is
 * that a caller inspecting it cannot come away thinking the complement is one
 * interchangeable position: `interchangeableWithoutAction` is typed `false`, the
 * legs are enumerated, and `outcomeSetStable` reports when the set can still
 * change underneath us.
 */
export function describePolymarketComplement(
  position: PolymarketOutcomePosition,
  group: PolymarketNegRiskGroup = {}
): PolymarketComplement {
  if (!position.negRisk) {
    // Binary market: the complement is the other outcome of the same condition,
    // and reaching collateral from the pair requires `mergePositions` with equal
    // balances and a prior adapter approval.
    if (position.outcomeIndex > 1) {
      return {
        kind: 'undeterminable',
        reason: `Outcome index ${position.outcomeIndex} exceeds the two outcomes a standard market has`
      };
    }
    return {
      kind: 'known',
      mechanism: 'merge-positions',
      legs: [{
        conditionId: position.conditionId,
        outcomeIndex: position.outcomeIndex === 0 ? 1 : 0
      }],
      interchangeableWithoutAction: false,
      outcomeSetStable: true
    };
  }

  const siblings = group.siblingConditionIds;
  if (!siblings) {
    // Not "no complement" â€” an unread event. Saying so is the honest answer and
    // is itself a reason never to normalise on a hunch.
    return {
      kind: 'undeterminable',
      reason: `Neg-risk event for condition ${position.conditionId} has not been read,`
        + ' so its complement set is unknown'
    };
  }
  const normalizedSiblings = siblings
    .map((value) => normalizeConditionId(value, 'sibling condition id'))
    .filter((value) => value !== position.conditionId);
  if (normalizedSiblings.length === 0) {
    return {
      kind: 'undeterminable',
      reason: `Neg-risk event for condition ${position.conditionId} reported no sibling markets`
    };
  }

  return {
    kind: 'known',
    mechanism: 'neg-risk-convert',
    // One YES per other market in the event, per the documented conversion.
    legs: normalizedSiblings.map((conditionId) => ({ conditionId, outcomeIndex: 0 })),
    interchangeableWithoutAction: false,
    // Augmented neg risk can add named outcomes after trading opens, so a
    // complement computed now may be incomplete by resolution.
    outcomeSetStable: group.augmented !== true
  };
}

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-staleness.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  evaluatePolymarketSignalStaleness,
  evaluatePolymarketStaleness,
  isPolymarketSignalStale,
  POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS,
  POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS,
  polymarketStalenessBudgetMs,
  resolvePolymarketStalenessPolicy
} from './polymarket-staleness.js';

const MINUTE = 60_000;
const HOUR = 60 * MINUTE;
const DAY = 24 * HOUR;

describe('Polymarket staleness as a fraction of time-to-resolution (S4-M18)', () => {
  describe('the rule is a fraction, not a constant', () => {
    it('accepts six hours late on a two-day market and refuses it on an eight-hour one', () => {
      // The checklist case, stated directly. Same age, same policy, two markets;
      // a constant cannot separate them and a fraction must.
      const policy = { maxResolutionFraction: 0.2, maxBudgetMs: 12 * HOUR };

      const twoDays = evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 6 * HOUR,
        msToResolution: 2 * DAY,
        policy
      });
      const eightHours = evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 6 * HOUR,
        msToResolution: 8 * HOUR,
        policy
      });

      expect(twoDays.kind).toBe('fresh');
      expect(eightHours.kind).toBe('stale');
      expect(eightHours).toMatchObject({ code: 'signal-age-exceeds-resolution-fraction' });
      // 6h of 48h is 12.5% consumed; 6h of 8h is 75%. The rule is reading the
      // ratio, which is the whole point of the item.
      expect(twoDays.consumedFraction).toBeCloseTo(0.125);
      expect(eightHours.consumedFraction).toBeCloseTo(0.75);
    });

    it('tightens the budget monotonically as resolution approaches', () => {
      const budgets = [30 * DAY, 2 * DAY, 6 * HOUR, HOUR, 10 * MINUTE, MINUTE]
        .map((ms) => polymarketStalenessBudgetMs(ms));

      for (let index = 1; index < budgets.length; index += 1) {
        expect(budgets[index]!).toBeLessThanOrEqual(budgets[index - 1]!);
      }
      // Long-dated markets sit on the flat ceiling; near-resolution markets are
      // pulled down to the floor.
      expect(budgets[0]).toBe(POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS);
      expect(budgets.at(-1)).toBe(POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS);
    });

    it('never loosens beyond the flat ceiling it refines', () => {
      // The safety property. A control added to reduce risk must not become
      // permission to accept a signal today's constant would have refused, so a
      // market resolving in a century still tops out at the ceiling.
      expect(polymarketStalenessBudgetMs(100 * 365 * DAY))
        .toBe(POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS);

      const ancient = evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS + 1,
        msToResolution: 100 * 365 * DAY
      });

      expect(ancient).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'stale',
        code: 'signal-age-exceeds-absolute-ceiling'
      });
    });

    it('never tightens below the order-book age allowance', () => {
      // A budget under `POLYMARKET_MAX_BOOK_AGE_MS` would refuse a signal younger
      // than the book we are about to trade against, which is incoherent.
      expect(polymarketStalenessBudgetMs(1)).toBe(POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS);
      expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS,
        msToResolution: 30_000
      }).kind).toBe('fresh');
    });
  });

  describe('fail-closed branches', () => {
    it('refuses a market with no readable resolution time', () => {
      // Docs type Gamma's `endDate` and `endDateIso` as nullable and say nothing
      // about what a null means, so the denominator is genuinely unknown.
      // Falling back to the flat constant would reinstate exactly the behaviour
      // this item replaces, on the markets where risk is least measurable.
      for (const msToResolution of [null, undefined, Number.NaN]) {
        expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({ signalAgeMs: 1_000, msToResolution })).toMatchObject({
          kind: 'stale',
          code: 'resolution-time-unknown'
        });
      }
    });

    it('refuses a market already eligible for resolution', () => {
      expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({ signalAgeMs: 1_000, msToResolution: 0 }))
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'stale', code: 'market-already-resolved' });
      expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({ signalAgeMs: 1_000, msToResolution: -1 }))
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'stale', code: 'market-already-resolved' });
    });

    it('refuses an unmeasurable age rather than treating it as zero', () => {
      // A negative age means our clock and the indexer's disagree. Clamping it to
      // zero would read a skewed signal as maximally fresh.
      for (const signalAgeMs of [-1, Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY]) {
        expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({ signalAgeMs, msToResolution: DAY })).toMatchObject({
          kind: 'stale',
          code: 'signal-age-invalid'
        });
      }
    });

    it('raises on a misconfigured policy instead of silently coercing it', () => {
      // An operator threshold that cannot be honoured is a bug, not a datum about
      // this trade, so it must not resolve to a quiet skip.
      expect(() => evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 0, msToResolution: DAY, policy: { maxResolutionFraction: 0 }
      })).toThrow('greater than 0 and at most 1');
      expect(() => evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 0, msToResolution: DAY, policy: { maxResolutionFraction: 1.5 }
      })).toThrow('greater than 0 and at most 1');
      expect(() => evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 0, msToResolution: DAY, policy: { minBudgetMs: 2, maxBudgetMs: 1 }
      })).toThrow('must not exceed');
    });
  });

  describe('the venue matching delay is charged against the budget', () => {
    it('counts secondsDelay as latency, because an order cannot match until it elapses', () => {
      // `/market-data/market-details` documents `secondsDelay` as the delay before
      // a newly placed marketable order can match, and `/trading/place-orders`
      // returns a `delayed` status for it. Ignoring it would measure freshness at
      // submission when the fill happens later.
      const policy = { maxResolutionFraction: 1, minBudgetMs: 0, maxBudgetMs: 60_000 };

      expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 55_000, msToResolution: DAY, policy
      }).kind).toBe('fresh');
      expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 55_000, msToResolution: DAY, matchingDelayMs: 10_000, policy
      })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'stale', effectiveAgeMs: 65_000 });
    });

    it('refuses a negative or non-finite delay rather than ignoring it', () => {
      expect(evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
        signalAgeMs: 0, msToResolution: DAY, matchingDelayMs: -1
      })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'stale', code: 'signal-age-invalid' });
    });
  });

  describe('timestamp adapter', () => {
    it('derives both durations from an injected clock, never Date.now()', () => {
      const now = Date.UTC(2026, 7, 20, 12, 0, 0);
      const decision = evaluatePolymarketSignalStaleness({
        signalAt: new Date(now - 2 * MINUTE),
        resolutionAt: new Date(now + 2 * DAY),
        now,
        matchingDelaySeconds: 30
      });

      expect(decision).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'fresh',
        effectiveAgeMs: 2 * MINUTE + 30_000,
        msToResolution: 2 * DAY
      });
    });

    it('treats a null end date as an unknown resolution time', () => {
      const now = Date.UTC(2026, 7, 20, 12, 0, 0);
      expect(evaluatePolymarketSignalStaleness({
        signalAt: now, resolutionAt: null, now
      })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'stale', code: 'resolution-time-unknown' });
    });

    it('is a boolean through the predicate helper', () => {
      const now = Date.UTC(2026, 7, 20, 12, 0, 0);
      expect(isPolymarketSignalStale({ signalAgeMs: 0, msToResolution: 2 * DAY })).toBe(false);
      expect(isPolymarketSignalStale({ signalAgeMs: 0, msToResolution: null })).toBe(true);
      expect(evaluatePolymarketSignalStaleness({
        signalAt: now - 12 * HOUR, resolutionAt: now + 4 * HOUR, now
      }).kind).toBe('stale');
    });
  });

  describe('environment policy', () => {
    it('defaults to the shipped policy and reads overrides', () => {
      expect(resolvePolymarketStalenessPolicy({})).toEqual({
        maxResolutionFraction: 0.05,
        minBudgetMs: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS,
        maxBudgetMs: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS
      });
      expect(resolvePolymarketStalenessPolicy({
        POLYMARKET_STALENESS_RESOLUTION_FRACTION: '0.1',
        POLYMARKET_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS: '5000',
        POLYMARKET_STALENESS_CEILING_MS: '120000'
      })).toEqual({ maxResolutionFraction: 0.1, minBudgetMs: 5_000, maxBudgetMs: 120_000 });
    });

    it('fails at boot on an out-of-range fraction rather than on the first signal', () => {
      expect(() => resolvePolymarketStalenessPolicy({
        POLYMARKET_STALENESS_RESOLUTION_FRACTION: '2'
      })).toThrow('greater than 0 and at most 1');
      expect(() => resolvePolymarketStalenessPolicy({
        POLYMARKET_STALENESS_CEILING_MS: '1000',
        POLYMARKET_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS: '5000'
      })).toThrow('must not exceed');
    });
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-staleness.ts <==
import { UnrecoverableError } from 'bullmq';
import { parseNonNegativeNumber, parsePositiveNumber } from './policy.js';

/**
 * Polymarket signal staleness, expressed as a fraction of the remaining
 * time-to-resolution rather than as a constant (checklist `S4-M18`).
 *
 * **Why a constant is the wrong shape here.** Every other venue in this repo is
 * a spot market, where a signal's information decays against price volatility
 * and nothing else â€” so a flat `SOURCE_COPY_MAX_EVENT_AGE_MS` (10 min default,
 * `index.ts`) is a defensible approximation. A prediction market has a second
 * clock the spot venues do not have: the market resolves, and as it approaches
 * resolution the price stops being a forecast and becomes a report. Six hours
 * late on a market resolving in two days has consumed 12.5% of the remaining
 * uncertainty; six hours late on a market resolving in eight hours has consumed
 * 75% of it, and the price we would pay has already absorbed most of what the
 * master was early to. One constant cannot separate those two cases, and the
 * constant that is right for the second is far too tight for the first.
 *
 * **The budget is a tightening, never a loosening.** `maxBudgetMs` keeps the
 * existing flat ceiling in force, and the fractional term can only reduce it.
 * That is deliberate and mirrors the one grid move `polymarket-mirror-bound.ts`
 * makes: a control added for safety must not become a licence to accept a signal
 * today's code would have refused. A long-dated market therefore behaves exactly
 * as it does now, and only near-resolution markets get stricter.
 *
 * **Why the floor exists.** As `msToResolution` falls, `fraction Ã— msToResolution`
 * approaches zero, and a budget below our own irreducible submission latency
 * (book fetch, live market-state read, sign, post) rejects every signal it is
 * ever shown â€” including ones that would have filled. `minBudgetMs` defaults to
 * the order-book age allowance (`POLYMARKET_MAX_BOOK_AGE_MS`, 15 s default),
 * because a staleness budget tighter than that is self-contradictory: it would
 * refuse a signal younger than the order book we are about to trade against.
 *
 * **Verified venue facts this is built on** (live docs, 2026-08-20):
 *
 *   * `/concepts/resolution` â†’ *Resolution Rules* defines a market's **end date**
 *     as "when the market is eligible for resolution". That makes `endDate` the
 *     correct denominator for time-to-resolution; it is the earliest moment the
 *     outcome can be locked in, not merely a display date.
 *   * `/api-reference/markets/get-market-by-id` types Gamma's `endDate` as
 *     `string<date-time> | null` and `endDateIso` as `string | null` â€” **both
 *     nullable**, and both present on the same market object. So a resolution
 *     time is not guaranteed and either field may be the one that carries it.
 *   * `/market-data/market-details` â†’ *Market Timing* documents `secondsDelay` as
 *     "delay, in seconds, before a newly placed marketable order can match", and
 *     `/trading/place-orders` documents an order status of `delayed` for exactly
 *     that case. A market with a configured delay adds that much latency between
 *     our submission and any fill, so it is charged against the budget as
 *     `matchingDelayMs` rather than ignored.
 *   * `gameStartTime` is documented as the "scheduled start time of the
 *     underlying game for a sports market" and is `string | null`. It is the
 *     start of the event, not its resolution, and is absent on every
 *     non-sports market â€” so it is **not** used as the denominator here.
 *
 * **What the docs do not say, and how that is handled.** Nothing in the docs
 * states what a null `endDate` means, and `umaEndDate` / `umaEndDateIso` appear
 * in every Gamma market schema with no prose describing them anywhere on the
 * site. Neither is guessed at: a market with no readable resolution time is
 * refused as `resolution-time-unknown`. Falling back to the flat ceiling would
 * reinstate precisely the behaviour this item replaces, and it would do so on
 * the markets where the risk is least measurable. This also agrees with the gate
 * next to it â€” `parsePolymarketMarketState` already throws on a missing end date,
 * so a Polymarket order cannot reach submission without one.
 *
 * Pure and dependency-injected throughout: `now` and every threshold is a
 * parameter, so a per-user policy needs no call-site change (Standing Rule 2).
 * Nothing here reads the clock or the environment on its own.
 */

/** Default share of the remaining time-to-resolution a signal may consume. */
export const POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FRACTION = 0.05;

/**
 * Default floor on the budget. Matches the `POLYMARKET_MAX_BOOK_AGE_MS` default
 * in `polymarket.ts`; see the floor rationale above.
 */
export const POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS = 15_000;

/**
 * Default ceiling on the budget. Matches the `SOURCE_COPY_MAX_EVENT_AGE_MS`
 * default in `index.ts` so this control starts out no looser than the flat rule
 * it refines.
 */
export const POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS = 10 * 60_000;

export type PolymarketStalenessCode =
  /** No readable resolution time, so the fraction has no denominator. Fails closed. */
  | 'resolution-time-unknown'
  /** Resolution is at or before `now`; there is no remaining uncertainty to trade. */
  | 'market-already-resolved'
  /** A negative or non-finite age is not a measurement. Fails closed. */
  | 'signal-age-invalid'
  /** Age exceeded the fractional budget â€” the near-resolution case this item adds. */
  | 'signal-age-exceeds-resolution-fraction'
  /** Age exceeded the flat ceiling, which a long-dated market cannot relax. */
  | 'signal-age-exceeds-absolute-ceiling';

export interface PolymarketStalenessPolicy {
  /** Share of remaining time-to-resolution a signal may consume, in (0, 1]. */
  readonly maxResolutionFraction: number;
  /** Lower clamp on the derived budget. */
  readonly minBudgetMs: number;
  /** Upper clamp on the derived budget â€” the flat rule this refines. */
  readonly maxBudgetMs: number;
}

export const POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_POLICY: PolymarketStalenessPolicy = {
  maxResolutionFraction: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FRACTION,
  minBudgetMs: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS,
  maxBudgetMs: POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS
};

export interface PolymarketStalenessInput {
  /** How old the source event is, in ms. Injected, never measured here. */
  readonly signalAgeMs: number;
  /** Remaining ms until the market is eligible for resolution, or null if unknown. */
  readonly msToResolution: number | null | undefined;
  /**
   * The market's configured matching delay in ms (`secondsDelay Ã— 1000`). Charged
   * against the budget because an order cannot match until it elapses.
   */
  readonly matchingDelayMs?: number;
  readonly policy?: Partial<PolymarketStalenessPolicy>;
}

export interface PolymarketStalenessFresh {
  readonly kind: 'fresh';
  /** `signalAgeMs + matchingDelayMs` â€” the age at the earliest possible fill. */
  readonly effectiveAgeMs: number;
  readonly msToResolution: number;
  /** The clamped budget this decision was measured against. */
  readonly budgetMs: number;
  /** `effectiveAgeMs / msToResolution`, for observability and `S4-M23`. */
  readonly consumedFraction: number;
}

export interface PolymarketStalenessStale {
  readonly kind: 'stale';
  readonly code: PolymarketStalenessCode;
  /** Operator- and user-readable, and specific enough to act on. */
  readonly reason: string;
  readonly effectiveAgeMs: number | null;
  readonly msToResolution: number | null;
  readonly budgetMs: number | null;
  readonly consumedFraction: number | null;
}

export type PolymarketStalenessDecision =
  | PolymarketStalenessFresh
  | PolymarketStalenessStale;

function resolvePolicy(overrides: Partial<PolymarketStalenessPolicy> | undefined): PolymarketStalenessPolicy {
  const policy: PolymarketStalenessPolicy = {
    ...POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_POLICY,
    ...overrides
  };
  // A misconfigured threshold is an operator bug, not a datum about this trade,
  // so it raises rather than resolving to `stale`. Silently coercing it would
  // make every subsequent decision unexplainable.
  if (!Number.isFinite(policy.maxResolutionFraction)
    || policy.maxResolutionFraction <= 0
    || policy.maxResolutionFraction > 1) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      'POLYMARKET_STALENESS_RESOLUTION_FRACTION must be greater than 0 and at most 1'
    );
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(policy.minBudgetMs) || policy.minBudgetMs < 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('POLYMARKET_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS must be a non-negative number');
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(policy.maxBudgetMs) || policy.maxBudgetMs <= 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('POLYMARKET_STALENESS_CEILING_MS must be a positive number');
  }
  if (policy.minBudgetMs > policy.maxBudgetMs) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      'POLYMARKET_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS must not exceed POLYMARKET_STALENESS_CEILING_MS'
    );
  }
  return policy;
}

/**
 * Derive the staleness budget for a market resolving in `msToResolution`.
 *
 * Exported so an operator or a test can see the curve directly rather than
 * inferring it from accept/reject boundaries.
 */
export function polymarketStalenessBudgetMs(
  msToResolution: number,
  policy: Partial<PolymarketStalenessPolicy> = {}
): number {
  const resolved = resolvePolicy(policy);
  if (!Number.isFinite(msToResolution) || msToResolution <= 0) return 0;
  const fractional = resolved.maxResolutionFraction * msToResolution;
  return Math.min(resolved.maxBudgetMs, Math.max(resolved.minBudgetMs, fractional));
}

/**
 * Decide whether a Polymarket signal is still fresh enough to act on.
 *
 * Returns a decision rather than throwing so the caller can record a stable
 * reason code alongside the skip, in the same shape as the mirror-bound skips
 * (`S4-M16`). Only a misconfigured *policy* throws.
 */
export function evaluatePolymarketStaleness(
  input: PolymarketStalenessInput
): PolymarketStalenessDecision {
  const policy = resolvePolicy(input.policy);

  const matchingDelayMs = input.matchingDelayMs ?? 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(matchingDelayMs) || matchingDelayMs < 0) {
    return {
      kind: 'stale',
      code: 'signal-age-invalid',
      reason: `Polymarket matching delay ${String(input.matchingDelayMs)} is not a duration`,
      effectiveAgeMs: null,
      msToResolution: null,
      budgetMs: null,
      consumedFraction: null
    };
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.signalAgeMs) || input.signalAgeMs < 0) {
    // A negative age means our clock and the indexer's disagree by more than the
    // skew tolerance upstream allowed, which is not something to trade through.
    return {
      kind: 'stale',
      code: 'signal-age-invalid',
      reason: `Polymarket signal age ${String(input.signalAgeMs)} is not a measurable duration`,
      effectiveAgeMs: null,
      msToResolution: null,
      budgetMs: null,
      consumedFraction: null
    };
  }

  const effectiveAgeMs = input.signalAgeMs + matchingDelayMs;

  const msToResolution = input.msToResolution;
  if (msToResolution === null || msToResolution === undefined || !Number.isFinite(msToResolution)) {
    return {
      kind: 'stale',
      code: 'resolution-time-unknown',
      reason: 'Polymarket market has no readable resolution time, so staleness cannot be bounded',
      effectiveAgeMs,
      msToResolution: null,
      budgetMs: null,
      consumedFraction: null
    };
  }
  if (msToResolution <= 0) {
    return {
      kind: 'stale',
      code: 'market-already-resolved',
      reason: 'Polymarket market is already eligible for resolution',
      effectiveAgeMs,
      msToResolution,
      budgetMs: 0,
      consumedFraction: null
    };
  }

  const budgetMs = polymarketStalenessBudgetMs(msToResolution, policy);
  const consumedFraction = effectiveAgeMs / msToResolution;

  if (effectiveAgeMs > budgetMs) {
    // Which constraint bound decides the code, so an operator can tell "this
    // market is too close to resolution" from "this signal is simply old".
    const boundByCeiling = budgetMs >= policy.maxBudgetMs;
    return boundByCeiling
      ? {
        kind: 'stale',
        code: 'signal-age-exceeds-absolute-ceiling',
        reason: `Polymarket signal is ${Math.round(effectiveAgeMs)}ms old, over the ${Math.round(policy.maxBudgetMs)}ms ceiling`,
        effectiveAgeMs,
        msToResolution,
        budgetMs,
        consumedFraction
      }
      : {
        kind: 'stale',
        code: 'signal-age-exceeds-resolution-fraction',
        reason: `Polymarket signal is ${Math.round(effectiveAgeMs)}ms old, over the ${Math.round(budgetMs)}ms allowed for a market resolving in ${Math.round(msToResolution)}ms`,
        effectiveAgeMs,
        msToResolution,
        budgetMs,
        consumedFraction
      };
  }

  return { kind: 'fresh', effectiveAgeMs, msToResolution, budgetMs, consumedFraction };
}

/** Boolean convenience over `evaluatePolymarketStaleness` for predicate call sites. */
export function isPolymarketSignalStale(input: PolymarketStalenessInput): boolean {
  return evaluatePolymarketStaleness(input).kind === 'stale';
}

/**
 * Build the decision from the timestamps a caller actually holds.
 *
 * `resolutionAt` is the market's end date â€” per `/concepts/resolution` the point
 * at which it becomes eligible for resolution. A null or unparseable value is
 * passed through as an unknown resolution time and fails closed above.
 */
export function evaluatePolymarketSignalStaleness(input: {
  readonly signalAt: Date | number;
  readonly resolutionAt: Date | number | null | undefined;
  readonly now: number;
  readonly matchingDelaySeconds?: number | null;
  readonly policy?: Partial<PolymarketStalenessPolicy>;
}): PolymarketStalenessDecision {
  const signalMs = input.signalAt instanceof Date ? input.signalAt.getTime() : input.signalAt;
  const resolutionMs = input.resolutionAt instanceof Date
    ? input.resolutionAt.getTime()
    : input.resolutionAt;
  const matchingDelaySeconds = input.matchingDelaySeconds ?? 0;

  return evaluatePolymarketStaleness({
    signalAgeMs: Number.isFinite(signalMs) ? input.now - (signalMs as number) : Number.NaN,
    msToResolution: resolutionMs === null
      || resolutionMs === undefined
      || !Number.isFinite(resolutionMs)
      ? null
      : resolutionMs - input.now,
    matchingDelayMs: Number.isFinite(matchingDelaySeconds)
      ? Math.max(0, matchingDelaySeconds * 1_000)
      : Number.NaN,
    ...(input.policy ? { policy: input.policy } : {})
  });
}

/**
 * Read the policy from the environment once, at the edge, so the pure functions
 * above stay parameterised. Intended for a module-scope constant in `index.ts`
 * exactly like `COPY_ELIGIBILITY_THRESHOLDS`.
 */
export function resolvePolymarketStalenessPolicy(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
): PolymarketStalenessPolicy {
  const policy: PolymarketStalenessPolicy = {
    maxResolutionFraction: parsePositiveNumber(
      env.POLYMARKET_STALENESS_RESOLUTION_FRACTION,
      POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FRACTION,
      'POLYMARKET_STALENESS_RESOLUTION_FRACTION'
    ),
    minBudgetMs: parseNonNegativeNumber(
      env.POLYMARKET_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS,
      POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS,
      'POLYMARKET_STALENESS_FLOOR_MS'
    ),
    maxBudgetMs: parsePositiveNumber(
      env.POLYMARKET_STALENESS_CEILING_MS,
      POLYMARKET_DEFAULT_STALENESS_CEILING_MS,
      'POLYMARKET_STALENESS_CEILING_MS'
    )
  };
  // Validate here too, so a bad `.env` fails at boot rather than on the first
  // Polymarket signal of the day.
  return resolvePolicy(policy);
}

      funderAddress: ACCOUNT_WALLET,
      signatureType: SignatureType.POLY_PROXY,
      signatureTypeName: 'POLY_PROXY',
      directWalletWritesAllowed: false
    };
    const dependencies = startupDependencies({
      initializeClient: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(proxyIdentity),
      getCode: vi.fn(async (address: string) =>
        address.toLowerCase() === POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyImplementation.toLowerCase()
          ? '0x'
          : '0x6000')
    });

    await expect(verifyPolymarketEnvironment(dependencies)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Polymarket Proxy implementation has no deployed bytecode'
    );
    expect(dependencies.createCollateralGateway).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('fails if the authenticated CLOB balance cannot support the live minimum', async () => {
    await expect(verifyPolymarketEnvironment(startupDependencies({
      getAuthenticatedCollateralBalance: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(0.5)
    }))).rejects.toThrow('Authenticated CLOB collateral balance is below');
    expect(getPolymarketLiveReadiness().ready).toBe(false);
  });

  it('revokes readiness before resolving database execution policy', async () => {
    setPolymarketLiveReadiness(true);
    await expect(verifyPolymarketEnvironment(startupDependencies({
      resolveMode: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('database unavailable'))
    }))).rejects.toThrow('Polymarket verification failed: database unavailable');
    expect(getPolymarketLiveReadiness()).toEqual({
      ready: false,
      reason: 'database unavailable'
    });
  });
});

import { production } from '@polymarket/client';
import { ethers } from 'ethers';
import { resolveChainMode } from '@swat/db';
import {
  getPolymarketAvailableBalance,
  initializePolymarketClient,
  polygonProvider,
  polymarketSigner,
  POLYMARKET_CLOB_HOST,
  POLYGON_CHAIN_ID,
  POLYMARKET_SDK_VERSION,
  setPolymarketLiveReadiness,
  type PolymarketClientInitialization
} from './polymarket.js';
import {
  EthersPolymarketCollateralGateway,
  ensurePolymarketCollateralReadiness,
  POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS,
  type PolymarketCollateralGateway
} from './polymarket-collateral.js';

const CORE_ATTESTED_CONTRACTS = [
  ['CTF Exchange V2', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.ctfExchange],
  ['Neg Risk CTF Exchange V2', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.negRiskCtfExchange],
  ['pUSD', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.pUsd],
  ['pUSD implementation', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.pUsdImplementation],
  ['CollateralOnramp', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp],

] as const;

interface SdkProductionRuntime {
  name: string;
  chainId: number;
  clob: { rest: string };
  contracts: {
    collateralToken: string;
    conditionalTokens: string;
    standardExchange: string;
    negRiskExchange: string;
  };
  walletDerivation: {
    depositWalletFactory: string;
    depositWalletBeacon: string;
    depositWalletImplementation: string;
    proxyFactory: string;
    proxyImplementation: string;
    safeFactory: string;
  };
}

interface PolymarketStartupDependencies {
  resolveMode: () => Promise<{ effectiveMode: string; reason?: string | null }>;
  getNetwork: () => Promise<{ chainId: number }>;
  getCode: (address: string) => Promise<string>;
  initializeClient: () => Promise<PolymarketClientInitialization>;
  createCollateralGateway: (directWalletWritesAllowed: boolean) => PolymarketCollateralGateway;
  getAuthenticatedCollateralBalance: () => Promise<number>;
  setLiveReadiness: (ready: boolean, reason?: string) => void;
  sdkProduction: unknown;
  clobHost: string;
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
}

export function parseBooleanEnvironment(
  value: string | undefined,
  name: string,
  fallback = false
): boolean {
  if (value === undefined || value.trim() === '') return fallback;
  if (value === 'true') return true;
  if (value === 'false') return false;
  throw new Error(`${name} must be exactly true or false`);
}

export function parseUsdUnits(value: string | undefined, name: string, fallback: string): bigint {
  const raw = value?.trim() || fallback;
  let units: ethers.BigNumber;
  try {
    units = ethers.utils.parseUnits(raw, 6);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-negative decimal with at most 6 places`);
  }
  if (units.lt(0)) throw new Error(`${name} cannot be negative`);
  return BigInt(units.toString());
}

export function parseFeeBufferBps(value: string | undefined): bigint {
  const parsed = Number(value?.trim() || '300');
  if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed < 0 || parsed > 5000) {
    throw new Error('POLYMARKET_FEE_BUFFER_BPS must be an integer between 0 and 5000');
  }
  return BigInt(parsed);
}

function parseOfficialOrigin(value: unknown, label: string): URL {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    throw new Error(`${label} is missing from the pinned Polymarket SDK production environment`);
  }

  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${label} is not a valid URL`);
  }
  if (
    url.protocol !== 'https:' ||
    url.hostname !== 'clob.polymarket.com' ||
    url.port !== '' ||
    url.username !== '' ||
    url.password !== '' ||
    url.pathname !== '/' ||
    url.search !== '' ||
    url.hash !== ''
  ) {
    throw new Error(`${label} is not the official production CLOB origin`);
  }
  return url;
}

function assertMatchingAddress(name: string, sdkAddress: unknown, expectedAddress: string): void {
  let actual: string;
  let expected: string;
  try {
    if (typeof sdkAddress !== 'string') throw new Error('missing');
    actual = ethers.utils.getAddress(sdkAddress);
    expected = ethers.utils.getAddress(expectedAddress);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${name} has an invalid or missing address in the SDK production inventory`);
  }
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${name} does not match the pinned SDK production address`);
  }
}

export function assertOfficialPolymarketContractConfig(
  sdkEnvironment: unknown = production,
  clobHost = POLYMARKET_CLOB_HOST
): void {
  if (typeof sdkEnvironment !== 'object' || sdkEnvironment === null) {
    throw new Error('Pinned Polymarket SDK production environment is unavailable');
  }
  const sdk = sdkEnvironment as Partial<SdkProductionRuntime>;
  if (sdk.name !== 'production' || sdk.chainId !== POLYGON_CHAIN_ID) {
    throw new Error('Pinned Polymarket SDK production environment is not Polygon 137');
  }

  parseOfficialOrigin(sdk.clob?.rest, 'SDK production CLOB endpoint');
  parseOfficialOrigin(clobHost, 'Executor CLOB endpoint');

  assertMatchingAddress(
    'CTF Exchange V2',
    sdk.contracts?.standardExchange,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.ctfExchange
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Neg Risk CTF Exchange V2',
    sdk.contracts?.negRiskExchange,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.negRiskCtfExchange
  );
  assertMatchingAddress('pUSD', sdk.contracts?.collateralToken, POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.pUsd);
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Conditional Tokens',
    sdk.contracts?.conditionalTokens,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.conditionalTokens
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Polymarket Proxy Factory',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.proxyFactory,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyFactory
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Polymarket Proxy implementation',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.proxyImplementation,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyImplementation
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Gnosis Safe Factory',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.safeFactory,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.safeFactory
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Deposit Wallet Factory',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.depositWalletFactory,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletFactory
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Deposit Wallet Beacon',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.depositWalletBeacon,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletBeacon
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Deposit Wallet implementation',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.depositWalletImplementation,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletImplementation
  );

  const normalizedAddresses = new Set<string>();
  for (const [name, address] of Object.entries(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS)) {
    let normalized: string;
    try {
      normalized = ethers.utils.getAddress(address).toLowerCase();
    } catch {
      throw new Error(`${name} has an invalid address in the official contract inventory`);
    }
    if (normalizedAddresses.has(normalized)) {
      throw new Error(`${name} duplicates another address in the official contract inventory`);
    }
    normalizedAddresses.add(normalized);
  }
}

export function assertPolymarketContractBytecode(
  name: string,
  address: string,
  code: string
): void {
  const validHex = /^0x(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/.test(code);
  const hasExecutableBytes = validHex && !/^0x(?:00)+$/i.test(code);
  if (!hasExecutableBytes) {
    throw new Error(`${name} has no deployed bytecode at ${address}`);
  }
}

async function attestDeployedContract(
  getCode: (address: string) => Promise<string>,
  name: string,
  address: string
): Promise<void> {
  const code = await getCode(address);
  assertPolymarketContractBytecode(name, address, code);
}

function accountWalletPathContracts(
  signatureTypeName: PolymarketClientInitialization['signatureTypeName']
): ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, string]> {
  switch (signatureTypeName) {
    case 'EOA':
      return [];
    case 'POLY_PROXY':
      return [
        ['Polymarket Proxy Factory', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyFactory],
        ['Polymarket Proxy implementation', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyImplementation]
      ];
    case 'POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE':
      return [['Gnosis Safe Factory', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.safeFactory]];
    case 'POLY_1271':
      return [
        ['Deposit Wallet Factory', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletFactory],
        ['Deposit Wallet Beacon', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletBeacon],
        ['Deposit Wallet implementation', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletImplementation]
      ];
  }
}

async function attestAccountWalletPath(
  getCode: (address: string) => Promise<string>,
  identity: PolymarketClientInitialization
): Promise<void> {
  const signer = ethers.utils.getAddress(identity.signerAddress);
  const funder = ethers.utils.getAddress(identity.funderAddress);
  const funderCode = await getCode(funder);
  const funderHasCode = /^0x(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/.test(funderCode) && !/^0x(?:00)+$/i.test(funderCode);

  if (identity.signatureTypeName === 'EOA') {
    if (!identity.directWalletWritesAllowed || signer !== funder) {
      throw new Error('EOA account wallet path does not resolve directly to the authenticated signer');
    }
    if (funderHasCode) {
      throw new Error('EOA signature mode resolved to a contract account wallet');
    }
    return;
  }

  if (identity.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
    throw new Error(`${identity.signatureTypeName} account wallet path cannot permit signer EOA writes`);
  }
  assertPolymarketContractBytecode('authenticated account wallet', funder, funderCode);
  await Promise.all(
    accountWalletPathContracts(identity.signatureTypeName).map(([name, address]) =>
      attestDeployedContract(getCode, name, address)
    )
  );
}

export function assertAuthenticatedCollateralBalance(
  authenticatedBalanceUsd: number,
  pUsdBalanceUnits: bigint,
  minimumPusdUnits: bigint
): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(authenticatedBalanceUsd) || authenticatedBalanceUsd < 0) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB returned an invalid collateral balance');
  }
  const onchainBalanceUsd = Number(ethers.utils.formatUnits(pUsdBalanceUnits.toString(), 6));
  const minimumBalanceUsd = Number(ethers.utils.formatUnits(minimumPusdUnits.toString(), 6));
  if (!Number.isFinite(onchainBalanceUsd) || !Number.isFinite(minimumBalanceUsd)) {
    throw new Error('pUSD balance exceeds the supported startup attestation range');
  }
  if (authenticatedBalanceUsd + 0.0000001 < minimumBalanceUsd) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB collateral balance is below the configured live minimum');
  }
  if (authenticatedBalanceUsd > onchainBalanceUsd + 0.0000001) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB collateral balance exceeds the attested onchain pUSD balance');
  }
}

function defaultStartupDependencies(): PolymarketStartupDependencies {
  return {
    resolveMode: () => resolveChainMode('polygon'),
    getNetwork: () => polygonProvider.getNetwork(),
    getCode: (address) => polygonProvider.getCode(address),
    initializeClient: () => initializePolymarketClient(),
    createCollateralGateway: (directWalletWritesAllowed) =>
      new EthersPolymarketCollateralGateway(
        polygonProvider,
        directWalletWritesAllowed ? polymarketSigner : null
      ),
    getAuthenticatedCollateralBalance: () => getPolymarketAvailableBalance('', 'buy'),
    setLiveReadiness: setPolymarketLiveReadiness,
    sdkProduction: production,
    clobHost: POLYMARKET_CLOB_HOST,
    env: process.env
  };
}

export async function verifyPolymarketEnvironment(
  overrides: Partial<PolymarketStartupDependencies> = {}
): Promise<boolean> {
  const dependencies = { ...defaultStartupDependencies(), ...overrides };
  dependencies.setLiveReadiness(false, 'Polymarket startup verification is in progress');
  console.log('[trade-executor] Verifying Polymarket CLOB V2 environment...');

  try {
    const mode = await dependencies.resolveMode();
    if (mode.effectiveMode !== 'live' && mode.effectiveMode !== 'live+shadow') {
      dependencies.setLiveReadiness(
        false,
        mode.reason ?? 'Polygon is not configured for live execution'
      );
      return false;
    }

    const network = await dependencies.getNetwork();
    if (network.chainId !== POLYGON_CHAIN_ID) {
      throw new Error(`Expected Polygon chain ID ${POLYGON_CHAIN_ID}, got ${network.chainId}`);
    }
    assertOfficialPolymarketContractConfig(dependencies.sdkProduction, dependencies.clobHost);
    await Promise.all(
      CORE_ATTESTED_CONTRACTS.map(([name, address]) =>
        attestDeployedContract(dependencies.getCode, name, address)
      )
    );

    const identity = await dependencies.initializeClient();
    await attestAccountWalletPath(dependencies.getCode, identity);

    const minimumPusdUnits = parseUsdUnits(
      dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_MIN_PUSD_BALANCE_USD,
      'POLYMARKET_MIN_PUSD_BALANCE_USD',
      '1'
    );
    const baseAllowanceUnits = parseUsdUnits(
      dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_ALLOWANCE_CAP_USD ?? dependencies.env.MAX_POSITION_USDC,
      'POLYMARKET_ALLOWANCE_CAP_USD',
      '500'
    );
    const feeBufferBps = parseFeeBufferBps(dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_FEE_BUFFER_BPS);
    const allowanceCapUnits =
      (baseAllowanceUnits * (10_000n + feeBufferBps) + 9_999n) / 10_000n;

    const gateway = dependencies.createCollateralGateway(identity.directWalletWritesAllowed);
    const collateral = await ensurePolymarketCollateralReadiness(gateway, {
      funderAddress: identity.funderAddress,
      signerAddress: identity.signerAddress,
      accountWalletType: identity.signatureTypeName,
      directWalletWritesAllowed: identity.directWalletWritesAllowed,
      minimumPusdUnits,
      allowanceCapUnits,
      autoOnramp: parseBooleanEnvironment(
        dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_AUTO_ONRAMP,
        'POLYMARKET_AUTO_ONRAMP'
      ),
      autoApprove: parseBooleanEnvironment(
        dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE,
        'POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE'
      )
    });

    const authenticatedBalanceUsd = await dependencies.getAuthenticatedCollateralBalance();
    assertAuthenticatedCollateralBalance(
      authenticatedBalanceUsd,
      collateral.pUsdBalanceUnits,
      minimumPusdUnits
    );

    for (const action of collateral.actions) {
      console.log(
        `[trade-executor] Polymarket collateral action confirmed: ${action.type} | ${action.transactionHash}`
      );
    }

    dependencies.setLiveReadiness(true);
    console.log(
      `[trade-executor] Polymarket CLOB V2 verified | chain=137 | sdk=${POLYMARKET_SDK_VERSION} | ` +
      `signer=${identity.signerAddress} | funder=${identity.funderAddress} | ` +
      `signatureType=${identity.signatureTypeName} | credentials=${identity.credentialSource} | ` +
      `builderAuth=${identity.builderAuthentication} | ` +
      `builderFees=${identity.builderMakerFeeBps}/${identity.builderTakerFeeBps}bps | ` +
      `builderAttribution=enabled`
    );
    return true;
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    dependencies.setLiveReadiness(false, message);
    console.error(
      `[trade-executor] CRITICAL: Polymarket verification failed: ${message}. Polygon is clamped to paper.`
    );
    throw new Error(`Polymarket verification failed: ${message}`);
  }
}
