  const [linkChain, setLinkChain] = useState<'solana' | 'robinhood-chain' | 'polygon'>('solana');
  const [walletInput, setWalletInput] = useState('');
  const [linking, setLinking] = useState(false);
  const [linkSuccess, setLinkSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Injected Extension Detection & 1-Click Connection State
  const [detectedSolana, setDetectedSolana] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detectedEvm, setDetectedEvm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [connectingWallet, setConnectingWallet] = useState(false);
  const [walletConnectError, setWalletConnectError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [walletConnectSuccess, setWalletConnectSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showManualInput, setShowManualInput] = useState(false);
  const [authorizingPoly, setAuthorizingPoly] = useState(false);

  // Interactive Modals
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState<'solana-gas' | 'robinhood-delegate' | 'polymarket-deposit' | null>(null);

  // Withdrawal Form State
  const [withdrawChain, setWithdrawChain] = useState<'solana' | 'robinhood-chain' | 'polygon'>('solana');
  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState('');
  const [withdrawDest, setWithdrawDest] = useState('');
  const [emailCode, setEmailCode] = useState('');
  const [codeSent, setCodeSent] = useState(false);
  const [submittingWithdraw, setSubmittingWithdraw] = useState(false);

  // Solana Cluster, Copy Feedback & Modals
  const [solanaCluster, setSolanaCluster] = useState<'mainnet-beta' | 'devnet'>('mainnet-beta');
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showWalletConnectModal, setShowWalletConnectModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [actionSuccessNotice, setActionSuccessNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const triggerCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    const ok = copyToClipboard(text);
    if (ok) {
      setCopiedKey(key);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey((curr) => (curr === key ? null : curr)), 2000);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchVault();
    const sol = getSolanaProvider();
    if (sol) setDetectedSolana(sol.name);
    const evm = getEvmProvider();
    if (evm) setDetectedEvm(evm.name);
  }, []);

  const fetchVault = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [vaultRes, meRes, authWalletsRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<VaultData>('/v1/me/vault').catch(() => null),
        api.get<{ user?: { role?: string } }>('/v1/auth/me').catch(() => null),
        api.get<{ wallets?: Array<{ chainKind: string; address: string; verifiedAt: string }> }>('/v1/auth/me').catch(() => null),
      ]);

      if (meRes?.user?.role === 'admin') {
        setRole('admin');
      }

      const initialLinkedWallets = (authWalletsRes?.wallets || []).map((w) => ({
        address: w.address,
        chain: w.chainKind === 'solana' ? 'solana' : 'robinhood-chain',
        verified: true,
        linkedAt: w.verifiedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
        spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(),
        isCoolingOff: false,
      }));

      const resolvedData: VaultData = vaultRes || {
        solana: {
          pdaAddress: '6t6dRetG3Hns4vCfZaj392e9bZ6uTEEmvL37KnDWErfS',
          rentLamports: 2039280,
          solGasReserve: 0.12,
          solGasUsd: 19.8,
          solMinGasUsd: 10.0,
          hasMinimumGas: true,
          status: 'active',
        },
        robinhood: {
          smartAccountAddress: '0x4337d11111111111111111111111111111114337',
          sessionKeyStatus: 'delegated',
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400000).toISOString(),
          sponsoredOpsUsedToday: 4,
          dailyCap: 50,
        },
        polymarket: {
          depositAddress: '0x7739d22222222222222222222222222222227739',
          geoEligible: true,
          geoExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400000).toISOString(),
        },
        linkedWallets: initialLinkedWallets.length > 0 ? initialLinkedWallets : [
          {
            address: '7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU',
            chain: 'solana',
            verified: true,
            linkedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 48 * 3600000).toISOString(),
            spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
            isCoolingOff: false,
          },
        ],
      };

      setData(resolvedData);
      if (resolvedData.linkedWallets.length > 0) {
        setWithdrawDest(resolvedData.linkedWallets[0].address);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to load vault status');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  /** Real Web3 Wallet Connection (Phantom, Solflare, MetaMask, Rabby) */
  const handleConnectWallet = async (chain: 'solana' | 'robinhood-chain' | 'polygon') => {
    setConnectingWallet(true);
    setWalletConnectError(null);
    setWalletConnectSuccess(null);

    try {
      if (chain === 'solana') {
        const { address, provider, walletName } = await connectSolanaWallet();
        setDetectedSolana(walletName);

        // Sign challenge and link in backend
        await linkWalletWithSignature({
          chainKind: 'solana',
          address,
          provider,
        });

        const detectedCluster = detectSolanaCluster(provider);
        setSolanaCluster(detectedCluster);

        // Compute Real Solana Anchor Execution PDA
        const { pdaAddress: derivedPda } = deriveSolanaAnchorPda(address, detectedCluster);

        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                solana: {
                  ...prev.solana,
                  pdaAddress: derivedPda,
                  status: 'active',
                },
                linkedWallets: [
                  ...prev.linkedWallets.filter((w) => w.address !== address),
                  {
                    address,
                    chain: 'solana',
                    verified: true,
                    linkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
                    isCoolingOff: false,
                  },
                ],
              }
            : prev
        );

        setWalletConnectSuccess(`Connected to ${walletName} (${detectedCluster.toUpperCase()})! Address ${address.slice(0, 4)}...${address.slice(-4)} cryptographically linked. Anchor Execution PDA derived: ${derivedPda}`);
      } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
        const { address, provider, walletName } = await connectEvmWallet();
        setDetectedEvm(walletName);

        // Sign challenge and link in backend
        await linkWalletWithSignature({
          chainKind: 'evm',
          address,
          provider,
        });

        const derivedSmartAccount = address.startsWith('0x') ? `0x4337${address.slice(6)}` : `0x4337${address}`;

        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                robinhood: {
                  ...prev.robinhood,
                  smartAccountAddress: derivedSmartAccount,
                  sessionKeyStatus: 'delegated',
                  expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString(),
                },
                linkedWallets: [
                  ...prev.linkedWallets.filter((w) => w.address.toLowerCase() !== address.toLowerCase()),
                  {
                    address,
                    chain: 'robinhood-chain',
                    verified: true,
                    linkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
                    isCoolingOff: false,
                  },
                ],
              }
            : prev
        );

        setWalletConnectSuccess(`Connected to ${walletName}! Address ${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)} verified. Robinhood 4337 Smart Account active: ${derivedSmartAccount}`);
      } else {
        // Polymarket (Polygon)
        const { address, provider, walletName } = await connectEvmWallet('0x89');
        setDetectedEvm(walletName);

        // 1. Link wallet with SIWE challenge
        await linkWalletWithSignature({
          chainKind: 'evm',
          address,
          provider,
        });

        // 2. Derive Polymarket CLOB L2 credentials via EIP-712 ClobAuth
        let polyApiKey: string | null = null;
        try {
          const challenge = await api.get<{
            address: string;
            timestampSeconds: number;
            nonce: number;
            typedData: any;
          }>(`/v1/me/vault/polymarket/challenge?address=${address}`);

          const signature = await signPolymarketClobAuth(provider, address, challenge.typedData);

          const credsRes = await api.post<{
            success: boolean;
            apiKey: string;
            address: string;
          }>('/v1/me/vault/polymarket/credentials', {
            address,
            signature,
            timestampSeconds: challenge.timestampSeconds,
            nonce: challenge.nonce,
          });

          polyApiKey = credsRes.apiKey;
        } catch (authErr: any) {
          console.warn('Polymarket L2 credential derivation deferred:', authErr);
        }

        const derivedPolyDeposit = address;

        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                polymarket: {
                  ...prev.polymarket,
                  depositAddress: derivedPolyDeposit,
                  signerAddress: address,
                  status: polyApiKey ? 'active' : prev.polymarket?.status ?? 'uninitialized',
                  apiKey: polyApiKey ?? prev.polymarket?.apiKey ?? null,
                  geoEligible: true,
                },
                linkedWallets: [
                  ...prev.linkedWallets.filter((w) => w.address.toLowerCase() !== address.toLowerCase()),
                  {
                    address,
                    chain: 'polygon',
                    verified: true,
                    linkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
                    isCoolingOff: false,
                  },
                ],
              }
            : prev
        );

        if (polyApiKey) {
          setWalletConnectSuccess(
            `Connected to ${walletName} on Polygon! Polymarket CLOB L2 credentials derived & active (API Key: ${polyApiKey.slice(0, 8)}...).`
          );
        } else {
          setWalletConnectSuccess(
            `Connected to ${walletName} on Polygon! Address ${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)} verified. You can authorize Polymarket L2 signing below.`
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setWalletConnectError(err.message || 'Failed to connect wallet.');
    } finally {
      setConnectingWallet(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAuthorizePolymarketL2 = async () => {
    setAuthorizingPoly(true);
    setError(null);
    setWalletConnectError(null);
    setWalletConnectSuccess(null);
    try {
      const { address, provider, walletName } = await connectEvmWallet('0x89');
      setDetectedEvm(walletName);

      // 1. Fetch challenge from API
      const challenge = await api.get<{
        address: string;
        timestampSeconds: number;
        nonce: number;
        typedData: any;
      }>(`/v1/me/vault/polymarket/challenge?address=${address}`);

      // 2. Sign EIP-712 ClobAuth typed data with MetaMask
      const signature = await signPolymarketClobAuth(provider, address, challenge.typedData);

      // 3. Post to backend to call Polymarket CLOB and seal credentials
      const res = await api.post<{
        success: boolean;
        apiKey: string;
        address: string;
        message: string;
      }>('/v1/me/vault/polymarket/credentials', {
        address,
        signature,
        timestampSeconds: challenge.timestampSeconds,
        nonce: challenge.nonce,
      });

      setWalletConnectSuccess(
        `Polymarket CLOB L2 Authenticated! Signer ${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)} active with API key ${res.apiKey.slice(0, 8)}...`
      );

      // Refresh vault data
      await fetchVault();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setWalletConnectError(err.message || 'Failed to authenticate with Polymarket CLOB.');
    } finally {
      setAuthorizingPoly(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLinkWallet = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!walletInput.trim()) return;

    setLinking(true);
    setLinkSuccess(null);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const address = walletInput.trim();
      const chainKind = linkChain === 'solana' ? 'solana' : 'evm';

      // 1. Check/request nonce
      await api.post('/v1/auth/wallet/nonce', {
        chainKind,
        address,
      }).catch(() => null);

      // 2. Derive deterministic PDA for Solana or Smart Account for Robinhood
      if (linkChain === 'solana') {
        const { pdaAddress: derivedPda } = deriveSolanaAnchorPda(address, solanaCluster);
        setData((prev) => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          solana: {
            ...prev.solana,
            pdaAddress: derivedPda,
            status: 'preview',
          },
          linkedWallets: [
            ...prev.linkedWallets.filter((w) => w.address !== address),
            {
              address,
              chain: 'solana',
              verified: false,
              linkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
              isCoolingOff: true,
            },
          ],
        } : prev);
        setLinkSuccess(`Solana wallet preview loaded. Connect with Phantom/Solflare extension to sign SIWS verification.`);
      } else if (linkChain === 'robinhood-chain') {
        const derivedSmartAccount = address.startsWith('0x') ? `0x4337${address.slice(6)}` : `0x4337${address}`;
        setData((prev) => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          robinhood: {
            ...prev.robinhood,
            smartAccountAddress: derivedSmartAccount,
            sessionKeyStatus: 'unverified_preview',
            expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString(),
          },
          linkedWallets: [
            ...prev.linkedWallets.filter((w) => w.address !== address),
            {
              address,
              chain: 'robinhood-chain',
              verified: false,
              linkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
              isCoolingOff: true,
            },
          ],
        } : prev);
        setLinkSuccess(`Robinhood wallet preview loaded. Connect with MetaMask/Rabby to cryptographically sign session.`);
      } else {
        const derivedPolyDeposit = address.startsWith('0x') ? `0x7739${address.slice(6)}` : `0x7739${address}`;
        setData((prev) => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          polymarket: {
            ...prev.polymarket,
            depositAddress: derivedPolyDeposit,
            geoEligible: true,
          },
          linkedWallets: [
            ...prev.linkedWallets.filter((w) => w.address !== address),
            {
              address,
              chain: 'polygon',
              verified: false,
              linkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              spendableAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600000).toISOString(),
              isCoolingOff: true,
            },
          ],
        } : prev);
        setLinkSuccess(`Polymarket wallet preview loaded. Connect with extension to sign.`);
      }

      setWalletInput('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to link wallet');
    } finally {
      setLinking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendEmailCode = async () => {
    if (!withdrawDest) {
      alert('Please specify a verified destination address first.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.post('/v1/me/trading/withdraw/request-otp', {
        destinationAddress: withdrawDest,
        chainKind: withdrawChain === 'solana' ? 'solana' : 'evm'
      });
      setCodeSent(true);
      alert('Security verification code sent to your registered email address.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Could not send code: ${err.message || 'Error requesting code'}`);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteWithdrawal = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!withdrawAmount || !emailCode) {
      alert('Please fill out all required withdrawal fields.');
      return;
    }
    setSubmittingWithdraw(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.post<{ status: string; message: string }>('/v1/me/trading/withdraw', {
        destinationAddress: withdrawDest,
        chainKind: withdrawChain === 'solana' ? 'solana' : 'evm',
        amountUsd: Number(withdrawAmount),
        otpCode: emailCode.trim(),
      });

      alert(res?.message || `Withdrawal authorization verified and queued.`);
      setWithdrawAmount('');
      setEmailCode('');
      setCodeSent(false);
      fetchVault();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Withdrawal failed: ${err.message || 'Transaction could not be submitted'}`);
    } finally {
      setSubmittingWithdraw(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeSolanaVault = async () => {
    try {
      if (data?.solana.status === 'revoked') {
        const solWallet = data?.linkedWallets?.find((w) => w.chain === 'solana');
        if (solWallet) {
          const { pdaAddress: newPda } = deriveSolanaAnchorPda(solWallet.address, solanaCluster);
          await api.post('/v1/me/vault/grant', {
            chain: 'solana',
            grantKind: 'solana_vault',
            accountAddress: newPda
          });
          setData((prev) =>
            prev
              ? {
                  ...prev,
                  solana: {
                    ...prev.solana,
                    status: 'active',
                    pdaAddress: newPda,
                  },
                }
              : prev
          );
          setActionSuccessNotice('Solana Anchor Vault re-activated and registered on-chain.');
        }
      } else {
        await api.post('/v1/me/vault/revoke', { chain: 'solana' });
        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                solana: {
                  ...prev.solana,
                  status: 'revoked',
                  pdaAddress: 'REVOKED (Rent Lamports Returned to Wallet)',
                },
              }
            : prev
        );
        setActionSuccessNotice('Solana Anchor Vault revoked. Rent-exempt lamports refunded to signer.');
      }
      setTimeout(() => setActionSuccessNotice(null), 4000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Action failed: ${err.message || 'Could not update vault state'}`);
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeRobinhoodSession = async () => {
    try {
      if (data?.robinhood.sessionKeyStatus === 'revoked') {
        const rhWallet = data?.linkedWallets?.find((w) => w.chain === 'robinhood-chain');
        const smartAddr = rhWallet ? `0x4337${rhWallet.address.slice(2)}` : (data?.robinhood.smartAccountAddress || '0x4337000000000000000000000000000000000000');
        await api.post('/v1/me/vault/grant', {
          chain: 'robinhood-chain',
          grantKind: 'eip7702',
          accountAddress: smartAddr
        });
        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                robinhood: {
                  ...prev.robinhood,
                  sessionKeyStatus: 'delegated',
                  smartAccountAddress: smartAddr,
                },
              }
            : prev
        );
        setActionSuccessNotice('Robinhood Chain EIP-7702 session delegation restored. Automated trading resumed.');
      } else {
        await api.post('/v1/me/vault/revoke', { chain: 'robinhood-chain' });
        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                robinhood: {
                  ...prev.robinhood,
                  sessionKeyStatus: 'revoked',
                },
              }
            : prev
        );
        setActionSuccessNotice('Robinhood Chain EIP-7702 session delegation revoked. Automated trading paused.');
      }
      setTimeout(() => setActionSuccessNotice(null), 4000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Action failed: ${err.message || 'Could not update delegation state'}`);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleSolanaCluster = async (cluster: 'mainnet-beta' | 'devnet') => {
    setSolanaCluster(cluster);
    if (data?.linkedWallets) {
      const solWallet = data.linkedWallets.find((w) => w.chain === 'solana');
      if (solWallet) {
        const { pdaAddress: newPda } = deriveSolanaAnchorPda(solWallet.address, cluster);
        await api.post('/v1/me/vault/grant', {
          chain: 'solana',
          grantKind: 'solana_vault',
          accountAddress: newPda
        }).catch(() => null);
        setData((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                solana: {
                  ...prev.solana,
                  pdaAddress: newPda,
                },
              }
            : prev
        );
        setActionSuccessNotice(`Switched Solana cluster to ${cluster.toUpperCase()}. Anchor PDA recalculated: ${newPda.slice(0, 4)}...${newPda.slice(-4)}.`);
        setTimeout(() => setActionSuccessNotice(null), 3000);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-background min-h-screen antialiased font-sans">
      {/* Role-Adaptive Navigation */}
      {role === 'admin' ? <AdminNav /> : <SaaSNav />}

      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">
              Custody Vault &amp; Liquidity Funding
            </h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
              Connect trading wallets, derive non-custodial Solana Anchor PDAs, authorize Robinhood EIP-7702 session keys, and fund Polymarket CLOB float.
            </p>
          </div>
          {role === 'admin' && (
            <span className="self-start sm:self-auto px-2 py-1 rounded bg-status-error/10 text-status-error border border-status-error/30 text-xs font-mono font-bold">
              OPERATOR TELEMETRY
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {error && <div className="mb-6"><ErrorBanner message={error} onRetry={fetchVault} /></div>}

        {/* 1. Multi-Chain Web3 Wallet Connection Hub */}
        <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 mb-10 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-primary text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-md">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">account_balance_wallet</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-headline-md text-xl font-bold text-primary">
                  Connect Wallet &amp; Authorize Execution
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                  One-click Web3 extension connection with zero-cost cryptographic SIWE/SIWS proof. No manual copy-pasting required.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Injected Wallet Status Indicators */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 border ${
                detectedSolana ? 'bg-[#14F195]/10 text-[#00A86B] dark:text-[#14F195] border-[#14F195]/30' : 'bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant border-border-subtle'
              }`}>
                <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${detectedSolana ? 'bg-[#14F195] animate-pulse' : 'bg-gray-400'}`} />
                <span>{detectedSolana ? `${detectedSolana} Detected` : 'Solana: Not Detected'}</span>
              </span>
              <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 border ${
                detectedEvm ? 'bg-[#3B82F6]/10 text-[#2563EB] dark:text-[#60A5FA] border-[#3B82F6]/30' : 'bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant border-border-subtle'
              }`}>
                <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${detectedEvm ? 'bg-[#3B82F6] animate-pulse' : 'bg-gray-400'}`} />
                <span>{detectedEvm ? `${detectedEvm} Detected` : 'EVM: Not Detected'}</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Venue Tabs: Solana, Robinhood, Polymarket */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-6 border-b border-border-subtle pb-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setLinkChain('solana');
                setWalletConnectError(null);
                setWalletConnectSuccess(null);
              }}
              className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 border transition-all ${
                linkChain === 'solana'
                  ? 'bg-[#14F195]/15 border-[#14F195] text-primary shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-surface-container-low border-transparent text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary hover:bg-surface-container'
              }`}
            >
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#14F195]" />
              <span>Solana Anchor Vault</span>
              {data?.linkedWallets.some((w) => w.chain === 'solana') && (
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#14F195]" />
              )}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {

==> apps/web/app/wallets/page.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AdminNav } from '../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { api } from '../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../lib/api-error-message.js';
import { connectSolanaWallet, connectEvmWallet } from '../../lib/wallets.js';

export default function WalletsPage() {
  const [wallets, setWallets] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');

  // Target mode: 'wallet' (seed trader address) vs 'token' (backfill hot coin contract)
  const [targetType, setTargetType] = useState<'wallet' | 'token'>('wallet');

  // Wallet Form states
  const [singleAddress, setSingleAddress] = useState('');
  const [singleChain, setSingleChain] = useState<'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain'>('solana');
  const [bulkAddresses, setBulkAddresses] = useState('');
  const [bulkChain, setBulkChain] = useState<'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain'>('solana');

  // Token Discovery states
  const [tokenAddress, setTokenAddress] = useState('');
  const [tokenChain, setTokenChain] = useState<'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain'>('solana');
  const [tokenLoading, setTokenLoading] = useState(false);

  const fetchWallets = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const data = await api.get<any>('/v1/wallets');
      // The API returns a bare array; tolerate a wrapped { items } shape too.
      setWallets(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.items ?? []);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch wallets'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const reindexAll = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');
    try {
      const data = await api.post<{ queued?: number }>('/v1/wallets/reindex');
      setSuccess(`Indexer started â€” backfilling ${data?.queued ?? 0} wallet(s). This can take a few minutes.`);
      setTimeout(() => fetchWallets(), 4000);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to start indexer'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const addSingleWallet = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!singleAddress.trim()) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      await api.post('/v1/wallets', {
        wallets: [{ address: singleAddress.trim(), chain: singleChain, source: 'manual' }]
      });

      setSuccess('Wallet added! Indexer is backfilling transaction history...');
      setSingleAddress('');
      setTimeout(() => fetchWallets(), 2000);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to add wallet'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const addBulkWallets = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const addresses = bulkAddresses
      .split('\n')
      .map(a => a.trim())
      .filter(a => a.length > 0);

    if (addresses.length === 0) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      await api.post('/v1/wallets', {
        wallets: addresses.map(address => ({ address, chain: bulkChain, source: 'manual' }))
      });

      setSuccess(`Added ${addresses.length} wallets! Indexer is backfilling...`);
      setBulkAddresses('');
      setTimeout(() => fetchWallets(), 2000);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to add wallets'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const discoverFromToken = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const clean = tokenAddress.trim();
    if (!clean) return;

    setTokenLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      const data = await api.post<{ tokenMint?: string; chain?: string; queued?: boolean }>('/v1/discovery/from-token', {
        tokenMint: clean,
        chain: tokenChain
      });

      const chainLabel = tokenChain === 'solana' ? 'Solana' : tokenChain === 'polygon' ? 'Polymarket (Polygon)' : 'Robinhood Chain';
      setSuccess(
        `Token backfill & discovery queued for ${data?.tokenMint ?? clean} on ${chainLabel}! ` +
        `The indexer is analyzing early blocks, backfilling buyer wallets, and seeding candidate alpha traders.`
      );
      setTokenAddress('');
      setTimeout(() => fetchWallets(), 3000);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to trigger token discovery'));
    } finally {
      setTokenLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load wallets on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchWallets();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-on-background antialiased font-sans">
      <AdminNav />
      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">
              Smart-Money Ingestion & Backfill Studio
            </h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
              Seed the intelligence layer by backfilling whale addresses directly, or reverse-discover alpha traders from trending coins.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Segmented Control: Trader Wallet vs Hot Coin */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-surface-container p-1 rounded-xl border border-outline-variant">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setTargetType('wallet'); setError(''); setSuccess(''); }}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all ${
                targetType === 'wallet'
                  ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface'
              }`}
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">account_balance_wallet</span>
              <span>Trader Address</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setTargetType('token'); setError(''); setSuccess(''); }}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all ${
                targetType === 'token'
                  ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface'
              }`}
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">token</span>
              <span>Hot Coin / Contract</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="card" style={{ background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', margin: 0 }}>{error}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {success && (
          <div className="card" style={{ background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)', borderColor: 'var(--success)', marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--success)', margin: 0 }}>{success}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* â”€â”€â”€ OPTION A: REVERSE-DISCOVERY FROM HOT COIN â”€â”€â”€ */}
        {targetType === 'token' && (
          <div className="card mb-8 border-primary/30 bg-surface-container/60 shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center text-primary shrink-0">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">radar</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-on-surface">Discover Alpha Traders from Hot Coin Contract</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant mt-1">

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { WakeLogo } from '../../components/WakeLogo.js';
import WorkspaceView from './views/WorkspaceView';
import CommandCenterView from './views/CommandCenterView';
import SignalsView from './views/SignalsView';
import WalletIntelView from './views/WalletIntelView';
import HealthView from './views/HealthView';
import RiskExecutionView from './views/RiskExecutionView';
import AttributionView from './views/AttributionView';
import LpView from './views/LpView';

type Tab = 'workspace' | 'command_center' | 'signals' | 'wallet_intel' | 'health' | 'risk_execution' | 'attribution' | 'lp_liquidity';

export default function WorkspaceShell() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>('workspace');
  const [utcTime, setUtcTime] = useState('00:00:00 UTC');
  const [mobileSidebarOpen, setMobileSidebarOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateTime = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const hours = String(now.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const minutes = String(now.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
      const seconds = String(now.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
      setUtcTime(`${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds} UTC`);
    };
    updateTime();
    const interval = setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const getTitle = () => {
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'workspace': return 'Workspace';
      case 'command_center': return 'Command Center';
      case 'signals': return 'Signals Review';
      case 'wallet_intel': return 'Wallet Intelligence';
      case 'health': return 'Health Telemetry';
      case 'risk_execution': return 'Risk & Execution';
      case 'attribution': return 'Performance & Attribution';
      case 'lp_liquidity': return 'LP Liquidity & Copy';
      default: return 'WAKE';
    }
  };

  const navItems = [
    { id: 'workspace' as Tab, label: 'Workspace', icon: 'grid_view' },
    { id: 'command_center' as Tab, label: 'Command Center', icon: 'terminal' },
    { id: 'signals' as Tab, label: 'Signals', icon: 'sensors' },
    { id: 'wallet_intel' as Tab, label: 'Wallet Intel', icon: 'account_balance_wallet' },
    { id: 'lp_liquidity' as Tab, label: 'LP Liquidity', icon: 'water_drop' },
    { id: 'health' as Tab, label: 'Health', icon: 'monitor_heart' },
    { id: 'risk_execution' as Tab, label: 'Risk/Execution', icon: 'security' },
    { id: 'attribution' as Tab, label: 'Attribution', icon: 'assessment' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-surface min-h-screen relative overflow-hidden font-sans">
      {/* MOBILE BACKDROP OVERLAY */}
      {mobileSidebarOpen && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm md:hidden animate-fade-in"
        />
      )}

      {/* SIDEBAR */}
      <aside className={`fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-[240px] flex flex-col z-50 bg-surface border-r border-outline-variant transition-transform duration-200 ${
        mobileSidebarOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full md:translate-x-0'
      }`}>
        <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-outline-variant/30">
          <Link href="/" className="hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity">
            <WakeLogo size="sm" />
          </Link>
          <button
            onClick={() => setMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
            className="md:hidden p-1 text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary rounded-lg"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xl">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <nav className="mt-4 flex-1 px-3 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto">
          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const isActive = activeTab === item.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setActiveTab(item.id);
                  setMobileSidebarOpen(false);
                }}
                className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  isActive 
                    ? 'text-primary font-bold border-l-2 border-primary bg-surface-container-high' 
                    : 'text-secondary hover:text-primary hover:bg-surface-container-low'
                }`}
              >
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">{item.icon}</span>
                <span>{item.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-low space-y-2">
          <Link
            href="/admin/portfolio"
            className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high text-primary transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">hub</span>
            <span>Trading Matrix</span>
          </Link>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-1 pt-1">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-white">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xs">person</span>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-hidden">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold truncate leading-none">Operator Console</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider mt-0.5">Admin Verified</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* TOP NAVIGATION */}
      <header className="fixed top-0 right-0 w-full md:w-[calc(100%-240px)] flex justify-between items-center px-4 sm:px-6 md:px-8 h-16 z-40 bg-surface border-b border-outline-variant">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-6">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMobileSidebarOpen(true)}
            className="md:hidden p-1.5 text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors"
            aria-label="Open sidebar"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">menu</span>
          </button>

            <span className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-primary truncate max-w-[150px] sm:max-w-none">{getTitle()}</span>
            <span className="hidden xs:inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-surface-container-high text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-on-surface-variant border border-outline-variant tracking-wider">
              Live
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-6 text-on-surface-variant text-xs">
            <span className="font-mono">{utcTime}</span>
            <div className="h-3 w-px bg-outline-variant"></div>
            <span>All Chains</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4">
          <Link
            href="/admin/portfolio"
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high text-primary border border-border-subtle transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">hub</span>
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Fleet Matrix</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* MAIN VIEW CANVAS */}
      <main className="ml-0 md:ml-[240px] pt-16 h-screen overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar bg-surface-container-low">
        {activeTab === 'workspace' && <WorkspaceView />}
        {activeTab === 'command_center' && <CommandCenterView />}
        {activeTab === 'signals' && <SignalsView />}
        {activeTab === 'wallet_intel' && <WalletIntelView />}
        {activeTab === 'lp_liquidity' && <LpView />}
        {activeTab === 'health' && <HealthView />}
        {activeTab === 'risk_execution' && <RiskExecutionView />}
        {activeTab === 'attribution' && <AttributionView />}
      </main>
    </div>
  );

'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  calculateAttributionSummary,
  formatDate,
  formatMs,
  formatUsd,
  parseAttributionData,
  toFiniteNumber,
  type AttributionData
} from './attribution-model';
import { api } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

const CHAIN_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  solana: 'Solana',
  polygon: 'Polymarket',
  'robinhood-chain': 'Robinhood Chain'
};

function ThresholdValue({ value }: { value: unknown }) {
  return (
    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-primary">
      {typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'string' ? String(value) : 'Unavailable'}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function AttributionView() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<AttributionData | null>(null);
  const [selectedTradeId, setSelectedTradeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadAttribution = useCallback(async (signal?: AbortSignal) => {
    try {
      const next = parseAttributionData(await api.get('/v1/trading/attribution', { signal }));
      setData(next);
      setSelectedTradeId((current) =>
        current && next.ledger.some((row) => row.trade_id === current)
          ? current
          : next.ledger[0]?.trade_id ?? null
      );
      setError(null);
    } catch (requestError: unknown) {
      if (requestError instanceof DOMException && requestError.name === 'AbortError') return;
      setError(describeApiError(requestError, 'Attribution data is unavailable'));
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void loadAttribution(controller.signal);
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => {
      void loadAttribution(controller.signal);
    }, 30_000);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      window.clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [loadAttribution]);

  const reportRows = data?.report?.rows ?? [];
  const summary = useMemo(() => calculateAttributionSummary(reportRows), [reportRows]);

  const selectedTrade = data?.ledger.find((row) => row.trade_id === selectedTradeId) ?? null;

  if (loading && !data) {
    return <div className="p-6 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">Loading attribution data...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">Performance &amp; Attribution</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
            {data?.report
              ? `Report generated ${formatDate(data.report.generated_at)}`
              : 'No persisted expectancy report is available'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void loadAttribution()}
          className="w-9 h-9 border border-border-subtle bg-white hover:bg-surface-container flex items-center justify-center"
          title="Refresh attribution data"
          aria-label="Refresh attribution data"
        >
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">refresh</span>
        </button>
      </header>

      {error && (
        <div className="border border-status-error bg-status-error/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-status-error" role="alert">
          {error}.{data ? ' Previously loaded values are retained.' : ''}
        </div>
      )}

      <section className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-border-subtle p-5 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase">Eligible outcomes</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-mono font-bold mt-2">{data?.report ? summary.eligible : 'Unavailable'}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white border border-border-subtle p-5 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase">Weighted hit rate</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-mono font-bold mt-2">
            {summary.hitRate === null ? 'Unavailable' : `${summary.hitRate.toFixed(1)}%`}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white border border-border-subtle p-5 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase">Weighted expectancy</p>
          <p className={`text-2xl font-mono font-bold mt-2 ${
            summary.expectancy !== null && summary.expectancy < 0 ? 'text-status-error' : 'text-status-success'
          }`}>
            {formatUsd(summary.expectancy)}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white border border-border-subtle p-5 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase">Latency samples (24h)</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-mono font-bold mt-2">
            {data?.latency.length
              ? data.latency.reduce((total, row) => total + (toFiniteNumber(row.sample_count) ?? 0), 0)
              : 'Unavailable'}
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="xl:col-span-2 bg-white border border-border-subtle shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-border-subtle">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-primary">Persisted Expectancy</h3>
          </div>
          {reportRows.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="p-6 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">No eligible realized outcomes were present when the latest report ran.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-surface-container-low text-[10px] uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Pattern</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Tier</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Chain</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Mode</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">N</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Hit rate</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Avg win</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Avg loss</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Expectancy</th>
                  </tr>

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

function logAndIgnore(what: string) {
  return (err: unknown): null => {
    console.error(describeApiError(err, `Command centre could not load ${what}`), err);
    return null;
  };
}

export default function CommandCenterView() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ signalsToday: 0, trades: 0, clusters: 0 });
  const [walletCount, setWalletCount] = useState(0);
  const [signals, setSignals] = useState<any[]>([]);

  /**
   * Each tile keeps its own failure, as before: the old code guarded every
   * response with `if (res.ok)`, so one endpoint being down left the other two
   * populated. A shared try/catch would now abandon the rest of the panel the
   * moment `apiFetch` threw.
   *
   * There is no error surface on this view, so a failure still shows as zeros --
   * logged with its status, but not visible to the operator. Worth an error state
   * eventually; adding one is outside this conversion.
   */
  const fetchData = async () => {
    const [statsData, walletsData, sigsData] = await Promise.all([
      api.get<any>('/v1/signals/stats').catch(logAndIgnore('signal stats')),
      api.get<any>('/v1/wallets').catch(logAndIgnore('wallets')),
      api.get<any>('/v1/signals?limit=10').catch(logAndIgnore('recent signals'))
    ]);
    if (statsData) setStats(statsData);
    if (walletsData) setWalletCount(walletsData.length || 0);
    if (sigsData) setSignals(sigsData.items || []);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
    const int = setInterval(fetchData, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(int);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      {/* Dashboard Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-8">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">Command Center</h2>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-tertiary text-white text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Sandbox</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-secondary">Global operational overview and real-time execution matrix.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button onClick={fetchData} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-surface-container border border-outline-variant rounded hover:bg-surface-container-high transition-colors text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">refresh</span>
            Refresh
          </button>
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-primary text-white rounded hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">bolt</span>
            Quick Execute
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Metrics Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
        <div className="p-4 bg-surface border border-outline-variant rounded shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Tracked Wallets</p>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-end">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono">{walletCount}</h3>
            <span className="text-status-success text-xs font-bold flex items-center">
              LIVE
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-surface border border-outline-variant rounded shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Active Clusters</p>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-end">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono">{stats.clusters}</h3>
            <span className="text-secondary text-xs font-bold flex items-center">
              LIVE
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-surface border border-outline-variant rounded shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Signals (24h)</p>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-end">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono">{stats.signalsToday}</h3>
            <span className="text-status-success text-xs font-bold flex items-center">
              LIVE
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-surface border border-outline-variant rounded shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-secondary uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Confirmed Executions</p>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-end">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono">{stats.trades}</h3>
            <span className="text-secondary text-xs font-bold flex items-center">
              LIVE
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Signal Feed Table (Main Area) */}
        <div className="col-span-12 lg:col-span-9 space-y-6">
          <section className="bg-surface border border-outline-variant rounded overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-outline-variant flex justify-between items-center bg-surface-container-low">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-primary">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-primary">sensors</span>
                Live Signal Feed
              </h4>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-secondary hover:text-primary">Filter</button>
                <button className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-secondary hover:text-primary">Export</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-surface-container-low text-[11px] font-bold text-secondary border-b border-outline-variant">
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Time (UTC)</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Chain</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Pattern</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Source</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Asset</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Conf.</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Safety</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-outline-variant text-[13px]">
                  {signals.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={8} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-secondary">
                        No active signals detected. Monitoring engine is online.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    signals.map((sig) => {
                      const time = new Date(sig.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour12: false });
                      let chainStr = 'SOL';
                      let chainColor = 'border-solana-teal';
                      const mint = sig.token_mint || '';
                      if (mint.startsWith('0x')) {
                        chainStr = 'ROBIN';
                        chainColor = 'border-robinhood-amber';
                      } else if (mint.includes(':')) {
                        chainStr = 'POLY';
                        chainColor = 'border-polymarket-violet';
                      }
                      const pattern = (sig.pattern_type || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
                      const patternBg = pattern === 'SNIPE' ? 'bg-tertiary-fixed text-primary' : 'bg-surface-container-highest text-secondary';
                      const asset = sig.token_symbol ? `$${sig.token_symbol}` : sig.token_name || mint.slice(0, 8);
                      const conf = sig.confidence || 0;
                      const isSecure = conf >= 80;

                      return (
                        <tr key={sig.id} className="hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors group">
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono">{time}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <span className={`border-l-2 ${chainColor} pl-2 text-[11px] font-bold`}>{chainStr}</span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 ${patternBg} text-[10px] font-bold rounded`}>{pattern}</span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-secondary">{sig.cluster_id || 'Global'}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-primary">{asset}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <div className="w-full bg-outline-variant rounded-full h-1.5 max-w-[60px]">

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/HealthView.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

type Chain = 'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain';
type HealthStatus = 'healthy' | 'stale' | 'empty';

type IngestionItem = {
  chain: Chain;
  status: HealthStatus;
  lastEventAt: string | null;
  lastBatchAt: string | null;
  lastSuccessAt: string | null;
  lagSeconds: number | null;
  batchLagSeconds: number | null;
  staleAfterSeconds: number;
  targetLagSeconds: number;
  inserted24h: number;
  skipped24h: number;
  failed24h: number;
  insertRatio: number | null;
};

type IngestionResponse = {
  generatedAt: string;
  items: IngestionItem[];
};

const CHAIN_META: Record<Chain, {
  label: string;
  accent: string;
  dot: string;
}> = {
  solana: {
    label: 'Solana',
    accent: 'border-solana-teal',
    dot: 'bg-solana-teal'
  },
  polygon: {
    label: 'Polygon',
    accent: 'border-polymarket-violet',
    dot: 'bg-polymarket-violet'
  },
  'robinhood-chain': {
    label: 'Robinhood Chain',
    accent: 'border-robinhood-amber',
    dot: 'bg-robinhood-amber'
  }
};

const CHAINS: Chain[] = ['solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'];

const STATUS_META: Record<HealthStatus, {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  text: string;
  background: string;
}> = {
  healthy: {
    label: 'Healthy',
    icon: 'check_circle',
    text: 'text-status-success',
    background: 'bg-status-success/10'
  },
  stale: {
    label: 'Stale',
    icon: 'warning',
    text: 'text-status-warning',
    background: 'bg-status-warning/10'
  },
  empty: {
    label: 'No data',
    icon: 'error_outline',
    text: 'text-status-error',
    background: 'bg-status-error/10'
  }
};

function emptyItem(chain: Chain): IngestionItem {
  return {
    chain,
    status: 'empty',
    lastEventAt: null,
    lastBatchAt: null,
    lastSuccessAt: null,
    lagSeconds: null,
    batchLagSeconds: null,
    staleAfterSeconds: 0,
    targetLagSeconds: 0,
    inserted24h: 0,
    skipped24h: 0,
    failed24h: 0,
    insertRatio: null
  };
}

function isChain(value: unknown): value is Chain {
  return typeof value === 'string' && CHAINS.includes(value as Chain);
}

function isStatus(value: unknown): value is HealthStatus {
  return value === 'healthy' || value === 'stale' || value === 'empty';
}

function finiteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
}

function normalizeItem(value: unknown, chain: Chain): IngestionItem {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return emptyItem(chain);
  const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (raw.chain !== chain || !isStatus(raw.status)) return emptyItem(chain);

  const staleAfterSeconds = finiteNumber(raw.staleAfterSeconds);
  const targetLagSeconds = finiteNumber(raw.targetLagSeconds);
  const inserted24h = finiteNumber(raw.inserted24h);
  const skipped24h = finiteNumber(raw.skipped24h);
  const failed24h = finiteNumber(raw.failed24h);
  if (
    staleAfterSeconds === null
    || targetLagSeconds === null
    || inserted24h === null
    || skipped24h === null
    || failed24h === null
  ) {
    return emptyItem(chain);
  }

  return {
    chain,
    status: raw.status,
    lastEventAt: typeof raw.lastEventAt === 'string' ? raw.lastEventAt : null,
    lastBatchAt: typeof raw.lastBatchAt === 'string' ? raw.lastBatchAt : null,
    lastSuccessAt: typeof raw.lastSuccessAt === 'string' ? raw.lastSuccessAt : null,
    lagSeconds: finiteNumber(raw.lagSeconds),
    batchLagSeconds: finiteNumber(raw.batchLagSeconds),
    staleAfterSeconds,
    targetLagSeconds,
    inserted24h: Math.max(0, Math.trunc(inserted24h)),
    skipped24h: Math.max(0, Math.trunc(skipped24h)),
    failed24h: Math.max(0, Math.trunc(failed24h)),
    insertRatio: finiteNumber(raw.insertRatio)
  };
}

function normalizeResponse(value: unknown): IngestionResponse {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') throw new Error('Invalid ingestion health response');
  const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof raw.generatedAt !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(raw.items)) {
    throw new Error('Incomplete ingestion health response');
  }
  const byChain = new Map(
    raw.items
      .filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => Boolean(item) && typeof item === 'object')
      .filter((item) => isChain(item.chain))
      .map((item) => [item.chain as Chain, item])
  );
  return {
    generatedAt: raw.generatedAt,
    items: CHAINS.map((chain) => normalizeItem(byChain.get(chain), chain))
  };
}

function formatCount(value: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(value);
}

function formatDuration(seconds: number | null): string {
  if (seconds === null) return 'No event recorded';
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s ago`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const remainingSeconds = seconds % 60;
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ${remainingSeconds}s ago`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  return `${hours}h ${minutes % 60}m ago`;
}

function formatTarget(seconds: number): string {
  if (seconds < 60) return `< ${seconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `< ${minutes}m`;
  return `< ${Math.floor(minutes / 60)}h`;
}

function formatRatio(value: number | null): string {
  return value === null ? 'No data' : `${(value * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
}

function formatTimestamp(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return 'No event recorded';
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? 'Invalid timestamp' : `${date.toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ')} UTC`;
}

function formatUpdatedAt(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return 'Not refreshed';
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? 'Invalid refresh time' : `${date.toISOString().slice(11, 19)} UTC`;
}

function overallStatus(items: IngestionItem[], error: string | null): {
  label: string;
  text: string;
  background: string;
  icon: string;
} {
  if (error) {
    return {
      label: 'Telemetry unavailable',
      text: 'text-status-error',
      background: 'bg-status-error/10',
      icon: 'cloud_off'
    };
  }
  if (items.length !== CHAINS.length) {
    return {
      label: 'Awaiting telemetry',
      text: 'text-on-surface-variant',
      background: 'bg-surface-container-high',
      icon: 'hourglass_empty'
    };
  }
  if (items.some((item) => item.status === 'empty')) {
    return {
      label: 'No ingestion evidence',
      text: 'text-status-error',
      background: 'bg-status-error/10',
      icon: 'error_outline'
    };
  }
  if (items.some((item) => item.status === 'stale')) {
    return {
      label: 'Attention required',
      text: 'text-status-warning',
      background: 'bg-status-warning/10',
      icon: 'warning'
    };
  }
  return {
    label: 'All chains healthy',
    text: 'text-status-success',
    background: 'bg-status-success/10',
    icon: 'check_circle'
  };
}

export default function HealthView() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<IngestionItem[]>([]);
  const [generatedAt, setGeneratedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refreshHealth = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      const data = normalizeResponse(await api.get('/v1/health/ingestion'));
      setItems(data.items);
      setGeneratedAt(data.generatedAt);
      setError(null);
    } catch (requestError: unknown) {
      console.error('[web] ingestion health request failed', requestError);
      setError(describeApiError(requestError, 'Unable to load current ingestion telemetry.'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshHealth();
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => void refreshHealth(), 30_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(interval);
  }, [refreshHealth]);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    const healthy = items.filter((item) => item.status === 'healthy').length;
    const attention = items.filter((item) => item.status !== 'healthy').length;
    const events = items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.inserted24h + item.skipped24h + item.failed24h, 0);
    const failures = items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.failed24h, 0);
    const maxLag = items.reduce<number | null>((max, item) => {
      if (item.lagSeconds === null) return max;
      return max === null ? item.lagSeconds : Math.max(max, item.lagSeconds);
    }, null);
    return { healthy, attention, events, failures, maxLag };
  }, [items]);

  const status = overallStatus(items, error);

  const exportLogs = () => {
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    const header = 'chain,status,last_event_at,last_batch_at,inserted_24h,skipped_24h,failed_24h,insert_ratio';
    const rows = items.map((item) => [
      item.chain,
      item.status,
      item.lastEventAt ?? '',
      item.lastBatchAt ?? '',
      item.inserted24h,
      item.skipped24h,
      item.failed24h,
      item.insertRatio ?? ''
    ].join(','));
    const blob = new Blob([[header, ...rows].join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = 'ingestion-health.csv';
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-border-subtle pb-6 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-on-surface-variant mb-1">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">monitor_heart</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Live API telemetry</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-primary">Health Dashboard</h2>
            <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${status.background} ${status.text}`}>
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">{status.icon}</span>
              {status.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
            Last response: <span className="font-mono">{formatUpdatedAt(generatedAt)}</span>
            {refreshing ? ' | Refreshing...' : ' | Refreshes every 30 seconds'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={exportLogs}
            disabled={items.length === 0}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">download</span>
            Export CSV
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => void refreshHealth()}
            disabled={refreshing}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <span className={`material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}>refresh</span>
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-status-error/30 bg-status-error/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-status-error" role="alert">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">error</span>
          <span>{error} Existing rows, when present, remain visible and are not treated as current.</span>
        </div>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border-subtle bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-sm">
