                <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="font-bold text-primary">{chain.label}</span>
                  <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${itemStatus.text}`}>{itemStatus.label}</span>
                </div>
                <dl className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Last success</dt><dd className="text-right font-mono">{formatTimestamp(item.lastSuccessAt)}</dd></div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Batch lag</dt><dd className="text-right font-mono">{formatDuration(item.batchLagSeconds)}</dd></div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Failures (24h)</dt><dd className="text-right font-mono">{formatCount(item.failed24h)}</dd></div>
                </dl>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {items.length === 0 && <p className="p-6 text-sm text-status-error">No current chain evidence is available.</p>}
        </div>
      </section>

      <p className="text-right text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
        {summary.failures > 0 ? `${formatCount(summary.failures)} failed events in the last 24 hours.` : 'No failed events reported in the last 24 hours.'}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/LpView.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { lpApi } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

type LpSubTab = 'discover' | 'whales' | 'builder' | 'positions';
type Chain = 'All' | 'solana' | 'robinhood-chain' | 'base' | 'ethereum' | 'bsc';

interface PoolItem {
  id: string;
  chain: string;
  protocol: string;
  poolAddress: string;
  pairLabel: string;
  currentPrice: number | null;
  tvl: number | null;
  activeTvl: number | null;
  volume24h: number | null;
  feeApr24h: number | null;
  riskScore: number | null;
  riskFlags: string[];
  isNewLaunch?: boolean;
  ageHours?: number;
  volumeToActiveLiquidity?: number;
  volatilitySurgeIndex?: number;
  dailyFeeYieldPct?: number;
  rugShieldPassed?: boolean;
}

interface WhaleLeaderboardEntry {
  walletAddress: string;
  chain: string;
  totalPositions: number;
  winRate: number;
  realizedPnlUsd: number;
  unrealizedPnlUsd: number;
  netPnlUsd: number;
}

interface CopySubscription {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  masterWalletAddress: string;
  chain: string;
  venue: string;
  allocatedBudgetUsd: number;
  maxCapitalPerPositionUsd: number;
  status: 'active' | 'paused' | 'closed';
  createdAt: string;
}

interface PositionItem {
  id: string;
  chain: string;
  protocol: string;
  poolAddress: string;
  strategyType: string;
  rangeLower: number;
  rangeUpper: number;
  depositAmount: number;
  state: 'building' | 'active' | 'near_edge' | 'out_of_range' | 'rebalancing' | 'closed';
  autoRebalance: boolean;
  rebalanceRecommended?: boolean;
}

export default function LpView() {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<LpSubTab>('discover');
  const [selectedChain, setSelectedChain] = useState<Chain>('All');
  const [showHotOnly, setShowHotOnly] = useState(false);

  // Discover state
  const [pools, setPools] = useState<PoolItem[]>([]);
  const [loadingPools, setLoadingPools] = useState(false);
  const [poolError, setPoolError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Whales state
  const [whales, setWhales] = useState<WhaleLeaderboardEntry[]>([]);
  const [subscriptions, setSubscriptions] = useState<CopySubscription[]>([]);
  const [loadingWhales, setLoadingWhales] = useState(false);
  const [copyModalWhale, setCopyModalWhale] = useState<WhaleLeaderboardEntry | null>(null);
  const [copyBudget, setCopyBudget] = useState(1000);
  const [copyMaxCapital, setCopyMaxCapital] = useState(500);
  const [copySubmitting, setCopySubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [copySuccessMsg, setCopySuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Builder state
  const [builderPool, setBuilderPool] = useState<string>('solana:Meteora-SOL-USDC');
  const [builderChain, setBuilderChain] = useState<string>('solana');
  const [builderDistribution, setBuilderDistribution] = useState<'spot' | 'curve' | 'bidask'>('spot');
  const [builderRangeLower, setBuilderRangeLower] = useState(175);
  const [builderRangeUpper, setBuilderRangeUpper] = useState(195);
  const [builderRungCount, setBuilderRungCount] = useState(10);
  const [builderDeposit, setBuilderDeposit] = useState(500);
  const [builderAutoRebalance, setBuilderAutoRebalance] = useState(true);
  const [deploying, setDeploying] = useState(false);
  const [deployResult, setDeployResult] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Positions state
  const [positions, setPositions] = useState<PositionItem[]>([]);
  const [loadingPositions, setLoadingPositions] = useState(false);

  // --- Fetch Discover Pools ---
  const fetchPools = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingPools(true);
    setPoolError(null);
    try {
      if (showHotOnly) {
        const queryChain = selectedChain === 'All' ? '' : `?chain=${selectedChain}`;
        const res = await lpApi.get<{ newLaunches: PoolItem[] }>(`/v1/lp/new-launches${queryChain}`);
        setPools(res.newLaunches ?? []);
      } else {
        const queryChain = selectedChain === 'All' ? '' : `?chain=${selectedChain}`;
        const res = await lpApi.get<{ pools: PoolItem[] }>(`/v1/lp/discover${queryChain}`);
        setPools(res.pools ?? []);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setPoolError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch LP pools'));
    } finally {
      setLoadingPools(false);
    }
  }, [selectedChain, showHotOnly]);

  // --- Fetch Whales & Subscriptions ---
  const fetchWhales = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingWhales(true);
    try {
      const queryChain = selectedChain === 'All' ? '' : `?chain=${selectedChain}`;
      const [leaderboardRes, subsRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        lpApi.get<{ entries: WhaleLeaderboardEntry[] }>(`/v1/lp/wallets/leaderboard${queryChain}`),
        lpApi.get<{ subscriptions: CopySubscription[] }>('/v1/lp/copy/subscriptions')
      ]);

      if (leaderboardRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
        setWhales(leaderboardRes.value.entries ?? []);
      }
      if (subsRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
        setSubscriptions(subsRes.value.subscriptions ?? []);
      }
    } catch {
      // Best-effort load
    } finally {
      setLoadingWhales(false);
    }
  }, [selectedChain]);

  // --- Fetch Positions ---
  const fetchPositions = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingPositions(true);
    try {
      const res = await lpApi.get<{ positions: PositionItem[] }>('/v1/lp/positions?includeClosed=true');
      setPositions(res.positions ?? []);
    } catch {
      // Best-effort load
    } finally {
      setLoadingPositions(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSubTab === 'discover') void fetchPools();
    if (activeSubTab === 'whales') void fetchWhales();
    if (activeSubTab === 'positions') void fetchPositions();
  }, [activeSubTab, fetchPools, fetchWhales, fetchPositions]);

  // --- Handle Copy Subscription ---
  const handleCreateCopySubscription = async () => {
    if (!copyModalWhale) return;
    setCopySubmitting(true);
    setCopySuccessMsg(null);
    try {
      const venue = copyModalWhale.chain === 'solana' ? 'meteora-dlmm' : 'uniswap-v3';
      await lpApi.post('/v1/lp/copy/subscribe', {
        masterWalletAddress: copyModalWhale.walletAddress,
        chain: copyModalWhale.chain,
        venue,
        allocatedBudgetUsd: copyBudget,
        maxCapitalPerPositionUsd: copyMaxCapital
      });
      setCopySuccessMsg('Subscription activated! Forward-only execution enabled.');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setCopyModalWhale(null);
        setCopySuccessMsg(null);
        void fetchWhales();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to activate copy subscription'));
    } finally {
      setCopySubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Handle Toggle Subscription Status ---
  const handleToggleSubStatus = async (sub: CopySubscription) => {
    const nextStatus = sub.status === 'active' ? 'paused' : 'active';
    try {
      await lpApi.patch(`/v1/lp/copy/subscriptions/${sub.id}`, { status: nextStatus });
      void fetchWhales();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to update subscription status'));
    }
  };

  // --- Handle Deploy Ladder ---
  const handleDeployLadder = async () => {
    setDeploying(true);
    setDeployResult(null);
    try {
      await lpApi.post('/v1/lp/positions/deploy', {
        chain: builderChain,
        poolAddress: builderPool,
        custom: {
          rangeLower: builderRangeLower,
          rangeUpper: builderRangeUpper,
          rungCount: builderRungCount,
          distribution: builderDistribution
        },
        depositAmount: builderDeposit,
        depositAsset: `${builderChain}:USDC`,
        autoRebalance: builderAutoRebalance
      });
      setDeployResult('LP Ladder successfully deployed in paper/execution mode!');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setActiveSubTab('positions');
        void fetchPositions();
      }, 1200);
    } catch (err) {
      setDeployResult(`Deploy failed: ${describeApiError(err, 'Could not deploy ladder')}`);
    } finally {
      setDeploying(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Handle Position Rebalance Trigger ---
  const handleTriggerRebalance = async (posId: string) => {
    try {
      await lpApi.post(`/v1/lp/positions/${posId}/rebalance`);
      alert('Rebalance job queued on execution queue.');
      void fetchPositions();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to trigger rebalance'));
    }
  };

  // --- Handle Close Position ---
  const handleClosePosition = async (posId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to close this LP position?')) return;
    try {
      await lpApi.post(`/v1/lp/positions/${posId}/close`);
      void fetchPositions();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to close position'));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto p-6 relative">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 pb-6 border-b border-border-subtle">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-primary text-2xl">water_drop</span>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-primary tracking-tight">WAKE LP Protocol</h2>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-primary/20 text-primary border border-primary/30 uppercase">
              Multi-Chain CLMM & DLMM
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-on-surface-variant text-xs mt-1">
            Institutional concentrated liquidity engine: Meteora DLMM, Raydium CLMM, Uniswap v3 & PancakeSwap v3 across 5 chains.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Sub-tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle p-1 rounded-lg gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('discover')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeSubTab === 'discover'
                ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-sm'
                : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary hover:bg-surface-container'
            }`}
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">travel_explore</span>
            <span>Discover Pools</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('whales')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeSubTab === 'whales'
                ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-sm'
                : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary hover:bg-surface-container'
            }`}
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">group</span>
            <span>LP Whales & Copy</span>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('builder')}

              activeSubTab === 'builder'
                ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-sm'
                : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary hover:bg-surface-container'

        </div>
      )}

      {/* --- TAB 2: LP WHALES & FORWARD-ONLY COPY TRADING --- */}
      {activeSubTab === 'whales' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-primary">LP Whale Leaderboard</h3>

                Top liquidity masters ranked by realized LP fee harvest & win rate. Forward-only copy engine guarantees no entry at stale/out-of-range bounds.

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/RiskExecutionView.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, ApiError } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

const CHAINS = ['solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'] as const;
const MODES = ['off', 'paper', 'live', 'live+shadow'] as const;

type Chain = (typeof CHAINS)[number];
type ExecutionMode = (typeof MODES)[number];

interface ChainModeStatus {
  requestedMode: ExecutionMode;
  effectiveMode: ExecutionMode;
  certified: boolean;
  reason?: string;
}

interface TradingStatus {
  modes: Record<Chain, ChainModeStatus>;
  killSwitchActive: boolean;
}

const chainLabels: Record<Chain, string> = {
  solana: 'Solana',
  polygon: 'Polygon / Polymarket',
  'robinhood-chain': 'Robinhood Chain'
};

const modeLabels: Record<ExecutionMode, string> = {
  off: 'Off',
  paper: 'Paper',
  live: 'Live',
  'live+shadow': 'Live + Shadow'
};

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function isExecutionMode(value: unknown): value is ExecutionMode {
  return typeof value === 'string' && MODES.some((mode) => mode === value);
}

function parseChainModeStatus(value: unknown): ChainModeStatus | null {
  if (!isRecord(value)
    || !isExecutionMode(value.requestedMode)
    || !isExecutionMode(value.effectiveMode)
    || typeof value.certified !== 'boolean'
    || (value.reason !== undefined && typeof value.reason !== 'string')) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    requestedMode: value.requestedMode,
    effectiveMode: value.effectiveMode,
    certified: value.certified,
    ...(value.reason === undefined ? {} : { reason: value.reason })
  };
}

function parseTradingStatus(value: unknown): TradingStatus | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !isRecord(value.modes) || typeof value.killSwitchActive !== 'boolean') {
    return null;
  }

  const rawModes = value.modes;
  const entries = CHAINS.map((chain) => [chain, parseChainModeStatus(rawModes[chain])] as const);
  if (entries.some(([, status]) => status === null)) return null;

  return {
    modes: Object.fromEntries(entries) as Record<Chain, ChainModeStatus>,
    killSwitchActive: value.killSwitchActive
  };
}

/**
 * The non-2xx branch moved into `apiFetch`, which throws `ApiError` with the
 * status attached. What is left is the shape check, which still has to happen
 * here: a 200 carrying a payload we cannot parse is not a success.
 */
function readStatus(payload: unknown): TradingStatus {
  const status = parseTradingStatus(payload);
  if (!status) throw new Error('Trading control returned an invalid status payload');
  return status;
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) return describeApiError(error, 'Trading control request failed');
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
  return 'Trading control request failed';
}

export default function RiskExecutionView() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<TradingStatus | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [pendingChain, setPendingChain] = useState<Chain | null>(null);
  const [emergencyPending, setEmergencyPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchStatus = useCallback(async (signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const nextStatus = readStatus(await api.get('/v1/trading/status', { signal }));
      setStatus(nextStatus);
      setError(null);
    } catch (caught) {
      if (caught instanceof DOMException && caught.name === 'AbortError') return;
      setError(errorMessage(caught));
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void fetchStatus(controller.signal);
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => {
      void fetchStatus(controller.signal);
    }, 5_000);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      window.clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const updateMode = async (chain: Chain, mode: ExecutionMode): Promise<void> => {
    setPendingChain(chain);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setStatus(readStatus(await api.post('/v1/trading/mode', { chain, mode })));
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(errorMessage(caught));
    } finally {
      setPendingChain(null);
    }
  };

  const activateEmergencyOff = async (): Promise<void> => {
    setEmergencyPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setStatus(readStatus(await api.post('/v1/trading/emergency-off')));
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(errorMessage(caught));
    } finally {
      setEmergencyPending(false);
    }
  };

  const confirmEmergencyOff = (): void => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      'Disable new execution on all chains? This does not liquidate or claim that open positions were closed.'
    );
    if (confirmed) void activateEmergencyOff();
  };

  const mutationPending = pendingChain !== null || emergencyPending;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1440px] space-y-6 p-6">
      <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-12">
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest p-5 shadow-sm md:col-span-8">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${status?.killSwitchActive ? 'bg-secondary/15 text-secondary' : 'bg-error/10 text-error'}`}>
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined font-bold">bolt</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-primary">All-chain emergency off</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-secondary">
                  Atomically stores <code>{'{"*":"off"}'}</code>. Executors honor it within one 30-second config TTL.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={confirmEmergencyOff}
              disabled={mutationPending || status?.killSwitchActive === true}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded bg-error px-6 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-white transition-opacity disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">gavel</span>
              {emergencyPending ? 'Applyingâ€¦' : status?.killSwitchActive ? 'Emergency off active' : 'Emergency off'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-low p-4 md:col-span-4">
          <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider text-secondary">CONTROL STATUS</p>
          <p className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold ${error ? 'text-status-error' : status?.killSwitchActive ? 'text-status-warning' : 'text-status-success'}`}>
            <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${error ? 'bg-status-error' : status?.killSwitchActive ? 'bg-status-warning' : 'bg-status-success'}`} />
            {loading && !status
              ? 'LOADING'
              : error
                ? 'STATUS UNAVAILABLE'
                : status?.killSwitchActive
                  ? 'ALL CHAINS OFF'
                  : 'API STATUS CURRENT'}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-secondary">The matrix refreshes from the authenticated API every five seconds.</p>
        </div>
      </section>

      {error && (
        <section role="alert" className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-lg border border-error/30 bg-error/5 p-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-error">Trading control update failed</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-secondary">{error}. Existing values below are the last confirmed API state.</p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { void fetchStatus(); }}
            className="rounded border border-error px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-error"
          >
            Retry
          </button>
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-secondary">Execution matrix</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-secondary">Requested modes are independent. Effective modes include live certification and emergency clamps.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-sm">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[760px] border-collapse text-left text-[13px]">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-low text-[10px] font-bold text-secondary">
                <th className="p-4">CHAIN</th>
                <th className="p-4">LIVE READINESS</th>
                <th className="p-4">REQUESTED MODE</th>
                <th className="p-4">EFFECTIVE MODE</th>
                <th className="p-4">CLAMP / RESOLUTION</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-outline-variant">
              {CHAINS.map((chain) => {
                const chainStatus = status?.modes[chain];
                return (
                  <tr key={chain} className="transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low/50">
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-primary">{chainLabels[chain]}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-secondary">{chain}</p>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4">
                      {chainStatus ? (
                        <span className={`inline-flex rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chainStatus.certified ? 'bg-status-success/10 text-status-success' : 'bg-status-warning/10 text-status-warning'}`}>
                          {chainStatus.certified ? 'CERTIFIED' : 'NOT CERTIFIED'}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-secondary">Unavailable</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex w-fit rounded border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-low p-0.5">
                        {MODES.map((mode) => (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            key={mode}
                            onClick={() => { void updateMode(chain, mode); }}
                            disabled={!chainStatus || mutationPending}
                            className={`rounded px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold transition-all disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${chainStatus?.requestedMode === mode ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'text-secondary hover:text-primary'}`}
                          >
                            {modeLabels[mode]}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-primary">
                        {chainStatus ? modeLabels[chainStatus.effectiveMode] : 'Unavailable'}
                      </span>
                      {pendingChain === chain && <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-secondary">Updatingâ€¦</p>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="max-w-[360px] p-4">
                      <p className={`text-xs ${chainStatus?.reason ? 'text-status-warning' : 'text-secondary'}`}>
                        {chainStatus?.reason ?? (chainStatus ? 'Requested mode is effective' : 'No confirmed API status')}
                      </p>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-lg border border-status-warning/30 bg-status-warning/5 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-status-warning">verified_user</span>
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-status-warning">Live modes remain evidence-gated</h4>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-secondary">
              Selecting Live or Live + Shadow changes the requested mode only. The API keeps the effective mode at Paper until both operator opt-in and a current reviewed chain certification are present.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/SignalsView.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

type Chain = 'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain';

type Signal = {
  id: string;
  time: string;
  chain: string;
  chainColor: string;
  pattern: string;
  patternBg: string;
  patternColor: string;
  asset: string;
  context: string;
  wallets: string;
  latency: string;
  latencyColor: string;
  confidence: number;
  safetyIcon: string;
  safetyColor: string;
  safetyRating: string;
  status: string;
  tokenMint: string | null;
  safetyWarnings: string[];
  triggerData: Record<string, unknown> | null;
};

const CHAIN_META: Record<Chain, { label: string; color: string }> = {
  solana: { label: 'Solana', color: 'bg-solana-teal' },
  polygon: { label: 'Polymarket', color: 'bg-polymarket-violet' },
  'robinhood-chain': { label: 'Robinhood', color: 'bg-robinhood-amber' }
};

const PATTERN_OPTIONS = ['All Patterns', 'snipe', 'accumulation', 'rotation', 'stealth', 'exit'];

// signals.chain is an indexed NOT NULL column (sql/013). Fall back to the address
// prefix only when the API predates it â€” never sniff for '0x', since every stored
// address is chain-prefixed and would misclassify.
function resolveChain(raw: unknown, tokenMint: string | null): Chain {
  if (raw === 'solana' || raw === 'polygon' || raw === 'robinhood-chain') return raw;
  const prefix = (tokenMint ?? '').split(':')[0];
  if (prefix === 'polygon' || prefix === 'robinhood-chain') return prefix;
  return 'solana';
}

export default function SignalsView() {
  const [selectedSignal, setSelectedSignal] = useState<Signal | null>(null);
  const [confidenceFilter, setConfidenceFilter] = useState(80);
  const [selectedNetwork, setSelectedNetwork] = useState('All');
  const [selectedPattern, setSelectedPattern] = useState('All Patterns');
  const [signals, setSignals] = useState<Signal[]>([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<{
    total: number; alerted: number; executed: number; rejected: number; avg_score: number | null;
  } | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const [banner, setBanner] = useState<{ kind: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const fetchSignals = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (selectedPattern !== 'All Patterns') params.set('pattern', selectedPattern);
      const suffix = params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';

      // Stats failure stays tolerated, as before: the old code only threw on the
      // signals response and rendered `null` stats otherwise. Promise.all would
      // now reject on either, so the stats call swallows its own error.
      const [data, statsData] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<any>(`/v1/signals${suffix}`),
        api.get<any>('/v1/signals/stats').catch(() => null)
      ]);

      const mapped: Signal[] = (data.items || []).map((s: any) => {
        const tokenMint: string | null = s.token_mint ?? null;
        const chain = resolveChain(s.chain, tokenMint);
        const meta = CHAIN_META[chain];
        const confidence = Number(s.confidence ?? 0);
        const warnings: string[] = Array.isArray(s.safety_warnings) ? s.safety_warnings : [];
        const flags: string[] = Array.isArray(s.safety_flags) ? s.safety_flags : [];
        const hasRisk = warnings.length > 0 || flags.length > 0;
        const bareMint = (tokenMint ?? '').includes(':') ? (tokenMint as string).split(':').slice(1).join(':') : tokenMint;

        return {
          id: s.id,
          time: s.created_at ? new Date(s.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour12: false }) : '--:--:--',
          chain: meta.label,
          chainColor: meta.color,
          pattern: (s.pattern_type || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase(),
          patternBg: 'bg-primary text-on-primary',
          patternColor: 'text-on-primary',
          asset: s.token_symbol ? `$${s.token_symbol}` : s.token_name || bareMint || 'Unknown asset',
          context: bareMint ? `${bareMint.slice(0, 6)}...${bareMint.slice(-4)}` : (s.cluster_id ? `Cluster ${String(s.cluster_id).slice(0, 8)}` : 'Global'),
          wallets: s.cluster_id ? 'Cluster' : 'Unclustered',
          latency: s.status ?? 'pending',
          latencyColor: s.status === 'executed' ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-on-surface-variant',
          confidence,
          safetyIcon: hasRisk ? 'report' : 'verified_user',
          safetyColor: hasRisk ? 'text-status-warning' : 'text-status-success',
          safetyRating: hasRisk ? 'Caution' : 'Secure',

          status: s.status ?? 'pending',
          tokenMint,
          safetyWarnings: [...warnings, ...flags],
          triggerData: s.trigger_data && typeof s.trigger_data === 'object' ? s.trigger_data : null
        };
      });
      setSignals(mapped);
      setStats(statsData);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error('[web] signals request failed', err);
      setLoadError(describeApiError(err, 'Unable to load signals. Displayed rows may be out of date.'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [selectedPattern]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSignals();
    const interval = setInterval(() => void fetchSignals(), 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fetchSignals]);

  // The backend enqueues to BullMQ and returns { queued: true } â€” it does not confirm a
  // fill. Wording must stay "queued" so the operator does not read this as a settled trade.
  const actOnSignal = async (signal: Signal, action: 'execute' | 'ignore') => {
    setActing(true);
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      await api.post(`/v1/signals/${signal.id}/${action}`);
      setBanner({
        kind: 'ok',
        text: action === 'execute'
          ? `Signal ${signal.id.slice(0, 8)} queued for execution â€” awaiting executor confirmation.`
          : `Signal ${signal.id.slice(0, 8)} marked rejected.`
      });
      setSelectedSignal(null);
      void fetchSignals();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      // Keep the drawer open on failure so the operator sees which signal did not act.
      setBanner({ kind: 'err', text: describeApiError(err, 'Request failed') });
    } finally {
      setActing(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredSignals = signals.filter(sig => {
    if (sig.confidence < confidenceFilter) return false;
    if (selectedNetwork !== 'All' && sig.chain !== selectedNetwork) return false;
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto p-6 relative">
      {/* Header Section */}
      <div className="mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">Signals Review</h2>
        <p className="text-on-surface-variant text-xs">Deep inspection and verification of cross-chain intelligence.</p>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Bar */}
      <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-4 mb-6 shadow-sm flex flex-wrap items-end gap-6">
        {/* Chain Filter */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Network</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {['All', 'Solana', 'Polymarket', 'Robinhood'].map((net) => (
              <button
                key={net}
                onClick={() => setSelectedNetwork(net)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded ${
                  selectedNetwork === net 
                    ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary' 
                    : 'bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant'
                }`}
              >
                {net}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Pattern Filter */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Pattern</label>
          <select
            value={selectedPattern}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedPattern(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-surface-container border-border-subtle rounded text-xs py-1.5 pr-8 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary"
          >
            {PATTERN_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
              <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                {opt === 'All Patterns' ? opt : opt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + opt.slice(1)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Confidence Slider */}
        <div className="space-y-2 flex-1 max-w-xs">
          <div className="flex justify-between">
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Confidence</label>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-primary font-bold">&gt; {confidenceFilter}%</span>
          </div>
          <input
            type="range"
            min="0"
            max="100"
            value={confidenceFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setConfidenceFilter(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full h-1.5 bg-surface-container-highest rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-primary"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Result count */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Matching</label>
          <p className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-primary py-1.5">
            {filteredSignals.length} of {signals.length}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {banner && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className={`mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm ${
            banner.kind === 'ok'
              ? 'border-status-success/30 bg-status-success/5 text-status-success'
              : 'border-status-error/30 bg-status-error/5 text-status-error'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">
            {banner.kind === 'ok' ? 'check_circle' : 'error'}
          </span>
          <span className="flex-1">{banner.text}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setBanner(null)} className="text-xs font-bold underline">Dismiss</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {loadError && (
        <div role="alert" className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-status-warning/30 bg-status-warning/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-status-warning">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">warning</span>
          <span>{loadError}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Signal Table Container */}
      <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
          <thead className="bg-surface-container-low border-b border-border-subtle sticky top-0">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Time (UTC)</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Chain</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Pattern</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Asset/Context</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Wallets</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Status</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant">Confidence</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant text-center">Safety</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant text-right">Action</th>
            </tr>

          <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle text-[13px]">

                <td className="px-4 py-3">

                  <span className={`material-symbols-outlined text-lg ${sig.safetyColor}`} style={{ fontVariationSettings: "'FILL' 1" }}>
                    {sig.safetyIcon}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  <button className="px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold border border-border-subtle rounded hover:bg-primary hover:text-on-primary">
                    INSPECT
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Dashboard Stats Summary â€” GET /v1/signals/stats */}
      <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
        <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest p-4 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Total Signals</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{stats ? Number(stats.total ?? 0).toLocaleString() : '--'}</p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-2 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant font-bold">
            <span>All time</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest p-4 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Alerted</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{stats ? Number(stats.alerted ?? 0).toLocaleString() : '--'}</p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-2 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant font-bold">
            <span>Avg score {stats?.avg_score != null ? Number(stats.avg_score).toFixed(1) : 'n/a'}</span>

          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-status-success">{stats ? Number(stats.executed ?? 0).toLocaleString() : '--'}</p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-2 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant font-bold">
            <span>Queued or filled</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest p-4 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Rejected</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{stats ? Number(stats.rejected ?? 0).toLocaleString() : '--'}</p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-2 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant font-bold">
            <span>Operator or engine</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Detail Drawer */}
      <div 
        className={`fixed top-0 right-0 h-screen w-[480px] bg-surface-container-lowest border-l border-border-subtle shadow-2xl z-[100] transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          selectedSignal ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
        }`}
      >
        {selectedSignal && (
          <div className="h-full flex flex-col">
            {/* Drawer Header */}
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-border-subtle flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">Signal Inspection</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">{selectedSignal.asset} Â· {selectedSignal.chain}</p>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSelectedSignal(null)}
                className="p-2 hover:bg-surface-container rounded-full transition-colors"
              >
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            {/* Drawer Content */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-8">
              {/* Source Evidence Section â€” real trigger_data JSONB */}
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant mb-4">Source Evidence</h4>
                <div className="bg-surface-container-low p-4 rounded-lg border border-border-subtle">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-primary">Trigger Data</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-primary bg-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-border-subtle uppercase">
                      {selectedSignal.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {selectedSignal.triggerData ? (
                    <pre className="text-[10px] font-mono text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-all max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
                      {JSON.stringify(selectedSignal.triggerData, null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">No trigger data recorded for this signal.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Safety */}
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant mb-4">Safety Assessment</h4>
                {selectedSignal.safetyWarnings.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-status-success/30 bg-status-success/5 px-4 py-3">
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-status-success">verified_user</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-status-success font-semibold">No safety flags or warnings recorded.</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {selectedSignal.safetyWarnings.map((warning, idx) => (
                      <li key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-status-warning/30 bg-status-warning/5 px-4 py-2">
                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-status-warning mt-0.5">warning</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-status-warning">{warning}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </div>
              {/* Identity */}
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-on-surface-variant mb-4">Identity</h4>
                <dl className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                    <dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Signal ID</dt>
                    <dd className="font-mono text-right break-all">{selectedSignal.id}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                    <dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Chain</dt>
                    <dd className="font-mono text-right">{selectedSignal.chain}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                    <dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Token</dt>
                    <dd className="font-mono text-right break-all">{selectedSignal.tokenMint ?? 'None (not executable)'}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                    <dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Confidence</dt>
                    <dd className="font-mono text-right">{selectedSignal.confidence}%</dd>
                  </div>
                </dl>
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Drawer Footer */}
            <div className="p-6 border-t border-border-subtle bg-surface-container-lowest space-y-3">
              {!selectedSignal.tokenMint && (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-status-warning font-semibold">
                  This signal has no token and cannot be executed (API returns 409).
                </p>
              )}
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <button
                  onClick={() => void actOnSignal(selectedSignal, 'ignore')}
                  disabled={acting}
                  className="flex-1 bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle text-primary py-3 rounded font-bold text-xs hover:bg-surface-variant transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {acting ? 'WORKING...' : 'REJECT SIGNAL'}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => void actOnSignal(selectedSignal, 'execute')}
                  disabled={acting || !selectedSignal.tokenMint}
                  className="flex-1 bg-primary text-white py-3 rounded font-bold text-xs shadow-lg active:scale-[0.98] transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:active:scale-100"
                >
                  {acting ? 'WORKING...' : 'QUEUE EXECUTION'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/WorkspaceView.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../../lib/api-error-message.js';

type IngestionChain = 'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain';
type IngestionStatus = 'healthy' | 'stale' | 'empty';

type WorkspaceIngestionItem = {
  chain: IngestionChain;
  status: IngestionStatus;
  lagSeconds: number | null;
};

const INGESTION_CHAINS: Array<{
  chain: IngestionChain;
  label: string;
  bar: string;
}> = [
  { chain: 'solana', label: 'SOLANA MAINNET', bar: 'bg-solana-teal' },
  { chain: 'polygon', label: 'POLYGON CLOB', bar: 'bg-polymarket-violet' },
  { chain: 'robinhood-chain', label: 'ROBINHOOD CHAIN', bar: 'bg-robinhood-amber' }
];

function emptyIngestionItems(): WorkspaceIngestionItem[] {
  return INGESTION_CHAINS.map(({ chain }) => ({ chain, status: 'empty', lagSeconds: null }));
}

function normalizeIngestionItems(value: unknown): WorkspaceIngestionItem[] {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return emptyIngestionItems();
  const rawItems = (value as { items?: unknown }).items;
  if (!Array.isArray(rawItems)) return emptyIngestionItems();

  return INGESTION_CHAINS.map(({ chain }) => {
    const raw = rawItems.find((item) => (
      Boolean(item)
      && typeof item === 'object'
      && (item as { chain?: unknown }).chain === chain
    )) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    const status = raw?.status;
    const lagSeconds = typeof raw?.lagSeconds === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.lagSeconds)
      ? Math.max(0, raw.lagSeconds)
      : null;
    if (status !== 'healthy' && status !== 'stale' && status !== 'empty') {
      return { chain, status: 'empty', lagSeconds: null };
    }
    if (status !== 'empty' && lagSeconds === null) {
      return { chain, status: 'empty', lagSeconds: null };
    }
    return { chain, status, lagSeconds };
  });
}

function formatIngestionLag(seconds: number | null): string {
  if (seconds === null) return 'NO DATA';
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s LAG`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ${seconds % 60}s LAG`;
  return `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)}h ${minutes % 60}m LAG`;
}

export default function WorkspaceView() {
  const [showToast, setShowToast] = useState(true);
  const [ingestionItems, setIngestionItems] = useState<WorkspaceIngestionItem[]>(emptyIngestionItems);
  const [ingestionGeneratedAt, setIngestionGeneratedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ingestionLoading, setIngestionLoading] = useState(true);
  const [ingestionError, setIngestionError] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const loadIngestionHealth = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await api.get<{ generatedAt?: unknown; items?: unknown }>(
          '/v1/health/ingestion',
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );
        const generatedAt = typeof data.generatedAt === 'string' ? new Date(data.generatedAt) : null;
        setIngestionItems(normalizeIngestionItems(data));
        setIngestionGeneratedAt(
          generatedAt && !Number.isNaN(generatedAt.getTime()) ? generatedAt.toISOString() : null
        );
        setIngestionError(false);
      } catch (error) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        console.error(describeApiError(error, '[web] workspace ingestion health request failed'), error);
        setIngestionItems(emptyIngestionItems());
        setIngestionGeneratedAt(null);
        setIngestionError(true);
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setIngestionLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadIngestionHealth();
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => void loadIngestionHealth(), 30_000);
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      window.clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  const ingestionSummary = ingestionError

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/attribution-model.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  calculateAttributionSummary,
  formatMs,
  formatUsd,
  parseAttributionData,
  toFiniteNumber,
  type ExpectancyRow
} from './attribution-model';

const baseRow: ExpectancyRow = {
  pattern_type: 'snipe',
  tier: 'elite',
  chain: 'solana',
  execution_mode: 'live',
  eligible_outcomes: 2,
  hit_rate_pct: 50,
  avg_win_usd: 2,
  avg_loss_usd: -1,
  expectancy_usd: 0.5
};

describe('attribution view model', () => {
  it('weights report statistics only by eligible outcome counts', () => {
    expect(calculateAttributionSummary([
      baseRow,
      { ...baseRow, chain: 'polygon', eligible_outcomes: '1', hit_rate_pct: '100', expectancy_usd: '2' }
    ])).toEqual({
      eligible: 3,
      hitRate: 200 / 3,
      expectancy: 1
    });
  });

  it('keeps unavailable numeric data unavailable instead of fabricating zero', () => {
    expect(toFiniteNumber('not-a-number')).toBeNull();
    expect(formatUsd(null)).toBe('Unavailable');
    expect(formatMs(Number.NaN)).toBe('Unavailable');
    expect(calculateAttributionSummary([])).toEqual({
      eligible: 0,
      hitRate: null,
      expectancy: null
    });
  });

  it('rejects malformed API payloads before the component consumes them', () => {
    expect(() => parseAttributionData({ report: null, latency: [] })).toThrow(
      'Attribution API returned an invalid response'
    );
    expect(() => parseAttributionData({
      report: { rows: 'invalid' },
      latency: [],
      live_vs_shadow: [],
      ledger: [],
      manual_thresholds: {}
    })).toThrow('Attribution API returned an invalid report');
  });
});

==> apps/web/app/workspace/views/attribution-model.ts <==
export type NumericValue = number | string;

export type ExpectancyRow = {
  pattern_type: string;
  tier: string | null;
  chain: string;
  execution_mode: string;
  eligible_outcomes: NumericValue;
  hit_rate_pct: NumericValue;
  avg_win_usd: NumericValue | null;
  avg_loss_usd: NumericValue | null;
  expectancy_usd: NumericValue;
};

export type ConfigEntry = { value: unknown; updated_at: string };

export type ExpectancyReport = {
  id: string;
  generated_at: string;
  config_snapshot: Record<string, ConfigEntry>;
  rows: ExpectancyRow[];
};

export type LatencyRow = {
  chain: string;
  pattern_type: string;
  tier: string | null;
  execution_mode: string;
  sample_count: NumericValue;
  p50_detection_to_confirmation_ms: NumericValue;
  p95_detection_to_confirmation_ms: NumericValue;
  p50_submission_to_confirmation_ms: NumericValue;
  p95_submission_to_confirmation_ms: NumericValue;
};

export type ShadowCostRow = {
  chain: string;
  matched_trades: NumericValue;
  avg_execution_cost_bps: NumericValue;
};

export type LedgerRow = {
  trade_id: string;
  signal_id: string;
  chain: string;
  pattern_type: string;
  execution_mode: string;
  executed_at: string;
  detected_at: string | null;
  submitted_at: string | null;
  confirmed_at: string | null;
  slippage_bps: NumericValue | null;
  realized_pnl_usd: NumericValue | null;
};

export type ManualThresholds = {
  min_signal_score: number | null;
  auto_execute_min_score: number | null;
  max_position_pct: number | null;
  max_daily_exposure_pct: number | null;
  stop_loss_pct: number | null;
  captured_at: string | null;
};

export type AttributionData = {
  report: ExpectancyReport | null;
  latency: LatencyRow[];
  live_vs_shadow: ShadowCostRow[];
  ledger: LedgerRow[];
  manual_thresholds: ManualThresholds;
};

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

export function parseAttributionData(value: unknown): AttributionData {
  if (!isRecord(value)
    || (value.report !== null && !isRecord(value.report))
    || !Array.isArray(value.latency)
    || !Array.isArray(value.live_vs_shadow)
    || !Array.isArray(value.ledger)
    || !isRecord(value.manual_thresholds)) {
    throw new Error('Attribution API returned an invalid response');
  }
  if (isRecord(value.report) && !Array.isArray(value.report.rows)) {
    throw new Error('Attribution API returned an invalid report');
  }
  return value as AttributionData;
}

export function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') return null;
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '') return null;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

export function calculateAttributionSummary(rows: ExpectancyRow[]) {
  let eligible = 0;
  let hitRateWeight = 0;
  let weightedHitRate = 0;
  let expectancyWeight = 0;
  let weightedExpectancy = 0;

  for (const row of rows) {
    const count = toFiniteNumber(row.eligible_outcomes);
    if (count === null || count <= 0) continue;
    eligible += count;

    const hitRate = toFiniteNumber(row.hit_rate_pct);
    if (hitRate !== null) {
      hitRateWeight += count;
      weightedHitRate += hitRate * count;
    }

    const expectancy = toFiniteNumber(row.expectancy_usd);
    if (expectancy !== null) {
      expectancyWeight += count;
      weightedExpectancy += expectancy * count;
    }
  }

  return {
    eligible,
    hitRate: hitRateWeight > 0 ? weightedHitRate / hitRateWeight : null,
    expectancy: expectancyWeight > 0 ? weightedExpectancy / expectancyWeight : null
  };
}

export function formatUsd(value: unknown): string {
  const amount = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (amount === null) return 'Unavailable';
  return `${amount >= 0 ? '+' : '-'}$${Math.abs(amount).toFixed(2)}`;
}

export function formatMs(value: unknown): string {
  const milliseconds = toFiniteNumber(value);
  if (milliseconds === null) return 'Unavailable';
  return milliseconds >= 1000
    ? `${(milliseconds / 1000).toFixed(2)}s`
    : `${milliseconds.toFixed(0)}ms`;
}

export function formatDate(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return 'Unavailable';
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? 'Unavailable' : date.toLocaleString();
}

import React from 'react';

export type StreamState = 'connected' | 'reconnecting' | 'offline';

export interface StatusPillProps {
  state: StreamState;
  reconnectAttempts?: number;
}

export function StatusPill({ state, reconnectAttempts = 0 }: StatusPillProps) {
  if (state === 'connected') {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-status-success/10 border border-status-success/30 text-xs font-mono text-status-success tracking-tight">
        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-status-success animate-pulse" />
        <span>STREAM LIVE</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (state === 'reconnecting') {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-status-warning/10 border border-status-warning/30 text-xs font-mono text-status-warning tracking-tight">
        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-status-warning animate-ping" />
        <span>RECONNECTING {reconnectAttempts > 0 ? `(${reconnectAttempts})` : ''}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-status-error/10 border border-status-error/30 text-xs font-mono text-status-error tracking-tight">
      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-status-error" />
      <span>OFFLINE</span>
    </div>
  );

        className={`${iconDimensions} shrink-0 object-contain dark:block hidden`}
      />

      {showText && (
        <span
          className={`font-headline-md font-black tracking-tight text-primary select-none ${textSize} ${textClassName}`}
        >
          Wake Protocol
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { ApiError } from './api.js';
import {
  describeApiError,
  CSRF_MESSAGE,
  FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE,
  SESSION_EXPIRED_MESSAGE

describe('describeApiError', () => {
  it('tells a 401 to sign in again rather than repeating the operation name', () => {
    expect(describeApiError(new ApiError(401, 'Not signed in'), 'Failed to fetch clusters'))
      .toBe(SESSION_EXPIRED_MESSAGE);
  });

  it('does not invite a re-login on 403', () => {
    expect(describeApiError(new ApiError(403, 'Forbidden'), 'Failed to fetch clusters'))
      .toBe(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
    expect(describeApiError(new ApiError(403, 'Forbidden'), 'x')).not.toContain('sign in');
  });

  it('keeps the status on any other ApiError so a 500 is not mistaken for a 400', () => {

      .toBe('Failed to save configuration (HTTP 500: boom)');
  });

  it('keeps the fallback in front of an opaque network error', () => {
    expect(describeApiError(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'), 'Failed to fetch wallets'))
      .toBe('Failed to fetch wallets (Failed to fetch)');
  });

  it('falls back cleanly on a thrown non-Error', () => {
    expect(describeApiError('nope', 'Failed to fetch wallets')).toBe('Failed to fetch wallets');
    expect(describeApiError(new Error(''), 'Failed to fetch wallets')).toBe('Failed to fetch wallets');
  });

describe('describeApiError â€” CSRF vs role, both 403', () => {
  it('distinguishes a stale CSRF token from a role refusal', () => {
    // Both are 403. Without the split, a stale swat_csrf cookie reads as "you
    // lack permission" and sends the operator hunting a role problem that does
    // not exist -- on a surface they are actually allowed to use.
    const csrf = new ApiError(403, 'Invalid CSRF token', { error: 'Invalid CSRF token', code: 'csrf_invalid' });
    expect(describeApiError(csrf, 'x')).toBe(CSRF_MESSAGE);
    expect(describeApiError(csrf, 'x')).not.toBe(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
  });

  it('still reports a role refusal as a role refusal', () => {
    const forbidden = new ApiError(403, 'Forbidden', { error: 'Forbidden' });
    expect(describeApiError(forbidden, 'x')).toBe(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
  });

  it('matches the API code, not its prose, so rewording cannot re-break it', () => {
    // The message here is deliberately nothing like the real one.
    const reworded = new ApiError(403, 'nope', { code: 'csrf_invalid' });
    expect(describeApiError(reworded, 'x')).toBe(CSRF_MESSAGE);
  });

  it('falls back to the role message when the body is absent or not an object', () => {
    expect(describeApiError(new ApiError(403, 'Forbidden'), 'x')).toBe(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
    expect(describeApiError(new ApiError(403, 'Forbidden', 'plain text'), 'x')).toBe(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
  });

==> apps/web/lib/api-error-message.ts <==
/**
 * Turns a thrown value from `lib/api.ts` into something an operator can act on.
 *
 * Exists because the thirteen call sites converted in S6-3 all used to do
 * `if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch X')`, which threw away the
 * status. A 401 (your session lapsed, sign in again), a 403 (you are signed in
 * but this is an admin surface) and a 500 (the API is broken) all rendered as
 * the same red box, so the one failure the operator could fix themselves was
 * indistinguishable from the two they could not.
 *
 * Kept out of `lib/api.ts` on purpose: that module decides what to *send*, this
 * one decides what to *say*. Wording is a UI concern and changes far more often
 * than the transport does.
 */

import { ApiError } from './api.js';

/** Shown on 401. Deliberately actionable -- there is a thing the reader can do. */
export const SESSION_EXPIRED_MESSAGE = 'Your session expired â€” sign in again.';

/** Shown on 403. Not a login problem, so it must not invite a re-login. */
export const FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE = 'This account is not permitted to use this operator surface.';

/**
 * Shown on a 403 whose cause is the double-submit token, not the user's role.
 *
 * These are the same status, and without this branch a stale `swat_csrf` cookie
 * reads as "you lack permission" -- sending the operator to hunt a role problem
 * that does not exist, on a surface they are in fact allowed to use. Newly
 * load-bearing: since S6-3 every mutating call in the app depends on that cookie.
 *
 * Matched on the API's stable `code`, not on its prose, so rewording the message
 * cannot silently re-break this.
 */
export const CSRF_MESSAGE =
  'Your session token is stale â€” reload the page and try again.';

/** True when a 403 body carries the API's CSRF marker. */
function isCsrfFailure(error: ApiError): boolean {
  const code = (error.body as { code?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.code;
  return code === 'csrf_invalid';
}

/**
 * @param error   Whatever reached the `catch`. Anything is legal here.
 * @param fallback What the caller was trying to do, e.g. 'Failed to fetch clusters'.
 */
export function describeApiError(error: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    if (error.isUnauthenticated) return SESSION_EXPIRED_MESSAGE;
    if (error.isForbidden) return isCsrfFailure(error) ? CSRF_MESSAGE : FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE;
    // `ApiError.message` is already the API's own `error`/`message` field when it
    // sent one, and `"<status> <statusText>"` when it did not. Either way the
    // status is worth repeating: "Bad Request" alone does not say who is at fault.
    return `${fallback} (HTTP ${error.status}: ${error.message})`;
  }
  // A network failure or a CORS rejection lands here as a plain TypeError whose
  // message ('Failed to fetch') is useless on its own.
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return `${fallback} (${error.message})`;
  return fallback;
}

==> apps/web/lib/api-server.ts <==
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { resolveApiBase, ApiError, SESSION_COOKIE } from './api.js';

/**
 * Server-component half of the API client (checklist S6-3).
 *
 * `lib/api.ts` is browser-only by construction: it reads `document.cookie` for
 * the CSRF token and `window.location` for the host. A React Server Component
 * has neither. It runs on the server, where the user's cookies arrive on the
 * *incoming request* and must be forwarded explicitly -- `credentials:
 * 'include'` means nothing there, because there is no browser in the call.
 *
 * Two of the thirteen converted files are server components
 * (`app/signals/page.tsx`, `app/performance/page.tsx`), which is why this exists
 * rather than being folded into `api.ts`. Keeping them separate also keeps
 * `next/headers` -- which throws if imported into a client component -- out of
 * the module every client view imports.
 *
 * **Read-only on purpose.** There is no `post` here. A server component cannot
 * mutate anyway, and the CSRF token is a *double-submit* check: the client must
 * echo a cookie it can read, which is precisely the thing a server component
 * cannot participate in. A mutation belongs in a client component or a Server
 * Action, and offering a `post` here would invite someone to write one that
 * fails CSRF for reasons that look like an auth bug.
 */

/**
 * Fetches from the API on behalf of the signed-in user, forwarding their session.
 *
 * Returns `null` when there is no session rather than throwing, because the
 * common case for a server component is "render the signed-out state", and
 * middleware has already redirected anyone who should not be here.
 */
export async function serverApiGet<T = unknown>(path: string): Promise<T | null> {
  const jar = await cookies();
  const session = jar.get(SESSION_COOKIE);
  if (!session) return null;

  const response = await fetch(`${resolveApiBase(null)}${path}`, {
    // Forwarding only the session cookie, not the whole jar. Nothing else the
    // browser holds is ours to relay to the API, and a narrow forward cannot
    // leak a third-party cookie into our own logs.
    headers: { cookie: `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${session.value}` },
    // Never cache a per-user response. Next would otherwise happily serve one
    // user's data to another on a shared route -- the worst possible bug in a
    // multi-tenant product, and the default is opt-out, not opt-in.
    cache: 'no-store'
  });

  if (response.status === 401) return null;
  if (!response.ok) throw new ApiError(response.status, `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  parseCsrfToken,
  buildApiRequestInit,
  resolveApiBase,
  ApiError,
  CSRF_HEADER
} from './api.js';

describe('parseCsrfToken', () => {
  it('reads the token from a multi-cookie string', () => {
    expect(parseCsrfToken('a=1; swat_csrf=tok-123; swat_session=zzz')).toBe('tok-123');
  });

  it('is not fooled by a cookie whose name merely ends with the target', () => {
    // `not_swat_csrf` shares a suffix. A naive `includes` or a regex without an
    // anchor reads its value and sends a token the API will reject.
    expect(parseCsrfToken('not_swat_csrf=wrong')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('url-decodes the value', () => {
    expect(parseCsrfToken('swat_csrf=a%2Bb')).toBe('a+b');
  });

  it('returns null rather than empty string for a blank cookie', () => {
    // "no token" must not be confusable with "a blank token": the second would
    // build a request that fails CSRF for a reason indistinguishable from being
    // signed out.
    expect(parseCsrfToken('swat_csrf=')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null for absent, empty and undefined cookie strings', () => {
    expect(parseCsrfToken('other=1')).toBeNull();
    expect(parseCsrfToken('')).toBeNull();
    expect(parseCsrfToken(undefined)).toBeNull();
    expect(parseCsrfToken(null)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('buildApiRequestInit', () => {
  it('always sends credentials, so the session cookie crosses origins', () => {
    // The web app and API are different origins in every deployment we have.
    // Without this every request is anonymous and cookie auth cannot work.
    expect(buildApiRequestInit().credentials).toBe('include');
    expect(buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'POST', csrfToken: 't' }).credentials).toBe('include');
  });

  it('attaches the CSRF header on mutating methods', () => {
    for (const method of ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']) {
      const init = buildApiRequestInit({ method, csrfToken: 'tok' });
      expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)[CSRF_HEADER]).toBe('tok');
    }
  });

  it('omits the CSRF header on GET', () => {
    const init = buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'GET', csrfToken: 'tok' });
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)[CSRF_HEADER]).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('omits the CSRF header when no token exists rather than sending empty', () => {
    const init = buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'POST', csrfToken: null });
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)[CSRF_HEADER]).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('uppercases the method so a lowercase caller still gets CSRF', () => {
    const init = buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'post', csrfToken: 'tok' });
    expect(init.method).toBe('POST');
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)[CSRF_HEADER]).toBe('tok');
  });

  it('never emits an API key header under any option combination', () => {
    // This is the regression guard for S6-3. `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY` shipped the  check-public-secrets:allow-mention
    // operator control-plane key in the browser bundle; the fix is only durable
    // if the client cannot express it.
    const combos = [
      buildApiRequestInit(),
      buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'POST', body: '{}', csrfToken: 'tok' }),
      buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'DELETE', csrfToken: null })
    ];
    for (const init of combos) {
      const names = Object.keys(init.headers as Record<string, string>).map((h) => h.toLowerCase());
      expect(names).not.toContain('x-api-key');
      expect(names).not.toContain('authorization');
    }
  });

  it('sets Content-Type only when there is a body', () => {
    const withBody = buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'POST', body: '{}' });
    expect((withBody.headers as Record<string, string>)['Content-Type']).toBe('application/json');
    const without = buildApiRequestInit({ method: 'POST' });
    expect((without.headers as Record<string, string>)['Content-Type']).toBeUndefined();
    expect(without.body).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
