==> packages/db/sql/009_signals_dedupe_index.sql <==
-- Clean up existing duplicate pending signals, keeping only the latest one.
DELETE FROM signals s1
WHERE s1.status = 'pending'
  AND s1.token_mint IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM signals s2
    WHERE s2.pattern_type = s1.pattern_type
      AND s2.token_mint = s1.token_mint
      AND s2.status = 'pending'
      AND s2.id > s1.id
  );

-- Unique partial index to enforce atomic deduplication at the DB level.
-- Prevents the CTE-based check-then-insert race condition.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_signals_dedupe_active
  ON signals (pattern_type, token_mint)
  WHERE status = 'pending' AND token_mint IS NOT NULL;

-- Covering index for the dedupe query to eliminate sequential scans.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_signals_dedupe_lookup
  ON signals (pattern_type, token_mint, created_at DESC)
  WHERE token_mint IS NOT NULL;

==> packages/db/sql/010_chain_discriminator.sql <==
-- Multi-venue foundation: add chain discriminators to core entities.
-- Existing rows default to Solana to preserve current behavior.

ALTER TABLE wallets
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chain VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'solana';

UPDATE wallets
SET chain = 'solana'
WHERE chain IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE wallets
  ALTER COLUMN chain SET DEFAULT 'solana',
  ALTER COLUMN chain SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE wallets
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS wallets_chain_check;

ALTER TABLE wallets
  ADD CONSTRAINT wallets_chain_check
  CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wallets_chain_status
  ON wallets (chain, status);

ALTER TABLE tokens
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chain VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'solana';

UPDATE tokens
SET chain = 'solana'
WHERE chain IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE tokens
  ALTER COLUMN chain SET DEFAULT 'solana',
  ALTER COLUMN chain SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE tokens
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tokens_chain_check;

ALTER TABLE tokens
  ADD CONSTRAINT tokens_chain_check
  CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tokens_chain_first_seen
  ON tokens (chain, first_seen DESC);

ALTER TABLE transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chain VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'solana';

UPDATE transactions
SET chain = 'solana'
WHERE chain IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE transactions
  ALTER COLUMN chain SET DEFAULT 'solana',
  ALTER COLUMN chain SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE transactions
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS transactions_chain_check;

ALTER TABLE transactions
  ADD CONSTRAINT transactions_chain_check
  CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tx_chain_wallet_ts
  ON transactions (chain, wallet_address, timestamp DESC);

DO $$
DECLARE
  current_definition TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT pg_get_indexdef(indexrelid)
    INTO current_definition
    FROM pg_index
   WHERE indexrelid = to_regclass('idx_tx_dedup');

  IF current_definition IS NULL THEN
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tx_dedup
      ON transactions (chain, signature, wallet_address, COALESCE(target_token, ''));
  ELSIF current_definition NOT LIKE '%chain, signature, wallet_address%' THEN
    DROP INDEX idx_tx_dedup;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tx_dedup
      ON transactions (chain, signature, wallet_address, COALESCE(target_token, ''));
  END IF;
END $$;

    WHERE table_name = 'signals' AND column_name = 'chain'

  END IF;

    WHERE table_name = 'trades' AND column_name = 'chain'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE trades ADD COLUMN chain VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'solana';
    ALTER TABLE trades ADD CONSTRAINT chk_trades_chain CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'));
  END IF;

==> packages/db/sql/014_missing_indexes.sql <==
-- Create index to optimize hasRecentBuy() cooldown checks using correct executed_at column
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_token_mint_cooldown

    SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public'
       AND table_name = 'transactions'
       AND column_name = 'amount_in'
       AND data_type <> 'numeric'
  ) THEN

      ALTER COLUMN amount_in TYPE NUMERIC USING amount_in::numeric;

    SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public'

       AND column_name = 'amount_out'
       AND data_type <> 'numeric'
  ) THEN

      ALTER COLUMN amount_out TYPE NUMERIC USING amount_out::numeric;
  END IF;

==> packages/db/sql/016_timestamp_tz.sql <==
-- Standardize UTC timestamp storage without shifting columns already converted.

DO $$
DECLARE
  target RECORD;
  current_type TEXT;
BEGIN
  FOR target IN
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
      ('wallets', 'first_seen'),
      ('wallets', 'last_active'),
      ('wallets', 'created_at'),
      ('wallets', 'updated_at'),
      ('tokens', 'first_seen'),
      ('tokens', 'launch_timestamp'),
      ('tokens', 'created_at'),
      ('transactions', 'timestamp'),
      ('transactions', 'created_at'),
      ('wallet_clusters', 'first_seen'),
      ('wallet_clusters', 'last_active'),
      ('wallet_clusters', 'created_at'),
      ('wallet_clusters', 'updated_at'),
      ('cluster_memberships', 'joined_at'),
      ('wallet_relationships', 'created_at'),
      ('wallet_relationships', 'updated_at'),
      ('signals', 'executed_at'),
      ('signals', 'created_at'),
      ('signals', 'expires_at'),
      ('signals', 'alerted_at'),
      ('trades', 'executed_at'),
      ('trades', 'confirmed_at'),
      ('config', 'updated_at'),
      ('discovery_log', 'ran_at'),
      ('polymarket_markets', 'end_date'),
      ('polymarket_markets', 'created_at'),
      ('polymarket_markets', 'updated_at')
    ) AS expected(relation_name, column_name)
  LOOP
    SELECT data_type
      INTO current_type
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public'
       AND table_name = target.relation_name
       AND column_name = target.column_name;

    IF current_type IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected timestamp column %.% is missing',
        target.relation_name, target.column_name;
    ELSIF current_type = 'timestamp without time zone' THEN
      EXECUTE format(
        'ALTER TABLE %I ALTER COLUMN %I TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING %I AT TIME ZONE ''UTC''',
        target.relation_name,
        target.column_name,
        target.column_name
      );
    ELSIF current_type != 'timestamp with time zone' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected timestamp column %.% has unsupported type %',
        target.relation_name, target.column_name, current_type;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END $$;

==> packages/db/sql/024_chain_certifications.sql <==
-- Live execution requires both an operator allowlist entry and an independently
-- reviewed certification record. This migration intentionally seeds no rows.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chain_certifications (
  chain TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'certified', 'revoked')),
  evidence_path TEXT,
  evidence_sha256 TEXT,
  reviewed_by TEXT,
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT chain_certifications_certified_evidence_check CHECK (
    status != 'certified'
    OR (
      evidence_path LIKE 'docs/certification/%'
      AND evidence_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND LENGTH(BTRIM(reviewed_by)) > 0
      AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL
    )
  ),
  CONSTRAINT chain_certifications_expiry_check CHECK (
    expires_at IS NULL OR reviewed_at IS NULL OR expires_at > reviewed_at
  )
);

  ON chain_certifications (status, expires_at);

==> packages/db/sql/028_copy_execution_lifecycle.sql <==
-- Canonical source-event, position, and copy-execution lifecycle.
-- This migration extends 023/027 forward so previously-applied migrations remain immutable.

ALTER TABLE source_trades
  ALTER COLUMN transaction_hash DROP NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_event_type TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_event_id VARCHAR(256),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_event_index VARCHAR(128),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS confirmation_state TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS confirmation_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

UPDATE source_trades
SET source_event_type = COALESCE(source_event_type, 'transaction'),
    source_event_id = COALESCE(source_event_id, transaction_hash),
    source_event_index = COALESCE(source_event_index, '0'),
    event_at = COALESCE(event_at, created_at),
    observed_at = COALESCE(observed_at, created_at),
    confirmation_state = COALESCE(
      confirmation_state,
      CASE
        WHEN status IN ('observed', 'confirmed', 'finalized', 'reversed') THEN status
        ELSE 'observed'
      END
    ),
    confirmation_updated_at = COALESCE(confirmation_updated_at, created_at)
WHERE source_event_type IS NULL
   OR source_event_id IS NULL
   OR source_event_index IS NULL
   OR event_at IS NULL
   OR observed_at IS NULL
   OR confirmation_state IS NULL
   OR confirmation_updated_at IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE source_trades
  ALTER COLUMN source_event_type SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN source_event_id SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN source_event_index SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN source_event_index SET DEFAULT '0',
  ALTER COLUMN event_at SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN observed_at SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN observed_at SET DEFAULT NOW(),
  ALTER COLUMN confirmation_state SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN confirmation_state SET DEFAULT 'observed',
  ALTER COLUMN confirmation_updated_at SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN confirmation_updated_at SET DEFAULT NOW();

DO $$
DECLARE
  legacy_source_trade_key text;
BEGIN
  -- Drop 023's UNIQUE(chain, transaction_hash, wallet_address, token_mint,
  -- direction), matched by COLUMN SHAPE rather than by name.
  --
  -- This was name-matched against a 76-character literal. PostgreSQL truncates
  -- identifiers at 63 bytes, so the constraint it actually created is named
  -- source_trades_chain_transaction_hash_wallet_address_token_mint_ and the
  -- equality test could never be true. The guard silently did nothing, the DROP
  -- never ran, and 023's key survived on every database that applied 023 -- while
  -- this file went on to install the replacement identity
  -- (unq_source_trades_canonical_event) as though the old one were gone.
  --
  -- The consequence is not cosmetic. That key forbids two rows sharing
  -- (chain, transaction_hash, wallet_address, token_mint, direction), which is a
  -- shape real ingestion produces: one transaction carrying two fills of the same
  -- token in the same direction. source_event_index exists in the replacement key
  -- precisely to tell those apart, so the collision is expected -- and was being
  -- rejected with a 23505 instead.
  --
  -- Shape matching is what this repo's migration rule asks for, for exactly this
  -- reason. It stays idempotent: once dropped, the SELECT finds nothing.
  SELECT c.conname INTO legacy_source_trade_key
  FROM pg_constraint c
  WHERE c.conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
    AND c.contype = 'u'
    AND (
      SELECT array_agg(a.attname::text ORDER BY a.attname)
      FROM unnest(c.conkey) AS k(attnum)
      JOIN pg_attribute a
        ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid
       AND a.attnum = k.attnum
    ) = ARRAY['chain', 'direction', 'token_mint', 'transaction_hash', 'wallet_address']
  LIMIT 1;

  IF legacy_source_trade_key IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE source_trades DROP CONSTRAINT %I', legacy_source_trade_key);
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'source_trades_direction_check'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades DROP CONSTRAINT source_trades_direction_check;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_source_trades_direction'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_source_trades_direction
      CHECK (direction IN ('buy', 'sell', 'transfer_in', 'transfer_out'));
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_source_trades_chain'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_source_trades_chain
      CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'));
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_source_trades_event_type'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_source_trades_event_type
      CHECK (source_event_type IN ('transaction', 'order', 'venue_trade'));
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_source_trades_confirmation'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_source_trades_confirmation
      CHECK (confirmation_state IN ('observed', 'confirmed', 'finalized', 'reversed'));
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_source_trades_quantities'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_source_trades_quantities
      CHECK (
        token_amount > 0
        AND (amount_usd IS NULL OR amount_usd >= 0)
        AND (price_usd IS NULL OR price_usd >= 0)
      );
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'source_trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_source_trades_transaction_identity'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE source_trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_source_trades_transaction_identity
      CHECK (source_event_type <> 'transaction' OR transaction_hash IS NOT NULL);
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_source_trades_canonical_event
  ON source_trades (chain, source_event_type, source_event_id, source_event_index);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_trades_position_order
  ON source_trades (wallet_address, chain, token_mint, event_at, id)
  WHERE confirmation_state IN ('confirmed', 'finalized');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION reject_source_trade_payload_mutation()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.chain IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.chain
    OR NEW.source_event_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_event_type
    OR NEW.source_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_event_id
    OR NEW.source_event_index IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_event_index
    OR NEW.transaction_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.transaction_hash
    OR NEW.wallet_address IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.wallet_address
    OR NEW.token_mint IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_mint
    OR NEW.direction IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.direction
    OR NEW.amount_usd IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount_usd
    OR NEW.token_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.token_amount
    OR NEW.price_usd IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.price_usd
    OR NEW.event_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.event_at
    OR NEW.observed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.observed_at
    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'source trade payload is immutable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_source_confirmation_transition()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.confirmation_state = OLD.confirmation_state THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT (
    (OLD.confirmation_state = 'observed' AND NEW.confirmation_state IN ('confirmed', 'finalized', 'reversed'))
    OR (OLD.confirmation_state = 'confirmed' AND NEW.confirmation_state IN ('finalized', 'reversed'))
    OR (OLD.confirmation_state = 'finalized' AND NEW.confirmation_state = 'reversed')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid source confirmation transition: % -> %', OLD.confirmation_state, NEW.confirmation_state;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_source_trade_payload_immutable ON source_trades;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_source_trade_payload_immutable
  BEFORE UPDATE ON source_trades
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_source_trade_payload_mutation();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_source_confirmation_transition ON source_trades;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_source_confirmation_transition
  BEFORE UPDATE OF confirmation_state ON source_trades
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_source_confirmation_transition();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_trade_confirmation_history (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  source_trade_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES source_trades(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  confirmation_state TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (confirmation_state IN ('observed', 'confirmed', 'finalized', 'reversed')),
  evidence_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (source_trade_id, confirmation_state, evidence_id)
);

ALTER TABLE wallet_positions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS opening_balance NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS opening_cost_basis_usd NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_acquired_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_reduced_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS unmatched_reduction_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_event_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

UPDATE wallet_positions
SET opening_balance = balance,
    opening_cost_basis_usd = cost_basis_usd
WHERE opening_balance = 0
  AND opening_cost_basis_usd = 0
  AND (balance <> 0 OR cost_basis_usd <> 0)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.tables
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'source_position_applications'
  );

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'wallet_positions'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_wallet_positions_lifecycle_totals'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE wallet_positions
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_wallet_positions_lifecycle_totals
      CHECK (
        opening_balance >= 0
        AND opening_cost_basis_usd >= 0
        AND total_acquired_quantity >= 0
        AND total_reduced_quantity >= 0
        AND unmatched_reduction_quantity >= 0
        AND cost_basis_usd >= 0
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_position_applications (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copy_positions (
  target_account VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  chain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain')),
  token_mint VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  opening_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (opening_quantity >= 0),
  opening_cost_basis_usd NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (opening_cost_basis_usd >= 0),
  confirmed_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (confirmed_quantity >= 0),
  reserved_sell_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reserved_sell_quantity >= 0),
  cost_basis_usd NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_basis_usd >= 0),
  total_acquired_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_acquired_quantity >= 0),
  total_reduced_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_reduced_quantity >= 0),
  unmatched_reduction_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (unmatched_reduction_quantity >= 0),
  last_evidence_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copy_executions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  source_trade_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES source_trades(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  chain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain')),
  target_account VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  token_mint VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  direction VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('buy', 'sell')),
  execution_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (execution_mode IN ('paper', 'live', 'shadow')),
  client_order_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested'
    CHECK (state IN (
      'requested', 'simulated', 'submitted', 'partially_filled', 'confirmed',
      'failed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required'
    )),
  requested_base_quantity NUMERIC,
  requested_quote_quantity NUMERIC,
  confirmed_base_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (confirmed_base_quantity >= 0),
  confirmed_quote_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (confirmed_quote_quantity >= 0),
  reserved_base_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reserved_base_quantity >= 0),
  max_submission_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK (max_submission_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
  submission_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (submission_attempts >= 0),
  simulation_id VARCHAR(256),
  simulated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  submission_type VARCHAR(32) CHECK (submission_type IN ('transaction', 'order')),
  submission_id VARCHAR(256),
  venue_order_id VARCHAR(256),
  transaction_hash VARCHAR(256),
  last_error TEXT,
  next_reconciliation_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  reconciliation_claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  reconciliation_claim_id UUID,
  reconciliation_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reconciliation_attempts >= 0),
  max_reconciliation_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (max_reconciliation_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CHECK (
    (requested_base_quantity IS NOT NULL AND requested_base_quantity > 0)
    OR (requested_quote_quantity IS NOT NULL AND requested_quote_quantity > 0)
  ),
  CHECK (requested_base_quantity IS NULL OR requested_base_quantity > 0),
  CHECK (requested_quote_quantity IS NULL OR requested_quote_quantity > 0),
  CHECK (submission_attempts <= max_submission_attempts),
  CHECK ((submission_type IS NULL) = (submission_id IS NULL)),
  UNIQUE (source_trade_id, target_account, execution_mode),
  UNIQUE (chain, target_account, client_order_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_copy_executions_reconciliation
  ON copy_executions (next_reconciliation_at, requested_at)
  WHERE state IN ('submitted', 'partially_filled', 'reconciliation_required');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copy_execution_state_history (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  execution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES copy_executions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  from_state VARCHAR(32),
  to_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_copy_execution_state_transition()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.state = OLD.state THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT (
    (OLD.state = 'requested' AND NEW.state IN ('simulated', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'simulated' AND NEW.state IN ('submitted', 'confirmed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'submitted' AND NEW.state IN ('partially_filled', 'confirmed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'partially_filled' AND NEW.state IN ('partially_filled', 'confirmed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'reconciliation_required' AND NEW.state IN ('submitted', 'partially_filled', 'confirmed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'confirmed' AND NEW.state = 'reconciliation_required')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid copy execution transition: % -> %', OLD.state, NEW.state;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_copy_execution_state_transition ON copy_executions;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_copy_execution_state_transition
  BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON copy_executions
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_copy_execution_state_transition();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copy_execution_evidence (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  execution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES copy_executions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  evidence_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
    CHECK (evidence_type IN ('chain_receipt', 'venue_fill', 'balance_reconciliation', 'paper_simulation')),
  evidence_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  base_quantity NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (base_quantity > 0),
  quote_quantity NUMERIC CHECK (quote_quantity IS NULL OR quote_quantity >= 0),
  price_usd NUMERIC CHECK (price_usd IS NULL OR price_usd >= 0),
  confirmation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'observed'
    CHECK (confirmation_state IN ('observed', 'confirmed', 'finalized', 'reversed')),
  completes_execution BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  confirmation_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (execution_id, evidence_type, evidence_id)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION reject_copy_evidence_payload_mutation()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.execution_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.execution_id
    OR NEW.evidence_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.evidence_type
    OR NEW.evidence_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.evidence_id
    OR NEW.base_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.base_quantity
    OR NEW.quote_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.quote_quantity
    OR NEW.price_usd IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.price_usd
    OR NEW.completes_execution IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.completes_execution
    OR NEW.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.occurred_at
    OR NEW.observed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.observed_at
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'copy execution evidence payload is immutable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_copy_evidence_payload_immutable ON copy_execution_evidence;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_copy_evidence_payload_immutable
  BEFORE UPDATE ON copy_execution_evidence
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_copy_evidence_payload_mutation();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_copy_evidence_confirmation_transition ON copy_execution_evidence;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_copy_evidence_confirmation_transition
  BEFORE UPDATE OF confirmation_state ON copy_execution_evidence
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_source_confirmation_transition();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copy_position_applications (

  execution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES copy_executions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

  chain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain')),
  token_mint VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_copy_position_applications_position

==> packages/db/sql/029_attribution_semantics.sql <==
-- Attribution identity and immutable expectancy report snapshots.

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_signal_outcomes_signal_id;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_signal_outcomes_identity
  ON signal_outcomes (signal_id, chain, execution_mode);

-- Migration 019 treated missing realized P&L as zero. Retain those outcome rows,
-- but restore unknown semantics when no complete buy/sell evidence exists.
UPDATE signal_outcomes so
SET realized_pnl_usd = NULL,
    hit_result = NULL
WHERE so.realized_pnl_usd = 0
  AND so.hit_result = FALSE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trades t
    WHERE t.signal_id = so.signal_id
      AND t.chain = so.chain
      AND COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper') = so.execution_mode
      AND t.status = 'filled'
      AND (t.execution_mode IS NULL OR t.execution_mode <> 'shadow')
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'buy') > 0
       AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'sell') > 0
       AND BOOL_AND(t.amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND t.token_amount IS NOT NULL)
             FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'buy')
       AND BOOL_AND(t.amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND t.token_amount IS NOT NULL)
             FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'sell')
  );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expectancy_reports (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  config_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  rows JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  CONSTRAINT expectancy_reports_config_object
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(config_snapshot) = 'object'),
  CONSTRAINT expectancy_reports_rows_array
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(rows) = 'array')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_expectancy_reports_generated_at
  ON expectancy_reports (generated_at DESC, id DESC);

==> packages/db/sql/030_source_signal_execution_linkage.sql <==
-- Link immutable source events to their derived signal, canonical execution,
-- and compatibility trade row without changing legacy aggregate signals.

ALTER TABLE signals
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_trade_id UUID REFERENCES source_trades(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_side VARCHAR(16),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_position_before_quantity NUMERIC,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_position_evidence_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_sell_fraction NUMERIC,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_dispatched_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_signals_source_trade
  ON signals (source_trade_id)
  WHERE source_trade_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_signals_id_source_trade
  ON signals (id, source_trade_id);

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'signals'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_signals_source_trade_snapshot'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE signals
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_signals_source_trade_snapshot
      CHECK (
        (source_trade_id IS NULL
          AND source_side IS NULL
          AND source_position_before_quantity IS NULL
          AND source_position_evidence_at IS NULL
          AND source_sell_fraction IS NULL)
        OR
        (source_trade_id IS NOT NULL
          AND source_side = 'buy'
          AND source_position_before_quantity IS NULL
          AND source_position_evidence_at IS NULL
          AND source_sell_fraction IS NULL)
        OR
        (source_trade_id IS NOT NULL
          AND source_side = 'sell'
          AND source_position_before_quantity > 0
          AND source_position_evidence_at IS NOT NULL
          AND source_sell_fraction > 0
          AND source_sell_fraction <= 1)
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE copy_executions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS signal_id UUID,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_position_before_quantity NUMERIC,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_sell_fraction NUMERIC;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_copy_executions_id_signal_source
  ON copy_executions (id, signal_id, source_trade_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_copy_executions_signal_target_mode
  ON copy_executions (signal_id, target_account, execution_mode)
  WHERE signal_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_copy_executions_submission_identity
  ON copy_executions (chain, submission_type, submission_id)
  WHERE submission_id IS NOT NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'copy_executions'::regclass
      AND conname = 'fk_copy_executions_signal_source'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE copy_executions
      ADD CONSTRAINT fk_copy_executions_signal_source
      FOREIGN KEY (signal_id, source_trade_id)
      REFERENCES signals (id, source_trade_id)
      ON DELETE RESTRICT;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'copy_executions'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_copy_executions_source_snapshot'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE copy_executions
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_copy_executions_source_snapshot
      CHECK (
        signal_id IS NULL
        OR (direction = 'buy'
          AND source_position_before_quantity IS NULL
          AND source_sell_fraction IS NULL)
        OR (direction = 'sell'
          AND source_position_before_quantity > 0
          AND source_sell_fraction > 0
          AND source_sell_fraction <= 1)
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE trades
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS copy_execution_id UUID;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS unq_trades_copy_execution
  ON trades (copy_execution_id)
  WHERE copy_execution_id IS NOT NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'fk_trades_copy_execution_identity'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trades_copy_execution_identity
      FOREIGN KEY (copy_execution_id, signal_id, source_trade_id)
      REFERENCES copy_executions (id, signal_id, source_trade_id)
      ON DELETE RESTRICT;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
      AND conname = 'chk_trades_copy_execution_identity_complete'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE trades
      ADD CONSTRAINT chk_trades_copy_execution_identity_complete
      CHECK (
        copy_execution_id IS NULL
        OR (signal_id IS NOT NULL AND source_trade_id IS NOT NULL)
      );
  END IF;
END $$;
