==> packages/shared/src/jupiter-swap.ts <==
import {
  AddressLookupTableAccount,
  PublicKey,
  TransactionInstruction,
  TransactionMessage,
  VersionedTransaction
} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type { JupiterQuote } from './jupiter.js';

/**
 * Jupiter Swap API V2 `/build` transaction-assembly step (checklist S4-M34).
 *
 * Migrated from the undocumented V1 POST /swap to Swap API V2 GET /build.
 * Assembles raw instructions into a VersionedTransaction with Address Lookup
 * Tables (ALTs) resolved in the response payload.
 *
 * Sets `forJitoBundle: true` to exclude DEXes incompatible with Jito bundles,
 * uses `wrapAndUnwrapSol: true` (with wrapUnwrapSOL supported for compatibility),
 * and maps `userPublicKey` to `taker`.
 *
 * Returns null rather than throwing so callers can fall back gracefully.
 */

const JUPITER_API_BASE = 'https://api.jup.ag/swap/v2';
const JUPITER_SWAP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;

async function fetchWithTimeout(
  url: string,
  init: RequestInit = {},
  timeoutMs = 10_000
): Promise<Response> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: controller.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

export interface JupiterSwapBuildParams {
  readonly quote?: JupiterQuote;
  readonly inputMint?: string;
  readonly outputMint?: string;
  readonly amountLamports?: number | string;
  readonly slippageBps?: number;
  /** The wallet that will sign and pay for the transaction (`taker` in V2). */
  readonly userPublicKey: string;
  /**
   * Wrap/unwrap SOL as needed. Set `true` for safety: a user cannot *spend* an
   * unwrapped SOL balance without this, and a swap that would leave dust in a
   * wrapped token account is wasteful â€” better to close it and recover the rent.
   * Named `wrapAndUnwrapSol` in V2; `wrapUnwrapSOL` is retained for backwards compatibility.
   */
  readonly wrapAndUnwrapSol?: boolean;
  readonly wrapUnwrapSOL?: boolean;
  /**
   * Exclude DEXes that are incompatible with Jito bundles. Defaults to `true`
   * because SWAT submits transactions exclusively through Jito bundles.
   */
  readonly forJitoBundle?: boolean;
  /**
   * When true, include compute-budget and priority-fee instructions. Should
   * always be false for Jito bundles â€” the *tip* is what buys inclusion, and a
   * priority fee layered on top is double-paying for the same thing.
   */
  readonly computeUnitPriceMicroLamports?: number;
  readonly apiKey?: string;
  readonly apiBase?: string;
}

export interface JupiterSwapTransaction {
  /** Base64-encoded versioned transaction ready to sign. */
  readonly swapTransaction: string;
  /** The slot the quote was built against; after this expires the tx is stale. */
  readonly lastValidBlockHeight: number;
}

export interface JupiterApiInstruction {
  programId: string;
  accounts: Array<{
    pubkey: string;
    isWritable: boolean;
    isSigner: boolean;
  }>;
  data: string;
}

export interface JupiterSwapBuildResponse {
  computeBudgetInstructions?: JupiterApiInstruction[];
  setupInstructions?: JupiterApiInstruction[];
  swapInstruction?: JupiterApiInstruction;
  cleanupInstruction?: JupiterApiInstruction | null;
  otherInstructions?: JupiterApiInstruction[];
  addressesByLookupTableAddress?: Record<string, string[]>;
  blockhashWithMetadata?: {
    blockhash: string | number[];
    lastValidBlockHeight: number;
  };
  swapTransaction?: string;
  lastValidBlockHeight?: number;
  error?: string;
}

function deserializeInstruction(ix: JupiterApiInstruction): TransactionInstruction {
  return new TransactionInstruction({
    programId: new PublicKey(ix.programId),
    keys: ix.accounts.map((acc) => ({
      pubkey: new PublicKey(acc.pubkey),
      isWritable: acc.isWritable,
      isSigner: acc.isSigner
    })),
    data: Buffer.from(ix.data, 'base64')
  });
}

function parseBlockhash(blockhash: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof blockhash === 'string' && blockhash.length > 0) return blockhash;
  if (Array.isArray(blockhash) && blockhash.length === 32) {
    try {
      return new PublicKey(Buffer.from(blockhash)).toBase58();
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Builds the swap transaction from a quote or mint/amount parameters.
 *
 * Uses Jupiter Swap API V2 `GET /build` with `forJitoBundle: true`.
 * Returns `null` on failure so callers can gracefully fall back or skip.
 */
export async function buildJupiterSwap(
  params: JupiterSwapBuildParams
): Promise<JupiterSwapTransaction | null> {
  const inputMint = params.quote?.inputMint ?? params.inputMint;
  const outputMint = params.quote?.outputMint ?? params.outputMint;
  const amount = params.quote?.inAmount ?? params.amountLamports;
  const slippageBps = params.quote?.slippageBps ?? params.slippageBps;
  const wrapAndUnwrapSol = params.wrapAndUnwrapSol ?? params.wrapUnwrapSOL ?? true;
  const forJitoBundle = params.forJitoBundle ?? true;

  if (!inputMint || !outputMint || amount === undefined || amount === null) {
    console.error('[jupiter] swap build missing inputMint, outputMint, or amount');
    return null;
  }

  const base = params.apiBase ?? JUPITER_API_BASE;
  const url = new URL(`${base}/build`);
  url.searchParams.set('inputMint', inputMint);
  url.searchParams.set('outputMint', outputMint);
  url.searchParams.set('amount', String(amount));
  url.searchParams.set('taker', params.userPublicKey);
  if (typeof slippageBps === 'number') {
    url.searchParams.set('slippageBps', String(slippageBps));
  }
  url.searchParams.set('wrapAndUnwrapSol', String(wrapAndUnwrapSol));
  url.searchParams.set('forJitoBundle', String(forJitoBundle));

  const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: 'application/json' };
  if (params.apiKey) headers['x-api-key'] = params.apiKey;

  try {
    const response = await fetchWithTimeout(
      url.toString(),
      {
        method: 'GET',
        headers
      },
      JUPITER_SWAP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      const snippet = (await response.text().catch(() => '')).slice(0, 200);
      console.error(`[jupiter] swap build failed ${response.status}: ${snippet}`);
      return null;
    }

    const payload = (await response.json()) as JupiterSwapBuildResponse;
    if (payload.error) {
      console.error(`[jupiter] swap build error: ${payload.error}`);
      return null;
    }

    // Direct transaction return (for compatibility with pre-assembled responses or test mocks)
    if (payload.swapTransaction && typeof payload.lastValidBlockHeight === 'number') {
      return {
        swapTransaction: payload.swapTransaction,
        lastValidBlockHeight: payload.lastValidBlockHeight
      };
    }

    // Assemble instructions returned by Swap API V2
    const blockhashStr = parseBlockhash(payload.blockhashWithMetadata?.blockhash);
    const lastValidBlockHeight =
      payload.blockhashWithMetadata?.lastValidBlockHeight ?? payload.lastValidBlockHeight;

    if (!blockhashStr || typeof lastValidBlockHeight !== 'number') {
      console.error('[jupiter] swap build response missing valid blockhash or lastValidBlockHeight');
      return null;
    }

    const lookupTableAccounts: AddressLookupTableAccount[] = [];
    if (
      payload.addressesByLookupTableAddress &&
      typeof payload.addressesByLookupTableAddress === 'object'
    ) {
      for (const [tableKey, addresses] of Object.entries(payload.addressesByLookupTableAddress)) {
        if (Array.isArray(addresses)) {
          try {
            lookupTableAccounts.push(
              new AddressLookupTableAccount({
                key: new PublicKey(tableKey),
                state: {
                  deactivationSlot: BigInt('18446744073709551615'),
                  lastExtendedSlot: 0,
                  lastExtendedSlotStartIndex: 0,
                  authority: undefined,
                  addresses: addresses.map((addr) => new PublicKey(addr))
                }
              })
            );
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn(`[jupiter] failed to parse ALT ${tableKey}:`, e);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const instructions: TransactionInstruction[] = [];
    if (Array.isArray(payload.computeBudgetInstructions)) {
      instructions.push(...payload.computeBudgetInstructions.map(deserializeInstruction));
    }
    if (Array.isArray(payload.setupInstructions)) {
      instructions.push(...payload.setupInstructions.map(deserializeInstruction));
    }
    if (payload.swapInstruction) {
      instructions.push(deserializeInstruction(payload.swapInstruction));
    }
    if (payload.cleanupInstruction) {
      instructions.push(deserializeInstruction(payload.cleanupInstruction));
    }
    if (Array.isArray(payload.otherInstructions)) {
      instructions.push(...payload.otherInstructions.map(deserializeInstruction));
    }

    if (instructions.length === 0) {
      console.error('[jupiter] swap build returned no instructions');
      return null;
    }

    const message = new TransactionMessage({
      payerKey: new PublicKey(params.userPublicKey),
      recentBlockhash: blockhashStr,
      instructions
    }).compileToV0Message(lookupTableAccounts);

    const versionedTx = new VersionedTransaction(message);
    const swapTransaction = Buffer.from(versionedTx.serialize()).toString('base64');

    return {
      swapTransaction,
      lastValidBlockHeight
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      '[jupiter] swap build request failed:',
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
    );
    return null;
  }
}

==> packages/shared/src/jupiter.ts <==
/**
 * Jupiter Swap API v1 client for SWAT paper-trade simulation.
 *
 * This module fetches **quotes only** â€” it never signs or broadcasts a
 * transaction.  A quote tells us the exact output amount, price impact, and
 * routing a real swap would produce, which is far more accurate than the
 * simple `amountUsd / spotPrice` division the paper path used before.
 *
 * Every public function returns `null` on failure so callers can gracefully
 * fall back to the existing spot-price logic without crashing the job.
 *
 * Endpoint:  GET https://api.jup.ag/swap/v1/quote
 * Auth:      x-api-key header (free tier from https://developers.jup.ag/portal)
 * Rate limit: ~60 req/min on free tier (trade-executor runs at concurrency 1,
 *             signals fire every 15 s max â€” well within this budget).
 */

// â”€â”€â”€ Configuration â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

const JUPITER_API_BASE = 'https://api.jup.ag/swap/v1';

/** Per-request timeout. Mirrors the convention in prices.ts. */
const JUPITER_QUOTE_TIMEOUT_MS = Number(
  process.env.JUPITER_QUOTE_TIMEOUT_MS ?? 8000
);

// â”€â”€â”€ Types â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/** A single hop in the route returned by the Quote API. */
export interface JupiterRouteStep {
  swapInfo: {
    ammKey: string;
    label: string;
    inputMint: string;
    outputMint: string;
    inAmount: string;
    outAmount: string;
    feeAmount: string;
    feeMint: string;
  };
  percent: number;
}

/** Subset of the Quote API response we actually consume. */
export interface JupiterQuote {
  inputMint: string;
  outputMint: string;
  inAmount: string;
  outAmount: string;
  otherAmountThreshold: string;
  swapMode: 'ExactIn' | 'ExactOut';
  slippageBps: number;
  priceImpactPct: string;
  routePlan: JupiterRouteStep[];
  contextSlot: number;
}

/** Parameters accepted by {@link getJupiterQuote}. */
export interface JupiterQuoteParams {
  inputMint: string;
  outputMint: string;
  /**
   * Raw amount in the specified side's smallest unit: input for ExactIn,
   * output for ExactOut. The legacy name is retained for caller compatibility.
   */
  amountLamports: number;
  /** Slippage tolerance in basis points.  Defaults to 150 (1.5 %). */
  slippageBps?: number;
  swapMode?: 'ExactIn' | 'ExactOut';
}

/**
 * Pre-processed result returned by {@link getJupiterSimulatedFill}.
 * Contains human-friendly numbers ready to persist into the `trades` table.
 */
export interface JupiterSimulatedFill {
  /** This is quote evidence, not a confirmed or submitted chain fill. */
  status: 'quoted';
  swapMode: 'ExactIn' | 'ExactOut';
  /** Raw input amount returned by Jupiter (smallest input-token unit). */
  inAmountRaw: string;
  /** Raw output amount as returned by Jupiter (smallest token unit). */
  outAmountRaw: string;
  /** Output amount converted to human units using `outputDecimals`. */
  tokenAmount: number;
  /** Minimum output after slippage for ExactIn; null for ExactOut. */
  minTokenAmount: number | null;
  /** Maximum input after slippage for ExactOut; null for ExactIn. */
  maxInputAmount: number | null;
  /** Direction-aware interpretation of Jupiter's otherAmountThreshold. */
  threshold:
    | { kind: 'minimum-output'; rawAmount: string; amount: number; decimals: number }
    | { kind: 'maximum-input'; rawAmount: string; amount: number; decimals: number };
  /** Price impact as a number (e.g. 0.12 means 0.12 %). */
  priceImpactPct: number;
  /** The full route plan for informational logging / storage. */
  routePlan: JupiterRouteStep[];
  /** Solana slot the quote was computed at. */
  contextSlot: number;
}

export type JupiterQuoteDecimals = {
  inputDecimals: number;
  outputDecimals: number;
};

// â”€â”€â”€ Internal helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

async function fetchWithTimeout(
  url: string,
  init: RequestInit,
  timeoutMs = JUPITER_QUOTE_TIMEOUT_MS
): Promise<Response> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: controller.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

function assertTokenDecimals(value: number, label: string): void {
  if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0 || value > 30) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid ${label} token decimals: ${value}`);
  }
}

function parsePositiveRawAmount(value: unknown): bigint | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[0-9]+$/.test(value)) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = BigInt(value);
    return parsed > 0n ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function rawAmountToNumber(rawAmount: string, decimals: number): number | null {
  const parsed = parsePositiveRawAmount(rawAmount);
  if (parsed === null) return null;
  if (decimals === 0) {
    const value = Number(parsed);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
  }

  const divisor = 10n ** BigInt(decimals);
  const whole = parsed / divisor;
  const fraction = (parsed % divisor).toString().padStart(decimals, '0');
  const value = Number(`${whole.toString()}.${fraction}`);
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Public API â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

/**
 * Fetch a Jupiter swap quote.  Returns `null` on any error (network, rate
 * limit, missing route, bad response shape) so the caller never has to
 * worry about exceptions.
 *
 * @param params  Quote parameters (mints, amount, slippage).
 * @param apiKey  Optional Jupiter API key.  When omitted the request is
 *                still sent (some endpoints allow unauthenticated access at
 *                a lower rate limit), but authenticated calls are preferred.
 */
export async function getJupiterQuote(
  params: JupiterQuoteParams,
  apiKey?: string
): Promise<JupiterQuote | null> {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(params.amountLamports) || params.amountLamports <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Jupiter raw quote amount: ${params.amountLamports}`);
  }
  const requestedSwapMode = params.swapMode ?? 'ExactIn';
  const url = new URL(`${JUPITER_API_BASE}/quote`);
  url.searchParams.set('inputMint', params.inputMint);
  url.searchParams.set('outputMint', params.outputMint);
  url.searchParams.set('amount', Math.round(params.amountLamports).toString());
  url.searchParams.set(
    'slippageBps',
    (params.slippageBps ?? 150).toString()
  );
  url.searchParams.set('swapMode', requestedSwapMode);

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (apiKey) {
    headers['x-api-key'] = apiKey;
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetchWithTimeout(url.toString(), { headers });

    if (!response.ok) {
      // Log status but don't throw â€” caller falls back gracefully.
      const snippet = (await response.text().catch(() => '')).slice(0, 200);
      console.error(
        `[jupiter] quote failed ${response.status}: ${snippet}`
      );
      return null;
    }

    const data = (await response.json()) as JupiterQuote;

    // Minimal shape validation â€” reject clearly malformed payloads rather than
    // letting a broken upstream silently produce NaN token amounts downstream.
    if (
      parsePositiveRawAmount(data.outAmount) === null
      || parsePositiveRawAmount(data.inAmount) === null
      || parsePositiveRawAmount(data.otherAmountThreshold) === null
      || data.swapMode !== requestedSwapMode
    ) {
      console.error('[jupiter] malformed quote response â€” missing amounts');
      return null;
    }

    return data;
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    // AbortError (timeout) or network failure â€” log and return null.
    const msg =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    console.error(`[jupiter] quote fetch error: ${msg}`);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * High-level helper that fetches a quote and converts it into values ready
 * for the `trades` table.  Returns `null` when the quote is unavailable so
 * the paper-fill path can fall back to the existing spot-price logic.
 *
 * @param params         Same as {@link getJupiterQuote}.
 * @param decimals       Resolved token decimals. ExactOut requires both input
 *                       and output decimals because its threshold is max-input.
 *                       ExactIn temporarily accepts an output-decimals number
 *                       for existing callers, with no guessed fallback.
 * @param apiKey         Jupiter API key (optional, but recommended).
 */
export async function getJupiterSimulatedFill(
  params: JupiterQuoteParams,
  decimals: number | JupiterQuoteDecimals,
  apiKey?: string
): Promise<JupiterSimulatedFill | null> {
  const requestedSwapMode = params.swapMode ?? 'ExactIn';
  const outputDecimals = typeof decimals === 'number'
    ? decimals
    : decimals.outputDecimals;
  const inputDecimals = typeof decimals === 'number'
    ? null
    : decimals.inputDecimals;

  assertTokenDecimals(outputDecimals, 'output');
  if (inputDecimals !== null) assertTokenDecimals(inputDecimals, 'input');
  if (requestedSwapMode === 'ExactOut' && inputDecimals === null) {
    throw new Error('ExactOut Jupiter quotes require resolved input token decimals');
  }

  const quote = await getJupiterQuote(params, apiKey);
  if (!quote) return null;

  const tokenAmount = rawAmountToNumber(quote.outAmount, outputDecimals);
  const priceImpact = parseFloat(quote.priceImpactPct);
  const thresholdDecimals = quote.swapMode === 'ExactIn'
    ? outputDecimals
    : inputDecimals!;
  const thresholdAmount = rawAmountToNumber(
    quote.otherAmountThreshold,
    thresholdDecimals
  );

  // Guard against NaN leaking into the DB.
  if (tokenAmount === null || tokenAmount <= 0 || thresholdAmount === null) {
    console.error(
      `[jupiter] non-finite quote amounts: ${quote.inAmount}/${quote.outAmount}/${quote.otherAmountThreshold}`
    );
    return null;
  }

  const threshold = quote.swapMode === 'ExactIn'
    ? {
        kind: 'minimum-output' as const,
        rawAmount: quote.otherAmountThreshold,
        amount: thresholdAmount,
        decimals: thresholdDecimals
      }
    : {
        kind: 'maximum-input' as const,
        rawAmount: quote.otherAmountThreshold,
        amount: thresholdAmount,
        decimals: thresholdDecimals
      };

  return {
    status: 'quoted',
    swapMode: quote.swapMode,
    inAmountRaw: quote.inAmount,
    outAmountRaw: quote.outAmount,
    tokenAmount,
    minTokenAmount: quote.swapMode === 'ExactIn' ? thresholdAmount : null,
    maxInputAmount: quote.swapMode === 'ExactOut' ? thresholdAmount : null,
    threshold,
    priceImpactPct: Number.isFinite(priceImpact) ? priceImpact : 0,
    routePlan: quote.routePlan ?? [],
    contextSlot: quote.contextSlot ?? 0
  };
}

    } = await import('./logger.js');

      hidden: { enumerable: true, get: getter },
      [Symbol.for('nodejs.util.inspect.custom')]: {

==> packages/shared/src/logger.ts <==
/**
 * SWAT Unified System Logger
 * 
 * Hijacks console.log and console.error globally.
 * Logs are automatically printed to the terminal (so ./start.sh works as usual)
 * and sent to Redis to be streamed on the dashboard live log panel.
 */
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { inspect } from 'node:util';

const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
const MAX_LOG_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 20_000;
let redis: Redis | null = null;
let currentService = 'unknown';

const originalLog = console.log;
const originalError = console.error;

export function serializeLogArgument(value: unknown): string {
  try {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
    if (typeof value === 'bigint') return `${value}n`;
    if (
      (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null)
      || typeof value === 'function'
    ) {
      return inspect(value, {
        breakLength: Infinity,
        compact: true,
        customInspect: false,
        depth: 6,
        getters: false,
        maxArrayLength: 100,
        maxStringLength: 10_000
      });
    }
    return String(value);
  } catch {
    try {
      return `[Unserializable ${Object.prototype.toString.call(value)}]`;
    } catch {
      return '[Unserializable value]';
    }
  }
}

export function serializeLogArguments(args: unknown[]): string {
  try {
    const message = args.map(serializeLogArgument).join(' ');
    if (message.length <= MAX_LOG_MESSAGE_LENGTH) return message;
    return `${message.slice(0, MAX_LOG_MESSAGE_LENGTH)}...[truncated]`;
  } catch {
    return '[Log serialization failed]';
  }
}

function getRedisInstance(): Redis {
  if (!redis) {
    redis = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
    redis.on('error', (err: any) => {
      // Print directly to console without looping
      originalError(`[logger-internal] Redis connection error: ${err.message}`);
    });
  }
  return redis;
}

function publishToRedis(level: 'info' | 'error', message: string) {
  try {
    const client = getRedisInstance();
    const logItem = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      service: currentService,
      level,
      message
    };
    const logStr = JSON.stringify(logItem);

    // Push to list and trim to keep last 500 entries
    client.lpush('swat:logs:list', logStr).then(() => {
      client.ltrim('swat:logs:list', 0, 499).catch(() => {});
    }).catch(() => {});

    // Publish to live pub/sub stream channel
    client.publish('swat:logs:stream', logStr).catch(() => {});
  } catch (err: any) {
    originalError(`[logger-internal] Failed to publish log: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Intercepts console output globally for this service.
 */
export function initLogger(serviceName: string) {
  currentService = serviceName;

  console.log = (...args: any[]) => {
    originalLog(...args);
    const message = serializeLogArguments(args);
    // Avoid double logging redis errors or our own internal hooks
    if (message.startsWith('[logger-internal]')) return;
    publishToRedis('info', message);
  };

  console.error = (...args: any[]) => {
    originalError(...args);
    const message = serializeLogArguments(args);
    if (message.startsWith('[logger-internal]')) return;
    publishToRedis('error', message);
  };

  originalLog(`[logger-internal] Registered console interceptor for service: ${serviceName}`);
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { canTransitionLpPosition, isLpPositionState, LP_POSITION_STATES } from './lp-lifecycle.js';

describe('lp position lifecycle', () => {
  it('allows the happy path end to end', () => {
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('building', 'active')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('active', 'near_edge')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('near_edge', 'out_of_range')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('out_of_range', 'rebalancing')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('rebalancing', 'active')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('active', 'closed')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('rebalancing re-enters every range state so the monitor re-classifies', () => {
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('rebalancing', 'active')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('rebalancing', 'near_edge')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('rebalancing', 'out_of_range')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('rebalancing', 'closed')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('rebalancing', 'building')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('price moves are not monotonic: drift can recover on its own', () => {
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('near_edge', 'active')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('out_of_range', 'active')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('the manual trigger (Track I) may re-center an in-range position', () => {
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('active', 'rebalancing')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('closed is terminal and building cannot skip to rebalancing', () => {
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('closed', 'active')).toBe(false);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('building', 'rebalancing')).toBe(false);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('building', 'out_of_range')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('same-state transitions are allowed (idempotent relabeling)', () => {
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('active', 'active')).toBe(true);
    expect(canTransitionLpPosition('closed', 'closed')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('every declared state has a transition row and a valid guard', () => {
    expect(LP_POSITION_STATES).toHaveLength(6);
    for (const state of LP_POSITION_STATES) {
      expect(isLpPositionState(state)).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(isLpPositionState('liquidated')).toBe(false);
  });
});

==> packages/shared/src/lp-lifecycle.ts <==
/**
 * LP position lifecycle (LP Dashboard Track A).
 *
 * Mirrors the copy-execution machine in this package: one frozen state list, one
 * transition table, and one `canTransition*` predicate. The DB side enforces the
 * same table a second time with a trigger (migration `059`), because an LP
 * position is a fund-touching row â€” the CHECK-only subscription precedent does
 * not apply.
 */

export type LpPositionState =
  | 'building'
  | 'active'
  | 'near_edge'
  | 'out_of_range'
  | 'rebalancing'
  | 'closed';

export const LP_POSITION_STATES: readonly LpPositionState[] = [
  'building',
  'active',
  'near_edge',
  'out_of_range',
  'rebalancing',
  'closed'
] as const;

export function isLpPositionState(value: string): value is LpPositionState {
  return (LP_POSITION_STATES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/**
 * `building â†’ active â†’ near_edge â†’ out_of_range â†’ rebalancing â†’ closed` is the
 * happy path, but price moves are not monotonic: a position that drifted to
 * `near_edge` can return to `active`, and one that fell `out_of_range` can come
 * back in range without any transaction. `rebalancing` re-enters the range
 * states so the monitor re-classifies after the new ladder lands rather than
 * asserting an outcome it has not observed.
 *
 * `active â†’ rebalancing` exists for the manual rebalance trigger (Track I):
 * a user may re-center an in-range position on purpose. The scheduled monitor
 * never uses it â€” it only re-labels from price observations.
 */
const LP_POSITION_TRANSITIONS: Readonly<
  Record<LpPositionState, readonly LpPositionState[]>
> = {
  building: ['active', 'closed'],
  active: ['near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed'],
  near_edge: ['active', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed'],
  out_of_range: ['active', 'rebalancing', 'closed'],
  rebalancing: ['active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'closed'],
  closed: []
};

export function canTransitionLpPosition(
  current: LpPositionState,
  next: LpPositionState
): boolean {
  return current === next || LP_POSITION_TRANSITIONS[current].includes(next);
}

==> packages/shared/src/polymarket-book-depth.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration,
  assessPolymarketBookDepth,
  createInMemoryPolymarketBookCache,
  polymarketBookAverageImpactBps,
  polymarketBookDepthFullyAssessed,
  PolymarketBookDepthInputError,
  POLYMARKET_BOOK_CLOCK_SKEW_ALLOWANCE_MS,
  POLYMARKET_BOOK_DEFAULT_BOUND_BPS,
  POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS,
  POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_BOUND_BPS,
  POLYMARKET_BOOK_RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS,
  type PolymarketBookDepthRequest,
  type PolymarketBookEntry,
  type PolymarketBookLevel
} from './polymarket-book-depth.js';

/** A real-shaped CLOB token id: the `asset_id` on the market channel. */
const TOKEN_ID = '107505882767731489358349912513945399560393482969656700824895970500493757150417';
const PREFIXED = `polygon:${TOKEN_ID}`;

const NOW = 1_782_753_400_000;

/**
 * Polygon's aggregate-impact ceiling today: `DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.polygon` (300)
 * times `AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE` (1/3), floored.
 */
const POLYGON_CAP_BPS = 100;

function book(over: Partial<Extract<PolymarketBookEntry, { status: 'book' }>> = {}) {
  const entry: PolymarketBookEntry = {
    status: 'book',
    tokenId: TOKEN_ID,
    observedAt: NOW - 1_000,
    ladders: {
      bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 1_000 }],
      asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 1_000 }]
    },
    ...over
  };
  return entry;
}

function assess(
  entry: PolymarketBookEntry | undefined,
  over: Partial<PolymarketBookDepthRequest> = {}
) {
  const cache = createInMemoryPolymarketBookCache(entry === undefined ? [] : [entry]);
  return assessPolymarketBookDepth(cache, {
    tokenMint: PREFIXED,
    cohortDirection: 'buy',
    impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS,
    now: NOW,
    ...over
  });
}

describe('assessPolymarketBookDepth (S4-M38)', () => {
  it('prices a fresh book and reports it as fully assessed', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book());
    expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('assessed');
    expect(verdict.reasonCode).toBe('polymarket-book-depth-assessed');
    expect(verdict.unassessed).toEqual([]);
    expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBeNull();
    expect(polymarketBookDepthFullyAssessed(verdict)).toBe(true);
    expect(verdict.tokenMint).toBe(PREFIXED);
  });

  it('accepts a bare CLOB asset_id and still reports a chain-prefixed tokenMint', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book(), { tokenMint: TOKEN_ID });
    expect(verdict.tokenMint).toBe(PREFIXED);
    expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('assessed');
  });

  it('refuses a token prefixed for another chain rather than assessing it', () => {
    expect(() => assess(book(), { tokenMint: `solana:${TOKEN_ID}` }))
      .toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
  });

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Staleness. The rule S4-M6 records: a stale entry keeps reading unknown.
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  describe('staleness â€” a stale entry must read unknown, never its last value', () => {
    it('a stale snapshot returns unknown and NOT the last observed depth', () => {
      const stale = book({ observedAt: NOW - (POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS + 1) });
      const verdict = assess(stale);
      expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('unknown');
      expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-snapshot-stale');
      expect(verdict.reasonCode).toBe('polymarket-book-snapshot-stale');
      // The load-bearing assertions: no figure of any kind survives.
      expect(verdict.depth).toBeNull();
      expect(verdict.capacity).toBeNull();
      expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
      expect(verdict.liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
      expect(polymarketBookDepthFullyAssessed(verdict)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('a book exactly at the age budget is still assessed', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({ observedAt: NOW - POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS }));
      expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('assessed');
      expect(verdict.ageMs).toBe(POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS);
    });

    it('the age budget is two resync periods, so exactly one missed resync is tolerated', () => {
      expect(POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS).toBe(POLYMARKET_BOOK_RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS * 2);
      // One missed resync: assessed. Two: unknown.
      expect(assess(book({ observedAt: NOW - POLYMARKET_BOOK_RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS * 2 })).outcome)
        .toBe('assessed');
      expect(assess(book({ observedAt: NOW - POLYMARKET_BOOK_RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS * 3 })).outcome)
        .toBe('unknown');
    });

    it('honours an explicit maxAgeMs override in the tightening direction', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({ observedAt: NOW - 5_000 }), { maxAgeMs: 1_000 });
      expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-snapshot-stale');
    });

    it('refuses a book observed further in the future than the skew allowance', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({
        observedAt: NOW + POLYMARKET_BOOK_CLOCK_SKEW_ALLOWANCE_MS + 1
      }));
      expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-clock-implausible');
      expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
    });

    it('refuses a venue timestamp beyond the skew allowance, but tolerates a null one', () => {
      expect(assess(book({ venueTimestamp: NOW + 60_000 })).unknownCode)
        .toBe('book-clock-implausible');
      // Documented nullable on both `book` and `price_change`.
      expect(assess(book({ venueTimestamp: null })).outcome).toBe('assessed');
    });
  });

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Unknown is never zero and never "fine".
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  describe('an empty cache is its own code, never zero', () => {
    it('an empty cache returns book-not-cached with no numeric figure', () => {
      const verdict = assess(undefined);
      expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('unknown');
      expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-not-cached');
      expect(verdict.reasonCode).toBe('polymarket-book-not-cached');
      expect(verdict.depth).toBeNull();
      expect(verdict.capacity).toBeNull();
      expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
      expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).not.toBe(0);
      expect(verdict.ageMs).toBeNull();
    });

    it('a missing entry is distinguishable from an observed zero', () => {
      const missing = assess(undefined);
      const observedZero = assess(book({
        ladders: { bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 1_000 }], asks: [] }
      }));
      expect(missing.outcome).toBe('unknown');
      expect(observedZero.outcome).toBe('no-depth-within-bound');
      expect(missing.reasonCode).not.toBe(observedZero.reasonCode);
    });
  });

  it('a post-reconnect entry reads unknown even though top-of-book survived', () => {
    const verdict = assess({
      status: 'awaiting-snapshot',
      tokenId: TOKEN_ID,
      since: NOW - 500,
      bestBid: 0.4,
      bestAsk: 0.5
    });
    expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-awaiting-snapshot');
    expect(verdict.depth).toBeNull();
    expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a crossed book reads unknown â€” that is also a transposed bids/asks mapping', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book({
      ladders: {
        bids: [{ price: 0.6, size: 100 }],
        asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }]
      }
    }));
    expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-crossed');
  });

  it('a malformed level is refused for the whole entry rather than filtered out', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book({
      ladders: {
        bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 100 }],
        asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }, { price: 1.4, size: 100 }]
      }
    }));
    expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-level-invalid');
  });

  it('a zero-size level is a price_change deletion, dropped rather than refused', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book({
      ladders: {
        bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 1_000 }],
        asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 1_000 }, { price: 0.51, size: 0 }]
      }
    }));
    expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('assessed');
    expect(verdict.depth?.levelsWithinBound).toBe(1);
  });

  it('both sides empty reads unknown, because that is what a failed snapshot looks like', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book({ ladders: { bids: [], asks: [] } }));
    expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBe('book-empty');
    expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('one side empty against a populated other side is a known zero, not unknown', () => {
    const verdict = assess(book({
      ladders: { bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 1_000 }], asks: [] }
    }));
    expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('no-depth-within-bound');
    expect(verdict.reasonCode).toBe('polymarket-book-depth-empty-within-bound');
    expect(verdict.unknownCode).toBeNull();
    // Known zero still publishes no number, because UsableLiquidity cannot
    // express one â€” but it is a distinct outcome from unknown.
    expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
    expect(polymarketBookDepthFullyAssessed(verdict)).toBe(false);
  });

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Depth within a bound, not a scalar.
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  describe('depth is measured within a price bound, never as a total', () => {
    /**
     * Best ask 0.50; 200 bps takes prices up to 0.51. The 0.60 level is 2000 bps
     * away and must not be counted at all â€” that is the wall a "total depth"
     * figure would admit a cohort against.
     */
    const wallOutsideBound: readonly PolymarketBookLevel[] = [
      { price: 0.5, size: 100 },
      { price: 0.51, size: 100 },
      { price: 0.6, size: 1_000_000 }
    ];

    it('excludes size resting outside the bound, so a far wall is invisible', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: { bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }], asks: [...wallOutsideBound] },
        observedAt: NOW
      }), { boundBps: 200, impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      expect(verdict.outcome).toBe('assessed');
      // 100*0.50 + 100*0.51 = 101, and NOT 101 + 600_000.
      expect(verdict.depth?.notionalWithinBoundUsd).toBeCloseTo(101, 9);
      expect(verdict.depth?.worstPriceWithinBound).toBe(0.51);
      expect(verdict.capacity?.boundedBy).toBe('price-bound');
      expect(verdict.depth?.ladderExhausted).toBe(false);
    });

    it('a wider bound reaches more size, so the bound is doing the work', () => {
      const narrow = assess(book({
        ladders: { bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }], asks: [...wallOutsideBound] }
      }), { boundBps: 200, impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      const wide = assess(book({
        ladders: { bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }], asks: [...wallOutsideBound] }
      }), { boundBps: 2_000, impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      expect(wide.depth!.notionalWithinBoundUsd)
        .toBeGreaterThan(narrow.depth!.notionalWithinBoundUsd);
    });

    it('reports ladderExhausted when every visible level qualified, so depth is a lower bound', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book(), { impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      expect(verdict.depth?.ladderExhausted).toBe(true);
      expect(verdict.capacity?.boundedBy).toBe('book-exhausted');
    });

    it('defaults the bound to the executor own book-walk slippage cap', () => {
      expect(POLYMARKET_BOOK_DEFAULT_BOUND_BPS).toBe(200);
      const verdict = assess(book());
      expect(verdict.boundBps).toBe(POLYMARKET_BOOK_DEFAULT_BOUND_BPS);
    });

    it('refuses a bound wide enough to swallow the ladder', () => {
      expect(() => assess(book(), { boundBps: POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_BOUND_BPS + 1 }))
        .toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
      expect(() => assess(book(), { boundBps: 0 })).toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
    });

    it('walks asks for a cohort buy and bids for a cohort sell', () => {
      const asymmetric = book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 1_000 }],
          asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 10 }]
        }
      });
      const buy = assess(asymmetric, { cohortDirection: 'buy', impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      const sell = assess(asymmetric, { cohortDirection: 'sell', impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      expect(buy.depth?.bestPrice).toBe(0.5);
      expect(sell.depth?.bestPrice).toBe(0.4);
      expect(buy.depth?.notionalWithinBoundUsd).toBeCloseTo(5, 9);
      expect(sell.depth?.notionalWithinBoundUsd).toBeCloseTo(400, 9);
    });

    it('bounds a sell downward from the best bid, not upward', () => {
      // Best bid 0.50, 200 bps down is 0.49. A 0.45 bid is outside.
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }, { price: 0.49, size: 100 }, { price: 0.45, size: 1_000 }],
          asks: [{ price: 0.6, size: 10 }]
        }
      }), { cohortDirection: 'sell', boundBps: 200, impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      expect(verdict.depth?.worstPriceWithinBound).toBe(0.49);
      expect(verdict.depth?.notionalWithinBoundUsd).toBeCloseTo(99, 9);
    });

    it('sorts unsorted ladders rather than trusting the filler order', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.3, size: 10 }, { price: 0.4, size: 10 }],
          asks: [{ price: 0.51, size: 100 }, { price: 0.5, size: 100 }]
        }
      }), { impactCapBps: 5_000 });
      expect(verdict.depth?.bestPrice).toBe(0.5);
      expect(verdict.depth?.worstPriceWithinBound).toBe(0.51);
    });
  });

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // The book's own impact model, and the calibrated reserve.
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  describe('the impact model is the book walk, not constant product', () => {
    it('computes average execution impact from the ladder itself', () => {
      // 100 shares at 0.50 then 100 at 0.55. Taking $105 buys 200 shares at an
      // average of 0.525, i.e. 500 bps above best.
      const impact = polymarketBookAverageImpactBps({
        ladders: {
          bids: [],
          asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }, { price: 0.55, size: 100 }]
        },
        cohortDirection: 'buy',
        notionalUsd: 105
      });
      expect(impact).toBeCloseTo(500, 6);
    });

    it('returns null for a size the ladder cannot absorb rather than a large number', () => {
      expect(polymarketBookAverageImpactBps({
        ladders: { bids: [], asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 10 }] },
        cohortDirection: 'buy',
        notionalUsd: 1_000
      })).toBeNull();
    });

    it('caps capacity at the average-impact ceiling, solving the partial level exactly', () => {
      // Best 0.50, cap 100 bps -> target average 0.505. Taking all 100 shares at
      // 0.50 then x at 0.60: (50 + 0.6x) / (100 + x) = 0.505 -> x = 100*0.005/0.095.
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }],
          asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }, { price: 0.6, size: 10_000 }]
        }
      }), { impactCapBps: 100, boundBps: 2_000 });
      expect(verdict.capacity?.boundedBy).toBe('impact-cap');
      const expectedShares = 100 + (100 * 0.005) / 0.095;
      expect(verdict.capacity?.capacityShares).toBeCloseTo(expectedShares, 6);
      expect(verdict.capacity?.capacityImpactBps).toBeCloseTo(100, 6);
    });

    it('never reports a capacity whose own average impact exceeds the cap', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }],
          asks: [
            { price: 0.5, size: 1 },
            { price: 0.505, size: 10 },
            { price: 0.51, size: 10_000 }
          ]
        }
      }), { impactCapBps: 100, boundBps: 2_000 });
      expect(verdict.capacity!.capacityImpactBps).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100 + 1e-6);
    });

    it('publishes a reserve calibrated so the consumer threshold reproduces the book walk', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }],
          asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }, { price: 0.6, size: 10_000 }]
        }
      }), { impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS, boundBps: 2_000 });
      const capacity = verdict.capacity!;
      const reserve = verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd!;

      // The two identities that make the substitution honest, restated as the
      // consumer computes them: priceImpactBps(N, reserve) = N/reserve*10_000, and
      // capacityNotionalUsd(reserve, cap) = reserve*cap/10_000.
      const impactOfCapacity = (capacity.capacityNotionalUsd / reserve) * 10_000;
      expect(impactOfCapacity).toBeCloseTo(POLYGON_CAP_BPS, 9);
      expect((reserve * POLYGON_CAP_BPS) / 10_000).toBeCloseTo(capacity.capacityNotionalUsd, 9);

      // And a notional past capacity breaches the cap in the consumer's arithmetic.
      const over = capacity.capacityNotionalUsd * 1.01;
      expect((over / reserve) * 10_000).toBeGreaterThan(POLYGON_CAP_BPS);
    });

    it('publishes the reserve rather than the raw depth, and says so', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book({
        ladders: {
          bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }],
          asks: [{ price: 0.5, size: 100 }, { price: 0.6, size: 10_000 }]
        }
      }), { impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS, boundBps: 2_000 });
      expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd)
        .not.toBeCloseTo(verdict.depth!.notionalWithinBoundUsd, 6);
      expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd)
        .toBeCloseTo(verdict.capacity!.equivalentReserveUsd, 9);
      expect(verdict.liquidity.note).toMatch(/equivalent one-sided reserve/);
      expect(verdict.liquidity.note).toMatch(/not a constant-product pool/);
    });
  });

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // The UsableLiquidity contract S4-M6 consumes.
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  describe('the UsableLiquidity-shaped output', () => {
    it('uses the existing order-book-depth basis and needs no new basis value', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book());
      expect(verdict.liquidity.basis).toBe('order-book-depth');
      expect(verdict.liquidity.chain).toBe('polygon');
      expect(verdict.liquidity.tokenMint).toBe(PREFIXED);
      // Resting size is an option the maker holds, and the ladder is up to
      // maxAgeMs old, so this is never an exact figure.
      expect(verdict.liquidity.approximate).toBe(true);
    });

    it('every non-assessed outcome publishes basis unknown and a null figure', () => {
      const cases = [
        assess(undefined),
        assess(book({ observedAt: NOW - 120_000 })),
        assess({ status: 'awaiting-snapshot', tokenId: TOKEN_ID, since: NOW }),
        assess(book({ ladders: { bids: [], asks: [] } })),
        assess(book({ ladders: { bids: [{ price: 0.4, size: 10 }], asks: [] } }))
      ];
      for (const verdict of cases) {
        expect(verdict.liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
        expect(verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
        expect(verdict.liquidity.calibratedForImpactCapBps).toBeNull();
        expect(polymarketBookDepthFullyAssessed(verdict)).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    it('requires an impact cap and refuses a non-positive one', () => {
      expect(() => assess(book(), { impactCapBps: 0 })).toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
      expect(() => assess(book(), { impactCapBps: Number.NaN }))
        .toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
    });

    it('detects a figure judged against a cap it was not calibrated for', () => {
      const verdict = assess(book(), { impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS });
      expect(() => assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration(verdict.liquidity, POLYGON_CAP_BPS))
        .not.toThrow();
      expect(() => assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration(verdict.liquidity, 500))
        .toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
      // An unknown figure carries no calibration to mismatch.
      expect(() => assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration(assess(undefined).liquidity, 500))
        .not.toThrow();
    });

    it('reads a clock only from its argument', () => {
      const entry = book({ observedAt: NOW - 1_000 });
      const cache = createInMemoryPolymarketBookCache([entry]);
      const early = assessPolymarketBookDepth(cache, {
        tokenMint: PREFIXED,
        cohortDirection: 'buy',
        impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS,
        now: NOW
      });
      const late = assessPolymarketBookDepth(cache, {
        tokenMint: PREFIXED,
        cohortDirection: 'buy',
        impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS,
        now: NOW + 120_000
      });
      expect(early.outcome).toBe('assessed');
      expect(late.outcome).toBe('unknown');
      expect(() => assessPolymarketBookDepth(cache, {
        tokenMint: PREFIXED,
        cohortDirection: 'buy',
        impactCapBps: POLYGON_CAP_BPS,
        now: Number.NaN
      })).toThrow(PolymarketBookDepthInputError);
    });
  });

  it('every unknown outcome carries exactly one unassessed code, and assessed carries none', () => {
    expect(assess(undefined).unassessed).toEqual(['book-not-cached']);
    expect(assess(book({ observedAt: NOW - 120_000 })).unassessed).toEqual(['book-snapshot-stale']);
    expect(assess(book()).unassessed).toEqual([]);
  });
});
